ROVM dynamically ranks and aggregates multi-view evidence via a conservative memory to mitigate noisy observations, while PLVF performs coarse-to-fine spatial-linguistic reasoning for precise disambiguation. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance under the depth-free protocol, significantly improving localization for targets defined by complex relations and appearance cues.
summary_zh: 基于图像的3D视觉定位对具身智能体至关重要，但现有基准数据集普遍存在文本与观测对齐松散、忽略时序顺序的问题。本文提出SeqAlign3DVG，一个全新的面向时序有序、严格观测对齐的基于图像的3D视觉定位基准数据集。与以往采用顺序无关视图或全局点云的工作不同，SeqAlign3DVG中所有表述均经过人工验证，严格对应提供的RGB观测（单帧图像或有序观测序列），共包含9622个单视图样本和14493个序列样本，覆盖丰富的描述、复杂的关系和多实例歧义场景。为适配该基准数据集，本文提出统一的基于体素的流水线，包含ROVM（相关性排序体素内存）和PLVF（渐进式语言-体素融合）两个模块：ROVM通过保守内存动态排序并聚合多视图证据，缓解观测噪声问题；PLVF执行从粗到细的空间-语言推理，实现精准歧义消解。本文所提方法在无深度协议下取得了当前最优性能，大幅提升了由复杂关系和外观线索定义的目标的定位精度。

title: FlowVVTON: Flow-Guided Mask-Free Video Virtual Try-On
title_zh: FlowVVTON：光流引导的无掩码视频虚拟试穿方法
authors: Shengyao Chen, Xianbing Sun, Liqing Zhang, Jianfu Zhang
abstract: Video virtual try-on aims to transfer a target garment onto a moving person across video frames. Current methods rely on human parsing masks or pose keypoints that frequently fail under large motions and occlusions, causing boundary artifacts and temporal inconsistency. A further limitation is that most approaches rely solely on attention mechanisms for temporal modeling, providing no explicit motion supervision. We propose FlowVVTON, a mask-free framework that eliminates parsing mask dependency entirely. Optical flow is used solely as a training-time supervision signal: a flow-warped latent loss, applied across all layers of the generation model, enforces multi-scale temporal consistency by aligning adjacent-frame features under explicit physical motion constraints. A two-stage training strategy establishes mask-free spatial alignment before introducing flow-guided temporal supervision. Experiments on TikTokDress show that FlowVVTON outperforms baselines by substantial margins, particularly in temporal consistency (5.7$\times$ VFID-R improvement over SwiftTry), while requiring no segmentation masks, pose keypoints, or region annotations at any stage.
summary_zh: 视频虚拟试穿的目标是将目标衣物迁移到视频帧中的运动人物身上。现有方法依赖人体解析掩码或姿态关键点，在大运动和遮挡场景下频繁失效，导致边界伪影和时序不一致问题。另一项局限是多数方法仅依靠注意力机制完成时序建模，缺乏显式运动监督。本文提出FlowVVTON，一种完全不依赖解析掩码的无掩码框架。该方法仅将光流作为训练阶段的监督信号：跨生成模型所有层应用的光流扭曲潜变量损失，在显式物理运动约束下对齐相邻帧特征，实现多尺度时序一致性。两阶段训练策略先完成无掩码空间对齐，再引入光流引导的时序监督。在TikTokDress数据集上的实验表明，FlowVVTON性能大幅优于基线方法，尤其在时序一致性上相比SwiftTry实现了5.7倍的VFID-R提升，且在所有阶段均无需分割掩码、姿态关键点或区域标注。

title: Lies We Can See: Joint Verbal and Non-Verbal Deception by VLM Agents in Embodied Social Interactions
title_zh: 我们可见的谎言：具身社交交互中VLM智能体的联合言语与非言语欺骗行为研究
authors: Jaewoo Ahn, Junseo Kim, Hyunseo Kim, Heeseung Yun, Jaehyeon Son 等 (7 人)
abstract: Strategic deception by LLM and VLM agents has emerged as a central AI alignment and safety concern. Social-deduction games (where each player holds a hidden role and communicates with others to deduce identities) serve as the canonical testbed, particularly in multi-agent settings. Existing testbeds, however, are text-only and run on a single fixed agent configuration, missing the non-verbal sensorimotor channels treated as core by deception taxonomies and leaving it ambiguous whether an observed behavior reflects the underlying model or the surrounding harness. We introduce MineAmongUs, a 3D multimodal Among Us sandbox where imposter agents must deceive crewmates through joint verbal and non-verbal action. We also propose ARIA, a configurable VLM-agent harness that exposes five cognitive-component ablation axes; and an atom- and arc-level annotation scheme grounded in deception taxonomies and operationalized at scale by an LLM-as-a-Judge reaching near-human atom-labeling agreement. Empirical results show that VLM agents pursue imposter wins through joint verbal and non-verbal deception, with non-verbal channels emerging as the more decisive winning contributors across both harness ablation and cross-VLM evaluation. Taken together, our work opens a new path for embodied VLM-agent alignment research.
summary_zh: 大语言模型和视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体的策略性欺骗已成为人工智能对齐与安全领域的核心关注问题。社交推演游戏（每个玩家持有隐藏身份，通过与其他玩家通信推演身份）是该领域的标准测试平台，尤其适用于多智能体场景。但现有测试平台仅支持文本交互，且仅运行在单一固定智能体配置下，缺失欺骗分类体系中定义为核心的非言语感觉运动通道，也无法区分观测到的行为来自底层模型还是外部约束框架。本文提出MineAmongUs，一个3D多模态《Among Us》沙盒环境，其中卧底智能体需要通过联合言语与非言语动作欺骗船员。本文还提出ARIA，一个可配置的VLM智能体框架，支持5个认知组件的消融实验；同时提出基于欺骗分类体系的原子级和边级标注方案，通过大模型作为裁判实现大规模标注，标注一致性接近人类水平。实验结果表明，VLM智能体可通过联合言语与非言语欺骗实现卧底胜利，在框架消融实验和跨VLM评估中，非言语通道均是决定胜负的更关键因素。本工作为具身VLM智能体对齐研究开辟了新方向。

title: ObjectSplat: Improving Mesh Fidelity and Interactivity for 3D Scenes via Object-Level Mesh Splatting
title_zh: ObjectSplat：基于目标级网格溅射提升3D场景的网格保真度与交互性
authors: Minhas Kamal, Hiranya Garbha Kumar, Mahedi Kamal, Balakrishnan Prabhakaran
abstract: Splatting-based algorithms reconstruct photorealistic, real-time-renderable, and mesh-exportable 3D scenes from regular images, but they represent a scene as a single monolithic field. Therefore, the reconstruction has no object-level structure, leaving it infeasible for downstream editing or interaction. Moreover, regions that are never directly observed in the input scans are contaminated by the surrounding texture and left uncorrected, capping both mesh fidelity and novel-view synthesis. We propose a decompose-before-reconstruct approach: we segment the instances out of every frame, consider the remaining as background and inpaint it, reconstruct each instance and the background independently with mesh splatting, and compose them into a single scene. Our method significantly improves mesh fidelity (over a 5\% gain in F-score) and novel-view synthesis, while supporting object-wise modifiability and interactivity. The code will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 基于溅射的算法可从普通图像中重建出支持实时渲染、可导出网格的照片级真实感3D场景，但这类算法将场景表示为单一整体场，导致重建结果不存在目标级结构，无法支持下游编辑或交互操作。此外，输入扫描中从未直接观测到的区域会被周边纹理污染且无法修正，限制了网格保真度和新视角合成效果。本文提出先分解后重建的思路：首先对每一帧图像分割出独立实例，将剩余部分视为背景并完成补全，随后通过网格溅射分别重建每个实例和背景，最终将所有部分组合为完整场景。所提方法大幅提升了网格保真度（F值提升超过5%）和新视角合成效果，同时支持目标级修改与交互操作。相关代码将对外公开。

title: Whole-Slide Image Analysis under Realistic Few-Shot Annotation Protocols
title_zh: 面向真实少样本标注协议下的全切片图像分析
authors: Tiffanie Godelaine, Maxime Zanella, Karim El Khoury, Benoit Macq, Christophe De Vleeschouwer
abstract: Automating the analysis of whole-slide images has high clinical value, since characterizing cancers requires examining them in detail. Such analysis increasingly relies on vision-language models that provide patch-level zero-shot predictions. However, these predictions remain noisy and must be refined with a few annotations. A promising paradigm for this refinement is few-shot transduction. Rather than treating each patch independently, these methods leverage the relations between patches, together with a few annotations, to refine all predictions jointly. However, current transductive methods are evaluated under conditions that overlook key properties of whole-slide images: (i) datasets consist of independent patches extracted from multiple slides, ignoring the complex tissue organization; (ii) datasets are mostly balanced, whereas a single whole-slide image exhibits severe class imbalance, with several classes absent; and (iii) annotations are sampled at random, without reflecting how a pathologist annotates a limited number of regions. To align the transduction paradigm to realistic whole-slide settings, we introduce the following contributions. First, we propose SlideCRF, which adapts conditional random fields for whole-slide images by combining spatial and biological cues while accounting for classes that may be absent from a given slide. Second, we provide a set of realistic annotation protocols, based on spatially localized clicks and scribbles, modeling different pathologist interactions, such as the iterative correction of model errors. Across four datasets, we show that SlideCRF outperforms current transductive methods in macro F1, improving over the zero-shot predictions by +24.2% and +37.5% with one and 16 clicks per present class, respectively.
summary_zh: 自动化全切片图像分析具备极高临床价值，因为癌症表征需要对图像进行细致检查。这类分析目前越来越依赖视觉语言模型生成的补丁级零样本预测，但这类预测结果噪声较高，需要通过少量标注进行优化。少样本直推学习是极具潜力的优化范式：这类方法不对每个补丁进行独立处理，而是利用补丁间的关联关系结合少量标注，联合优化所有预测结果。但现有直推方法的评估场景忽略了全切片图像的核心特性：（1）数据集由从多张切片中提取的独立补丁组成，忽略了复杂的组织架构；（2）数据集大多类别平衡，但单张全切片图像存在严重的类别不平衡，部分类别完全缺失；（3）标注为随机采样，无法反映病理学家标注有限区域的实际操作流程。为将直推学习范式适配到真实全切片图像场景，本文做出如下贡献：第一，提出SlideCRF，将条件随机场适配到全切片图像场景，融合空间和生物线索，同时考虑单张切片中部分类别可能缺失的情况；第二，提出一套基于空间局部点击和涂鸦的真实标注协议，模拟不同病理学家的交互行为，包括模型错误的迭代修正。在4个数据集上的实验结果表明，SlideCRF的宏F1指标优于现有直推方法，在每类存在的类别仅标注1次点击和16次点击的场景下，相比零样本预测分别提升24.2%和37.5%。

title: SePArate: Segmenting Patterns from Defects in Wafer Manufacturing Using Weak Supervision
title_zh: SePArate：基于弱监督的晶圆制造缺陷与模式分割方法
authors: Dain Kwon, Changmin Shin, Sunjong Park, Kanghyun Choi, Hyeyoon Lee 等 (8 人)
abstract: In semiconductor manufacturing, defect analysis is essential, but manual inspection cannot scale. However, existing automated inspection methods remain insufficient for root-cause analysis and process optimization. To this end, we present SePArate, a weakly supervised wafer defect segmentation method. SePArate enables pixel-level separation of patterns by leveraging only image-level annotations. It consists of a three-phase training: encoder pretraining, knowledge transfer to learn spatial cues, and training on synthetic mixed-defect data for accurate segmentation. Experiments demonstrate that SePArate outperforms the baselines.
summary_zh: 半导体制造过程中，缺陷分析至关重要，但人工检测无法满足规模化需求。现有自动化检测方法仍无法满足根因分析和工艺优化的要求。针对该问题，本文提出SePArate，一种弱监督晶圆缺陷分割方法。SePArate仅利用图像级标注即可实现像素级的模式分离，训练过程分为三个阶段：编码器预训练、学习空间线索的知识迁移、基于合成混合缺陷数据的高精度分割训练。实验结果表明，SePArate的性能优于所有对比基线方法。

title: ImageCAS-X: a dataset and benchmark for coronary artery segmentation and centerline extraction in coronary CT angiography
title_zh: ImageCAS-X：用于冠状动脉CT血管造影中冠状动脉分割与中心线提取的数据集与基准测试集
authors: Kit M. Bransby, Esther Øksnebjerg, Kristoffer Kjær, Jacob Kirkeby, Yasmin El Youssef 等 (10 人)
abstract: Accurate segmentation of the coronary vessel lumen is a prerequisite for quantitative assessment of atherosclerotic plaque and perivascular adipose tissue in coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA). Cardiologists rely on semi-automated methods for this task because manual vessel tracing and segmentation are labour-intensive. Although many automated methods have been proposed, their validation remains limited by the lack of large, high-quality publicly available datasets. We provide a new dataset of voxel-wise annotations of the vessel lumen and coronary segments, alongside centerlines, and mesh surfaces for 800 scans from the publicly available ImageCAS dataset. Using this dataset, we benchmark established lumen segmentation methods against inter-observer variability, stratifying performance by disease, image quality, coronary dominance, coronary segment, vessel diameter, and lumen attenuation. These labels allow segmentation accuracy to be described in anatomical and clinical context rather than reported as a single aggregate score. The dataset supports the development and validation of methods for lumen segmentation, plaque and perivascular quantification, and haemodynamic modelling.
summary_zh: 冠状动脉血管腔的精确分割是冠状动脉计算机断层血管造影（CCTA）中动脉粥样硬化斑块与血管周围脂肪组织定量评估的前提。由于人工血管追踪和分割劳动强度极高，心脏病专家在该任务中依赖半自动方法。尽管目前已提出大量自动化方法，但其验证工作始终受缺乏大规模、高质量公开可用数据集的限制。本研究基于公开的ImageCAS数据集，为800次扫描提供了全新的体素级标注数据集，标注内容包含血管腔、冠状动脉节段，以及对应的中心线和网格曲面。基于该数据集，我们以观察者间变异为基准，对已有的血管腔分割方法开展基准测试，按疾病类型、图像质量、冠状动脉优势型、冠状动脉节段、血管直径和管腔衰减程度分层评估性能。这些标注可支持在解剖学和临床场景下描述分割精度，而非仅输出单一的聚合得分。该数据集可助力血管腔分割、斑块与血管周围量化、血流动力学建模相关方法的开发与验证。

title: Real-Time Scene-Adaptive Tone Mapping for High-Dynamic Range Object Detection
title_zh: 面向高动态范围目标检测的实时场景自适应色调映射
authors: Gongzhe Li, Linwei Qiu, Peibei Cao, Fengying Xie, Xiangyang Ji 等 (6 人)
abstract: High-dynamic-range (HDR) images, with their rich tone and detail reproduction, hold significant potential to enhance computer vision systems, particularly in autonomous driving. However, most neural networks for embedded systems are trained on low-dynamic-range (LDR) inputs and suffer substantial performance degradation when handling high-bit-depth HDR images due to the challenges posed by extreme dynamic ranges. In this paper, we propose a novel tone mapping method that not only bridges the gap between HDR RAW inputs and the LDR sRGB requirements of detection networks but also achieves end-to-end optimization with downstream tasks. Instead of relying on the traditional image signal processing (ISP) pipeline, we introduce neural photometric calibration to regularize dynamic ranges and a scaling-invariant local tone mapping model to preserve image details. In addition, our architecture also supports performance transfer finetuning, enabling efficient adaptation from the LDR sRGB images to the HDR RAW images with minimal cost. The proposed method outperforms traditional tone mapping algorithms and advanced AI-ISP methods in challenging automotive HDR scenes. Moreover, our pipeline achieves real-time processing of 4K high-bit-depth HDR inputs on NVIDIA Jetson platforms.
summary_zh: 高动态范围（HDR）图像凭借丰富的色调与细节还原能力，在计算机视觉系统尤其是自动驾驶场景中具备巨大的应用潜力。然而，面向嵌入式系统的多数神经网络均基于低动态范围（LDR）输入训练，在处理高位深HDR图像时，受极端动态范围带来的挑战影响，性能会出现大幅下降。本文提出一种全新的色调映射方法，既填补了HDR RAW输入与检测网络所需的LDR sRGB标准之间的鸿沟，又可与下游任务实现端到端优化。该方法摒弃传统图像信号处理（ISP）流水线，引入神经光度校准对动态范围进行正则化，同时采用缩放不变局部色调映射模型保留图像细节。此外，本文提出的架构还支持性能迁移微调，可在极低开销下实现从LDR sRGB图像到HDR RAW图像的高效适配。在高难度车载HDR场景下，该方法的表现优于传统色调映射算法与先进的AI-ISP方法。同时，我们的流水线可在NVIDIA Jetson平台上实现4K高位深HDR输入的实时处理。

title: PRISM: Predictive Recomposition via Semantic Latent Decomposition for View-invariant Video Representation Learning
title_zh: PRISM：面向视角不变视频表征学习的基于语义隐变量分解的预测重组方法
authors: Youngchae Chee, Hosu Lee, Sungjune Park, Junho Kim, Yong Man Ro
abstract: Cross-view video representation learning aims to capture viewpoint-invariant action semantics despite substantial appearance changes across egocentric and exocentric videos. However, existing methods encode each video as a unified embedding, where view-invariant and view-variant semantics inevitably entangle under co-occurrences - a failure mode we show persists even in cross-view methods explicitly trained for view-invariance. Our key insight is that a view-invariant feature is truly disentangled when it can be sufficiently recomposed with an arbitrary view-variant feature while preserving their independent semantics. Building on this, we propose PRISM, that decomposes video into view-invariant and view-variant latents and recompose them under language supervision encouraging clean decomposition of the two streams. PRISM achieves state-of-the-art results on EgoExo4D, EgoExoLearn, AE2, even surpassing in-domain models under zero-shot setting. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 跨视角视频表征学习旨在克服第一人称与第三人称视频间的显著外观变化，捕捉视角不变的动作语义。但现有方法将每段视频编码为统一嵌入，视角不变语义与视角可变语义在共现场景下不可避免地发生纠缠——我们的研究证实，该失效模式甚至在专门针对视角不变性训练的跨视角方法中也普遍存在。本文的核心思路是：当视角不变特征可与任意视角可变特征充分重组、同时保留二者独立语义时，该特征才真正实现解耦。基于该思路，我们提出PRISM框架，将视频分解为视角不变与视角可变隐变量，并在语言监督下对二者进行重组，引导两个分支实现清晰解耦。PRISM在EgoExo4D、EgoExoLearn、AE2数据集上取得了当前最优性能，甚至在零样本设置下性能超越域内训练模型。代码可通过对应公开https链接获取。

title: MCSeg: Pre-training and Fine-tuning Volumetric Pyramid Transformer for Multi-modal Cardiac Image Segmentation
title_zh: MCSeg：面向多模态心脏图像分割的体素金字塔Transformer预训练与微调框架
authors: Zhiyu Ye, Hairong Zheng, Tong Zhang
abstract: Automatic cardiac image segmentation is pivotal for diagnosing and treating cardiac diseases. In this work, we introduce MCSeg, a volumetric transformer-based network tailored for multi-modal cardiac segmentation. To overcome the architectural mismatch inherent in existing hybrid networks, we propose a novel Scaling Feature Pyramid (SFP). Unlike conventional skip connections, the SFP effectively bridges the single-scale 3D Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder and the multi-scale CNN decoder by transforming the ViT's output into a hierarchical feature pyramid, ensuring that global contextual information is effectively leveraged. For the training paradigm, the ViT encoder first undergoes self-supervised pre-training via masked image modeling. Subsequently, the network is fine-tuned on downstream tasks, during which a regional mutual information (RMI) loss is integrated to improve boundary segmentation accuracy. In experiments, MCSeg consistently outperforms eleven SOTA methods on CT dataset ImageCHD, multi-modal dataset MM-WHS, MRI dataset HVSMR-2.0 and MSD Heart, highlighting the effectiveness of our MCSeg for multi-modal cardiac segmentation tasks. Furthermore, MCSeg's superior performance in few-shot experiment showcases its significant potential in adapting to limited data scenarios. Codes and pre-trained ViT-B weights are open-sourced atthis https URL
summary_zh: 心脏图像自动分割是心脏疾病诊断与治疗的核心支撑。本研究提出MCSeg，一种专为多模态心脏分割设计的基于体素Transformer的网络。为解决现有混合网络固有的架构不匹配问题，我们提出全新的缩放特征金字塔（SFP）模块。与传统跳跃连接不同，SFP将3D视觉Transformer（ViT）编码器的输出转换为层级特征金字塔，有效衔接单尺度3D ViT编码器与多尺度CNN解码器，确保全局上下文信息得到充分利用。在训练范式层面，ViT编码器首先通过掩码图像建模完成自监督预训练，随后整个网络在下游任务中进行微调，微调阶段引入区域互信息（RMI）损失提升边界分割精度。实验结果显示，MCSeg在CT数据集ImageCHD、多模态数据集MM-WHS、MRI数据集HVSMR-2.0与MSD Heart上的表现始终优于11种当前最优方法，证明了MCSeg在多模态心脏分割任务中的有效性。此外，MCSeg在少样本实验中的优异性能也展现出其在有限数据场景下的强大适配潜力。相关代码与预训练ViT-B权重已开源至对应https链接。

title: Seeing the Unseen: Camouflaged Object Detection Beyond the Visible Spectrum
title_zh: Proximity3D：感知流形上基于电容接近度的三维形状重建方法
authors: Avi Gupta, Trasha Gupta
abstract: Recent advances in camouflaged object detection (COD) have led to substantial progress in challenging low-visibility scenarios, with pioneering studies demonstrating notable success in localizing objects in camouflaged scenes. Despite these achievements, existing approaches predominantly rely on conventional three-channel RGB imagery, thereby constraining the available visual information to a limited spectral range. Multispectral images offer a wide range of information about a scene by capturing fine-grained spectral signatures. Hence, by leveraging multispectral images for COD, we introduce a novel approach to detect camouflaged objects from the corresponding multispectral inputs. In particular, we propose an end-to-end framework, \textbf{\textit{MSFormer}}, that takes a multispectral camouflaged image as input and predicts a binary mask for it. Additionally, we also provide empirical justification for integrating multispectral bands for this complex low-vision task. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, which outperforms existing methods.
summary_zh: 现有多数形状重建方法假设测量值定义在平面感知域上，例如RGB图像或深度图。本文采用曲面电容织物作为形状传感器，将其表面视为非平面感知流形。每次扫描可表示为该流形上的电容接近场，由曲面电极布局与邻近物体几何结构的交互作用生成。我们提出一种多视图前馈重建模型，可聚合已知传感器视图下的所有接近场，恢复观测物体的形状。仿真与物理实验均证明，该方法可基于曲面感知表面采集的电容接近信号实现鲁棒重建，为机器人通过具身感知实现近场几何感知提供了全新路径。

title: Proximity3D: Shape from Capacitive Proximity on Sensing Manifold
authors: Hao Chen, Chenming Wu, Chun Ping Lam, Xiangjia Chen, Guoxin Fang 等 (9 人)
abstract: Most shape reconstruction methods assume measurements defined over planar sensing domains, such as RGB images or depth maps. In this paper, we use a curved capacitive textile as a shape sensor, treating its surface as a non-planar sensing manifold. Each scan is represented as a capacitive proximity field on this manifold, induced by the interaction between the curved electrode layout and nearby object geometry. We introduce a multi-view feedforward reconstruction model that aggregates these fields across known sensor views and recovers the observed object shape. Simulated and physical experiments demonstrate robust reconstruction from capacitive proximity signals acquired on curved sensing surfaces, pointing toward a new route to robotic near-field geometric awareness via embodied sensing.

title: CapFrame: Text-Instructed Viewpoint Grounding in 3D Gaussian Scenes via Geometric Pseudo Labels
title_zh: CapFrame：3D高斯场景中基于几何伪标签的文本指令视角定位方法
authors: Jirong Li, Satoshi Ikehata, Shuhei Kurita, Ikuro Sato
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic real-time novel view synthesis, yet placing a virtual camera to capture a desired frame remains largely manual. Existing language-guided approaches in 3D scenes mainly focus on object-centric grounding, determining what to observe but rarely controlling how it should appear in a single frame, such as subject orientation or frame layout. To address this limitation, we introduce a new task, Text-Instructed Viewpoint Grounding (TIVG), which aims to identify a 6-DoF camera pose in a 3D Gaussian scene whose rendered frame aligns with a text instruction. To solve this task, we propose CapFrame, a partially differentiable framework that converts language into geometric pseudo labels for camera pose optimization. CapFrame follows a Retrieve-Translate-Refine pipeline: it retrieves relevant views and ranks them through a Question-Evaluation process with MLLMs, translates the instruction into orientation and layout pseudo labels, and refines the camera pose via differentiable optimization with layout and orientation losses in 3DGS. Experiments on 38 real-world scenes with 135 instructions indicate that CapFrame produces viewpoints better aligned with texts than heuristic viewpoint search and adapted trajectory generation baselines, validated by VLM metrics, MLLM judges, and user studies. Code is available at:this https URL
summary_zh: 3D高斯溅射（3DGS）可实现照片级真实感的实时新视角合成，但目前放置虚拟相机以捕获目标帧的操作仍以人工为主。现有3D场景下的语言引导方法主要聚焦于以物体为中心的定位，仅确定观测目标，却极少控制目标在单帧中的呈现形式，例如主体朝向或帧布局。为解决该局限，本文提出全新任务：文本指令视角定位（TIVG），旨在3D高斯场景中识别出一组6自由度相机位姿，使得其渲染出的帧与文本指令完全对齐。为解决该任务，我们提出CapFrame，一种部分可微框架，可将语言转换为几何伪标签用于相机位姿优化。CapFrame遵循“检索-转换-优化”流水线：首先通过多模态大语言模型（MLLM）执行问题评估流程，检索相关视图并排序，随后将指令转换为朝向与布局伪标签，最终在3DGS中通过结合布局损失与朝向损失的可微优化完成相机位姿优化。在包含135条指令的38个真实场景上开展的实验表明，CapFrame生成的视角相比启发式视角搜索和适配后的轨迹生成基线方法，与文本的对齐度更高，该结论已通过视觉语言模型（VLM）指标、MLLM评估与用户调研得到验证。代码可通过对应https链接获取。

title: Knowing Beyond the Known: Reinforced Knowledge Specification for Multi-Label Class-Incremental Learning
title_zh: 知其所知之外：面向多标签类增量学习的强化知识规范框架
authors: Aoting Zhang, Dongbao Yang, Chang Liu, Xiaopeng Hong, Can Ma 等 (6 人)
abstract: Existing class-incremental learning methods struggle in multi-label scenarios (MLCIL) due to the inherent contradiction of learning objectives arising from co-occurring and incomplete labels. We argue that the core obstacle is the model's ambiguous boundary between known and unknown knowledge, which undermines historical knowledge retention, complicates current task learning, and limits adaptability to future concepts. To address this, we propose KBK (Knowing Beyond the Known), a reinforced knowledge specification framework that explicitly models what is known or not to unify historical, current, and prospective learning. Specifically, to clarify known knowledge, we develop a hierarchical feature purification module that disentangles fine-grained class-specific features from global features, where high-level semantic abstraction is reinforced with low-level visual features. Additionally, an uncertainty-aware recall enhancement strategy suppresses unreliable predictions based on distribution priors, improving the quality of historical recall. For probing the unknown, KBK leverages semantic correlations to synthesize informative unknown features under co-occurring, preserving embedding space for future learning. Furthermore, to mitigate heterogeneous forgetting, we design a category-balanced gradient compensation loss that dynamically reweights gradient backpropagation according to forgetting speeds. Experiments on multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness and robustness of KBK, which surpasses prior best methods by 2.7% in Avg. Acc on MS-COCO B0-C10 setting even without any replay buffers.
summary_zh: 现有类增量学习方法在多标签场景（MLCIL）中表现不佳，核心原因是共现标签与不完整标签带来的学习目标固有矛盾。我们认为其核心障碍是模型中已知知识与未知知识的边界模糊，既损害历史知识留存效果，又提升当前任务学习难度，还限制了模型对未来概念的适配能力。为解决该问题，我们提出KBK（Knowing Beyond the Known），一种强化知识规范框架，通过显式建模已知与未知内容，统一历史学习、当前学习与未来学习流程。具体而言，为明确已知知识，我们开发了层级特征提纯模块，从全局特征中解耦出细粒度的类别专属特征，实现高层语义抽象与低层视觉特征的相互强化。此外，我们提出不确定性感知的召回增强策略，基于分布先验抑制不可靠预测，提升历史召回的质量。针对未知内容探测，KBK利用语义相关性在共现场景下合成信息丰富的未知特征，为未来学习预留嵌入空间。同时，为缓解异构遗忘问题，我们设计了类别均衡梯度补偿损失，根据遗忘速度动态调整梯度反向传播的权重。在多个基准数据集上开展的实验验证了KBK的有效性与鲁棒性：即使不使用任何回放缓冲区，KBK在MS-COCO B0-C10设置下的平均准确率也比现有最优方法高出2.7%。

title: ScenePilot: Grow-and-Repair Policy for Text-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Generation
title_zh: ScenePilot：面向文本驱动3D室内场景生成的“生长-修复”策略
authors: Jiawei Zhang, Hongsong Wang, Pan Zhou
abstract: Text-driven 3D indoor scene generation has advanced from dataset-bound layout modeling to open-vocabulary synthesis with large language and vision-language models. Yet existing methods remain limited: one-pass generators often yield geometrically invalid layouts, heavy post-hoc optimization is costly and unstable, and prompt-only planners lack reusable layout priors for functional grouping and object relations. We propose \textbf{ScenePilot}, a retrieval-augmented \textbf{Grow-and-Repair} framework that formulates scene generation as prior-guided incremental growth with learned rectification. Given a prompt, the Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Planning (HRAP) module retrieves room-, group-, and anchor-level layout priors to support functional group planning. A text-driven base generator then inserts object groups sequentially, while the Reinforcement Multimodal Repair (RMR) module performs lightweight local correction after each insertion and a final global repair after completion. To train this policy, we construct \textbf{SceneReverse-17k}, a repair-trajectory dataset built by perturbing high-quality 3D scenes in position, rotation, and scale, then using inverse operations as executable rectification targets. The policy predicts structured \emph{move--rotate--scale} actions from rendered views, scene state, retrieved priors, and edit history. By combining HRAP with RMR, ScenePilot offers an efficient alternative to one-shot generation and heavy full-scene optimization, improving physical plausibility, functional coherence, and controllability while preserving diversity.
summary_zh: 文本驱动3D室内场景生成技术已从受数据集约束的布局建模，发展到结合大语言模型与视觉语言模型的开放词汇合成阶段。但现有方法仍存在明显局限：单次生成器通常会输出几何无效的布局，繁重的事后优化成本高且稳定性差，仅基于提示的规划器缺乏可复用的布局先验，无法支撑功能分组与物体关系建模。我们提出ScenePilot，一种检索增强的“生长-修复”框架，将场景生成建模为先验引导的增量生长过程，同时引入学习得到的校正机制。给定提示文本后，层级检索增强规划（HRAP）模块会检索房间级、组级与锚点级的布局先验，支撑功能组规划。随后文本驱动的基础生成器按顺序插入物体组，同时多模态强化修复（RMR）模块在每次插入后执行轻量级局部校正，全部插入完成后再执行最终全局修复。为训练该策略，我们构建了SceneReverse-17k修复轨迹数据集：通过对高质量3D场景的位置、旋转、缩放进行扰动，再将逆操作作为可执行的校正目标。该策略基于渲染视图、场景状态、检索到的先验与编辑历史，预测结构化的“移动-旋转-缩放”动作。通过结合HRAP与RMR，ScenePilot为单次生成与繁重的全场景优化提供了高效替代方案，在保留生成多样性的同时，提升了生成结果的物理合理性、功能连贯性与可控性。

title: Learning to Restore More: Continual Capability Expansion for Pretrained Image Restoration Models
title_zh: 学习实现更多恢复能力：预训练图像恢复模型的持续能力扩展方法
authors: Hu Gao, Yulong Chen, Lizhuang Ma
abstract: Image restoration models are typically trained with a fixed set of capabilities. When new restoration requirements emerge, existing solutions usually train additional models or jointly retrain the original model with both new and historical data. Instead of designing another restoration backbone, we investigate how a trained restorer can continually acquire new capabilities without forgetting those learned previously. We propose RestoreMore, a continual capability-expansion framework that preserves the pretrained restoration model as a frozen capability anchor and learns residual expansion modules for newly arriving degradations. RestoreMore introduces a capability-oriented bi-level routing mechanism at multiple feature stages. The first routing level identifies restoration capabilities relevant to the current input, while the second selects and combines a sparse set of complementary degradation experts. This design enables newly introduced tasks to selectively reuse historical restoration knowledge and progressively enriches the expert bank available for subsequent restoration tasks. Extensive experiments on a wide range of restoration benchmarks demonstrate that RestoreMore consistently acquires new restoration abilities while preserving and improving previously learned capabilities.
summary_zh: 图像恢复模型通常仅针对固定的能力集训练。当出现新的恢复需求时，现有解决方案通常需要训练额外模型，或结合新数据与历史数据对原始模型进行联合重训练。本文并未设计全新的图像恢复骨干网络，而是研究如何让已训练完成的恢复器在不遗忘已学能力的前提下，持续获取新的恢复能力。我们提出RestoreMore，一种持续能力扩展框架，将预训练恢复模型作为冻结的能力锚点，针对新出现的退化类型学习残差扩展模块。RestoreMore在多个特征阶段引入面向能力的双层路由机制：第一层路由识别与当前输入相关的恢复能力，第二层路由选择并组合一组稀疏的互补退化专家。该设计使得新引入的任务可选择性复用历史恢复知识，逐步丰富可用于后续恢复任务的专家库。在大量恢复基准数据集上开展的广泛实验表明，RestoreMore可在保留并提升已学能力的同时，持续获取新的图像恢复能力。

title: Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
title_zh: 面向流视频理解的动态轴辐式记忆
authors: Xinru Jiang, Lin Zhao, Xi Xiao, Yunbei Zhang, Janet Wang 等 (10 人)
abstract: Streaming video understanding requires answering questions at arbitrary times over a continuously growing visual stream. The central challenge is to compactly remember long-range history while effectively retrieving question-relevant evidence. We propose Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory (D-HSM), a training-free framework that represents distant history as structured textual memory while preserving the recent frames as visual tokens for fine-grained perception. Specifically, D-HSM turns selected historical video chunks into typed textual observations and stores them in an entity-centered hub-and-spoke memory, with entities as hubs and related evidence as spokes. When answering a question, D-HSM dynamically retrieves a compact question-aware memory subset, expands it through hub-and-spoke links, and combines it with the recent visual window for frozen-VLM answer prediction. Extensive experiments on both streaming and long video benchmarks show that D-HSM consistently and substantially improves VLM backbones and outperforms other state-of-the-art online and offline video understanding baselines.
summary_zh: 流视频理解需要在持续增长的视觉流中任意时刻回答相关问题，其核心挑战在于如何紧凑地存储长程历史信息，同时高效检索与问题相关的证据。本文提出动态轴辐式记忆（Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory, D-HSM），这是一种无需训练的框架，将远距离历史表示为结构化文本记忆，同时保留近期帧为视觉令牌以支持细粒度感知。具体而言，D-HSM将选定的历史视频块转换为类型化文本观测结果，存储在以实体为中心的轴辐式记忆中，其中实体作为轴，相关证据作为辐。回答问题时，D-HSM会动态检索出精简的面向问题的记忆子集，通过轴辐链接对其进行扩展，并与近期视觉窗口结合，输入冻结视觉语言模型（frozen-VLM）完成预测得到答案。在流视频和长视频基准上开展的大量实验表明，D-HSM能够持续大幅提升视觉语言模型骨干的性能，优于其他当前最先进的在线和离线视频理解基线方法。

title: SELECT: SELEctive Context Transfer for Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation
title_zh: SELECT：面向类增量语义分割的选择性上下文迁移方法
authors: Avi Gupta, Saurabh Yadav, Koteswar Rao Jerripothula, Tammam Tillo
abstract: Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation (CISS) is fundamentally challenged by catastrophic forgetting and background shift, where learning new concepts degrades performance on previously seen classes. While existing methods attempt to balance stability (retaining old knowledge) and plasticity (learning new knowledge), they often fail to leverage prior knowledge effectively. These approaches typically rely on indiscriminate knowledge transfer or ambiguous initializations, which can dilute crucial semantic information. To overcome this limitation, we propose SELECT, a novel approach for Selective Context Transfer, which instead grounds each new class in a small set of semantically similar past classes. Its core is a Context Transfer Attention mechanism that aggregates the learned tokens from similar classes into a structured initialization for the new class. To ensure this transfer does not corrupt the borrowed representations, we add a controlled noise perturbation and a margin-based context-transfer loss that enforces separation between the new class token and its source tokens. Extensive experiments on Pascal VOC and ADE20K show that SELECT consistently outperforms prior work, achieving mIoU of 2.2% on VOC and 2.8% on ADE, providing an effective handle on the stability-plasticity dilemma. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 类增量语义分割（Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation, CISS）面临灾难性遗忘和背景偏移的核心挑战，即学习新概念的过程会降低模型在已见过类别上的性能。现有方法试图平衡稳定性（保留旧知识）和可塑性（学习新知识），但往往无法有效利用先验知识。这类方法通常依赖无差别知识迁移或模糊初始化，会稀释关键语义信息。为克服该局限，本文提出SELECT这一全新的选择性上下文迁移方法，将每个新类别锚定到少量语义相似的历史类别上。其核心是上下文迁移注意力机制，可将相似类别的已学习令牌聚合为新类别的结构化初始化。为确保该迁移过程不会破坏借用的表征，本文添加了受控噪声扰动和基于间隔的上下文迁移损失，强制新类别令牌与其源令牌之间保持区分度。在Pascal VOC和ADE20K数据集上的大量实验表明，SELECT的性能持续优于现有研究，在VOC上的平均交并比（mIoU）达到2.2%、在ADE20K上达到2.8%，为解决稳定性-可塑性困境提供了有效方案。代码可通过给出的链接获取。

title: Motion-Saliency Complementary Masked Modeling for Point Cloud Video Understanding
title_zh: 面向点云视频理解的运动显著性互补掩码建模
authors: Wei Wang, Yiding Sun, Yuyan Wang, Zhuoyue Zhang, Zhengqiao Li 等 (7 人)
abstract: Point cloud video representation learning is crucial for 3D dynamic scene understanding. In this paper, we propose MoSaiC, a novel Motion-Saliency Complementary masked modeling framework for self-supervised point cloud video representation learning. MoSaiC couples three components: Curriculum Motion-Saliency Masking (CMSM), which guides the masking process toward motion-salient tokens under a curriculum schedule; Normal-Flow Motion (NFM) modeling, which supervises the local rigid rotation of each token in the Lie algebra so(3) as an explicit geometric motion target; and Cross-view Token Consistency Prediction (CTCP), which enforces consistency between two complementary masked views at the token level. Together, these components allow MoSaiC to effectively capture both appearance and motion dynamics. Extensive experiments on multiple downstream tasks, including action recognition, temporal action segmentation, and point-level semantic segmentation, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
summary_zh: 点云视频表征学习是3D动态场景理解的核心技术。本文提出MoSaiC，一种全新的运动显著性互补掩码建模框架，用于自监督点云视频表征学习。MoSaiC由三个组件构成：课程式运动显著性掩码（Curriculum Motion-Saliency Masking, CMSM），可在课程调度下引导掩码过程偏向运动显著令牌；法向流运动（Normal-Flow Motion, NFM）建模，将李代数so(3)中每个令牌的局部刚性旋转作为显式几何运动目标进行监督；跨视图令牌一致性预测（Cross-view Token Consistency Prediction, CTCP），在令牌层面强制两个互补掩码视图之间保持一致性。三个组件协同作用，让MoSaiC能够同时有效捕捉外观特征和运动动态。在动作识别、时序动作分割、点级语义分割等多个下游任务上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Centering before Pruning: Lightweight Geometry Correction for Diversity-Based Visual Token Pruning in LVLMs
title_zh: 先中心化后剪枝：面向大视觉语言模型的基于多样性的视觉令牌剪枝轻量化几何校正方法
authors: Shunjie Wen, Jaeyeon Lee, Dong-Wan Choi
abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) incur substantial inference costs due to their long and highly redundant visual-token sequences. Diversity-based pruning mitigates this cost by selecting token subsets based on pairwise cosine similarity. We find, however, that similarities between raw visual tokens are strongly concentrated in the positive range, limiting their ability to distinguish non-redundant tokens. A natural way to improve this resolution is to center token features before computing cosine similarity. Centering indeed reveals a substantially richer pairwise structure, yet unexpectedly degrades pruning performance when used alone. We show that this apparent contradiction arises because the raw geometry does more than represent pairwise diversity: it also implicitly favors globally distinctive tokens, which tend to contain semantically informative content. Centering better resolves subset diversity but loses this useful token-wise preference, revealing that diversity and distinctiveness are entangled in the raw geometry. Based on this analysis, we propose the \textbf{Cen}tered Geometry \textbf{Prune}r (Cen-Prune), which measures subset diversity using centered cosine similarity while retaining raw-space distinctiveness as a complementary token-wise preference. This lightweight, plug-and-play correction leaves the underlying selection mechanism unchanged and incurs negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments across multiple image- and video-understanding benchmarks and LVLM architectures demonstrate that Cen-Prune provides robust improvements in overall performance across existing diversity-based pruners.
summary_zh: 大视觉语言模型（Large vision-language models, LVLMs）的视觉令牌序列冗长且高度冗余，导致推理成本极高。基于多样性的剪枝方法通过基于成对余弦相似度选择令牌子集来降低成本，但研究发现原始视觉令牌之间的相似度高度集中在正区间，限制了其区分非冗余令牌的能力。提升该区分度的自然思路是在计算余弦相似度之前对令牌特征做中心化处理，中心化操作确实能揭示更丰富的成对结构，但单独使用时反而会降低剪枝性能。本文证明这一明显矛盾的成因是：原始几何结构不仅表征成对多样性，还隐式偏好全局独特令牌，这类令牌通常包含语义信息丰富的内容。中心化操作能更好地解析子集多样性，但丢失了这种有用的令牌级偏好，说明多样性和独特性在原始几何结构中是相互纠缠的。基于该分析，本文提出中心化几何剪枝器（Centered Geometry Pruner, Cen-Prune），使用中心化余弦相似度度量子集多样性，同时保留原始空间的独特性作为互补的令牌级偏好。该轻量化即插即用校正方法不会改变底层选择机制，带来的计算开销可忽略不计。在多个图像、视频理解基准和大视觉语言模型架构上开展的大量实验表明，Cen-Prune能够在现有各类基于多样性的剪枝方法上实现整体性能的稳健提升。

title: OPUS: A Simple yet Effective Unified Framework for Open-Vocabulary Detection
title_zh: OPUS：面向开放词汇检测的简单高效统一框架
authors: Xiaoyan Wei, Zhimin Yao, Ruilin Yang, Wei Zhang, Yong Dai 等 (7 人)
abstract: Recent unified open-vocabulary detection (OVD) supports heterogeneous prompts, including text queries, visual exemplars, and their combinations, but often rely on increasingly complex designs such as heavy cross-modal fusion, staged training, and iterative annotation pipelines. We revisit whether such complexity is necessary in the era of stronger foundation models. Our finding is that unified OVD can be made substantially simpler with semantic-rich visual representations and scalable grounding supervision. We present OPUS (\textbf{O}pen-vocabulary, \textbf{P}rompt-\textbf{U}nified, \textbf{S}imple), a unified detector supporting text, interactive visual, generic visual, and mixed prompting within one framework. OPUS adopts a simple three-part design. Its model architecture combines a semantic-rich visual encoder, built on a DINOv3-ConvNeXt-B backbone with efficient hybrid encoding, with a prompt-aware decoder that avoids prompt-specific branches for unified prompt reasoning. OPUS is trained with a one-stage text-visual training strategy with Instance-level Contrastive Alignment (ICA), and is supported by a SAM3-based single-pass data engine for heterogeneous grounding supervision. Experiments on COCO, LVIS-minival, and ODinW35 show that OPUS achieves state-of-the-art Visual-I performance, reaching 68.1/69.2/54.7 AP, while maintaining balanced Text and Visual-G accuracy. OPUS also turns mixed prompting from interference into complementarity, improving over text or visual prompt alone. These results show that simplicity and strong unified prompting capability can be achieved together.
summary_zh: 近期的统一开放词汇检测（Open-vocabulary Detection, OVD）方法支持文本查询、视觉示例及其组合等异构提示，但往往依赖越来越复杂的设计，例如繁重的跨模态融合、分阶段训练、迭代标注流水线。本文重新审视在基础模型能力更强的当下，这类复杂度是否必要。研究发现，借助语义丰富的视觉表征和可扩展的 grounding 监督，统一开放词汇检测可以大幅简化。本文提出OPUS（Open-vocabulary, Prompt-Unified, Simple），这一统一检测器可在单框架内支持文本、交互式视觉、通用视觉和混合提示。OPUS采用简洁的三部分设计：模型架构结合了基于DINOv3-ConvNeXt-B骨干网络构建的语义丰富视觉编码器（搭载高效混合编码），以及避免提示专属分支、实现统一提示推理的感知提示解码器。OPUS采用带实例级对比对齐（Instance-level Contrastive Alignment, ICA）的单阶段文本-视觉训练策略训练，配套基于SAM3的单遍数据引擎提供异构grounding监督。在COCO、LVIS-minival和ODinW35上的实验表明，OPUS取得了当前最先进的视觉提示性能，AP值分别达到68.1/69.2/54.7，同时保持了文本提示和通用视觉提示精度的均衡。OPUS还将混合提示从相互干扰转化为互补增益，性能优于单独使用文本或视觉提示的效果。上述结果证明，模型简洁性和强大的统一提示能力可以同时实现。

title: PaperBanana-Interact: Scientific Diagram Refinement with Multi-Turn Human Feedback
title_zh: PaperBanana-Interact：基于多轮人类反馈的科学图表优化方法
authors: Xueqing Wu, Ashwin Balasubramanian, Bingxuan Li, Dawei Zhu, Kai-Wei Chang 等 (10 人)
abstract: Recent efforts have aimed to automate scientific diagram generation from paper content (Lin et al., 2026; Zhu et al., 2026a). However, fully satisfying an author's visual and communicative preferences in a single turn is challenging: in our formative user study (N = 14), all participants requested further revisions after viewing an initial draft, and 86% of them rated the refined diagrams as more satisfactory. Despite the clear demand, the multi-turn workflow remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present MTPaperBananaBench, a benchmark for multi-turn diagram generation containing 292 images annotated with 3,518 user requirements. To reduce expensive human studies and enable scalable benchmarking, we construct a user simulator that, at each turn, identifies unsatisfied requirements and converts k of them into natural language feedback. Evaluating both requirement satisfaction and overall diagram quality reveals two key failure modes shared across baseline multiturn systems: (1) quality drift, where diagram quality progressively declines over turns, and (2) forgetting, where previously implemented features are lost in subsequent turns. To address these issues, we introduce PaperBanana-Interact, a multi-agent system that refines diagrams via an internal critique-and-refine loop. PaperBanana-Interact consistently improves rather than degrades diagram quality across turns, outperforming baselines by 11.9-18.6 points in quality score and reducing forgetting by 3.7-6.2 points.
summary_zh: 近期研究致力于从论文内容自动生成科学图表（Lin et al., 2026; Zhu et al., 2026a），但仅通过单轮生成完全满足作者的视觉和表达偏好仍极具挑战：在包含14名参与者的前期用户研究中，所有参与者在查看初始草稿后都提出了进一步修改需求，其中86%的参与者认为优化后的图表满意度更高。尽管需求明确，多轮生成工作流目前仍缺乏充分探索。为填补这一空白，本文提出MTPaperBananaBench，一个多轮图表生成基准集，包含292张图像，标注了3518条用户需求。为降低昂贵的人工研究成本、实现可扩展的基准测试，本文构建了用户模拟器，可在每轮识别未满足的需求，并将其中k条转换为自然语言反馈。通过评估需求满足度和图表整体质量，本文发现现有多轮基线系统存在两类共性失效模式：（1）质量漂移，即图表质量随轮次推进逐步下降；（2）遗忘，即后续轮次丢失之前已实现的特征。为解决这些问题，本文提出PaperBanana-Interact，一个多智能体系统，通过内部的批评-优化循环完成图表迭代优化。PaperBanana-Interact可在多轮迭代中持续提升而非降低图表质量，质量得分相比基线高出11.9-18.6分，遗忘问题的发生率降低3.7-6.2分。

title: Motus2: A Self-Evolving General World Model for Dexterous Manipulation
title_zh: 面向广义视觉定位的语义-空间可区分性增强方法
authors: Hongzhe Bi, Zihao Zhou, Yihang Tang, Jingrui Pang, Shuhe Huang 等 (19 人)
abstract: General embodied agents should perceive, predict, act, evaluate, and improve within a unified system. World models have shown great promise in building such agents, yet existing models typically append an action output head to a world simulator, without coupling them into a closed decision-and-learning loop for policy improvement. We present Motus2, a self-evolving general world model for dexterous manipulation. Motus2 advances world modeling through model scaling and data scaling. For model scaling, a single model with shared weights exposes three control interfaces: a policy (world-action model), a simulator (action-conditioned world model), and an evaluator (value model). The policy proposes candidate action chunks, the simulator predicts their visual consequences, and the evaluator assesses the predicted outcomes. Their coupling forms a closed decision-and-learning loop for policy improvement. This formulation uses curated expert demonstrations for action learning, while failed and suboptimal interactions provide valuable evidence for dynamics modeling and value learning. For data scaling, Motus2 progresses from large-scale monocular egocentric data to synchronized stereo egocentric data, followed by robot-domain adaptation with robot trajectories and supplementary human-robot alignment data. Motus2 further studies global-autoregressive and hybrid-memory extensions of its sliding-window context, adds tactile feedback for contact-aware control, and is instantiated on a fully biomimetic platform with stereo vision, dual arms, dual dexterous hands, and tactile sensing. Together, egocentric data scaling and closed-loop general world model scaling provide a general path toward self-evolving dexterous manipulation.
summary_zh: 广义视觉定位（Generalized Visual Grounding, GVG）任务旨在根据指代表达在图像中定位目标，融合了多目标和无目标场景，对经典视觉定位范式做了扩展。现有方法通常依赖全局语义匹配或粗粒度区域交互完成定位，区分性线索主要来自句子级语义或区域上下文。在复杂多目标场景下，这类方法容易混淆视觉相似的目标，难以建立稳定的实例级决策边界。针对上述局限，本文提出面向广义视觉定位的全新语义-空间可区分性增强（Semantic-Spatial Discriminability Enhancement, SSDE）框架，旨在提升细粒度语义和空间定位的区分能力，同时改善跨模态理解和实例级定位效果。具体而言，为在细粒度层面提升查询表征的语义区分度，本文提出语义可区分性增强（Semantic Discriminability Enhancement, SeDE）模块，利用空间引导的交叉注意力解耦与目标相关的细粒度视觉属性，并将其与文本主体语义融合。此外，为增强指代目标的空间区分度，本文提出空间可区分性增强（Spatial Discriminability Enhancement, SpDE）模块，通过建模实例中心密度图表征目标的空间分布，将其作为辅助监督信号，在空间域显式构建实例分离结构。大量实验表明，SSDE在经典和广义视觉定位任务的共10个数据集上均取得了更优性能。

title: Semantic-Spatial Discriminability Enhancement for Generalized Visual Grounding
authors: Kaiyan Lei, Xu-Yao Zhang
abstract: Generalized Visual Grounding (GVG) task aims to localize targets in an image based on referring expressions, extends the classical visual grounding paradigm by integrating multi-target and non-target scenarios. Previous methods typically rely on global semantic matching or coarse-grained region interactions for localization, where the discriminative cues are primarily derived from sentence-level semantics or regional context. In complex multi-target scenarios, such approaches tend to confuse visually similar targets, making it difficult to establish stable instance-level decision boundaries. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel Semantic-Spatial Discriminability Enhancement (SSDE) framework for generalized visual grounding, which aims to enhance the discriminative ability on fine-grained semantics and spatial localization, improving both cross-modal understanding and instance-level grounding. Specifically, to enhance the semantic discriminability of query representations at the fine-grained level, we propose a Semantic Discriminability Enhancement (SeDE) module, which leverages spatially guided cross-attention to disentangle fine-grained target-relevant visual attributes and integrates them with the textual subject semantics. Furthermore, to strengthen the spatial discriminability of the referred targets, we introduce a Spatial Discriminability Enhancement (SpDE) module, which models an instance center density map to characterize the spatial distribution of targets, and explicitly constructs instance separation structures in the spatial domain by employing them as an auxiliary supervision signal. Extensive experiments show that SSDE achieves superior performance on ten datasets across both classic and generalized visual grounding tasks.

title: Amortized Anchor Refinement for Deployable Continuous-Time 4D Gaussian Reconstruction
title_zh: 面向可部署连续时间4D高斯重建的摊销锚点优化方法
authors: Jingong Chen, Qingwen Zhang, Sanghyeon Jun, Chulwoo Pack, Kyle Gao 等 (6 人)
abstract: Continuous-time 4D reconstruction remains impractical on standalone XR headsets. Per-scene optimization demands deployment-infeasible compute, and lower budgets cause collapse rather than degrade gradually. Feed-forward prediction is fast, but struggle to recover scene-specific detail. We present Amortized Anchor Refinement, which uses a frozen backbone to predict an initial Gaussian representation and a short optimization to specialize it under a fixed compute budget, with a capacity floor preserving representational density. A training-free stage then applies a persistent-homology constraint to prune unstable Gaussians while preserving topologically persistent structures, and streams the resulting trajectories directly as scene flow. On the Stage-Capture benchmark, Amortized Anchor Refinement achieves 24.31$\pm$2.22dB, while our deployment experiments demonstrate reconstruction within the target budget on a single consumer GPU and playback on a standalone XR headset.
summary_zh: 连续时间4D重建目前仍无法在独立XR头显上落地使用：逐场景优化的计算量远超部署可承受范围，而降低计算预算又会导致重建完全崩溃而非性能逐步下降。前馈预测速度快，但难以恢复场景专属细节。本文提出摊销锚点优化方法，使用冻结骨干网络预测初始高斯表征，再通过短时间优化在固定计算预算下对其做专属化调整，同时设置容量下限保障表征密度。随后的无需训练阶段应用持续同伦约束，在保留拓扑持久结构的前提下剪枝不稳定高斯，直接将生成的轨迹作为场景流输出。在Stage-Capture基准上，摊销锚点优化方法的重建精度达到24.31±2.22dB，部署实验证明该方法可在单消费级GPU上以目标预算完成重建，并在独立XR头显上实现流畅回放。

title: Towards a Joint Khmer Text Recognition and Word Segmentation
title_zh: 高棉语文本识别与分词的联合框架研究
authors: Marry Kong, Rina Buoy, Sovisal Chenda, Nguonly Taing, Masakazu Iwamura 等 (6 人)
abstract: Text recognition, or extracting electronic text from document images, has been indispensable for knowledge retrieval tasks, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). For Khmer, extracted text is subject to an extra word segmentation step, as Khmer does not use any visible word delimiters to denote word boundaries. Thus, a recognition-then-segmentation pipeline for Khmer requires two separate sequential models; this is not only error-prone but also adds significant latency for large-scale document processing. This paper proposes a novel joint Khmer text recognition and word segmentation framework in a unified model. The proposed model, using a connectionist-temporal-classification (CTC) decoder for fast, parallel decoding, can be instructed to recognize Khmer text with ($b=1$) and without ($b=0$) word segmentation. Experimental results on different benchmark datasets of different document modalities (document, scene, and handwritten images) show that the proposed model can not only recognize characters in document images but also locate word boundaries, removing the need for an extra word segmentation step in a conventional sequential pipeline.
summary_zh: 文本识别即从文档图像中提取电子文本，是检索增强生成（retrieval-augmented generation, RAG）等知识检索任务的核心支撑技术。对于高棉语，提取得到的文本还需要额外的分词步骤，因为高棉语没有显式的词分隔符标识词边界。因此，传统高棉语处理的先识别后分词流水线需要两个独立的串行模型，不仅容易累积误差，还会大幅提升大规模文档处理的延迟。本文提出一种全新的高棉语文本识别与分词联合框架，在统一模型内完成两项任务。该模型采用连接时序分类（connectionist-temporal-classification, CTC）解码器实现快速并行解码，可通过指令控制输出带分词（b=1）或不带分词（b=0）的高棉语文本。在文档图像、场景图像、手写图像等不同文档模态的多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该模型不仅可以识别文档图像中的字符，还能定位词边界，省去了传统串行流水线中额外的分词步骤。

title: Frontier vision-language models have overtaken young adults at detecting AI-generated portraits -- but not their calibration
title_zh: 前沿视觉语言模型在检测AI生成肖像方面已超越年轻成年人——但在校准能力上尚未实现反超
authors: Sunwhi Kim, Sunyul Kim, Meounggun Jo, Jini Tae
abstract: AI image generators now create face portraits that are hard to tell from real photographs. Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly proposed to flag such images. We benchmarked 19 VLMs on the same 198 face portraits -- real photographs and identity-matched ChatGPT-4o and Imagen 3 versions -- under the same task as our earlier study of 1,667 adults (85% correct overall; accuracy fell steeply with age). The June-2026 cohort of 14 models only matched adults in their 20s-30s. Four weeks later the ceiling broke. Among five July-2026 releases under the identical protocol, gpt-5.6-sol reached 92.8% balanced accuracy (five-draw mean 92.1%), clearly above adults in their 20s (88.5%), and claude-fable-5 detected every AI image while averaging 91.9%. Model sensitivity now exceeds young adults decisively (d' up to 3.4 versus ~ 2.4). What has not been overtaken is human calibration. Model criteria spread from c = -1.10 to +1.45 while humans sit near zero at every age; both new leaders are biased (+0.44, -0.97), and only a few mid-ranked models approach the human balance. Changing the labelled examples still flipped about one answer in four. The best machines now out-see young adults here, without matching the human balance between suspicion and trust.
summary_zh: 当前AI图像生成器可创建难以与真实照片区分的人脸肖像，学界越来越多地提出使用视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）来标记这类生成图像。我们在198组人脸肖像数据集（包含真实照片、身份匹配的ChatGPT-4o生成肖像与Imagen 3生成肖像）上对19个VLMs进行了基准测试，测试任务与我们此前针对1667名成年人开展的研究完全一致：此前研究中成年人整体准确率为85%，且准确率随年龄增长急剧下降。2026年6月发布的14个模型组成的队列，表现仅与20-30岁年龄段的成年人持平；4周后性能天花板被突破，在完全相同的实验协议下测试的5个2026年7月发布的模型中，gpt-5.6-sol的平衡准确率达到92.8%（五次抽样均值为92.1%），明显高于20岁年龄段成年人的88.5%，claude-fable-5检测出了所有AI生成图像，平均准确率达91.9%。当前模型的敏感度已决定性地超过年轻成年人水平（判别力指标d'最高达3.4，而人类仅约为2.4）。尚未被超越的是人类的概率校准能力：模型的判别阈值分布范围为c=-1.10至+1.45，而所有年龄段人类的阈值都接近0；两款当前性能领先的模型均存在明显偏置（阈值分别为+0.44、-0.97），仅少数排名中游的模型接近人类的平衡状态。即便更换标注示例，模型仍有约四分之一的预测结果发生翻转。当前性能最优的模型在该任务中的识别能力已超过年轻成年人，但尚未达到人类在怀疑与信任之间的平衡水平。

title: DICS: Exploring Data Intrinsic Consistency for Visual Instruction Selection
title_zh: DICS：面向视觉指令选择的数据内在一致性探索
authors: Yuyang Hong, Jinhui Guo, Jiaqi Gu, Lubin Fan, Ruixiang Wang 等 (9 人)
abstract: Visual instruction tuning is crucial for advancing the vision-language alignment and instruction-following capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, identifying optimal subsets under a fixed ratio constraint from rapidly expanding datasets remains a significant bottleneck. While existing methods largely depend on distribution diversity or heuristic filtering, they often overlook the internal coherence within individual samples. To bridge this gap, we propose Data Intrinsic Consistency (DIC), a self-scoring metric designed to quantify the sample-level inter-component consistency. DIC consists of two modules: Visual Information Consistency (VIC), evaluating the alignment between visual content and instructions, and Response Information Consistency (RIC), assessing response coherence relative to the instruction. Building upon DIC, we introduce Data Intrinsic Consistency Selection (DICS), an adaptive data selection method that optimizes the trade-off between high intra-sample consistency and global distributional diversity under varying data budgets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DICS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse dataset scales and model architectures, surpassing full-dataset fine-tuning while using only 25% of the LLaVA-1.5-665K data. We further curate DICS-6M, a 6M-sample multi-modal instruction corpus that enables the largest-scale visual instruction selection study to date; remarkably, DICS reaches 94.52\% of the official InternVL3-8B-Instruct performance using less than 25\% of its reported training data. Code can be seen atthis https URL
summary_zh: 视觉指令调优对于提升视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）的视觉-语言对齐能力与指令遵循能力至关重要。但在快速扩张的数据集上按固定比例约束筛选最优子集，目前仍是领域内的显著瓶颈。现有方法大多依赖分布多样性或启发式过滤，往往忽略了单个样本内部的一致性。为填补这一空白，我们提出数据内在一致性（Data Intrinsic Consistency, DIC）这一自评分指标，用于量化样本层面的组件间一致性。DIC包含两个模块：视觉信息一致性（Visual Information Consistency, VIC）用于评估视觉内容与指令的对齐程度，响应信息一致性（Response Information Consistency, RIC）用于评估响应与指令之间的匹配连贯性。基于DIC，我们进一步提出数据内在一致性选择方法（Data Intrinsic Consistency Selection, DICS），这是一种自适应数据选择方法，可在不同数据预算下优化高样本内一致性与全局分布多样性之间的权衡。大量实验表明，在不同数据集规模与模型架构下，DICS的表现始终优于当前最先进的方法，仅使用25%的LLaVA-1.5-665K数据就超过了全数据集微调的效果。我们进一步构建了包含600万样本的多模态指令语料DICS-6M，支撑了迄今为止规模最大的视觉指令选择研究；值得注意的是，DICS使用不到25%的官方训练数据，就达到了InternVL3-8B-Instruct官方性能的94.52%。代码可访问对应公开链接获取。

title: NoisEasier: Test-Time Noise Optimization for Text-to-Video Generation
title_zh: NoisEasier：面向文本到视频生成的测试时噪声优化
authors: Yujiang Pu, Yu Kong
abstract: Diffusion models have recently advanced text-to-video (T2V) generation, yet they still struggle with fine-grained compositional alignment, such as attribute binding, spatial relations, and object interactions. While reward-based fine-tuning improves alignment, it is susceptible to reward hacking and adapts poorly to new prompt distributions. In this work, we propose NoisEasier, a test-time scaling framework that improves T2V generation through differentiable reward-guided noise optimization without modifying the underlying model. By combining efficient short-step generators with a multi-objective reward formulation, NoisEasier enables stable and practical test-time optimization under realistic inference budgets. Our key insight is that jointly optimizing the entire stochastic trajectory accelerates reward convergence and improves compositional alignment over optimizing only the initial latent, with negligible additional computational and time cost. Experiments on VBench and T2V-CompBench demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple backbones, achieving over 10% average gains on challenging dimensions such as attribute binding, object interaction, and numeracy. Overall, NoisEasier serves as both a flexible alternative and a complementary enhancement to reward-based fine-tuning, establishing test-time scaling as an effective paradigm for controllable text-to-video generation.
summary_zh: 扩散模型近期大幅推动了文本到视频（Text-to-Video, T2V）生成技术的发展，但该类模型在属性绑定、空间关系、物体交互等细粒度组合对齐任务上仍存在明显短板。基于奖励的微调方法可提升对齐效果，但容易出现奖励黑客问题，且对新提示分布的适配性较差。本文提出NoisEasier这一测试时缩放框架，在不修改底层生成模型的前提下，通过可微奖励引导的噪声优化提升文本到视频生成效果。该框架将高效短步长生成器与多目标奖励公式相结合，可在现实推理预算下实现稳定、可落地的测试时优化。我们的核心发现是：与仅优化初始隐变量的方案相比，联合优化整个随机轨迹可加快奖励收敛速度、提升组合对齐效果，且仅带来可忽略的额外计算与时间成本。在VBench与T2V-CompBench数据集上的实验表明，该方法可在多个骨干模型上实现稳定性能提升，在属性绑定、物体交互、计数能力等挑战性维度上平均增益超过10%。总体而言，NoisEasier既是基于奖励微调的灵活替代方案，也是其互补增强方案，证明了测试时缩放是可控文本到视频生成的有效范式。

title: ATGS: Anchored Temporal Gaussian Splatting for Long Volumetric Video Representation
title_zh: ATGS：面向长时序体视频表示的锚定时序高斯溅射
authors: Jiahao Wu, Jie Liang, Die Hu, Jiayu Yang, Kaiqiang Xiong 等 (9 人)
abstract: Volumetric video enables immersive free viewpoint rendering of dynamic real world scenes, yet existing methods struggle with long sequences and complex motions, often leading to temporal instability and visual artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose \ourname, a Gaussian splatting based framework for volumetric video reconstruction. Our key insight is that explicitly tracking long term complex motion with individual Gaussian primitives is inherently unstable. Instead, we organize Gaussians around time conditioned anchors that localize their spatial and temporal support, thereby reducing long range motion complexity. We further introduce a temporal windowing strategy to activate only anchors relevant to the queried time, which improves scalability and temporal coherence. In addition, to ensure spatial and temporal stability, we design a compact set of multi level anchor features that encode global features, local spatial features, and local temporal features, jointly constraining Gaussian generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \ourname \ consistently outperforms prior methods on long sequence volumetric videos with complex motions. Project page:this https URL.
summary_zh: 体视频技术可实现动态真实场景的沉浸式自由视角渲染，但现有方法难以处理长序列与复杂运动场景，往往会出现时序不稳定与视觉伪影问题。为应对上述挑战，本文提出ATGS（Anchored Temporal Gaussian Splatting，锚定时序高斯溅射）这一基于高斯溅射的体视频重建框架。我们的核心洞察是：使用单个高斯基元显式跟踪长期复杂运动本质上是不稳定的，因此我们将高斯单元组织在时间条件锚点周围，由锚点限定高斯单元的时空支撑范围，从而降低长程运动的复杂度。我们进一步引入时序窗口策略，仅激活与查询时间相关的锚点，提升了方法的可扩展性与时序连贯性。此外为保证时空稳定性，我们设计了一组精简的多层锚点特征，用于编码全局特征、局部空间特征与局部时序特征，共同约束高斯单元的生成过程。大量实验表明，在包含复杂运动的长序列体视频任务上，ATGS的表现始终优于现有方法。项目主页可访问对应公开链接获取。

title: ConCA: Concentration-Aware Channel Attention for Fine-Grained Visual Recognition
title_zh: ConCA：面向细粒度视觉识别的浓度感知通道注意力
authors: Yu-Sheng Liu, Yu-Chen Tung
abstract: Lightweight channel attention mechanisms are widely used in image classification, yet their effectiveness in fine-grained visual recognition (FGVR) remains limited. Most modules summarize each channel by global average pooling (GAP), which captures activation magnitude but ignores spatial concentration, so channels with different spatial distributions but identical means receive the same descriptor. We propose Concentration-Aware Channel Attention (ConCA), which pairs the mean with a shift-invariant negative-input entropy (NegEnt), computed via a softmax over the negated activations, forming a dual descriptor that jointly encodes magnitude and concentration. A depthwise 1-D convolutional multi-layer perceptron (MLP), whose parameter count is linear in the number of channels, maps the pair to a per-channel weight. On six fine-grained benchmarks, ConCA improves over attention-free, SE-Net, and ECA-Net baselines as well as four richer descriptor-based modules under a controlled from-scratch protocol, and it generalizes across eight backbones on iNat2021-mini. These results indicate that the channel descriptor, together with the per-channel gating that maps it to attention weights, is an important but underexplored aspect of lightweight channel attention in FGVR.
summary_zh: 轻量级通道注意力机制已被广泛应用于图像分类任务，但在细粒度视觉识别（Fine-Grained Visual Recognition, FGVR）场景下的性能仍存在明显局限。现有大多数模块采用全局平均池化（Global Average Pooling, GAP）汇总每个通道的特征，仅能捕捉激活幅度，却忽略了空间浓度信息，导致空间分布不同但均值相同的通道会获得完全相同的描述符。本文提出浓度感知通道注意力（Concentration-Aware Channel Attention, ConCA），该机制将通道均值与平移不变负输入熵（NegEnt）配对，其中负输入熵通过对取反后的激活值执行softmax运算得到，共同形成同时编码幅度与浓度的双描述符。我们使用深度1维卷积多层感知机（Multi-Layer Perceptron, MLP）将上述配对特征映射为逐通道权重，该模块的参数量与通道数呈线性关系。在6个细粒度基准数据集上，在受控从零训练协议下，ConCA的表现超过了无注意力基线、SE-Net、ECA-Net以及4种更复杂的基于描述符的注意力模块，且在iNat2021-mini数据集的8种骨干网络上均具备良好泛化性。上述结果表明，通道描述符以及将描述符映射为注意力权重的逐通道门控机制，是轻量级通道注意力在细粒度视觉识别领域中尚未被充分探索的重要研究方向。

title: Doc-REFRAG: Rethinking Multimodal Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: Doc-REFRAG：重新思考多模态文档检索增强生成
authors: Ruofan Hu, Shengyang Xu, Minjie Hong, Xiaoda Yang, Sashuai Zhou 等 (8 人)
abstract: Real-world knowledge resides in multimodal documents, necessitating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for accurate question answering. However, existing multimodal RAG models are primarily designed for single-image or closed-document settings and exhibit limited accuracy in realistic multi-image scenarios. Moreover, processing numerous retrieved images incurs substantial computational overhead from irrelevant visual tokens. To address these challenges, we introduce DocLongRAG, a large-scale dataset of 343K question--answer pairs, each associated with an average of 37.4 retrieved images to reflect authentic RAG workflows. Building on this dataset, we propose Doc-REFRAG, a question-guided framework that compresses visual tokens into coarse chunks and selectively expands question-relevant ones via a lightweight RL-based selector. Experiments on six benchmarks show that Doc-REFRAG outperforms eleven strong baselines, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy with significantly lower inference latency. Our resources are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 真实世界的知识大量存储在多模态文档中，需要借助检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）技术实现精准问答。但现有多模态RAG模型主要面向单图像或封闭文档场景设计，在真实多图像场景下的准确率十分有限；此外处理大量检索得到的图像时，无关视觉令牌会带来极高的计算开销。为应对上述挑战，我们构建了大规模数据集DocLongRAG，包含34.3万组问答对，每组问答对平均关联37.4张检索图像，可还原真实RAG工作流。基于该数据集，我们提出Doc-REFRAG这一问题引导框架，可将视觉令牌压缩为粗粒度块，并通过轻量级基于强化学习的选择器，选择性地扩展与问题相关的块。在6个基准数据集上的实验表明，Doc-REFRAG的表现超过11个强基线模型，在大幅降低推理延迟的同时取得了当前最先进的准确率。相关资源可访问对应公开链接获取。

title: AI-enabled Low-Cost 3D Maize Ear Morphometry Platform at Breeding Scale
title_zh: 面向育种场景的AI赋能低成本3D玉米穗形态测量平台
authors: Therin Young, Elijah Rodriguez, Lisa Coffey, Talukder Zaki Jubery, Adarsh Krishnamurthy 等 (7 人)
abstract: Maize ear geometry (length, width, curvature, and volume) is closely tied to yield and grain-filling outcomes, but existing high-throughput phenotyping pipelines remain constrained by the cost, labor, and specialized hardware they require. We developed and validated a low-cost pipeline that reconstructs a watertight 3-D mesh of a maize ear from a single 20-second video captured with a consumer-grade DSLR on a motorized turntable under uniform LED illumination. Camera poses from a multi-seed COLMAP procedure initialize a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF), and a cylindrical holder of known diameter, visible in every frame, provides automatic metric scaling with downstream geometric quality control. Applied to 300 ears spanning a diverse maize inbred panel, 250 (83.3%) passed automated processing and quality control. Skeleton length agreed with manual caliper measurements across all 250 ears (R^2 = 0.964, RMSE = 4.68 mm), and convex-hull volume agreed with water-displacement volume on a 15-ear subset spanning the full size range (R^2 = 0.982, RMSE = 5.26 mL). Residual length error grew with ear curvature, whereas bounding-box height, which records the same straight-line chord as calipers, showed no such trend; the discrepancy therefore originates in the measurement definition, since calipers record the chord while skeleton length traces the geodesic arc. The capture hardware costs approximately 607 USD, and operator involvement fell from roughly five minutes to one minute per ear, with all downstream processing running unattended. The platform provides a foundation for breeding-scale 3-D ear phenotyping.
summary_zh: 玉米穗的几何参数（长度、宽度、曲率、体积）与产量、籽粒灌浆结果密切相关，但现有高通量表型分析管线受成本、人力需求与专用硬件的限制。我们开发并验证了一套低成本处理管线：仅使用消费级数码单反相机在均匀LED照明环境下，在电动转台上拍摄20秒视频，即可重建出玉米穗的水密性3D网格。多种子COLMAP流程输出的相机位姿用于初始化神经辐射场（Neural Radiance Field, NeRF），每帧画面中可见的已知直径圆柱形支架可自动完成度量缩放，并支持后续几何质量控制。我们将该管线应用于包含不同玉米自交系的300个玉米穗样本，其中250个（83.3%）样本通过了自动处理与质量控制。250个样本的骨架长度与手动卡尺测量结果高度吻合（R²=0.964，均方根误差RMSE=4.68mm），覆盖全尺寸范围的15个样本子集的凸包体积与排水法测量体积吻合度良好（R²=0.982，RMSE=5.26mL）。残余长度误差随玉米穗曲率上升而增大，但与卡尺记录的直线弦长一致的边界框高度不存在该趋势，说明该差异来源于测量定义本身：卡尺记录的是弦长，而骨架长度追踪的是测地弧长。该采集硬件总成本约为607美元，单穗操作时长从约5分钟缩短至1分钟，所有后续处理均可无人值守运行。该平台为育种规模下的玉米穗3D表型分析提供了基础支撑。

title: CedarCypress3D: an annotated UAV-LiDAR dataset of individual trees in planted cedar and cypress forests
title_zh: CedarCypress3D：标注完备的人工柳杉与柏树林单木无人机激光雷达数据集
authors: Katsuto Shimizu, Fumiaki Kitahara, Tomohiro Nishizono, Hideki Saito, Masayoshi Takahashi 等 (11 人)
abstract: Individual tree measurements derived from Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) mounted on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) provide valuable information for forest inventory, ecosystem monitoring, and sustainable forest management. Recent advancements in machine learning have increased the demand for annotated datasets to develop and evaluate point cloud-based approaches, especially for individual tree segmentation. However, publicly available annotated UAV-LiDAR datasets in temperate forests are limited. In this article, we present CedarCypress3D, a manually annotated UAV-LiDAR dataset collected in Japanese cedar (Cryptomeria japonica) and Japanese cypress (Chamaecyparis obtusa) plantations in Japan. The dataset consists of UAV-LiDAR point clouds and field survey measurements from 34 circular plots across two sites with different topographic characteristics, along with terrestrial LiDAR point clouds available for a subset of 22 plots. A total of 1,627 trees were measured in the census field survey and manually annotated to match the corresponding trees in the UAV-LiDAR point clouds. For the subset of plots with terrestrial LiDAR data, semantic labels (i.e., stem and non-stem) were additionally assigned to tree points in the UAV-LiDAR data. CedarCypress3D provides high-quality annotated UAV-LiDAR data for developing and evaluating individual tree instance segmentation and semantic segmentation methods in temperate planted forests. The dataset can also support research on tree attribute prediction and multi-platform LiDAR analysis. The dataset is publicly available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 搭载于无人机（Unmanned Aerial Vehicle, UAV）的激光雷达（Light Detection and Ranging, LiDAR）获取的单木测量数据，可为森林清查、生态系统监测与可持续森林管理提供高价值信息。机器学习领域的最新进展大幅提升了对标注数据集的需求，以开发和评估基于点云的方法，尤其是单木分割方法。但目前公开可用的温带森林标注无人机激光雷达数据集十分有限。本文介绍了CedarCypress3D这一人工标注的无人机激光雷达数据集，采集自日本境内的日本柳杉（Cryptomeria japonica）与日本扁柏（Chamaecyparis obtusa）人工林。该数据集包含来自两个地形特征不同的站点共34个圆形样地的无人机激光雷达点云与实地调查测量数据，其中22个样地还提供了地面激光雷达点云。实地普查共测量1627棵树木，全部完成人工标注以匹配无人机激光雷达点云中对应的树木；在包含地面激光雷达数据的样地子集上，还为无人机激光雷达点云中的树木点额外标注了树干、非树干语义标签。CedarCypress3D可为温带人工林场景下的单木实例分割与语义分割方法开发、评估提供高质量标注无人机激光雷达数据，也可支撑树木属性预测、多平台激光雷达分析相关研究。该数据集可通过对应公开链接公开获取。

title: Repeatability Characterisation and Error Budget of a Consumer Structured-Light Scanner for 3-D Wound Geometry:A Rigid-Phantom Study
title_zh: 面向3D伤口几何测量的消费级结构光扫描仪可重复性表征与误差预算：基于刚性体模的研究
authors: Pushkal Kumar, Aadit Aggarwal, Karlen Aleksanyan
abstract: We characterise the measurement error of a free- hand consumer structured-light scanner used to derive three- dimensional geometric wound descriptors. Rigid wound-care phantoms cannot change, so every difference between repeat scans of one site is measurement error; all repeats come from a single scanner unit, nine sites and 23 scans, so this charac- terises one instrument. The 95 percent repeatability limit for reconstructed surface area is a factor of 4.8, with a confidence interval from 3.0 to 7.0, so rescanning an unchanged site can shift the reading from a 79 percent decrease to a 377 percent increase. Forty-four of 45 descriptors fall below an intraclass correlation of 0.50, and none of 248 descriptor and pipeline combinations reaches 0.75. An error budget formed by holding the analy- sis region fixed, leaving sensor and reconstruction untouched, bounds the share of variance attributable to how much surface the operator captured at 75 percent for surface area, 91 percent for hull area and 95 percent for bounding-box diagonal; only hull volume is majority instrumental, at 48 percent, so a better sensor would buy little. No wound is delineated anywhere in the chain, so the comparison against the four-week area reduction used clinically to predict healing, a ratio near 2.1, is a lower bound on the noise an unsegmented pipeline must overcome, not a measurement of wound-area reproducibility. Standardising the analysis region cuts the limit to 2.13, meeting that ratio rather than clearing it. Statistical outlier removal imposes a measured systematic area deficit near 11 percent.
summary_zh: 本文对一款手持消费级结构光扫描仪的测量误差进行表征，该扫描仪用于提取伤口三维几何描述符。刚性伤口护理体模的形态不会发生变化，因此同一位置重复扫描的所有差异均为测量误差；所有重复扫描均来自同一台扫描仪，覆盖9个测量位点共23次扫描，可完整表征单台设备的性能。重建表面积的95%可重复性限为4.8，置信区间为3.0至7.0，意味着对未发生变化的位点重新扫描时，测量值可能出现从下降79%到上升377%的大幅波动。45个描述符中有44个的组内相关系数低于0.50，248组描述符与处理管线的组合中没有一组达到0.75。通过固定分析区域、保持传感器与重建流程不变构建误差预算，可量化不同误差来源的占比：表面积75%的方差来源于操作者采集的表面范围，凸包面积91%的方差来源于该因素，边界框对角线95%的方差来源于该因素；仅凸包体积的大部分方差（48%）来自仪器本身，说明仅升级传感器对性能提升的作用十分有限。整个处理链路中未对伤口进行任何分割，因此与临床用于预测愈合效果的四周面积缩减率（约2.1）的对比，是未分割管线需要克服的噪声下限，而非伤口面积的可重复性测量值。将分析区域标准化后，可重复性限降至2.13，刚好达到该临床比值要求，仍未留出足够余量。统计离群值移除操作会带来约11%的系统性面积低估。

title: Efficient and High-Quality Depth Estimation via Pixel-Space Diffusion with Linear Attention
title_zh: 基于线性注意力的像素空间扩散实现高效高质量深度估计
authors: Bingde Liu, Wu Ran, Jinglei Zhang, Huanhuan Yuan, Chao Ma
abstract: This work presents $\textbf{Lapis}$, a $\textbf{l}$inear-$\textbf{a}$ttention-based $\textbf{pi}$xel-$\textbf{s}$pace generative framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity depth estimation with one-step diffusion. While generative frameworks have significantly advanced monocular depth estimation with superior detail fidelity, the $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ complexity of standard attention and the multi-step denoising process introduce prohibitive computational costs when scaling them to high-resolution image applications. Although linear attention and one-step prediction are intuitively viable, directly applying them leads to poor structural consistency, detail loss, and noise. Lapis rectifies these limitations through a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. Specifically, a Patch-level Consistency Module restores structural coherence by integrating semantic and spatial priors. Subsequently, a Pixel-level Refinement Module recovers sharp geometric boundaries via skip-connection-based pixel correspondence. Furthermore, to mitigate sampling noise inherent in one-step diffusion, we leverage the manifold assumption and adopt a direct $\mathbf{x}$-prediction strategy to target the clean data manifold. Extensive evaluations on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Lapis consistently achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy and boundary sharpness across various resolutions, reducing inference latency by up to 7.6$\times$ at 1080P and 10.9$\times$ at 1440P resolution compared to previous SOTA generative models.
summary_zh: 本文提出Lapis这一基于线性注意力的像素空间生成框架，可通过单步扩散实现高效、高保真的深度估计。生成式框架已大幅推动单目深度估计技术发展，具备更优的细节保真度，但标准注意力的O(N²)复杂度与多步去噪过程在扩展到高分辨率图像应用时会带来极高的计算成本。尽管线性注意力与单步预测是直观可行的优化方向，但直接应用这类技术会导致结构一致性差、细节丢失与噪声问题。Lapis通过由粗到细的层级结构解决上述缺陷：具体而言，补丁级一致性模块通过融合语义与空间先验恢复结构连贯性，随后像素级细化模块通过基于跳跃连接的像素对应关系还原清晰的几何边界。此外为缓解单步扩散固有的采样噪声，我们利用流形假设，采用直接x预测策略拟合干净数据流形。在多个基准数据集上的大量评估表明，Lapis在不同分辨率下均达到当前最先进的准确率与边界清晰度，与此前最先进的生成模型相比，1080P分辨率下推理延迟最高降低7.6倍，1440P分辨率下最高降低10.9倍。

title: VIBE: Video Instruction-aligned Background music gEneration
title_zh: VIBE：视频指令对齐背景音乐生成
authors: Aryan Vijay Bhosale, Vaibhavi Lokegaonkar, Vishnu Raj, Gouthaman KV, Sreyan Ghosh 等 (8 人)
abstract: Current video-to-music (V2M) models lack semantic control and fail to penalize instruction violations, largely due to their reliance on reconstruction objectives and the representational bottleneck of static cross-modal conditioning in Diffusion Autoregressive (DAR) architectures. To resolve this, we introduce VIBE, a novel text-and-video-to-music (T+V2M) generation model that leverages: (1) Conditioning Connection, a depth-wise cross-layer conditioning mechanism that dynamically bridges the planning and diffusion refinement heads and (2) a comprehensive reward modeling taxonomy, optimizing for both hard, verifiable constraints (e.g., tempo, key) and soft, subjective qualities (e.g., musicality, multimodal alignment) with a structured 5-stage training curriculum. Upon evaluation using audio-visual alignment, instruction following, and audio quality metrics, along with a subjective human evaluation study, we observe that VIBE demonstrates enhanced controllability and instruction adherence while performing comparably to most evaluated baselines on generation fidelity and multimodal alignment.
summary_zh: 当前的视频转音乐（V2M）模型存在语义控制能力不足、无法对违反指令的输出施加惩罚的问题，主要原因是这类模型依赖重建目标，且扩散自回归（Diffusion Autoregressive, DAR）架构中的静态跨模态条件约束存在表示瓶颈。为解决该问题，本文提出一种新型文本+视频转音乐（T+V2M）生成模型VIBE，其核心设计包括两部分：（1）条件连接机制，一种深度跨层条件约束机制，可动态衔接规划头与扩散细化头；（2）完备的奖励建模分类体系，通过结构化五阶段训练课程，同时对可硬验证约束（如速度、调式）和软主观属性（如音乐性、多模态对齐度）进行优化。在视听对齐度、指令遵循度、音频质量指标以及主观人工评估研究中开展的测试结果表明，VIBE的可控性与指令遵从性显著提升，同时在生成保真度和多模态对齐度上与多数对比基线模型表现相当。

title: Aligning Multi-Trajectory Supervision with Policy Optimization for VLA Driving
title_zh: 面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）驾驶任务的多轨迹监督与策略优化对齐方法
authors: Tian Zhang, Zhuo Huang, Hongrui Ye, Yu Wu, Zengmao Wang 等 (6 人)
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving methods increasingly combine multi-trajectory imitation learning with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), making trajectory selection critical to final performance. However, some high-scoring trajectories that improve imitation can degrade subsequent GRPO by inducing advantage estimates misaligned with the current policy's feasible behavior distribution, driving updates away from safe and compliant behaviors. To address this, we propose a novel framework that aligns multi-trajectory supervision with policy optimization. To address the policy gradient bias induced by infeasible noisy trajectories outside the feasible region, augmented trajectories are constrained to a neighboring manifold of the ground-truth feasible region, and a Pareto-optimality criterion is adopted in place of the conventional aggregate score, retaining only non-dominated candidates and thereby filtering out conflicting samples at the source. To ensure that expanded trajectory supervision is effectively absorbed during policy optimization, we introduce two complementary mechanisms: feasibility-first advantage assignment and dynamic distillation. The former adapts Pareto credit to the feasibility composition of each rollout group and guides fully infeasible groups toward safe references. The latter updates teacher trajectories across refinement rounds to continually transfer useful supervision. Together, they progressively translate the benefits of expanded supervision into policy improvement. On NAVSIM v1 and v2, our method achieves 91.4 PDMS and 89.1 EPDMS, respectively, under single-trajectory inference, and recovers 440 of 658 initially failed scenes, 11.1\% higher than the original GRPO baseline.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）驾驶方法越来越多地将多轨迹模仿学习与组相对策略优化（Group-Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）相结合，使得轨迹选择成为决定最终性能的关键因素。然而，部分可提升模仿学习效果的高分轨迹，会导致优势估计与当前策略的可行行为分布不匹配，进而降低后续GRPO的优化效果，使策略更新偏离安全合规行为。为解决该问题，本文提出一种将多轨迹监督与策略优化对齐的新型框架。针对可行区域外不可行噪声轨迹引发的策略梯度偏差问题，该框架将增广轨迹约束在真实可行区域的邻接流形上，采用帕累托最优准则替代传统的聚合评分方法，仅保留非支配候选样本，从源头过滤冲突样本。为确保策略优化过程中有效吸收扩展后的轨迹监督信息，本文引入两种互补机制：可行性优先优势分配机制与动态蒸馏机制。前者将帕累托信用适配到每个 rollout 组的可行性组成，引导完全不可行的组向安全参考值靠拢；后者在多轮细化过程中更新教师轨迹，持续传递有效监督信息。二者协同作用，逐步将扩展监督的收益转化为策略性能提升。在NAVSIM v1和v2数据集上，本文方法在单轨迹推理模式下分别达到91.4 PDMS和89.1 EPDMS，可恢复658个初始失败场景中的440个，性能比原始GRPO基线高出11.1%。

title: A Hybrid State-Space Approach for Census-Tract Population Estimation
title_zh: 用于人口普查小区人口估算的混合状态空间方法
authors: Jackson R. Ye, Alexandre V. Morozov
abstract: Sequence models---the architecture family behind large language models and, increasingly, state-of-the-art image recognition---have redefined how machines learn from high-dimensional data. Yet population estimation from satellite imagery, a task that underpins infrastructure planning, public health, and disaster response, has scarcely benefited: leading systems still bind population to a uniform raster, disaggregating census counts onto grid cells through weighting surfaces built from ancillary data (e.g., in WorldPop and LandScan), which can introduce systematic spatial bias, and predicting population per grid cell with convolutional neural networks. In this approach, the administrative-unit structure in which the census was actually collected is discarded. We close this gap with MambaPop, which renders each administrative unit as a single polygon-masked satellite image and treats tract-level population estimation as a sequence-modeling problem over its image patches, pairing each tract image directly with its population label and eliminating the disaggregation step entirely. Built on the hybrid state-space--attention MambaVision backbone, MambaPop is, to our knowledge, the first method to learn population directly from an administrative unit's own image as well as the first to apply a state-space based (Mamba) hybrid architecture to the population estimation task. Across all $\sim$84{,}000 contiguous-US census tracts of the 2020 census, MambaPop attains a mean absolute error (MAE) of $1{,}141$ persons per tract, matching the strongest convolutional baseline (YOLOv11, MAE $1{,}122$).
summary_zh: 序列模型是支撑大语言模型、同时也逐渐成为图像识别领域SOTA方案的架构家族，重新定义了机器从高维数据中学习的方式。但作为基础设施规划、公共卫生与灾害响应核心支撑任务的卫星图像人口估算领域，却很少受益于序列模型：现有主流系统仍将人口绑定到统一栅格，通过从辅助数据构建的权重表面将普查人口数分解到网格单元（例如WorldPop和LandScan方案），该过程会引入系统性空间偏差，同时结合卷积神经网络预测每个网格单元的人口，完全丢弃了人口普查实际采集所依托的行政单元结构。本文提出MambaPop填补这一空白，该方法将每个行政单元渲染为单张多边形掩码卫星图像，把小区级人口估算转化为基于图像块的序列建模问题，直接将每个小区图像与其人口标签配对，完全省去人口分解步骤。据我们所知，基于混合状态空间-注意力MambaVision骨干网络构建的MambaPop是首个直接从行政单元自身图像学习人口分布的方法，也是首个将基于状态空间的混合架构（Mamba）应用于人口估算任务的方法。在覆盖2020年人口普查全美大陆约84000个人口普查小区的测试集上，MambaPop的每小区平均绝对误差（MAE）为1141人，性能与最强卷积基线模型YOLOv11（MAE为1122人）相当。

title: The Nearest Target Is the Wrong One: Target Separation in Arc2Face Identity Unlearning
title_zh: 最近目标反而错误：Arc2Face身份遗忘中的目标分离研究
authors: Zeynel Tok
abstract: Unlearning an identity from a face-conditioned generator by redirecting its conditioning embedding can silently fail if the redirected output is still verified as the original person. We show that this failure depends on a controllable choice of how far the redirection target lies from the forget identity in recognition space, and that the most intuitive target, the nearest neighbour, is the one most likely to cause it. We audit Arc2Face with a locked ArcFace protocol and a projection adapter that redirects identity conditioning before generation. On a hard-neighbour stress test built from the hardest 0.5% of eligible identities, four target-selection policies show a monotonic response: clean forgetting rises from 9/30 groups under the nearest hard target to 30/30 under the least similar one. Mean forget-identity re-identification falls from 51.9 to 0.0 while mean retention stays flat. This reflects successful redirection rather than outputs becoming unverifiable: 710 of 720 least-sim-hard generations arrive at the chosen target, with no leakage to unrelated identities. Re-verifying identical images with an independent recogniser (AdaFace) preserves that trend, correlating at r=0.94, arguing against a verifier artefact. Target separation is thus a first-order, reportable design variable for identity unlearning.
summary_zh: 通过重定向条件嵌入从人脸条件生成器中遗忘指定身份的操作，可能会出现隐蔽失效：重定向后的输出仍可被验证为原始待遗忘身份。本文研究表明，该失效现象与重定向目标在识别空间中距离待遗忘身份的远近这一可控制选择直接相关，而最符合直觉的最近邻目标恰恰是最容易引发该失效的选项。本文采用锁定ArcFace协议与可在生成前重定向身份条件的投影适配器，对Arc2Face开展全面审计。在由最难区分的0.5%符合条件身份构建的硬近邻压力测试中，4种目标选择策略的性能呈现单调变化规律：干净遗忘的分组占比从选择最近硬目标时的9/30提升到选择最不相似目标时的30/30；待遗忘身份的平均重识别率从51.9降至0.0，同时平均保留性能保持稳定。该结果反映的是成功重定向，而非输出无法被验证：720张最不相似硬目标生成结果中有710张可匹配到选定目标，不存在向无关身份的泄露。使用独立识别器AdaFace对相同图像重新验证后，该趋势依然保持，相关系数达0.94，排除了验证器伪影的可能性。因此目标分离是身份遗忘任务中需要重点关注、可明确报告的一级设计变量。

title: Tracing Generated Samples to Training-Data Clusters in Flow-Matching Models
title_zh: 流匹配模型中生成样本到训练数据簇的溯源方法
authors: Rania Briq, Ohad Fried, Michael Kamp, Stefan Kesselheim
abstract: Understanding which training samples influence a generated image is an important problem in generative modeling. In flow matching, training samples influence the generated image through the velocity field along the generation trajectory. Removing samples to examine their counterfactual influence changes the velocity field, and the resulting effect on the final image depends on how the change propagates through the trajectory. Consequently, local changes in the velocity field do not necessarily predict the final counterfactual effect.This work investigates attribution in flow-matching models through a hybrid analytical--learned approach, and uses it to derive trajectory-based attribution scores at the cluster level. We evaluate these attribution scores using independently retrained leave-one-cluster-out (LOO) models, and compare with several attribution baselines using two different flow-matching latent spaces.
