Our experiments show that semantic similarity constitutes a strong baseline, while the closed-form trajectory-based attribution is competitive in some metrics without requiring counterfactual retraining or model gradients.Our results show that attribution in flow matching depends not only on semantic similarity to training samples, but also on the latent representation, trajectory dynamics, and how influence is propagated to the final output.
summary_zh: 明确生成图像受到哪些训练样本的影响，是生成建模领域的重要研究问题。在流匹配框架中，训练样本通过生成轨迹上的速度场对生成图像产生影响。移除样本以检验其反事实影响的操作会改变速度场，而最终图像受到的影响取决于该变化在轨迹中的传播方式，因此速度场的局部变化无法直接预测最终的反事实效果。本文通过结合分析方法与学习方法的混合方案研究流匹配模型中的归因问题，基于该方案推导得到簇级别的轨迹归因得分。本文使用独立重训练的留一簇（Leave-One-Cluster-Out, LOO）模型对归因得分开展评估，在两种不同的流匹配潜在空间下与多种归因基线方法进行对比。实验结果表明，语义相似度是效果优异的基线方法，而本文提出的闭式轨迹归因方法无需反事实重训练或模型梯度，在部分指标上性能具备竞争力。研究结果表明，流匹配中的归因效果不仅取决于生成样本与训练样本的语义相似度，还受到潜在表示、轨迹动力学以及影响向最终输出的传播方式的共同作用。

title: TAKE 85: Testing Audiovisual filmmaKer's intEnt across 85 Hours of Film
title_zh: TAKE 85：覆盖85小时影片的电影创作者意图测试基准
authors: Kaishuu Shinozaki-Conefrey, Olivier Pascaud, Robin Courant, Xi Wang, Dimitris Samaras 等 (6 人)
abstract: Films communicate through deliberate creative choices, including lighting, color, composition, editing, dialogue, music, and sound. Humans naturally interpret these signals as directorial intent, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are evaluated almost exclusively on understanding what happens rather than why it is presented that way. We introduce TAKE 85, the first benchmark for directorial-intent understanding, comprising 398 short films (85 hours) with expert-verified question-answer pairs spanning global and fine-grained visual and audio intent. Through controlled modality ablations, TAKE 85 enables systematic evaluation of multimodal reasoning. Experiments on state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal a substantial gap between perceptual recognition and intentional understanding: while models accurately describe events and narratives, they consistently fail to infer the communicative role of filmmaking decisions. Our results establish directorial intent as a previously overlooked dimension of multimodal understanding: even the strongest model reaches only 58 out of 100, and our ablations show that no input modality is sufficient on its own. All code, Q&As, and models are publicly available fromthis https URL
summary_zh: 电影通过灯光、色彩、构图、剪辑、对白、配乐、音效等一系列刻意的创作选择传递信息。人类可以自然地将这些信号解读为导演意图，但当前多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Model, MLLM）的评估几乎全部聚焦于理解影片发生了什么，而非影片为何采用该方式呈现。本文提出首个面向导演意图理解的基准TAKE 85，该基准包含398部短片（总时长85小时），配套经专家验证的问答对，覆盖全局与细粒度的视觉、音频意图。通过可控的模态消融实验，TAKE 85可实现对多模态推理能力的系统性评估。在当前SOTA多模态大语言模型上开展的实验揭示了感知识别与意图理解之间存在显著差距：模型可以准确描述事件与叙事内容，但始终无法推断电影创作决策的传播作用。研究结果表明，导演意图是多模态理解领域此前被忽视的重要维度：即使性能最优的模型得分也仅为58/100，且消融实验结果显示没有任何单一输入模态可独立完成该任务。所有代码、问答对与模型均可通过公开链接获取。

title: When 3D Gaussian Splatting Recovers Real Surfaces
title_zh: 3D高斯溅射（3DGS）恢复真实场景表面的条件研究
authors: Songhe Wang, David Johnathan Miller
abstract: When does 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) recover the true scene surface rather than just overfitting view-dependent appearance? We answer this by developing a mathematical framework based on a first-hit rendering abstraction that cleanly isolates geometry from appearance. We prove that geometric misalignment forcefully converts spatial textures into high-frequency angular signals via parallax. This establishes a strict identifiability window: if angular capacity is bounded, surface-consistent solutions are mathematically preferred; if unrestricted, the same images can be perfectly explained by an incorrect, opaque billboard geometry. Experiments on synthetic stress tests confirm this prediction, showing billboard failures emerge precisely at high angular capacities. Conversely, in the real-world datasets we evaluate under standard capture protocols, reconstructions remain surface-consistent even at high SH degrees, which is consistent with the prediction that rich spatial texture can push billboard solutions outside the tested angular-capacity range.
summary_zh: 3D高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting, 3DGS）何时可以恢复真实场景表面，而非仅对视角相关的外观过拟合？本文基于首次命中渲染抽象方法搭建数学框架，将几何信息与外观信息完全解耦，对该问题作出解答。本文证明，几何失配会通过视差效应将空间纹理强制转换为高频角度信号，由此可推导出严格的可识别性窗口：若角度容量有界，则与表面一致的解在数学上是更优的；若角度容量不受限，错误的不透明广告牌几何也可以完美拟合所有输入图像。合成压力测试实验结果验证了该结论：广告牌失效现象恰好出现在角度容量较高的区间。与之相对，在标准采集协议下评估的真实世界数据集上，即使球谐（SH）度较高，重建结果仍可保持与表面一致，该结果与“丰富的空间纹理可将广告牌解推离测试覆盖的角度容量区间”的预测结论吻合。

title: Input-Adaptive Gating of a Dehazing Front-End for On-Device Perception in Smoke-Obscured Environments
title_zh: 烟雾遮挡环境下端侧感知的去雾前端输入自适应门控机制
authors: Seongjun Kang, Ishaan Garg, Vishnu Bharadwaj
abstract: Two-stage vision pipelines often place an enhancement network before a task network, on the assumption that a cleaner input produces a better output. We evaluate this in a firefighter assistance pipeline, where a dehazer precedes an edge detector that renders smoke-filled rooms as structural outlines. Both were designed for a Raspberry Pi 4, at 355K and 23K parameters, and quantized to UINT8 via TensorFlow Lite. The float dehazer reaches 18.60 dB peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) on held-out real smoke against 13.60 dB unprocessed and 17.08 dB for an AOD-Net trained on the same data, and the edge detector reaches an F-measure at optimal dataset scale (ODS) of 0.738, outperforming an optimized Canny's result of 0.692. Dehazing improves edge extraction under dense smoke but degrades it on clear and lightly hazed frames, where the dehazer discards more detail than the haze obscures. We therefore run the dehazer only when a dark channel haze estimate exceeds a threshold, a 10.1 ms test that lets the pipeline save 469.6 ms on the dehazing stage. Averaged over four haze levels, gating is more accurate than either fixed decision, at 0.675 mean ODS against 0.664 for always dehazing and 0.630 for never dehazing. It reduces the mean per-frame time on the Raspberry Pi from 569 ms to 321 ms, and on clear frames increases the frame rate fivefold, from 1.8 to 9 frames per second.
summary_zh: 两阶段视觉流水线通常在任务网络前放置增强网络，其假设是更干净的输入可以产出更优的输出。本文在消防员辅助流水线中对该假设开展验证：该流水线在边缘检测器前部署去雾网络，可将充满烟雾的房间渲染为结构轮廓。两个网络均面向树莓派4设计，参数量分别为355K和23K，通过TensorFlow Lite量化为UINT8精度。浮点精度去雾网络在留出的真实烟雾数据集上的峰值信噪比（PSNR）可达18.60dB，优于未处理图像的13.60dB和在相同数据集上训练的AOD-Net的17.08dB；边缘检测器在最优数据集尺度（ODS）下的F值可达0.738，优于优化后Canny算子的0.692。去雾操作可提升浓烟场景下的边缘提取效果，但在清晰与轻度雾度帧上会劣化性能，该场景下去雾网络丢弃的细节比雾遮挡的细节更多。因此本文仅在暗通道雾度估计值超过阈值时运行去雾网络，该检测步骤耗时仅10.1ms，可让流水线在去雾阶段节省469.6ms。在4种雾度等级上取平均，该门控机制的平均ODS F值为0.675，优于始终去雾策略的0.664和始终不去雾策略的0.630，整体精度更高。该机制将树莓派上的单帧平均耗时从569ms降至321ms，在清晰帧上将帧率提升5倍，从1.8帧/秒提升至9帧/秒。

title: OPAL: Orthonormal Prototype Alignment Learning for Interpretable Image Classification
title_zh: OPAL：面向可解释图像分类的正交原型对齐学习
authors: Ilán Carretero, Gustavo Jesús Angulo, Rocío del Amor, Valery Naranjo
abstract: Prototypical part-based models provide explainable predictions by comparing input regions to learned prototypes. However, current approaches are burdened by complex, multi-stage training pipelines and heavily rely on auxiliary regularization to prevent prototype collapse. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Orthonormal Prototype Alignment Learning (OPAL), a single-stage, end-to-end framework that simplifies interpretable classification. Our approach anchors the latent space using predefined orthonormal bases, embedding each class within a dedicated subspace spanned by fixed part-prototypes. To achieve precise part localization, OPAL enforces spatial competition across feature maps. This mechanism isolates sparse, discriminative regions, directing each prototype to consistently attend to the same semantic concept across different images. By framing classification as a direct representation alignment task, our method eliminates the need for auxiliary losses. Extensive experiments on fine-grained benchmarks demonstrate that OPAL outperforms both its non-interpretable counterparts and state-of-the-art part-prototype methods, delivering granular visual explanations by explicitly revealing the specific image regions driving every prediction. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 基于原型部件的模型通过将输入区域与学习到的原型进行比对，可输出具备可解释性的预测结果。但现有方法存在训练流水线复杂多阶段、严重依赖辅助正则项避免原型坍缩的问题。为克服上述缺陷，本文提出正交原型对齐学习（Orthonormal Prototype Alignment Learning, OPAL），这是一种单阶段端到端框架，可简化可解释分类流程。该方法通过预定义的正交基锚定潜在空间，将每个类别嵌入到由固定部件原型张成的专属子空间中。为实现精确的部件定位，OPAL在特征图上施加空间竞争机制，该机制可分离出稀疏的判别性区域，引导每个原型在不同图像中始终关注同一语义概念。通过将分类任务建模为直接的表示对齐任务，该方法无需引入辅助损失函数。在细粒度基准数据集上开展的大量实验表明，OPAL的性能优于不可解释的对比模型以及当前SOTA部件原型方法，可通过明确展示驱动每一项预测的特定图像区域，输出细粒度的视觉解释。相关代码可通过公开链接获取。

title: Discrete Diffusion Bridges for Spatiotemporally Aligned Image Translation and Generation
title_zh: 面向时空对齐图像翻译与生成的离散扩散桥（DDB）模型
authors: Xing Xie, Jiawei Liu, Shijun Zhou, Huijie Fan, Zhi Han 等 (7 人)
abstract: We propose Discrete Diffusion Bridges (DDB), a novel framework designed to resolve the fundamental spatiotemporal misalignment of standard discrete diffusion in image translation and generation. By corrupting data into a pure mask state via a random schedule, the conventional forward process induces a twofold misalignment: spatially, this pure-mask destination entirely discards the rich structural priors of the source image; temporally, the random masking order inherently contradicts the ``easy-first, hard-last'' decoding mechanism used during inference. To address this, DDB constructs a direct and efficient trajectory between domains. Spatially, we introduce a hybrid absorption mechanism that redefines the absorbing state to a stochastic mixture of mask and source tokens, effectively injecting source prior as spatial anchors into the latent space. Temporally, we design an information-guided noise schedule that quantifies semantic variation to prioritize the corruption of high-information regions at earlier timesteps. This ensures the model learns to resolve difficult semantic changes using robust context from invariant regions. Extensive experiments validate the versatility and robustness of our framework across diverse generative paradigms. DDB effectively balances edit alignment with structural fidelity across both text-guided semantic manipulation and pure structural image translation, while inherently complementing text-to-image generation and guaranteeing robust high-quality decoding under extremely low sampling steps. Code and models are available at \href{this https URL}{this https URL}.
summary_zh: 本文提出离散扩散桥（Discrete Diffusion Bridges, DDB）新型框架，用于解决标准离散扩散在图像翻译与生成任务中存在的根本时空失配问题。传统方法通过随机调度将数据破坏为纯掩码状态，其前向过程会引发两类失配：空间层面，纯掩码目标完全丢弃源图像的丰富结构先验；时间层面，随机掩码顺序与推理阶段采用的“先易后难”解码机制天然矛盾。为解决该问题，DDB在不同域之间构建直接高效的生成轨迹：空间层面，本文引入混合吸收机制，将吸收状态重新定义为掩码与源令牌的随机混合，有效将源先验作为空间锚注入潜在空间；时间层面，本文设计信息引导噪声调度，通过量化语义变异度，优先在较早时间步破坏高信息区域，确保模型可利用不变区域的鲁棒上下文学习解决难处理的语义变化。大量实验验证了该框架在各类生成范式下的通用性与鲁棒性：DDB在文本引导语义操作与纯结构图像翻译任务中可有效平衡编辑对齐度与结构保真度，同时可天然适配文本到图像生成任务，在极低采样步长下也能保证鲁棒的高质量解码。相关代码与模型可通过公开链接获取。

title: Partition-Aware Unlearning for Removing Spurious Correlations in Large Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 面向大视觉语言模型伪关联去除的分区感知遗忘学习
authors: Aditi Sarker, Nazreen Shah, Rafi Ibn Sultan, Rhongho Jang, Dongxiao Zhu 等 (6 人)
abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance across many multimodal tasks; however, they often exploit spurious object-background correlations, resulting in predictions driven by contextual shortcuts rather than object-relevant visual evidence. Despite growing interest in hallucination and robustness evaluation, existing benchmarks provide limited control over whether model predictions are grounded in the target object or induced by correlated background cues. In this work, we introduce PURGE (\underline{P}artition-aware \underline{U}nlearning for \underline{R}emoving spurious-correlation \underline{G}enerated \underline{E}rrors), a framework for constructing, benchmarking, and mitigating spurious-correlation-induced failures in LVLMs. The framework consists of: -- (1) Structured dataset construction wherein we develop three complementary structured data construction strategies that partition examples by object-relevant evidence and spurious background cues, enabling controlled diagnosis of shortcut reliance; and -- (2) Partition-aware unlearning, which uses these partitions to selectively remove spurious object-background associations while preserving object-based reasoning. We evaluate the \algo~framework across multiple LVLMs, including LLaVA-1.6-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-9B, together with CLIP as a vision-language encoder, on a diverse suite of benchmarks, including CHAIR, POPE, Causal-HalBench, MM-SpuBench, AMBER, MMHal, and Waterbirds. Our results show that PURGE consistently reduces hallucinations and spurious-correlation-driven errors while maintaining or improving overall performance in most evaluated settings, providing both a reusable evaluation protocol and an effective mitigation framework for more reliable LVLMs.
summary_zh: 大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态任务中表现出优异性能，但这类模型往往会利用虚假的物体-背景关联，导致预测结果由上下文捷径而非与目标物体相关的视觉证据驱动。尽管当前针对幻觉与鲁棒性评估的研究热度不断提升，但现有基准难以控制模型预测是基于目标物体生成，还是由关联背景线索诱导得到。本研究提出PURGE（全称为Partition-aware Unlearning for Removing spurious-correlation Generated Errors，即面向伪关联生成误差消除的分区感知遗忘学习）框架，用于构建、基准测试和缓解大视觉语言模型中由伪关联诱导的故障。该框架包含两部分：（1）结构化数据集构建：开发三种互补的结构化数据构建策略，按照物体相关证据和伪背景线索对样本进行分区，实现对捷径依赖的可控诊断；（2）分区感知遗忘学习：利用上述分区选择性移除虚假的物体-背景关联，同时保留基于物体的推理能力。我们在LLaVA-1.6-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-9B等多个大视觉语言模型，以及作为视觉语言编码器的CLIP上，在CHAIR、POPE、Causal-HalBench、MM-SpuBench、AMBER、MMHal、Waterbirds等多类基准集上对该框架进行评估。实验结果表明，PURGE在绝大多数评估场景下都能持续减少幻觉和伪关联驱动的错误，同时维持甚至提升模型的整体性能，为构建更可靠的大视觉语言模型提供了可复用的评估协议和有效的缓解框架。

title: SVI2LoD3: Agent-Driven Reconstruction of LoD3 Facade Openings in Semantic 3D City Models from Volunteered Street View Imagery using Large Language and Visual Models
title_zh: SVI2LoD3：基于大语言与视觉模型从众包街景图像中智能体驱动重建语义3D城市模型的LoD3立面开口
authors: Elmehdi Kanna, Lukas Arzoumanidis, Huynh Duc An Son Nguyen, Youness Dehbi
abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end, agent-driven pipeline for the LoD3 reconstruction of facade openings in 3D city models, producing directly usable CityGML-conform outputs. In contrast to existing approaches that rely on supervised semantic segmentation and therefore require large amounts of manually annotated training data, the proposed method employs a zero-shot segmentation strategy. This substantially reduces the annotation effort while still achieving strong performance in our benchmark on the eTRIMS dataset. A further key contribution is the enforcement of correct partonomic hierarchies, thereby producing CityGML-conform LoD3 building models. Beyond the reconstruction pipeline itself, this work also introduces a novel evaluation metric for facade reconstruction, termed Facade Feature Distance (FFD). Unlike conventional metrics such as mIoU or FRDS, which assess similarity primarily through pixel-wise overlap, FFD measures distance in a high-level feature space derived from a vision transformer. In doing so, it captures both semantic correctness and architectural layout, providing a more suitable assessment of facade reconstruction quality. The proposed pipeline and evaluation strategy together offer a practical and scalable contribution toward the automated generation and analysis of semantically enriched 3D city models. The developed code is published at:this https URL.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一套端到端、智能体驱动的流水线，用于3D城市模型中立面开口的三级细节层次（LoD3，Level of Detail 3）重建，可直接生成符合城市地理标记语言（CityGML）规范的输出结果。现有方法依赖监督式语义分割，需要大量人工标注的训练数据，与之不同的是，本文提出的方法采用零样本分割策略，大幅降低了标注工作量，同时在eTRIMS数据集上的基准测试中仍取得了优异性能。本研究的另一项核心贡献是强制执行正确的部分层级结构，从而生成符合CityGML规范的LoD3建筑模型。除重建流水线本身外，本研究还提出了一种面向立面重建的全新评估指标，即立面特征距离（FFD，Facade Feature Distance）。不同于mIoU、FRDS等主要通过像素级重叠度评估相似度的传统指标，FFD在由视觉Transformer生成的高层特征空间中计算距离，可同时捕捉语义正确性和建筑布局特征，为立面重建质量提供更适配的评估方式。所提出的流水线和评估策略为语义增强型3D城市模型的自动生成与分析提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案，相关代码已发布至对应公开链接。

title: Beyond Fluency: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Saudi Dialect and Cultural Competence in Large Language Models
title_zh: 超越流畅度：面向大语言模型沙特方言与文化能力评估的基于评分量表的基准集
authors: Ghassan Al-Sumaidaee, Sajjad Abdoli, Ahmed Rashad, Maxim Legg
abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in Arabic-speaking markets, yet standard benchmarks overwhelmingly reward Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) fluency while leaving dialectal and culturally grounded competence unmeasured. This gap is consequential: everyday Arabic is largely dialectal, and dialect encodes social meaning that MSA-centric evaluation cannot capture. We present a rubric-based benchmark for the Saudi dialect, comprising 31 expert-authored prompts spanning idiomatic, pragmatic, lexical, and culturally-embedded phenomena, each paired with an expert-established ground truth. Our methodology separates evaluation into a model-agnostic phase, in which atomic, MECE positive criteria are derived solely from the ground truth, and a model-specific phase, in which four state-of-the-art systems -- Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.7, GPT-5.6, and Kimi K3 -- are scored against those criteria and penalised for errors they actively introduce. Across 124 model-prompt evaluations we catalogue 466 error instances under a nine-category taxonomy. The four systems cluster within a narrow macro-average band (42.7%-53.1%), with no model exceeding 55% and every model recording at least one negative-scoring prompt, confirming that Saudi dialectal competence remains broadly unsolved. Notably, Ambiguous Framing is the dominant failure mode (37.3% of errors) while outright Hallucination accounts for only 11.2%, indicating that models fail less by stating falsehoods than by distorting register and flattening pragmatic nuance. We further observe a consistency-versus-ceiling trade-off and model-distinctive error signatures. We release the full prompt set, ground truths, and scored rubrics to support reproducible dialectal evaluation.
summary_zh: 大语言模型在阿拉伯语市场的部署规模不断扩大，但现有标准基准普遍仅奖励现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）的流畅度，完全没有对方言能力和文化适配能力进行度量。这一研究缺口的影响十分显著：日常使用的阿拉伯语绝大多数为方言形式，而方言承载的社会意义无法被以现代标准阿拉伯语为核心的评估体系捕捉。本文提出了一套面向沙特方言的基于评分量表的基准集，包含31条由专家编写的提示，覆盖习语、语用、词汇、文化嵌入类现象，每条提示都配有专家确定的真实标注。本研究的评估方法分为两个阶段：与模型无关阶段，仅从真实标注中推导出原子化、相互独立完全穷尽（MECE）的正向评估标准；与模型相关阶段，对Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.7、GPT-5.6、Kimi K3四个当前最先进的系统按照上述标准打分，并对模型主动引入的错误进行惩罚。在124次模型-提示对评估中，我们将466个错误实例归类为9大类别。四个系统的宏观平均得分集中在42.7%~53.1%的窄区间内，没有任何模型得分超过55%，且所有模型都至少在一条提示上得到负分，证实当前大语言模型的沙特方言能力仍普遍存在明显缺陷。值得注意的是，歧义表述是占比最高的故障模式（占总错误的37.3%），而完全幻觉仅占11.2%，说明模型的故障更多来自语域扭曲和语用细节扁平化，而非输出虚假内容。我们还观察到模型性能存在一致性与上限的权衡关系，以及不同模型独有的错误特征。本研究公开了全部提示集、真实标注和评分量表，为可复现的方言评估提供支撑。

title: FIS-OT: Feature-Induced Optimal Transport for Unsupervised Action Segmentation
title_zh: FIS-OT：面向无监督动作分割的特征诱导最优传输方法
authors: Linxiang Peng, Xinyao Qin, Jinhan Li, Di Yang, Jiangtao Wang
abstract: Unsupervised action segmentation is a challenging task. It involves finding action categories and boundaries in videos without labels. Existing Optimal Transport (OT) methods use global constraints. This causes them to overlook the use of local information. Furthermore, existing Optimal transport architectures are prone to confirmation bias because they overly trust the pseudo-labels they generate. This causes models to learn from noise in the early training stages. To address these issues, we propose FIS-OT. It is a novel Feature-Induced Structured Optimal Transport framework. First, we introduce a Feature Enhanced Generator (FEG) module. It serves as an internal regularizer. By using triplet loss, FEG captures local consistency. It provides robust supervision that is independent of noisy pseudo-labels. Second, we propose a Feature-Induced Residual Structural Prior. This combines a fixed temporal backbone with dynamic feature similarities. This design ensures temporal continuity. It also allows the solver to adapt to complex action structures. Finally, we establish a cyclic optimization loop. This aligns local feature learning with global structural alignment. Extensive experiments on the three datasets show the effectiveness of our method.
summary_zh: 无监督动作分割是一项极具挑战性的任务，需要在无标注的视频中识别动作类别和边界。现有最优传输（OT）方法采用全局约束，往往忽略了局部信息的利用。此外，现有最优传输架构容易出现确认偏差，过度信任自身生成的伪标签，导致模型在训练早期就从噪声中学习。为解决上述问题，本文提出FIS-OT（全称为Feature-Induced Optimal Transport，即特征诱导最优传输），一种全新的特征诱导结构化最优传输框架。首先，本文引入特征增强生成器（FEG）模块作为内部正则化项，通过三元组损失捕捉局部一致性，提供独立于噪声伪标签的鲁棒监督信号；其次，提出特征诱导残差结构先验，将固定的时间主干网络与动态特征相似度相结合，既保证时间连续性，又允许求解器适配复杂的动作结构；最后构建循环优化回路，实现局部特征学习与全局结构对齐的统一。在三个公开数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: SpanCalib-VLM: Calibrated Hallucination Span Detection in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: SpanCalib-VLM：视觉语言模型中经过校准的幻觉跨度检测
authors: Amanuel Gizachew Abebe, Yasmin Moslem
abstract: Detecting hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) requires both accurate span localization and well-calibrated confidence scores. Fine-tuned generative VLMs excel at identifying hallucinated text spans but suffer from overconfidence and high inference latency. Discriminative sequence taggers offer deterministic speed and superior calibration but exhibit conservative span recall. We present SpanCalib-VLM, a hybrid dual-system for the SHROOM-Visions Shared Task that combines a multimodal sequence tagger, consisting of XLM-RoBERTa-Large fused with a SigLIP vision encoder via cross-attention, with our fine-tuned generative VLM (Qwen3.5-4B-SHROOM-SFT). Through a Union-Calibrated Fusion strategy, candidate spans from the generative model are re-scored with calibrated probabilities from the sequence tagger. On the SHROOM-Visions English evaluation split, our ensemble achieves a Pearson calibration correlation of 0.41 and an overall IoU of 0.39, with a clean-response IoU of 0.91} and overall detection accuracy of 70.7%. We make our model weights and code publicly available.
summary_zh: 大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的幻觉检测需要同时实现准确的跨度定位和校准良好的置信度得分。经过微调的生成式视觉语言模型擅长识别幻觉文本跨度，但存在过度自信和推理延迟高的问题；判别式序列标注器具备确定性的推理速度和更优的校准性能，但存在跨度召回率偏保守的缺陷。本文提出SpanCalib-VLM，一种面向SHROOM-Visions共享任务的混合双系统，将由XLM-RoBERTa-Large与SigLIP视觉编码器通过交叉注意力融合得到的多模态序列标注器，与经过微调的生成式视觉语言模型Qwen3.5-4B-SHROOM-SFT相结合。通过联合校准融合策略，利用序列标注器输出的校准后概率对生成式模型输出的候选跨度重新打分。在SHROOM-Visions英文评估集上，该集成模型的皮尔逊校准相关系数达到0.41，整体交并比（IoU）为0.39，其中正常响应样本的IoU为0.91，整体检测准确率为70.7%。相关模型权重和代码已全部公开。

title: Confidence-Aware Ensemble and Long-Word Refinement for Artistic Text Recognition
title_zh: 面向艺术文本识别的置信度感知集成与长单词优化方法
authors: Lucas A. Dias, Henrique A. Schulz, Rafaela de Miranda, Guilherme L. Peres, Pedro L. Bittencourt 等 (6 人)
abstract: Artistic Text Recognition (ATR) remains challenging because word images often combine decorative fonts, curved layouts, object-like characters, clutter, and severe distortions. This paper studies WordArt-V1.5 as a standardized benchmark for this setting and evaluates recent scene and artistic text recognizers under a common protocol. We propose a confidence-aware ensemble that combines SVTRv2, PARSeq, and MAERec after fine-tuning on the official training split. The ensemble selects predictions using the minimum confidence over disagreement positions, emphasizing characters that separate competing hypotheses. For long words, where a single character error can invalidate the whole prediction, we add a targeted refinement stage based on Needleman-Wunsch alignment and lexicon-guided correction. On the WordArt-V1.5 Test B split, the proposed system reaches 89.90% Word Recognition Accuracy, improving the best individual fine-tuned model by 1.77 percentage points. The long-word refinement produces a modest global gain, but improves the targeted long-word subset by 2.72 percentage points. Finally, an error analysis of all remaining mistakes shows that 48.8% are associated with labeling issues, visual ambiguity, or illegible samples, highlighting the value of diagnostic reporting for future ATR benchmarks and models. Our source code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 艺术文本识别（ATR，Artistic Text Recognition）任务仍面临诸多挑战：单词图像往往同时包含装饰性字体、弯曲布局、类字符物体、背景杂波和严重畸变。本文将WordArt-V1.5作为该场景下的标准化基准集，在统一协议下对当前最新的场景文本和艺术文本识别模型进行评估。我们提出一种置信度感知集成方法，在官方训练集上微调SVTRv2、PARSeq和MAERec三个模型后进行融合，该集成方法针对存在分歧的位置选择置信度最低的预测结果，重点关注能够区分不同竞争假设的字符。对于长单词场景，单个字符错误就会导致整个预测失效，我们引入基于Needleman-Wunsch对齐和词典引导校正的定向优化阶段。在WordArt-V1.5的Test B测试集上，所提系统的单词识别准确率达到89.90%，相比性能最优的单个微调模型提升了1.77个百分点。长单词优化虽然对全局性能的提升幅度有限，但将长单词子集的识别性能提升了2.72个百分点。最后对所有剩余错误的分析显示，48.8%的错误与标注问题、视觉歧义或样本本身无法识别有关，凸显了诊断性报告对未来艺术文本识别基准集和模型开发的重要价值。相关源代码已公开至对应链接。

title: RIDGE: Region-Informed Derivative-Guided Evidence Selection for Long Video Understanding
title_zh: RIDGE：面向长视频理解的区域感知导数引导证据选择方法
authors: Shanqing Xu, Meng Luo, Mengchen Qian, Yuhui Gao, Siyue Peng 等 (10 人)
abstract: Long videos contain far more visual content than Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) can process under a fixed visual-token budget, making frame selection essential. Existing query-aware selectors usually estimate frame-query relevance and build a compact subset from high-scoring frames. Although their mechanisms differ, the similarity sequence is still often treated primarily as values to rank or sample from, rather than as an ordered signal whose shape reflects how query-relevant evidence emerges, peaks, and fades over time. This can obscure frames that explain, contextualize, or follow an event, because such evidence may lie on the rising or falling sides of a nearby relevance peak and receive lower absolute scores. We propose RIDGE, a frame selection framework that reads the frame-query similarity curve as a temporal signal. By using local changes and curvature, RIDGE partitions the timeline into structural regions and applies region-specific selection to preserve event cores, transitions, buildup, aftermath, and contextual frames under a fixed budget. It is a lightweight post-processing step on precomputed frame-query scores and requires neither training nor iterative LVLM calls. Across four long-video benchmarks and three backbones, RIDGE achieves the best performance in most settings and remains competitive in the others.
summary_zh: 长视频包含的视觉内容远超过大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在固定视觉token预算下的处理能力，因此帧选择环节至关重要。现有查询感知选择器通常会估计帧与查询的相关性，从高分帧中构建紧凑子集。尽管不同方法的机制存在差异，但相关性序列往往仅被当作用于排序或采样的数值，而非反映查询相关证据随时间出现、达到峰值、消退规律的有序信号。这会导致解释事件、提供上下文或事件后续的帧被忽略，这类证据往往位于相关性峰值的上升沿或下降沿，绝对得分较低。本文提出RIDGE（全称为Region-Informed Derivative-Guided Evidence Selection，即区域感知导数引导证据选择），一种将帧-查询相关性曲线作为时序信号处理的帧选择框架。RIDGE利用局部变化和曲率特征，将时间线划分为多个结构区域，针对不同区域采用差异化的选择策略，在固定预算下同时保留事件核心、过渡阶段、事件铺垫、事件余波和上下文帧。该方法是在预计算的帧-查询得分上执行的轻量后处理步骤，无需训练，也不需要迭代调用大视觉语言模型。在四个长视频基准集和三个骨干网络上的实验结果表明，RIDGE在绝大多数场景下都取得了最优性能，其余场景下也具备极强的竞争力。

title: On the Role of MRI Sequences in Cross-Dataset Generalization for Brain Tumor Segmentation
title_zh: MRI序列在脑肿瘤分割跨数据集泛化中的作用研究
authors: Henrique Zan Grande, João G. Pitol, Lucas B. Schuck, Rafael V. Serenato, Rayson Laroca 等 (6 人)
abstract: Brain tumor segmentation in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a critical task for diagnosis and treatment planning. Despite the success of deep learning architectures such as U-Net and its variants, performance degradation across datasets remains a major challenge, particularly under domain shift and limited annotated data. To address this issue, this study systematically evaluates how individual MRI sequences influence model robustness across two well-known datasets. A ResUNet-based framework is employed, where each modality is trained independently to isolate its effect under a controlled cross-dataset evaluation protocol with tumor size stratification, without target-domain training, or with limited domain adaptation. Results show that the T2f/FLAIR sequence achieves the best cross-dataset performance, with Dice scores exceeding 75%. It consistently outperforms other modalities across most tumor size ranges, while multi-sequence training further improves performance. Additionally, even limited target-domain adaptation yields rapid initial gains, reducing the need for extensive annotations and costly retraining. Our source code is publicly available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 磁共振成像（MRI）脑肿瘤分割是诊断和治疗规划的核心任务。尽管U-Net及其变体等深度学习架构已经取得了优异性能，但跨数据集场景下的性能下降仍是当前面临的主要挑战，在域偏移和标注数据有限的场景下问题尤为突出。为解决该问题，本研究系统评估了不同MRI序列在两个知名数据集上对模型鲁棒性的影响。研究采用基于ResUNet的框架，在控制肿瘤大小分层、不使用目标域训练数据或仅使用有限域自适应的跨数据集评估协议下，对每个模态单独训练以隔离其作用。结果表明，T2f/FLAIR序列的跨数据集性能最优，Dice得分超过75%，在绝大多数肿瘤大小区间下的表现都持续优于其他模态，而多序列联合训练可以进一步提升性能。此外，即使是非常有限的目标域自适应也能快速带来初始性能提升，降低了对大量标注数据和高成本重训练的需求。相关源代码已公开至对应链接。

title: Evaluating 2D and 3D-Aware Vision Foundation Models for Vehicle Attribute Recognition
title_zh: 面向车辆属性识别的2D与3D感知视觉基础模型评估
authors: Alexandre V. Delazeri, Gabriel E. Lima, Eduil Nascimento Jr, Rayson Laroca, David Menotti
abstract: Vehicle attribute recognition is an important task in intelligent transportation systems, particularly when Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) is unavailable or unreliable. Although vision foundation models have shown strong transferability across domains, their effectiveness for fine-grained vehicle classification remains underexplored. Moreover, given the inherently three-dimensional structure of vehicles, it is unclear whether emerging 3D-aware foundation models offer advantages over standard 2D architectures. This paper presents an empirical benchmark of 14 state-of-the-art 2D and 3D-aware vision foundation models. Using the challenging real-world UFPR-VeSV dataset, we evaluate these models as frozen feature extractors via linear probing for vehicle type, make, and model recognition. We further stress-test the best-performing models under few-shot learning and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) domain shifts. Our results show that standard 2D self-supervised models, particularly DINOv3, substantially outperform 3D-aware models in fine-grained tasks, achieving over 93% Macro-Accuracy for make and model recognition. However, the 3D-aware Depth Anything v2 exhibits stronger invariance to viewing angles in vehicle type classification. These findings motivate hybrid approaches that combine 2D and 3D priors for robust vehicle recognition. Our code is publicly available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 车辆属性识别是智能交通系统中的重要任务，在自动车牌识别（ALPR）不可用或不可靠的场景下作用尤为突出。尽管视觉基础模型在跨域迁移任务中表现出极强的能力，但这类模型在细粒度车辆分类任务上的有效性仍有待探索。此外，由于车辆本身具备三维结构，新兴的3D感知基础模型是否比标准2D架构更具优势仍不明确。本文对14个当前最先进的2D和3D感知视觉基础模型开展了实证基准测试，在极具挑战性的真实世界UFPR-VeSV数据集上，通过线性探测将这些模型作为冻结特征提取器，评估其在车辆类型、品牌和型号识别任务上的性能。我们进一步在少样本学习和分布外（OOD）域偏移场景下对性能最优的模型进行压力测试。结果表明，标准2D自监督模型（尤其是DINOv3）在细粒度任务上的表现大幅优于3D感知模型，车辆品牌和型号识别的宏观准确率超过93%；但3D感知模型Depth Anything v2在车辆类型分类任务中对视角变化的不变性更强。上述研究结论为融合2D和3D先验的混合鲁棒车辆识别方法提供了动机。相关代码已公开至对应链接。

title: Biomechanical 3D Body: Self-Supervised Distillation of Biomechanical Pose from a 3D Body Foundation Model
title_zh: Biomechanical 3D Body：从3D人体基础模型自监督蒸馏生物力学姿态
authors: R. James Cotton, J.D. Peiffer, Lucinda Williamson, John Leske, Georgios Pavlakos
abstract: State-of-the-art monocular body recovery methods predict mesh vertices and angles on the corresponding kinematic tree, but their outputs lack biomechanically defined joint angles that downstream applications like clinical and biomechanical analyses require. We extend an existing foundation model, SAM-3D-Body, with an additional biomechanical prediction head that, from a single RGB image, regresses the joint angles and scales of a biomechanical model. Training this model presents a challenge, as there are limited datasets of paired images and biomechanical fits. To overcome this, we supervise biomechanical outputs with in-loop optimized targets from a Levenberg-Marquardt solver performing inverse kinematics fits against markers from the mesh predictions. This allows distilling the biomechanical head from the mesh head, even from unlabeled images. To make this work with GPU-optimized biomechanical models in MuJoCo, the entire model was implemented in JAX using Equinox. We trained this distilled output head on the publicly released SAM-3D-Body dataset. We then validated this model on biomechanical fits to two publicly available marker-based datasets, MoVi and BioCV, as well as movements from a clinical cohort captured with multiview markerless motion capture. The resulting model outperforms existing models for direct regression of biomechanics from images while only slightly underperforming the state-of-the-art monocular biomechanics method that performs more costly inference-time optimization of entire trajectories.
summary_zh: 当前最先进的单目人体恢复方法可以预测对应运动学树上的网格顶点和角度，但输出结果缺少临床分析、生物力学分析等下游应用所需的生物力学定义关节角度。本研究对现有基础模型SAM-3D-Body进行扩展，新增生物力学预测头，可从单张RGB图像回归得到生物力学模型的关节角度和缩放参数。训练该模型面临的核心挑战是图像与生物力学拟合结果的配对数据集十分有限。为解决该问题，我们利用Levenberg-Marquardt求解器对网格预测结果中的标记点执行逆运动学拟合，将求解器在循环中优化得到的目标作为生物力学输出的监督信号，实现从网格预测头向生物力学头的知识蒸馏，甚至可以利用无标注图像完成训练。为适配MuJoCo中经过GPU优化的生物力学模型，整个模型基于Equinox在JAX框架中实现。我们在公开的SAM-3D-Body数据集上训练该蒸馏输出头，随后在两个公开的基于标记点的数据集MoVi和BioCV，以及通过多视角无标记动作采集得到的临床队列运动数据上对模型进行验证。最终得到的模型在从图像直接回归生物力学参数的任务上性能优于现有模型，仅略逊于当前最先进的单目生物力学方法——后者需要在推理阶段对整条轨迹执行成本更高的优化操作。

title: Everybody Tracking Every Body
title_zh: 全员全身追踪：面向多交互人员的中心化协同第一视角3D人体姿态估计
authors: Daeyun Shin, Yunhan Zhao, Shu Kong, Alexander C. Berg, Charless Fowlkes
abstract: We address the problem of 3D body pose estimation of multiple interacting people from their egocentric views with centralized coordination. Each individual wears a camera recording egocentric video and IMU data. Processing this video with VIO SLAM provides high-quality tracking of each egocentric camera through space. The first-person view from one individual provides third-person observations of other people, although these exocentric observations are sparse, intermittent, and of highly variable reliability as both cameras and subjects move. To integrate these synchronized data streams, we propose a diffusion-based approach that fuses estimates of pose based on head motion derived from egocentric camera motion with exocentric pose observations, conditioning on both observation content and reliability. Our model is trained on a mixture of single-person motion-capture data and multi-person video in order to learn rich priors for body motion trajectories and video observation reliability. Evaluation on challenging multi-person datasets suggests our fusion approach improves over motion-only and vision-only baselines in terms of both absolute and relative pose accuracy.
summary_zh: 本文研究了从多交互人员的第一视角图像出发、通过中心化协同实现3D人体姿态估计的问题。每名受试者佩戴可拍摄第一视角视频与IMU数据的相机，通过视觉惯性同时定位与地图构建（VIO SLAM）处理该视频，即可对每台第一视角相机的空间运动实现高精度追踪。单一个体的第一视角可作为第三人称观测源获取其他人员的观测结果，但由于相机与受试者均处于运动状态，这类外视角观测存在稀疏性、间歇性、可靠性波动大的问题。为融合这些同步数据流，本文提出一种基于扩散的方法，将从第一视角相机运动推导得到的头部运动姿态估计结果与外视角姿态观测结果相融合，融合过程同时考虑观测内容与观测可靠性。该模型在单人动作捕捉数据与多人视频的混合数据集上训练，学习人体运动轨迹与视频观测可靠性的丰富先验知识。在高难度多人数据集上的评估结果表明，该融合方法在绝对姿态精度与相对姿态精度两个维度上均优于仅使用运动信息、仅使用视觉信息的基线方法。

title: Dior: Drawing the Light of Image via Material-Decoupled Illumination Representation
title_zh: Dior：基于材质解耦光照表征的图像光照绘制方法
authors: Xuanpu Zhang, Xuesong Niu, Haoxiang Cao, Ruidong Chen, Jianhao Zeng 等 (6 人)
abstract: Controllable image relighting is an important problem in image editing, and hand-drawn scribbles provide an intuitive interface for specifying the desired illumination. However, existing methods do not establish a consistent and effective mapping between scribble inputs and relighting results, limiting their ability to control illumination intensity, chromaticity, and complex spatial distributions. We address this limitation by introducing a material-decoupled illumination representation, termed the Lumi Map, which establishes an explicit mapping between user scribbles and the resulting illumination, thereby improving both relighting accuracy and controllability. Specifically, we use a renderer to synthesize source image-Lumi Map-relit image triplets and train the model to predict the target relighting result conditioned on the Lumi Map. To mitigate the domain gap introduced by synthetic data, we further perform reconstruction training on real relighting pairs, improving the model's generalization to real-world images. Finally, we present Dior-Light, an image relighting method controlled by hand-drawn strokes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in relighting accuracy and enables effective control over illumination intensity and chromaticity on in-the-wild images.
summary_zh: 可控图像重光照是图像编辑领域的核心问题，手绘涂鸦为用户指定目标光照效果提供了直观的交互接口。但现有方法无法在涂鸦输入与重光照结果之间建立一致有效的映射，限制了其对光照强度、色度与复杂空间分布的控制能力。针对该局限，本文提出一种材质解耦的光照表征，命名为光图（Lumi Map），该表征在用户涂鸦与最终生成的光照效果之间建立了显式映射，同时提升了重光照的精度与可控性。具体而言，本文使用渲染器合成「源图像-光图-重光照后图像」三元组，训练模型以光图为条件预测目标重光照结果。为缓解合成数据带来的域偏移问题，本文进一步在真实重光照配对数据上开展重建训练，提升模型对真实世界图像的泛化能力。最终本文提出Dior-Light，一种由手绘笔触控制的图像重光照方法。大量实验表明，该方法的重光照精度优于现有方案，可对自然场景图像的光照强度与色度实现有效控制。

title: Hallucination Mitigation for Large Vision-Language Models via Implicit Feature Stabilization
title_zh: 基于隐式特征稳定的大视觉语言模型幻觉抑制方法
authors: Aditi Sarker, Rafi Ibn Sultan, Hui Zhu, Dongxiao Zhu, Prashant Khanduri
abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are prone to hallucinations: they fluently describe objects, attributes, and scenes that are not in the image. We connect part of this failure to a measurable property of their representations, feature instability, where mild semantics-preserving perturbations of the input cause large changes in the learned embeddings; hallucination rates rise together with this variability. Existing stability-motivated remedies are explicit, in the sense that they intervene at inference time through latent steering or constrained decoding, and pay for it on every query. We propose implicit stabilization instead: perturbation-invariance is built into the model weights during fine-tuning, and nothing extra runs at deployment. Our framework, INFUSE, first stabilizes visual and textual representations around perturbation-averaged and ground-truth anchors, then aligns the stabilized representations across modalities with bidirectional contrastive objectives. We prove that the anchor's root-mean-square deviation from the perturbation-mean representation shrinks at rate $1/\sqrt{K}$ in the number of views, and that under a Lipschitz decoder, this bounds how much any perturbation can change the model's hallucination behavior. On LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-1.6, and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, INFUSE reduces AMBER CHAIR by 46-63% relative to each base model, improves ObjHal, MMHal, HallusionBench, and POPE, and preserves VQA-v2 and TextVQA, all with no inference-time overhead.
summary_zh: 大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）普遍存在幻觉问题：模型会流畅地描述图像中不存在的物体、属性与场景。本文将这类故障的部分成因与模型表征的可测量属性「特征不稳定性」相关联：输入仅发生不改变语义的轻微扰动时，模型学习得到的嵌入会出现大幅变化，且幻觉率与该特征波动程度同步上升。现有面向稳定性的解决方案均为显式方案，需要在推理阶段通过隐空间引导或约束解码实现干预，每次查询都需要额外计算开销。本文提出隐式稳定方案：在微调阶段就将扰动不变性嵌入模型权重，部署阶段无需额外运算。本文提出的框架INFUSE首先以扰动平均结果与真值为锚点，稳定视觉与文本表征，随后通过双向对比学习目标对齐跨模态的稳定表征。本文从理论上证明，锚点相对于扰动平均表征的均方根偏差会随视图数量K以1/√K的速率下降，且在Lipschitz解码器约束下，该偏差可限制任意扰动对模型幻觉行为的影响程度。在LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-1.6与Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct模型上的实验结果显示，INFUSE可将AMBER CHAIR指标相对基线模型降低46%-63%，在ObjHal、MMHal、HallusionBench与POPE数据集上的表现均有提升，同时保留了VQA-v2与TextVQA任务的性能，全程无推理阶段额外开销。

title: Towards Continual Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models in Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
title_zh: 面向开放词汇语义分割的视觉语言模型持续测试时自适应研究
authors: Chandler Timm C. Doloriel, Yunbei Zhang, Sarthak Kumar Maharana, Muhammad Salman Siddiqui, Tor Kristian Stevik 等 (8 人)
abstract: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) relies on vision-language alignment to recognize arbitrary text-defined categories, yet this alignment is fragile under continual test-time distribution shift. Our diagnostic analysis reveals that entropy minimization drives patch-level class collapse, continual updates erode vision-language alignment, and redundant gradients from low-shift samples waste computation. We propose Diversify, Anchor, and Filter (DAF), a stabilization framework that augments entropy-based adaptation with a marginal diversity loss that resists collapse, a cross-modal anchor consistency loss that constrains feature drift relative to a frozen source model, and feature salience filtering that skips low-value backward passes to offset part of the source-anchor overhead. We evaluate on five datasets spanning natural scenes, autonomous driving, underwater imagery, and remote sensing with their corrupted variants. Across the evaluated continual shifts, DAF remains stable where entropy minimization collapses, improving mIoU by over 8 points on Pascal VOC20-C, over 9 points on LoveDA, and over 3 points on Foggy Cityscapes compared to the source model, and is robust to aggressive adaptation and learning rate choices.
summary_zh: 开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）依赖视觉-语言对齐机制识别任意文本定义的类别，但该对齐关系在持续测试时分布偏移场景下十分脆弱。本文通过诊断分析发现：熵最小化会驱动图像块级别的类别坍缩，持续更新过程会侵蚀视觉-语言对齐关系，低偏移样本产生的冗余梯度会浪费计算资源。基于上述发现，本文提出「多样化-锚定-过滤（Diversify, Anchor, Filter, DAF）」稳定框架，在基于熵的自适应机制基础上补充三类优化：边际多样性损失用于对抗类别坍缩，跨模态锚点一致性损失用于约束特征相对于冻结源模型的漂移，特征显著性过滤用于跳过低价值反向传播过程，抵消源锚点机制带来的额外开销。本文在覆盖自然场景、自动驾驶、水下影像、遥感场景的5个数据集及其损坏变体上开展评估，结果显示在各类持续偏移场景下，熵最小化方法会出现性能坍缩，而DAF始终保持稳定：与源模型相比，其在Pascal VOC20-C数据集上的mIoU提升超过8个点，在LoveDA数据集上提升超过9个点，在Foggy Cityscapes数据集上提升超过3个点，且对激进自适应策略与学习率的选择具备鲁棒性。

title: Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Entropy Sensitivity-Guidance in Strict Online Setting
title_zh: 严格在线场景下基于熵灵敏度引导的持续测试时自适应方法
authors: Chandler Timm C. Doloriel, Yunbei Zhang, Muhammad Salman Siddiqui, Tor Kristian Stevik, Fadi Al Machot 等 (7 人)
abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) promises robustness under distribution shift by updating a pretrained model on unlabeled test data, but strict online TTA with batch size one and no access to source data is especially prone to drift or collapse. We introduce Sensitivity-Guided Erasing Adaptation (SEGA), a method for strict online continual TTA (CTTA) on corruption-style streams. SEGA uses a small number of structured erasures to probe how predictive entropy changes as information is removed, and uses the resulting per-sample sensitivity trajectories to coordinate recovery and sample selection rather than relying on raw entropy or batch statistics. This yields a practical feedback signal for long-horizon batch-size-one adaptation without periodic resets or model reservoirs. In experiments on ImageNet-C, CIFAR10/100-C, and corruption-generated aquaculture streams treated as controlled corruption-style proxies, SEGA yields consistent robustness and stability gains over strong CTTA baselines while reducing backward passes through sensitivity-based gating.
summary_zh: 测试时自适应（TTA）可通过在无标注测试数据上更新预训练模型，实现分布偏移场景下的鲁棒性，但批次大小为1、无法访问源数据的严格在线测试时自适应场景极易出现模型漂移或坍缩问题。本文提出灵敏度引导擦除自适应（Sensitivity-Guided Erasing Adaptation, SEGA）方法，面向损坏类型数据流实现严格在线持续测试时自适应（CTTA）。SEGA通过少量结构化擦除操作探测信息移除过程中预测熵的变化规律，利用得到的逐样本灵敏度轨迹协调模型恢复过程与样本选择过程，无需依赖原始熵值或批次统计量。该方法可为无周期性重置、无模型缓存的长时序批次大小为1的自适应任务提供实用的反馈信号。在ImageNet-C、CIFAR10/100-C与作为受控损坏代理的水产养殖损坏数据流上的实验结果显示，SEGA相比现有优秀CTTA基线方法获得了一致的鲁棒性与稳定性提升，同时通过基于灵敏度的门控机制减少了反向传播次数。

title: FoundYou: A Unified Model for Personalized Segmentation and Retrieval
title_zh: FoundYou：面向个性化分割与检索的统一模型
authors: Gabriele Trivigno, Marcos Alfaro, Claudia Cuttano, Gabriele Berton, Luis Payá 等 (6 人)
abstract: Personalized segmentation and personalized retrieval both aim to identify the same physical object across different images. While the former localizes the object within a target image, the latter retrieves images where it appears. Despite this shared instance-level objective, the two tasks have largely evolved separately and are addressed with distinct solutions. In this work, we introduce FoundYou, a unified framework built on the observation that Segment Anything 2 (SAM 2), trained to preserve object identity across video frames, inherently captures instance-level cues. We leverage this property to match objects across independent images, enabling segmentation and retrieval to emerge as two outcomes of the same instance alignment process. This unified view unlocks new capabilities beyond traditional benchmarks, including few-shot personalized retrieval and promptable personalized segmentation with flexible prompts. Extensive experiments show consistent gains over unified and task-specific methods, including +18.4 mIoU on PerMIS and +17.8 mAP on ILIAS. Performance scales with additional references and remains robust to weaker prompts. Beyond personalization, FoundYou achieves state-of-the-art results on category-level retrieval benchmarks. Notably, our approach keeps the SAM 2-small model entirely frozen and adds only 5.9 M trainable parameters, yielding a 52 M-parameter model that is over 75x faster and 20x smaller than the only prior unified solution. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 个性化分割与个性化检索的目标均为跨不同图像识别同一物理对象：前者在目标图像中定位该对象，后者检索包含该对象的所有图像。尽管二者共享实例级别的任务目标，但两类任务长期独立发展，采用完全不同的解决方案。本文提出统一框架FoundYou，其设计思路基于如下观察：训练用于跨视频帧保留对象身份的分割一切模型2（Segment Anything 2, SAM 2），天然具备提取实例级线索的能力。本文利用该特性实现跨独立图像的对象匹配，让分割与检索成为同一实例对齐过程的两类输出。该统一范式解锁了传统基准之外的全新能力，包括小样本个性化检索、支持灵活提示的可提示个性化分割。大量实验表明，该方法相比现有统一方案与单任务方案获得了一致性能提升：在PerMIS数据集上mIoU提升18.4，在ILIAS数据集上mAP提升17.8，性能随参考样本数量增加而提升，且对质量较差的提示具备鲁棒性。除个性化任务外，FoundYou在类别级检索基准上也取得了当前最优性能。值得注意的是，该方案完全冻结SAM 2-small模型，仅新增5.9M可训练参数，最终得到的模型参数量为52M，速度是现有唯一同类统一方案的75倍以上，体积仅为后者的1/20，代码已公开。

title: Matrix-Game 3.5: Enhancing Real-Time Streaming Interactive World Models with Patch Memory
title_zh: Matrix-Game 3.5：基于块记忆的实时流式交互世界模型增强方法
authors: Runjia Qian, Zile Wang, Jihai Zhang, Kai Zou, Wei Yu 等 (17 人)
abstract: Interactive world models extend video generation from offline clip synthesis toward persistent simulation of interactive virtual worlds, enabling applications in games, robotics, embodied agents, and XR. Achieving stable long-horizon interactive generation, however, remains challenging, as the model must simultaneously preserve scene geometry, dynamic consistency, and camera control while supporting real-time autoregressive generation. Building upon Matrix-Game 3.0, we present Matrix-Game 3.5, as shown in Figure 1, which advances real-time interactive world generation toward geometry-aware and long-horizon consistent simulation through three key improvements. First, we propose a unified geometry-aware memory framework, whose patch-memory and tiled-PRoPE components introduce no additional learnable parameters, combining explicit 3D patch retrieval with projective camera conditioning to enable geometry-consistent camera control and faithful long-horizon scene recall. Second, we introduce a static-dynamic disentangled world representation that separately models static scene geometry and dynamic subjects, preserving both geometric consistency and subject identity throughout long-horizon generation. Third, we develop a two-stage progressive real-time distillation framework that converts a bidirectional diffusion model into a few-step causal generator through Perceptual Flow Matching and curriculum based Self-Rollout DMD, enabling minute-long real-time interactive generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, with a unified training corpus spanning Unreal simulation environments, open-world games, and internet videos, MatrixGame 3.5 achieves strong performance in long-horizon scene recall, precise camera control, subject consistency, prompt-driven world generation, and stable real-time open-world interaction.
summary_zh: 交互世界模型将视频生成从离线片段合成拓展到交互式虚拟世界的持久仿真场景，可支撑游戏、机器人、具身智能体与XR领域的各类应用。但实现稳定的长时序交互生成仍存在较大挑战：模型需要同时保留场景几何一致性、动态一致性与相机控制能力，同时支持实时自回归生成。在Matrix-Game 3.0的基础上，本文提出Matrix-Game 3.5，通过三项核心改进将实时交互世界生成推向几何感知、长时序一致的仿真层级：第一，提出统一的几何感知记忆框架，其包含的块记忆（patch-memory）与分块PRoPE组件不引入额外可学习参数，将显式3D块检索与投影相机条件约束相结合，实现几何一致的相机控制与精准的长时序场景召回；第二，提出静态-动态解耦的世界表征，分别对静态场景几何与动态主体建模，在长时序生成过程中同时保留几何一致性与主体身份；第三，开发两阶段渐进式实时蒸馏框架，通过感知流匹配与基于课程学习的自滚动DMD，将双向扩散模型转换为少步长因果生成器，支持分钟级时长的实时交互生成。大量实验表明，在覆盖虚幻引擎仿真环境、开放世界游戏与互联网视频的统一训练语料支撑下，MatrixGame 3.5在长时序场景召回、精准相机控制、主体一致性、提示驱动世界生成、稳定实时开放世界交互等任务上均取得优异性能。

title: OrnaStyler: Ornament-Aware Latent Editing for Content-Preserving 3D Stylization
title_zh: OrnaStyler：面向内容保留3D风格化的装饰感知隐式编辑方法
authors: Tomohiro Aizawa, Shigeru Kuriyama, Chunzhi Gu
abstract: Text-guided style editing of 3D assets is essential for adapting existing objects to diverse visual aesthetics in digital content creation. Despite rapid progress in 3D shape modeling, faithfully stylizing an existing asset remains challenging when the desired stylization involves fine-grained structural ornamentation, which requires the model to preserve the source geometry and object identity, while coherently integrating new style-specific details. We propose \textbf{OrnaStyler}, a zero-shot framework for text-guided ornament-aware 3D stylization. Built upon rectified flow-based generative modeling, OrnaStyler introduces an inversion-guided editing strategy that recovers content-aware latent representations at both geometry and appearance levels in a staged manner to facilitate faithful editing. Our core idea is to explicitly model the spatial configuration of stylistic elements, thereby mitigating the fundamental tension between content preservation and style expression in the voxel space. Specifically, at the geometry level, we manipulate voxel representations through flow inversion to synthesize ornament-enhanced structures while preserving the spatial identity of the source asset. Then, at the appearance level, we introduce an adjacency-aware feature inpainting mechanism to harmonize newly generated ornaments with the original content, yielding coherent geometry-appearance integration. Our approach operates solely in the inference phase and enables selective editing over geometric augmentation or appearance stylization. Extensive experiments on both generated and real-world 3D assets against prior methods demonstrate that OrnaStyler achieves state-of-the-art editing performance in terms of content preservation, style fidelity, and overall visual realism. Code is available at:this https URL
summary_zh: 3D资产的文本引导风格编辑是数字内容创作领域适配现有对象到多元视觉美学的核心技术。尽管3D形状建模技术发展迅速，当目标风格化涉及细粒度结构装饰时，现有方案仍难以实现对现有资产的精准风格化：这类任务要求模型在保留源几何结构与对象身份的同时，连贯地融合全新的风格专属细节。本文提出零样本框架OrnaStyler，用于实现文本引导的装饰感知3D风格化。该框架基于整流流生成建模技术构建，引入反转引导编辑策略，分阶段恢复几何与外观层级的内容感知隐表征，支撑精准编辑。其核心思路是显式建模风格元素的空间布局，缓解体素空间中内容保留与风格表达的固有冲突：具体而言，在几何层级，通过流反转操作处理体素表征，生成装饰增强的结构，同时保留源资产的空间身份；在外观层级，引入邻接感知特征修复机制，让新生成的装饰与原始内容自然融合，实现几何与外观的连贯统一。该方法仅在推理阶段运行，支持对几何增强或外观风格化的选择性编辑。在生成式与真实世界3D资产上开展的对比实验表明，OrnaStyler在内容保留度、风格保真度与整体视觉真实度维度上均取得当前最优编辑性能，代码已公开。

title: Off-Manifold Refinement: Guiding Video Generators with a Frozen World Model
title_zh: 流形外优化：基于冻结世界模型引导的视频生成器
authors: Hai Nguyen-Truong, Tuan-Anh Vu, Dang Huynh
abstract: Modern video generators routinely fail at physical dynamics: objects float, trajectories violate gravity, contacts vanish. Standard denoising and flow-matching objectives fit visual data distributions but do not explicitly penalize such physical violations. Existing remedies can improve physical consistency, but typically add substantial inference or training cost. Candidate-selection methods generate and score multiple videos, while gradient-based world-model guidance repeatedly decodes and re-encodes intermediate estimates. Generator-internal refinement adds perturbation and re-denoising loops, whereas post-training requires curated data and additional optimization. We propose Off-Manifold Refinement (OMR), an inference-time method that instead injects world-model feedback directly into a single sampling trajectory. During scheduled middle ODE steps, we augment the generator velocity with the gradient of an adapter-space V-JEPA 2.1 surprise energy. This external correction can move the latent away from the uncorrected sampling trajectory and toward regions ranked as more physically plausible by the frozen predictor, after which the generator continues rendering from the corrected state. A small trained latent-to-embedding adapter keeps the gradient tractable at inference, and both the video generator and the world model remain frozen. On our fixed 400-prompt VideoPhy-2 detailed subset, OMR lifts the joint Semantic-Adherence-and-Physical-Commonsense metric from 47.0% to 52.0% (+5.0pp absolute, +10.6% relative) over the base Wan2.2-T2V-A14B sampler. On a separate fixed 50-prompt efficiency subset, it requires $1.71 \times$ the base runtime rather than the multiplicative cost of reward/search alternatives. Project page:this https URL.
summary_zh: 当前主流视频生成器普遍存在物理动力学错误：对象漂浮、运动轨迹违反重力规则、接触关系消失等问题。标准去噪与流匹配目标仅拟合视觉数据分布，不会显式惩罚这类物理违规行为。现有改进方案可提升物理一致性，但通常会带来极高的推理或训练成本：候选选择类方法需要生成并打分多个视频，基于梯度的世界模型引导方案需要反复解码、重编码中间结果，生成器内部优化方案需要新增扰动与重复去噪循环，训练后优化方案需要精心筛选数据与额外的优化过程。本文提出流形外优化（Off-Manifold Refinement, OMR），一种推理阶段方法，可将世界模型反馈直接注入单条采样轨迹。在调度后的ODE中间步，本文通过适配器空间V-JEPA 2.1的惊喜能量梯度增强生成器速度，该外部校正项可将隐变量从无校正采样轨迹移动到冻结预测器判定为物理合理性更高的区域，之后生成器从校正后的状态继续渲染。少量训练得到的隐变量到嵌入适配器可保证推理阶段梯度的可计算性，视频生成器与世界模型全程保持冻结。在包含400条提示的VideoPhy-2详细子集上的实验结果显示，OMR可将Wan2.2-T2V-A14B基础采样器的语义一致性与物理常识联合指标从47.0%提升至52.0%（绝对提升5.0个百分点，相对提升10.6%）。在包含50条提示的独立效率子集上，OMR的运行时长仅为基础采样器的1.71倍，远低于基于奖励/搜索的其他替代方案的乘法级增长开销，项目主页已公开。

title: MASQ: Mask-Aware Spatiotemporal Quantization for Unsupervised Skeleton Action Segmentation
title_zh: MASQ：面向无监督骨架动作分割的掩码感知时空量化方法
authors: Xinyao Qin, Linxiang Peng, Youbao Ye, Di Yang, Jiangtao Wang
abstract: Unsupervised skeleton-based temporal action segmentation is a crucial task for understanding human behavior in long untrimmed sequences. Recent approaches often rely on discrete quantization to discover action boundaries from motion representations. However, when spatial masking is introduced for representation learning, it can introduce representation ambiguity, while discrete quantization further amplifies small fluctuations in the latent space. The interaction between these two factors often leads to unstable code switching and severe temporal jitter near actionthis http URLaddress these limitations, we propose a novel Mask-aware Action Spatiotemporal Quantization (MASQ) framework. Our framework decouples the conflicting tasks of spatial feature inference and temporalthis http URLthe spatial dimension, we introduce a Joint-Level Structured Dropout (JLSD) mechanism that masks the entire temporal trajectory of selected joints, to encourage the model to learn discriminative inter-joint coordination patterns. In the temporal dimension, we design a mask-aware velocity loss that enforces motion consistency only on visible joints, that prevents gradient conflicts caused by masked signals and stabilizing temporal predictions. Extensive experiments on three widely used skeleton datasets, including HuGaDB, LARa, and BABEL, demonstrate that the proposed MASQ framework significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art unsupervised methods. In particular, our model establishes a comprehensive and substantial leading advantage in the Mean over Frames accuracy.
summary_zh: 基于骨架的无监督时序动作分割是理解长时序未修剪序列中人类行为的核心任务。近期相关方法普遍依赖离散量化技术从运动表征中发现动作边界，但当引入空间掩码开展表征学习时，会引发表征歧义问题，而离散量化操作会进一步放大隐空间中的微小波动，两类因素的交互作用通常会导致动作边界附近出现不稳定的码切换现象与严重的时序抖动问题。针对上述局限，本文提出全新的掩码感知动作时空量化（Mask-aware Action Spatiotemporal Quantization, MASQ）框架，解耦空间特征推理与时序量化的冲突任务。在空间维度，本文提出关节级结构化丢弃（Joint-Level Structured Dropout, JLSD）机制，对选中关节的全时序轨迹执行掩码操作，引导模型学习具备区分度的关节间协同模式。在时序维度，本文设计掩码感知速度损失，仅在可见关节上强制运动一致性，避免掩码信号引发的梯度冲突，稳定时序预测结果。在HuGaDB、LARa与BABEL三个主流骨架数据集上的大量实验表明，提出的MASQ框架性能显著优于现有最优无监督方法，尤其在帧级平均精度指标上具备全面且显著的领先优势。

title: OptiGeo: Efficient Monocular Geometry for Embodied Perception in Optically Challenging Scenes
title_zh: OptiGeo：面向光学挑战性场景具身感知的高效单目几何方法
authors: Muxin Liu, Tianbo Liu, Jing Xia, Xiaoyang Lyu, Xiaoshan Wu 等 (10 人)
abstract: Monocular depth estimation has achieved strong open-domain generalization, yet reliable robotic deployment remains difficult in transparent, reflective, and specular environments, where depth sensors often produce missing or biased depth. Existing methods often handle such optical failures with scene-specific preprocessing, auxiliary modules, or post-hoc fine-tuning. While effective in constrained settings, these designs increase architectural redundancy and can over-specialize general geometry models to narrow optical scenarios. We revisit this problem as a localized failure mode within base-model training and identify sensor-induced supervision bias as a key bottleneck: models inherit sensor failure patterns from biased real-depth supervision in optically challenging regions. We then introduce OptiGeo, a bias-aware training framework that rehabilitates biased real supervision using a clean-geometry teacher and residual-trimmed alignment. We redefine transparency-targeted rendering as a compact source of clean optical geometry, rather than a large domain-specific fine-tuning set. With only a small targeted rendering set, OptiGeo learns the geometric structure of transparent objects and regions, correcting local geometry distortions that real sensors cannot reliably supervise. Despite only 30M parameters, OptiGeo outperforms substantially larger 300M-scale monocular models and billion-scale multi-view baselines on transparent-scene benchmarks, while remaining competitive on general zero-shot depth and boundary sharpness. Real-world navigation cases further validate its practicality as an efficient perception module in optically challenging scenes.
summary_zh: 单目深度估计已实现较强的开放域泛化能力，但在透明、反光、镜面环境中，深度传感器往往输出缺失或存在偏差的深度值，导致相关方法在机器人端的可靠部署仍十分困难。现有方法通常采用场景专属预处理、辅助模块或事后微调来处理这类光学失效问题，这类方案在受限场景下有效，但会增加架构冗余，还可能让通用几何模型过度特化到狭窄的光学场景中。本文将该问题重新定义为基础模型训练过程中的局部失效模式，发现传感器引入的监督偏差是核心瓶颈：模型会从光学挑战性区域中存在偏差的真实深度监督信号里继承传感器的失效模式。为此本文提出OptiGeo——一种偏差感知训练框架，通过干净几何教师模型和残差裁剪对齐机制修正存在偏差的真实监督信号。本文将面向透明场景的渲染重新定义为干净光学几何的紧凑数据源，而非大规模领域专属微调集。仅使用少量目标渲染数据集，OptiGeo就能学习透明物体与区域的几何结构，修正真实传感器无法可靠监督的局部几何畸变。尽管仅含30M参数，OptiGeo在透明场景基准测试集上的表现远超参数量大得多的300M级单目模型与十亿级多视图基线方法，同时在通用零样本深度估计与边界清晰度任务上仍保持竞争力。真实场景导航案例进一步验证了其作为高效感知模块在光学挑战性场景中的实用性。

title: MariSat: A Maritime Dataset for Instance Segmentation of Objects in Satellite and Aerial Images
title_zh: MariSat：面向卫星与航拍图像海事目标实例分割的数据集
authors: Amir Abbes, Ines Harrabi, Lucas Justin Yirepoa Kinda, Rim Trabelsi, Adnane Cabani 等 (6 人)
abstract: Automated maritime surveillance from satellite and aerial imagery requires large, precisely annotated datasets, which remain scarce for the instance-segmentation task, particularly for small vessels in cluttered port environments. We present MariSat, a new benchmark dataset of 1260 aerial and satellite images covering diverse port and coastal scenes, annotated at the pixel level for eight maritime object classes (sailboat, yacht, jet-ski, fishing boat, cruise ship, military vessel, tugboat and cargo ship). The dataset was produced through a semi-automatic annotation pipeline combining the textpromptable segmentation model SAM 3 with a cascade of geometric and colorimetric post-processing filters, followed by a manual correction and quality-control pass performed with the CVAT annotation platform. We describe the image-collection methodology, the annotation and correction process, and the resulting data organization. We also report class-wise statistics for the training, validation, and test splits. MariSat has already been used to fine-tune and benchmark segmentation and detection models (SAM 3 and YOLO11) for real-time maritime monitoring. We report detailed quantitative and per-class results for both tasks. The MariSat dataset is publicly available on GitHub :this https URL
summary_zh: 基于卫星与航拍图像的自动化海事监测需要大量标注精确的数据集，而当前实例分割任务的相关数据集十分稀缺，尤其缺少针对复杂港口环境下小型船舶的标注数据。本文提出MariSat这一全新基准数据集，包含1260张航拍与卫星图像，覆盖多样化的港口与海岸场景，针对8类海事目标（帆船、游艇、摩托艇、渔船、游轮、军用舰船、拖船、货船）完成像素级标注。该数据集通过半自动标注流水线生成：结合支持文本提示的分割模型SAM 3与级联几何、色度后处理滤波器，后续在CVAT标注平台上完成人工校正与质量校验。本文详细描述了图像采集方法、标注与校正流程以及最终的数据组织形式，同时给出训练集、验证集、测试集的各类别统计信息。MariSat已被用于针对实时海事监测场景的分割与检测模型（SAM 3、YOLO11）微调与基准测试，本文报告了两项任务的详细定量结果与逐类别表现。MariSat数据集已在GitHub上公开开放。

title: ContextBias: Controlled Evaluation of Bias Persistence Under Context Shift in Text-to-Image Models
title_zh: ContextBias：文本到图像模型在上下文偏移下偏差持续性的可控评估
authors: Shaghayegh Kolli, Sina Emami, Moreno D'Incà, Pouyan Nejadi, Nicu Sebe 等 (7 人)
abstract: Text-to-image models learn associations between concepts - in the case of this paper, people's professions, which we refer to as roles - and visual attributes. These associations can underpin many observed forms of stereotypical bias. A key open question in this area is whether these associations are stable or change when visual representations of people in professional roles are placed in different prompted contexts. We introduce ContextBias, a controlled evaluation framework, and ContextBench, a benchmark spanning 92 roles and 1,656 semantically controlled prompts, designed to isolate the effect of contextual variation on role-linked visual representations. Evaluating four state-of-the-art models on 66,240 generated images, we find that placing a role in a semantically unrelated context does not suppress role-linked attributes; instead, cross-role attribute concentration increases (pooled BI $+0.047$). Demographic cues, characteristic garments, and role-specific tools remain highly prevalent across context-free, related, and unrelated conditions, and are robust to semantic prompt reformulation. Scene composition and camera framing show the greatest context-sensitivity. These findings reveal a form of stereotypical persistence that remains largely invisible to context-free evaluations, highlighting the need for controlled contextual variation in bias benchmarking. Code and dataset:this https URL,this https URL
summary_zh: 文生图模型会学习概念间的关联——本文聚焦人物职业（下称角色）与视觉属性的关联，这类关联是大量已观测到的刻板偏差的形成基础。该领域的一个核心开放性问题是：当处于职业角色下的人物视觉表征被放置在不同的提示上下文时，上述关联是否会保持稳定或发生变化？本文提出ContextBias这一可控评估框架，以及覆盖92类角色、1656个语义可控提示的基准集ContextBench，用于分离上下文变化对角色关联视觉表征的影响。通过在66240张生成图像上对4个当前最优模型进行评估，研究发现：将角色放置在语义无关的上下文场景中并不会抑制角色关联属性，反而会提升跨角色属性的集中度（汇总BI值提升0.047）。人口统计特征、标志性服饰、角色专属工具在无上下文、相关上下文、无关上下文场景下都保持极高的出现率，且对语义提示的重表述具有鲁棒性；而场景构图与相机取景方式对上下文的敏感度最高。上述发现揭示了一类在无上下文评估中几乎不可见的刻板偏差持续性，说明偏差基准测试必须引入可控的上下文变化。相关代码与数据集已公开。

title: Null-Space Diffusion Restoration with Adaptive Uncertainty-Guided Fusion for Ultrasound Speckle Reduction
title_zh: 面向超声散斑抑制的自适应不确定性引导融合零空间扩散恢复方法
authors: Juneyong Lee, Jaeyoung Choi
abstract: Ultrasound B-mode imaging commonly suffers from speckle noise and artifacts, requiring a delicate balance between contrast, resolution, and preservation of anatomical structures. Although recently developed despeckling methods have achieved some progress, supervised learning approaches remain fundamentally limited by the ground truth paradox, which arises from the absence of noise-free, ground truth reference images in in vivo scenarios. Existing unsupervised diffusion-based methods typically enforce data consistency directly in the nonlinear log-compressed domain, which can disproportionately amplify background artifacts when mapped back to the envelope domain. To overcome these limitations, we propose an uncertainty-guided null-space diffusion (UGNS) framework, a novel label-free solution that enforces consistency correction on a stabilized positive-envelope proxy obtained via inverse log compression. The proposed UGNS introduces several technical novelties: (a) extraction of a structural prior in the stabilized envelope domain to produce a robust signal envelope that preserves anatomical structure, (b) development of an adaptive range-null reconstruction mechanism that uses an adaptive weight mask to preserve tissue regions via range-space projection, and (c) introduction of uncertainty-guided fusion in an adaptive way to mitigate sampling variability. Extensive and comparative experiments were conducted using the PICMUS benchmark and in vivo datasets. The results demonstrate that UGNS achieves competitive generalized contrast-to-noise ratio (gCNR) values across diverse datasets. In addition, it is successfully validated that UGNS effectively suppresses speckle noise while preserving fine spatial resolution. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 超声B模式成像普遍存在散斑噪声与伪影问题，需要在对比度、分辨率与解剖结构保留之间实现精细平衡。尽管近年提出的散斑抑制方法已取得一定进展，但监督学习方案本质上受限于真值悖论——即体内场景下不存在无噪声的真值参考图像。现有基于扩散的无监督方法通常直接在非线性对数压缩域执行数据一致性约束，映射回包络域时可能会过度放大背景伪影。为解决上述局限，本文提出不确定性引导零空间扩散（UGNS）框架，这一全新无标签方案通过逆对数压缩得到稳定的正包络代理值，并在该代理值上执行一致性校正。UGNS包含三项技术创新：（1）在稳定包络域提取结构先验，生成可保留解剖结构的鲁棒信号包络；（2）开发自适应范围-零空间重建机制，通过自适应权重掩码实现范围空间投影，保留组织区域；（3）引入自适应不确定性引导融合机制，缓解采样波动问题。研究基于PICMUS基准数据集与体内数据集开展大量对比实验，结果表明UGNS在各类数据集上均取得了有竞争力的广义对比度噪声比（gCNR）表现，同时可在保留精细空间分辨率的前提下有效抑制散斑噪声。相关代码已公开。

title: PhasorNet: Learning Structure from Frequency for Real-Time Stereo Matching
title_zh: PhasorNet：基于频率结构学习的实时立体匹配方法
authors: Md Raqib Khan, Santosh Kumar Vipparthi, Subrahmanyam Murala
abstract: Accurate stereo matching remains challenging in ill-posed regions such as fine structures, reflective, or transparent objects, where appearance cues are often ambiguous or unreliable. To tackle this, we propose PhasorNet, a lightweight yet powerful framework that boosts geometric discrimination via frequency-domain cues. At its core, the Phase-Augmented Transformer (PAT) injects Fourier-derived phase information into the attention mechanism, yielding photometrically robust, structure-preserving features that prioritize structural consistency in difficult areas. Additionally, we develop a Geometry-Context Fusion Refinement Module (GCFRM) that combines a full-resolution convolutional stream with a lightweight attention-based stream (leveraging WQA and CDGA blocks) to efficiently preserve fine details and object boundaries without excessive overhead. Training is further enhanced by a multi-scale Edge-guided High-Error Region (EHR) loss that adaptively focuses optimization on high-error and edge regions, guiding hierarchical cost volume refinement. With only 5.3M parameters, PhasorNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on the challenging ETH3D benchmark while exhibiting excellent cross-domain generalization on KITTI, delivering an efficient and practical solution for accurate real-time stereo matching.
summary_zh: 在精细结构、反光或透明物体这类不适定区域，外观线索通常模糊不可靠，高精度立体匹配任务仍面临巨大挑战。为解决该问题，本文提出PhasorNet这一轻量且性能优异的框架，通过频域线索提升几何判别能力。其核心模块相位增强Transformer（PAT）将傅里叶相位信息注入注意力机制，生成对光度变化鲁棒、可保留结构的特征，优先保障困难区域的结构一致性。此外本文还设计了几何上下文融合细化模块（GCFRM），将全分辨率卷积流与基于轻量注意力的流（集成WQA与CDGA模块）相结合，在不引入过多开销的前提下高效保留精细细节与物体边界。研究进一步通过多尺度边缘引导高误差区域（EHR）损失优化训练过程，自适应将优化重点放在高误差区域与边缘区域，引导分层代价体细化。PhasorNet仅含5.3M参数，在极具挑战性的ETH3D基准测试集上取得当前最优性能，同时在KITTI数据集上表现出优异的跨域泛化能力，为高精度实时立体匹配提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: RegionCache: Semantic-Aware Region Reuse for Efficient Multi-Turn Image Generation
title_zh: RegionCache：面向高效多轮图像生成的语义感知区域复用框架
authors: Peizheng Li, Xin Ai, Hanyuan Liu, Qiange Wang, Yanfeng Zhang
abstract: Real-world image generation often involves multi-turn editing, where users iteratively modify small regions while most image content remains unchanged. However, existing diffusion transformer (DiT)-based editing pipelines recompute the entire image at every turn, causing substantial redundant computation. Existing DiT acceleration methods further ignore semantic correspondence across prompts, leading to unnecessary recomputation or unsafe reuse that harms editing quality. To address this, we propose RegionCache, a semantic-aware reuse framework for multi-turn image editing that selectively reuses diffusion states from unchanged regions. RegionCache detects reusable regions through semantic overlap between consecutive prompts and cross-attention localization, and adopts an adaptive reuse schedule based on prompt similarity and contextual consistency. Experiments on PixArt-alpha demonstrate that RegionCache achieves 1.43x--2.55x end-to-end speedup while maintaining comparable image quality. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 真实场景下的图像生成通常涉及多轮编辑：用户迭代修改图像的小部分区域，而大部分图像内容保持不变。但现有基于扩散Transformer（DiT）的编辑流水线在每一轮都重新计算整张图像，产生大量冗余计算。现有DiT加速方法进一步忽略了跨提示的语义对应关系，导致不必要的重复计算或是损害编辑质量的不安全复用。针对该问题，本文提出RegionCache这一面向多轮图像编辑的语义感知复用框架，可选择性复用未变化区域的扩散状态。RegionCache通过连续提示间的语义重叠与交叉注意力定位检测可复用区域，并基于提示相似度与上下文一致性采用自适应复用调度策略。在PixArt-alpha上开展的实验表明，RegionCache可实现1.43倍至2.55倍的端到端加速，同时保持相当的图像质量。相关代码已公开。

title: Beyond Global Realism: Virtual Try-On Evaluation and Optimization with Dimension-wise Garment Fidelity Assessment
title_zh: 超越全局真实感：基于维度级服装保真度评估的虚拟试穿评价与优化
authors: Kaidong Zhang, Yukang Ding, Xiaoyu Liu, Ying Chen
abstract: Virtual try-on (VTON) requires not only realistic generation but also faithful preservation of garment characteristics. However, existing evaluation metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, KID and FID struggle to measure the consistency between the generated and reference garments, particularly in capturing the multi-dimensional characteristics of garment fidelity. To address this, we propose DAT: a Dimension-wise Assessment framework for virtual Try-on, which decomposes garment consistency into seven interpretable dimensions: silhouette, color, neckline and sleeve shape, major decoration and structure, material texture, fine-detail fidelity, and logo preservation, each formulated as a discrete attribute-level prediction task. To train this specialized assessment model, we adopt a two-stage learning paradigm comprising large-scale weak supervision on 50K samples, followed by refinement on 10K higher-quality annotations obtained via multi-model voting. Furthermore, we employ weighted cross-entropy loss to mitigate the severe label imbalance inherent across evaluation dimensions. Beyond its role as an evaluation framework, the assessment model can be integrated into reinforcement learning optimization of Qwen-Image-Edit for VTON, where dimension-wise rewards are adaptively aggregated to emphasize under-optimized aspects during training. Experimental results show that our method (8B parameters) achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of balanced accuracy, SROCC, and PLCC, outperforming strong proprietary models such as Gemini-3.1, Qwen3.7-plus, and GPT-5.5, while also serving as an effective optimization signal for reward-guided VTON generation
summary_zh: 虚拟试穿（VTON）不仅要求生成结果具备真实感，还需要忠实保留服装的各类特征。但现有评估指标如PSNR、SSIM、KID、FID难以衡量生成服装与参考服装的一致性，尤其无法捕捉服装保真度的多维度特征。针对该问题，本文提出面向虚拟试穿的维度级评估框架DAT，将服装一致性分解为7个可解释维度：轮廓、颜色、领型与袖型、主要装饰与结构、材质纹理、精细细节保真度、标识保留，每个维度被建模为离散属性级预测任务。为训练该专用评估模型，本文采用两阶段学习范式：首先在5万样本上开展大规模弱监督训练，随后基于多模型投票得到的1万份更高质量标注完成微调，同时采用加权交叉熵损失缓解评估维度间固有的严重标签不平衡问题。除作为评估框架外，该评估模型还可集成到Qwen-Image-Edit的虚拟试穿任务强化学习优化流程中，自适应聚合维度级奖励，在训练过程中重点优化欠拟合的维度。实验结果表明，本文提出的参数量为8B的方法在平衡精度、SROCC、PLCC指标上取得当前最优表现，性能超过Gemini-3.1、Qwen3.7-plus、GPT-5.5等主流闭源模型，同时可作为奖励引导虚拟试穿生成的有效优化信号。

title: Foundation and Multimodal Large Language Models for Face Presentation and Morph Attack Detection
title_zh: 面向人脸呈现攻击与形变攻击检测的基础模型与多模态大语言模型
authors: Hatef Otroshi Shahreza, Asif Hussain Khan, Peter Lorenz, Alain Komaty, Sébastien Marcel
abstract: Face recognition systems are increasingly deployed in security-critical applications, yet they remain vulnerable to presentation and morph attacks. Presentation attack detection (PAD) and morphing attack detection (MAD) are therefore essential components of trustworthy face biometrics. Despite advancements in PAD and MAD methods, existing detectors suffer from limited generalization and degrade in cross-dataset evaluation. In this paper, we systematically investigate whether general-purpose foundation models (FMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode PAD-relevant and MAD-relevant information, and how such models can best be deployed for both tasks. We study five approaches with increasing access to the internal information of the model: (i) zero-shot prompting of off-the-shelf MLLMs; (ii) training a shallow model on the next-token logit probabilities at the output of the MLLM; (iii) parameter-efficient fine-tuning on task-specific question-answer data, yielding two specialized MLLMs, called PADLLM and MADLLM, which additionally provide textual reasoning for their decisions; (iv) linear probing of frozen vision encoders; and (v) fine-tuning of vision encoders of FMs and MLLMs. We benchmark 16 open-weight MLLMs and 30 vision encoder backbones on four PAD datasets (MSU-MFSD, CASIA-FASD, Replay-Attack, and OULU-NPU) and four MAD datasets (FFHQ, FRGC, FRLL, and FERET). Our experiments show that FMs and MLLMs can achieve significant performance for PAD and MAD. In addition, the fine-tuned models achieve state-of-the-art detection performance in cross-dataset evaluation, indicating that general-purpose pretrained representations carry substantial attack-relevant information. Source code of all our experiments will be publicly released.
summary_zh: 人脸识别系统越来越多地部署在安全关键场景中，但这类系统仍易受到呈现攻击与形变攻击的威胁。呈现攻击检测（PAD）与形变攻击检测（MAD）因此成为可信人脸生物识别系统的核心组件。尽管PAD与MAD方法已取得诸多进展，现有检测器仍存在泛化能力有限、跨数据集评估性能下降的问题。本文系统研究了通用基础模型（FM）与多模态大语言模型（MLLM）是否编码了PAD与MAD相关的有效信息，以及如何将这类模型最优部署到两项任务中。本文研究了5种对模型内部信息访问程度逐步提升的方案：（1）对开箱即用的MLLM执行零样本提示；（2）在MLLM输出的下一个token对数概率上训练浅层模型；（3）在任务专属问答数据上执行参数高效微调，得到两个专用MLLM——PADLLM与MADLLM，二者还可针对自身决策输出文本化推理过程；（4）对冻结的视觉编码器执行线性探测；（5）对基础模型与多模态大语言模型的视觉编码器执行微调。本文在4个PAD数据集（MSU-MFSD、CASIA-FASD、Replay-Attack、OULU-NPU）与4个MAD数据集（FFHQ、FRGC、FRLL、FERET）上对16个开源MLLM与30个视觉编码器骨干开展基准测试。实验结果表明，基础模型与多模态大语言模型可在PAD与MAD任务上取得优异性能，其中微调后的模型在跨数据集评估中达到当前最优检测性能，说明通用预训练表征包含大量与攻击相关的有效信息。所有实验的源代码将对外公开。

title: Source-Dependent Deference in Medical Imaging Agents Under Falsified Findings: A Pilot Audit
title_zh: 虚假检测结果下医学影像智能体的源相关顺从性研究：一项初步审计
authors: Ridam Roy, Md Shahriar Rashid, Md. Rajib Mia
abstract: Tool-using agents are being proposed for medical imaging, and their behaviour when a tool returns a false finding is largely unmeasured. We audit whether a ReAct-style tool-calling agent abandons an answer it has already given correctly once a falsified finding arrives, and whether that depends on how the finding is presented. On 20 VQA-RAD closed questions across four vendor-designated model tiers, the agent commits to an answer from the image alone; a negated finding is then delivered either as JSON from an analyze_image tool the agent invokes itself, or as quoted prose attributed to a radiologist. Our outcome is the commission-error rate over cases answered correctly without any tool. Deference is much higher under the prose-attributed claim: at the strongest tier the agent revised its correct answer in 10 of 13 cases against 1 of 13 under the tool (exact McNemar p=0.0039, Holm-adjusted 0.012). We do not claim this isolates the source label. Attribution travels with the delivery channel in our design, and exposure differs because the tool claim reaches the agent only when it calls the tool. The finding is a joint source-and-delivery asymmetry from a small-scale pilot whose pre-specified stopping rule was not met.
summary_zh: 当前已有研究提出将可调用工具的智能体用于医学影像场景，但当工具返回虚假结果时这类智能体的行为特性尚未得到充分测量。本文开展审计研究，验证ReAct风格的工具调用智能体在收到虚假结果后是否会放弃此前已经给出的正确答案，以及该行为是否取决于结果的呈现方式。研究针对4个厂商指定的模型层级，选取20道VQA-RAD闭集问题开展测试：智能体首先仅基于图像给出答案，随后收到的否定结果分为两种呈现形式——要么来自智能体自身调用的analyze_image工具输出的JSON格式结果，要么是标注为放射科医师给出的引用文本。研究的核心指标为「无工具辅助时回答正确的样本中智能体出错的比例」。结果显示，当虚假结果以放射科医师文本标注形式给出时，智能体的顺从性显著更高：在最高性能层级的模型中，13个正确答案里有10个被智能体修改，而当虚假结果来自工具输出时，13个正确答案中仅有1个被修改（精确McNemar检验p=0.0039，经Holm校正后p=0.012）。本研究并未声称该结果完全由来源标签单独导致，在实验设计中来源属性与交付通道绑定，且工具输出的虚假结果仅在智能体主动调用工具时才能被智能体获取，二者的曝光条件存在差异。该发现是小规模初步实验得到的来源-交付联合不对称性结论，实验预先设定的停止规则并未被触发。

title: GridFlow: Structured Latent Flow for Seamless City-Scale 3D Point Cloud Generation
title_zh: GridFlow：面向无缝城域级3D点云生成的结构化潜流框架
authors: Xinyu Wang, Muhammad Ibrahim, Atif Mansoor, Ajmal Mian
abstract: Generating realistic 3D city environments from remote sensing data is important for simulation, urban planning, and mixed reality, yet existing point cloud generation methods are limited to single objects or bounded indoor scenes and cannot handle the scale, seamless tiling, and partial observability challenges of city-scale generation. We present \ours{}, a multi-stage framework that generates dense, colored point clouds ($10^5$ points per $150\text{m}{\times}150\text{m}$ tile) at city scale, conditioned on satellite imagery, semantic segmentation maps, and digital surface models (DSM). A \emph{Grid-Aligned VAE} encodes each tile into a topology-preserving latent grid where tokens correspond to fixed spatial regions, enabling spatially coherent multi-modal conditioning and compact latent-space edge consistency that implicitly aligns thousands of boundary points for seamless cross-tile generation. A conditional rectified flow model synthesizes geometry latents from the fused multi-modal conditions, and an orientation-aware diffusion colorizer separately handles satellite-visible horizontal surfaces and occluded vertical façades. To support standardized evaluation, we build on public 3D data sources to introduce \emph{City3D-MultiGen}, a benchmark of $163$K densely annotated tiles from Melbourne and London with aligned point clouds, satellite images, semantic maps, and elevation data. Experiments show that \ours{} outperforms adapted point cloud generation baselines across all geometry metrics and produces visually coherent colored point clouds with seamless boundaries over arbitrarily large urban extents. Our benchmark details are available atthis https URL
summary_zh: 基于遥感数据生成真实感3D城市场景对仿真、城市规划、混合现实领域都具有重要价值，但现有点云生成方法仅局限于单物体或有限室内场景，无法应对城域级生成任务的规模、无缝拼接、部分可观测性挑战。本文提出GridFlow这一多阶段框架，以卫星图像、语义分割图、数字表面模型（DSM）为条件，生成城域级的密集彩色点云（每150m×150m瓦片包含10^5个点）。Grid-Aligned VAE模块将每个瓦片编码为保拓扑的潜网格，其中每个token对应固定的空间区域，可实现空间一致的多模态条件约束与紧凑的潜空间边缘一致性，隐式对齐数千个边界点，实现跨瓦片的无缝生成。条件整流流模型基于融合后的多模态条件合成几何潜变量，方向感知扩散着色器则分别处理卫星可见的水平表面与被遮挡的垂直立面。为支持标准化评估，本文基于公开3D数据源构建City3D-MultiGen基准集，包含来自墨尔本与伦敦的16.3万个密集标注瓦片，配套对齐的点云、卫星图像、语义图与高程数据。实验结果表明，GridFlow在所有几何指标上的表现均优于经过适配的点云生成基线方法，可在任意大的城市范围内生成边界无缝、视觉连贯的彩色点云。基准集详情已公开。

title: InspectorGPT: A Comparative Reasoning Enhanced VLM for Comprehensive Industrial Anomaly Detection
title_zh: InspectorGPT：面向综合工业异常检测的对比推理增强视觉语言模型（VLM）
authors: Weifei Chen, Honghao Zhang, Zhiyuan You, Xinyi Le
abstract: Industrial anomaly detection is a critical component of modern manufacturing. Most traditional unsupervised methods rely on modelling normal feature distributions, inherently limiting generalization to unknown categories. To improve generalizability, some recent methods incorporate vision-language models (VLMs) for zero-shot detection via text prompts. However, we observe that reasoning-oriented post-training can cause anomaly discrimination to collapse, with some fine-tuned models performing worse than their base VLMs. Existing methods also provide only textual decisions or coarse boxes, without pixel-level segmentation. A more explicit detection principle comes from human inspection: anomalies are identified by comparing a query image with a defect-free reference. Inspired by this, we propose InspectorGPT, a VLM framework centered on comparative reasoning. Given a normal reference and a query image, InspectorGPT compares them to identify discrepancies and perform multiple inspection tasks with detailed reasoning. We internalize this capability through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with tailored, verifiable rewards. We further introduce InspectorGPT-Seg for pixel-level anomaly masks. Segmentation supervision improves anomaly discrimination but weakens semantic reasoning, while joint training fails to balance them. We therefore train the two branches separately and combine them through task-vector fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior multi-dimensional performance and generalization to unseen benchmarks, validating comparative reasoning for comprehensive industrial inspection.
summary_zh: 工业异常检测是现代制造业的核心组成部分。传统无监督方法大多依赖于对正常特征分布建模，本质上限制了其对未知类别的泛化能力。为提升泛化性能，近期部分研究引入视觉语言模型（VLM），通过文本提示实现零样本检测。但本研究发现，面向推理的后训练可能导致异常判别能力退化，部分经过微调的模型性能甚至低于其基础VLM。现有方法仅能输出文本判定结果或粗略检测框，无法实现像素级分割。人类检测过程遵循更明确的判定逻辑：通过将待检测图像与无缺陷参考图像进行比对识别异常。受该思路启发，本文提出InspectorGPT，一个以对比推理为核心的VLM框架。输入一张正常参考图像和一张待检测图像后，InspectorGPT可通过比对识别二者差异，依托详细推理完成多项检测任务。本文通过思维链（CoT, Chain-of-Thought）微调与定制化可验证奖励驱动的分组相对策略优化（GRPO, Group Relative Policy Optimization）内化该对比能力。本文进一步推出面向像素级异常掩码生成的InspectorGPT-Seg模块：分割监督可提升异常判别能力，但会削弱语义推理能力，而联合训练无法平衡二者性能，因此本研究对两个分支分别训练，再通过任务向量融合完成整合。大量实验证明，该框架具备优异的多维性能与对未见基准数据集的泛化能力，验证了对比推理在综合工业检测场景中的有效性。

title: SynCrash: A Multi-Stage Pipeline for Zero-Shot Accident Detection and Localization in Traffic Surveillance Video
title_zh: SynCrash：面向交通监控视频零样本事故检测与定位的多阶段流水线
authors: Arkya Jyoti Bagchi, Ritul Jangir, Varun Raskar
abstract: We present SynCrash, a multi-stage pipeline for zero-shot accident detection, spatial localization, and collision-type classification in fixed-view CCTV surveillance video. Our approach addresses the ACCIDENT at CVPR 2026 Challenge, which requires predicting when an accident occurs, where in the frame the impact happens, and what type of collision it is, all without access to labeled real-world training data.
