We systematically evaluate a constrained iterative refinement harness that combines visual feedback, structured editing, and constrained decoding to characterize the capabilities and limitations of current VLMs for SVG generation. Across multiple VLMs and generation settings, we find that constrained decoding improves compilation success rates, while iterative refinement reveals a deficit in visual reasoning and self-correction. Our results highlight both the promise and current limitations of using inference-time methods to adapt general-purpose VLMs for SVG generation.
summary_zh: 可缩放矢量图形（SVG）是现代视觉生态系统的核心支撑技术之一，但当前最优生成模型几乎全部聚焦于栅格图像生成。本文探索了推理阶段方法能否在不重新训练的前提下，让现成视觉语言模型（VLM）具备SVG生成能力。我们系统评估了融合视觉反馈、结构化编辑与约束解码的约束迭代优化框架，全面表征了当前VLM在SVG生成任务上的能力与局限性。在多个VLM与生成设置下的实验结果表明，约束解码可提升SVG编译成功率，而迭代优化过程暴露了当前模型在视觉推理与自校正能力上的缺陷。本研究结果既验证了使用推理阶段方法适配通用VLM完成SVG生成的可行性，也明确了当前技术路径的局限性。

title: Automated pipeline for herbarium label digitization
title_zh: 植物标本馆标签数字化自动化流水线
authors: Hiba Abbad, Hanane Ariouat, Eva Perez Pimpare, Nicolas Turenne, Eric Chenin 等 (9 人)
abstract: Digitized herbarium collections, now comprising over 100 million freely accessible specimen images, have become a critical resource for addressing fundamental questions in ecology and evolutionary biology. Yet the rich metadata encoded in herbarium labels (collector identities, geographic localities, collection dates, and ecological observations) remains largely inaccessible at scale, constraining both biodiversity informatics and the construction of specimen-specific image-text corpora for multimodal AI. We present HERBIOME, a modular end-to-end pipeline for automated herbarium label digitization, integrating YOLOv8-based component detection, CRAFT Hezar word-level text localization, fine-tuned TrOCR for recognition of mixed handwritten and printed text, and GPT-4o Mini for semantic metadata structuring into standardized fields. TrOCR was trained on a multi-source dataset combining general transcription corpora (CREMMA-AN, PictoCatalogs) with herbarium-specific data (RéColNat), achieving a Character Error Rate of 4.05-4.10%. End-to-end evaluation on 450 French herbarium specimens, using a dual-metric framework of Maximum Window Similarity (MWS: 0.614-0.618) and Semantic Metadata Accuracy (SMA: 0.440-0.445), reveals that hybrid training strategies improve semantic fidelity while random sampling maximizes surface similarity, with taxonomic fields remaining the principal bottleneck. By automating the extraction of structured metadata from complex, heterogeneous labels, HERBIOME reduces transcription burden, enables the construction of paired image-text datasets that faithfully capture specimen individuality, which is a prerequisite for next-generation multimodal biodiversity AI systems.
summary_zh: 目前已完成数字化的植物标本馆藏包含超过1亿份可免费访问的标本图像，已成为解决生态学与进化生物学基础问题的核心资源。但植物标本馆标签中蕴含的丰富元数据（采集人身份、地理地点、采集日期、生态观测记录等）始终无法实现规模化访问，既限制了生物多样性信息学的发展，也阻碍了面向多模态AI的标本专属图文语料库构建。本文提出HERBIOME，这是一套模块化端到端的植物标本馆标签数字化自动流水线，集成了基于YOLOv8的组件检测、CRAFT Hezar词级文本定位、经微调的TrOCR用于手写与印刷混合文本识别、以及GPT-4o Mini用于将语义元数据结构化到标准字段中。TrOCR在融合通用转录语料库（CREMMA-AN、PictoCatalogs）与植物标本馆专属数据（RéColNat）的多源数据集上完成训练，字符错误率达到4.05%-4.10%。在450份法国植物标本上开展的端到端评估采用最大窗口相似度（MWS：0.614-0.618）与语义元数据准确率（SMA：0.440-0.445）双指标框架，结果显示混合训练策略可提升语义保真度，而随机采样可最大化表层相似度，其中分类学相关字段仍是当前的主要瓶颈。通过实现从复杂异质性标签中自动提取结构化元数据，HERBIOME降低了转录工作负担，支持构建可准确表征标本个体特征的配对图文数据集，而这正是下一代多模态生物多样性AI系统的核心前提。

title: Multi-Agent Self-Improving Reinforcement Learning for Video Reasoning
title_zh: 面向视频推理的多智能体自改进强化学习
authors: Mingwen Zhang, Jisheng Dang, Minqiang Yang, Bimei Wang, Bin Hu 等 (6 人)
abstract: Video reasoning tasks such as grounded video question answering and temporal grounding require selecting temporal evidence that supports the query. In many current training setups, temporal supervision is applied through local objectives such as boundary regression or span generation, while verification is used mainly to rerank candidate segments at inference time. We study whether a frozen verifier can also guide training. Our multi-agent framework couples a trainable \emph{Grounder} with a frozen \emph{Verifier}: the Grounder samples candidate trajectories and evidence segments, the Verifier assigns query-conditioned segment scores, a group-relative policy-gradient objective favors trajectories that outperform their within-input peers, and a bootstrapped calibration loss steers temporal predictions toward verifier-preferred spans. Trained on source tasks and evaluated without target-dataset fine-tuning, a two-billion-parameter instantiation transfers zero-shot across grounded question answering, temporal grounding, and long-video question answering, reaching 28.7\% intersection-over-union and 25.4\% answer-grounding accuracy on a grounded-question-answering benchmark, 46.1\% intersection-over-union on a temporal-grounding benchmark, and 54.1\% on a long-video question-answering benchmark. Relative to a strong same-scale baseline, the gains are modest but consistent, with the clearest improvements on relevance-oriented metrics such as intersection-over-union and moderate-overlap recall. Within the tested benchmarks and transfer setting, the results support frozen verification as a training signal for evidence selection, while showing that strict boundary precision remains comparatively weaker. Code and models are available atthis https URL
summary_zh: 带 grounding 的视频问答、时序定位等视频推理任务需要筛选出支持查询的时序证据。当前多数训练方案中，时序监督通过边界回归、片段生成等局部目标实现，而验证环节主要用于在推理阶段对候选片段重排序。本文研究了冻结状态的验证器是否也可用于指导训练过程。我们提出的多智能体框架将可训练的Grounder（定位器）与冻结的Verifier（验证器）相结合：定位器采样候选轨迹与证据片段，验证器输出基于查询条件的片段得分，组间相对策略梯度目标会优先选择在同输入样本中表现优于其他样本的轨迹，自举校准损失则引导时序预测向验证器偏好的片段靠拢。该20亿参数的实例在源任务上完成训练后，无需在目标数据集上微调即可实现零样本迁移，覆盖带 grounding 的视频问答、时序定位、长视频问答三类任务，在带 grounding 视频问答基准上取得28.7%的交并比与25.4%的答案定位准确率，在时序定位基准上取得46.1%的交并比，在长视频问答基准上取得54.1%的准确率。与同等规模的强基线方法相比，该方法的性能提升幅度适中但表现稳定，在交并比、中度重叠召回率等面向相关性的指标上提升最为明显。在测试的基准与迁移设置下，实验结果证明冻结验证可作为证据筛选的训练信号，同时也表明该方法在严格边界精度上的表现仍相对较弱。代码与模型可通过对应公开链接获取。

title: Multi-exposure HDR Imaging: A Review of Pixel-level and Feature-level Reconstruction Methods
title_zh: 多曝光高动态范围（HDR）成像：像素级与特征级重建方法综述
authors: Qian Tao, Wei Wang, Chaobing Zheng, Zhengguo Li
abstract: Multi-exposure is an efficient way to capture real-world high-dynamic-range (HDR) scenes. However, HDR imaging suffers from severe ghosting artifacts in dynamic scenes due to the temporal gap between sequential exposures. In this article, we categorize the literature on two important topics on HDR imaging: multi-exposure fusion (MEF) and ghost removal. Conventional filter-based and data-driven methods are studied in pixel space and feature space. For popular deep learning-based approaches, we provide a granular taxonomy based on their alignment and fusion domains: pixel-space methods, which typically employ explicit motion compensation such as optical flow or spatial transformers, and feature-space methods, which leverage implicit alignment through deformable convolutions, attention mechanisms, or latent representation merging. Representative works are compared across different supervision settings, and key design principles are summarized. In addition, this survey summarizes commonly used datasets and evaluation metrics, discussing their applicability under diverse output forms. Finally, major bottlenecks and promising directions for future research are outlined.
summary_zh: 多曝光是采集真实世界高动态范围（HDR）场景的高效方案。但由于连续曝光之间存在时间差，动态场景下的HDR成像会出现严重的重影伪影。本文围绕HDR成像的两大核心主题：多曝光融合（MEF）与重影去除，对相关研究进行分类梳理，从像素空间与特征空间两个维度研究了传统基于滤波的方法与数据驱动方法。针对当前主流的深度学习方法，本文基于对齐与融合域提出了细粒度分类体系：像素空间方法通常采用光流、空间变换器等显式运动补偿方案，特征空间方法则通过可变形卷积、注意力机制、隐表征融合实现隐式对齐。本文在不同监督设置下对比了代表性工作，总结了核心设计原则。此外，本综述梳理了常用的数据集与评估指标，讨论了其在不同输出形式下的适用性，最后指出了当前领域的主要瓶颈与未来研究的潜在方向。

title: AdaptAV: Continuous Adaption of Vision Models for Autonomous Vehicles Using Cloud-based Oracle
title_zh: AdaptAV：基于云端Oracle（高精度参考模型）的自动驾驶视觉模型连续适配方法
authors: Yuheng Zhu, Dhruva Ungrupulithaya, Boluo Ge, Man-Ki Yoon
abstract: Deploying vision perception models in autonomous vehicles requires that we prioritize inference speeds, resulting in a model with shallower architectures and lesser model parameters (i.e., more pruned). Such small models do not generalize well, which could result in poor performance when encountered with novel scenarios. We propose a system that overcomes this by continuously retraining the vision models on the cloud with data uploaded by vehicles. We leverage the abundant compute resources, including machine learning accelerators, of the cloud to run a highly-accurate oracle model that will guide the retraining process of the on-vehicle model. This newly trained model is transmitted to the vehicle over the network and is utilized by the vehicle for perceptions, leading to improved inference accuracy over time.
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶车辆上部署视觉感知模型时，需要优先保障推理速度，因此最终使用的模型通常架构更浅、参数量更少（即经过更高程度的剪枝）。这类小型模型的泛化能力较差，遇到全新场景时容易出现性能骤降的问题。本文提出一套可解决该问题的系统，该系统利用车辆上传的数据在云端对视觉模型进行持续重训练。我们利用云端充足的计算资源（包括机器学习加速器）运行高精度的oracle参考模型，由该模型引导车载模型的重训练过程。训练完成的新模型通过网络下发到车辆端供感知任务使用，随时间推移可不断提升推理精度。

title: FrameScope: Temporal Data Valuation for Stream Active Learning in Autonomous Vehicle Systems
title_zh: FrameScope：自动驾驶系统中面向流式主动学习的时序数据估值方法
authors: Yuheng Zhu, Man-Ki Yoon
abstract: Autonomous vehicles operate in dynamic, ever-changing environments where new scenarios and edge cases constantly emerge. As a result, static learning models are inadequate for ensuring safe and reliable operation. Continuous learning is essential for adapting to these evolving conditions and maintaining robust performance across diverse real-world settings. However, autonomous vehicles generate massive streams of visual data during operation, and existing continuous learning approaches typically rely on heuristic sampling methods that fail to capture temporal dynamics, often overlooking critical learning opportunities or selecting redundant frames. In this paper, we introduce FrameScope, a temporal data valuation framework for continuous learning in autonomous vehicles. FrameScope extends neural tangent kernel theory to temporal domains, enabling principled valuation of streaming visual data. Unlike cloud-centric methods that transmit all video data for processing, our approach performs principled, local frame selection on the vehicle and queries a cloud-based oracle model only for labels of those high-value frames. Extensive experiments across multiple domain shifts show that FrameScope consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving higher sample efficiency and significantly reducing catastrophic forgetting in autonomous vehicle perception. By valuing data on the vehicle and querying only labels for selected frames, FrameScope reduces bandwidth requirements, enabling scalable operation with a lightweight cloud labeling service.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶车辆运行在动态变化的环境中，新场景与边缘案例不断涌现，因此静态学习模型无法保障运行的安全性与可靠性。持续学习是适配动态环境、在各类真实场景下维持鲁棒性能的核心技术。但自动驾驶车辆在运行过程中会生成海量流式视觉数据，现有持续学习方法通常依赖启发式采样策略，无法捕捉时序动态特征，经常遗漏关键学习机会或选择冗余帧。本文提出FrameScope，这是一套面向自动驾驶持续学习的时序数据估值框架。FrameScope将神经正切核理论扩展到时序域，实现对流式视觉数据的原则性估值。不同于需要传输全部视频数据到云端处理的云侧方法，本文提出的方案在车辆端完成符合理论规范的本地帧筛选，仅针对高价值帧向云端oracle参考模型查询标签。在多个域偏移场景下开展的大量实验表明，FrameScope的性能始终优于现有方法，样本效率更高，可显著降低自动驾驶感知任务中的灾难性遗忘问题。通过在车辆端完成数据估值、仅针对选中的帧查询标签，FrameScope降低了带宽需求，可依托轻量级云端标注服务实现规模化运行。

title: Measuring Similarity between Artistic and AI Generated Images using Siamese Neural Networks
title_zh: 基于孪生神经网络的艺术图像与AI生成图像相似度度量研究
authors: Diego Castro Elvira, Navil Pineda Rugerio, Jesús García-Ramírez, Cecilia Reyes-Peña, Ricardo Ramos-Aguilar
abstract: AI-generated art has sparked debates around potential plagiarism, as these images may closely resemble existing artworks. This research quantifies the similarity between original pieces and AI-generated counterparts, particularly those produced by the Stable Diffusion XL Refiner 1.0. We use Siamese Networks with frozen CLIP encoders and cosine similarity optimized through triplet loss. A dataset of paired original and generated images was built using image-to-image generation and custom prompts, enriched with semantic descriptors and BLIP-2 captions. Prior studies report up to 81\% style replication and 90\% visual similarity. Our results show high discriminative performance: training accuracy reached 99.9\%, and the best model configuration achieved 99.4\% test accuracy with strong inter-class separation ($\delta \mu$ = 0.677), demonstrating the effectiveness of our semantic-visual embeddings.
summary_zh: AI生成艺术作品可能与现有艺术作品高度相似，引发了关于潜在抄袭的广泛讨论。本研究量化了原创艺术作品与AI生成图像（尤其是由Stable Diffusion XL Refiner 1.0生成的图像）之间的相似度。我们采用搭载冻结CLIP编码器的孪生神经网络，通过三元组损失优化余弦相似度。通过图像到图像生成与自定义提示词构建了包含配对原创图像与生成图像的数据集，补充了语义描述符与BLIP-2生成的图像字幕。此前的研究报告最高可实现81%的风格复刻与90%的视觉相似度，本文的实验结果显示所提方法具备极高的判别性能：训练准确率达到99.9%，最优模型配置的测试准确率达99.4%，类间分离度优异（δμ=0.677），验证了本文提出的语义-视觉嵌入方案的有效性。

title: Memory-Efficient Training-Free Acceleration of Diffusion Transformers with BaryCache
title_zh: 基于BaryCache的内存高效、无需训练的扩散Transformer加速方法
authors: Chengjie Lu, Tianchi Deng, Zhengqi He, Zhijian Gao, Huisi Wu 等 (6 人)
abstract: Diffusion Transformers achieve high-fidelity image and video generation, but their iterative sampling remains expensive, for each denoising step requires large matrix operations. Existing cache-based acceleration reduces redundant computation yet increases the VRAM footprint by storing intermediate states, which can directly constrain inference batch size. In this work, we propose a training-free acceleration method that performs stepwise forecasting for DiT sampling using a Barycentric Extrapolator. By leveraging barycentric extrapolation, our predictor is numerically stable and alleviates oscillatory artifacts analogous to the Runge phenomenon during forward forecasting. Across extensive experiments on both image and video generation, our approach provides a favorable trade-off between memory usage and perceptual quality, while delivering up to 3.30x end-to-end sampling speedup compared with baseline DiT inference.
summary_zh: 扩散Transformer（DiT）可实现高保真的图像与视频生成，但其迭代采样过程成本高昂，每一步去噪都需要执行大规模矩阵运算。现有基于缓存的加速方案可减少冗余计算，但需要存储中间状态，会增加显存占用，直接限制推理的批处理规模。本文提出一种无需训练的加速方法，采用重心外推器对DiT采样过程进行逐步预测。借助重心外推技术，本文提出的预测器具备数值稳定性，可缓解前向外推过程中类似龙格现象的振荡伪影。在图像与视频生成任务上开展的大量实验表明，该方法在内存占用与感知质量之间实现了更优的权衡，与基线DiT推理方案相比，端到端采样速度最高可提升3.30倍。

title: MIRAGE-CAD: Construction-Mediated Multimodal Generation of Executable CAD Programs
title_zh: MIRAGE-CAD：构造过程介导的可执行CAD程序多模态生成方法
authors: Jizong Zhan
abstract: Recovering an executable parametric CAD program from an observed object is fundamentally ambiguous, because the same final geometry can result from different construction procedures. We study this problem from four types of input: natural-language descriptions, rendered images, point clouds, and STEP/B-Rep geometry. MIRAGE-CAD maps each input to a shared construction representation and mediates program generation through an explicit construction-plan interface. The resulting Python CAD code is executed by an OpenCASCADE kernel to build the solid and export it as STEP. On 2,500 held-out queries per modality, the system achieves 55.4-70.0% build success and 52.3-66.2% STEP export success without retrieval at inference. Controlled comparisons show that strong reconstruction does not depend on expressing the construction representation as text: a decoder conditioned directly on the continuous representation also reconstructs strongly, while an exposure-matched plan-based decoder shows no detected material loss in per-part geometric fidelity. The explicit plan instead provides a readable and separately measurable intermediate representation whose agreement with the reference construction is informative about downstream execution success. Finally, we show that executable validity, geometric fidelity, and parametric responsiveness can diverge substantially and should therefore be evaluated separately.
summary_zh: 从观测对象中恢复可执行的参数化CAD程序本质上存在歧义，因为相同的最终几何形态可通过不同的构造流程得到。本文针对四类输入开展研究：自然语言描述、渲染图像、点云、STEP/B-Rep几何。MIRAGE-CAD将各类输入映射到统一的构造表征空间，通过显式构造计划接口介导程序生成。最终输出的Python CAD代码可由OpenCASCADE内核执行，生成实体模型并导出为STEP格式。在每个模态的2500个留出测试查询上，该系统在推理阶段无需检索即可实现55.4%-70.0%的模型构建成功率与52.3%-66.2%的STEP导出成功率。对照实验表明，高性能重建不依赖于将构造表征表示为文本：直接以连续表征为条件的解码器同样可实现高质量重建，而与暴露度匹配的基于计划的解码器在单部件几何保真度上未出现可检测的性能损失。显式计划提供了可读性强、可独立度量的中间表征，其与参考构造的匹配度可有效反映下游执行的成功率。最后本文指出，可执行有效性、几何保真度、参数响应性三者可能出现明显的分化，因此需要分别开展评估。

title: Improving Spatial-Temporal Reasoning in Video-Language Models with Structured Video Prompting
title_zh: 基于结构化视频提示的视频语言模型时空推理能力提升方法
authors: Sadegh Mohammadian
abstract: Video-language models (VLMs) remain brittle on tasks that require tracking events over time and grounding answers in specific spatial regions. We propose that part of this limitation can be addressed through better organization of visual evidence at inference time. We introduce structured video prompting, a training-free inference-time method that augments the input video with lightweight spatial structure and temporal structure, providing explicit anchors for organizing evidence across space and time without changing model weights or decoding and without altering the question prompt in the main comparison. We evaluate this approach on two complementary video benchmarks and two open video-language models. Across these settings, structured inputs improve performance in several cases, with gains varying by model and task. Our findings suggest that some failures of VLMs arise not only from reasoning capacity, but also from how video evidence is presented at inference time. These results highlight structured video prompting as a simple and practical direction for improving video understanding.
summary_zh: 视频语言模型（VLM）在需要长期追踪事件、将答案锚定到特定空间区域的任务上表现仍然较为脆弱。本文提出该局限性的部分成因可通过在推理阶段对视觉证据进行更合理的组织来解决。本文提出结构化视频提示，这是一种无需训练的推理阶段方法，通过为输入视频补充轻量级的空间结构与时间结构，为跨时空的证据组织提供显式锚点，全程无需修改模型权重、解码逻辑，也无需改动主对比实验中的问题提示。我们在两个互补的视频基准与两个开源视频语言模型上对该方法开展评估，在多种设置下，结构化输入均可提升任务性能，性能提升幅度随模型与任务的不同存在差异。研究结果表明，视频语言模型的部分失败并非完全由推理能力不足导致，也与推理阶段视频证据的呈现方式有关。该结果证明结构化视频提示是提升视频理解能力的简单实用方向。

title: Understanding Temporal Semantic Stability in Open-Vocabulary UAV Perception through Metric 3D Fusion
title_zh: 基于度量3D融合的开放词汇无人机感知时序语义稳定性研究
authors: Saurbh Singh Jamwal
abstract: Recent open-vocabulary segmentation models have advanced semantic perception for UAVs, but predictions from moving aerial platforms can remain temporally inconsistent across repeated observations of the same physical scene. We investigate temporal semantic stability by associating frame-wise predictions with persistent world-space locations through metric 3D fusion. We introduce a voxel-level evaluation framework that jointly characterises final semantic agreement, Semantic Belief Drift (SBD), Observation Persistence (OP), and semantic uncertainty. Experiments on UAVid-3D reveal substantial frame-wise semantic flicker and show that high aggregate world-space agreement can overstate temporal stability when locations have limited repeated-observation support. Persistence-stratified analysis shows that recurrent voxels expose greater semantic disagreement, while belief drift decreases as additional evidence accumulates. This behaviour is observed across two segmentation backbones and remains consistent under variations in voxel resolution, geometric association, and temporal sampling density. Conditions that reduce world-space recurrence can increase apparent aggregate stability, demonstrating that semantic consistency must be interpreted together with observation support. Our findings highlight observation persistence as an essential conditioning variable for evaluating long-horizon semantic reliability.
summary_zh: 近期的开放词汇分割模型大幅提升了无人机的语义感知能力，但移动空中平台输出的预测结果在重复观测同一物理场景时，时序上仍然存在不一致的问题。本文通过将单帧预测结果与持久化的世界空间位置关联，开展度量3D融合，对时序语义稳定性进行研究。本文提出体素级评估框架，可同时表征最终语义一致性、语义信念漂移（SBD）、观测持久性（OP）与语义不确定性。在UAVid-3D数据集上开展的实验显示，单帧语义存在明显的闪烁现象，当位置的重复观测支持度不足时，较高的全局世界空间一致性会高估时序稳定性。基于持久性的分层分析显示，被重复观测的体素语义不一致性更高，而随着观测证据的不断积累，信念漂移会逐渐降低。该现象在两类分割骨干网络上均存在，且在体素分辨率、几何关联方式、时序采样密度变化时表现稳定。降低世界空间重复度的条件会提升表观全局稳定性，说明语义一致性必须结合观测支持度共同解读。本研究结果表明，观测持久性是评估长时序语义可靠性的核心条件变量。

title: The Potential of Haptic Foundation Models
title_zh: 触觉基础模型（Haptic Foundation Models, HFMs）的潜力
authors: Jianquan Wang, Haiwei Dong, Abdulmotaleb El Saddik
abstract: Despite the success of foundation models in language and vision, their expansion into embodied AI is bottlenecked by a lack of generalized touch sensing. This limitation is especially relevant to consumer electronics, where smartphones, wearables, VR controllers, home robots, and health monitoring devices require safe and adaptive physical interaction. Constrained by hardware heterogeneity and the necessity of active physical data collection, current haptic models remain rigidly task-specific. To overcome these limitations, this article explores the transformative potential and developmental trajectory of Haptic Foundation Models (HFMs). We detail the paradigm shift required to transition from passive Large Language Models and Vision Language Models into active HFMs across four core dimensions: action coupling, physical dynamical representation space, continuous time-series data granularity, and action-conditioned future state prediction. Furthermore, we synthesize existing large-scale tactile datasets and benchmark UniTouch, AnyTouch, T3, and Sparsh on TacBench for force estimation, slip detection, and relative pose estimation.
summary_zh: 尽管基础模型在语言和视觉领域已取得成功，但其向具身人工智能领域的拓展仍受通用触觉感知能力不足的瓶颈限制。这一局限性在消费电子领域尤为突出：智能手机、可穿戴设备、VR控制器、家用机器人和健康监测设备均需要安全且自适应的物理交互能力。受硬件异质性和主动物理数据采集需求的约束，当前的触觉模型仍严格局限于特定任务场景。为克服上述局限，本文探讨了触觉基础模型的变革性潜力与发展路径。我们从四个核心维度详细阐述了从被动式大语言模型、视觉语言模型向主动式触觉基础模型转型所需的范式转变：动作耦合、物理动力学表征空间、连续时序数据粒度、基于动作条件的未来状态预测。此外，我们整合了现有大规模触觉数据集，并在TacBench基准平台上对UniTouch、AnyTouch、T3和Sparsh四个基准模型在力估计、滑移检测和相对位姿估计任务上的性能进行了评测。

title: Open-Set Cattle Muzzle Identification: A Leakage-Controlled Benchmark and Evaluation Protocol
title_zh: 开集牛鼻纹识别：泄漏可控基准与评估协议
authors: Lalit BC, Dharmendra Singh Chaudhary, Shovit Nepal
abstract: Reliable individual cattle identification supports disease surveillance, vaccination records, breeding management, and livestock insurance. Although the bovine muzzle provides a stable, non-contact biometric, existing muzzle-recognition systems largely assume a closed set of enrolled animals, limiting their practical deployment. We reformulate cattle muzzle biometrics as an open-set, gallery-based identification problem that can reject previously unseen animals and support incremental enrollment without model retraining. We introduce a leakage-controlled evaluation protocol based on identity-disjoint splits, per-fold retraining, held-out threshold calibration, verified duplicate removal, and bootstrap confidence intervals. We evaluate the framework using two contrasting embedding configurations: a hybrid CNN-ViT metric-learning model and the MegaDescriptor-L foundation model. Under oracle threshold selection, the hybrid model achieves detection-and-identification rates of 98.3%, 96.4%, and 93.6% at target false-acceptance rates of 10^(-1), 10^(-2), and 10^(-3), respectively, while MegaDescriptor-L achieves 99.3%, 98.1%, and 96.1%. However, deployable threshold calibration reveals a substantial difference between oracle and calibrated performance: the hybrid model achieves a false-acceptance rate of 1.03% at a 1% target, whereas MegaDescriptor-L reaches 2.44%. Incremental enrollment further achieves Rank-1 accuracy above 91% with a single reference image and up to 97.3% with eight reference images, without retraining the model or degrading the existing gallery. These results demonstrate that threshold calibration, leakage control, and embedding quality are critical for reliable open-set cattle identification and provide a practical evaluation framework for deployment-oriented animal biometric systems.
summary_zh: 可靠的牛个体识别可为疾病监测、疫苗接种记录、育种管理和牲畜保险提供支撑。尽管牛鼻纹是一种稳定的非接触式生物特征，但现有鼻纹识别系统大多假设待识别动物属于已登记的闭集，严重限制了其实际部署。本文将牛鼻纹生物特征识别重新定义为可拒识未见过个体、无需模型重训练即可支持增量登记的开集、基于图库集的识别问题。我们提出了基于身份互斥划分、每折重训练、留出集阈值校准、验证去重和自助置信区间的泄漏可控评估协议。我们采用两种差异显著的嵌入配置对该框架进行评估：混合CNN-ViT度量学习模型和MegaDescriptor-L基础模型。在采用最优阈值选择的条件下，混合模型在目标误接受率为10^(-1)、10^(-2)、10^(-3)时的检测识别率分别达到98.3%、96.4%和93.6%，MegaDescriptor-L则分别达到99.3%、98.1%和96.1%。但面向部署的阈值校准结果显示，最优阈值性能与校准后性能存在显著差异：在1%的目标误接受率下，混合模型的实际误接受率为1.03%，而MegaDescriptor-L为2.44%。增量登记场景下，仅使用单张参考图像即可实现91%以上的Rank-1准确率，使用8张参考图像时准确率最高可达97.3%，整个过程无需重训练模型，也不会对现有图库集的性能造成负面影响。上述结果表明，阈值校准、泄漏控制和嵌入质量是实现可靠开集牛识别的关键要素，本文为面向部署的动物生物特征系统提供了实用的评估框架。

title: RedLight-VLA: Models for traffic-rule grounding and behavioral emphasis in driving policies
title_zh: RedLight-VLA：面向驾驶策略的交通规则锚定与行为强化模型
authors: Bala Murali Manoghar Sai Sudhakar, Sourab Bapu Sridhar, Sandipan Das, Rahul Ahuja, Meda Lazar 等 (8 人)
abstract: Behavior-cloned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) driving policies struggle with rare rule-governed maneuvers at signalized intersections. Braking and launching examples contribute little to averaged trajectory loss, while fused representations lack explicit supervision for the governing traffic-light and stop-line state. We present RedLight-VLA, a training objective that uses expert futures and automatically generated perception targets without additional manual rule annotation. First, trajectory-derived behavioral reweighting (BR) emphasizes rare deceleration and acceleration using rotation-invariant longitudinal dynamics and a scale-preserving reduction that exactly recovers the baseline when disabled. Second, parallel auxiliary (AUX) heads ground traffic-light and stop-line state in continuous post-fusion rule tokens, without autoregressive language generation or changes to the trajectory decoder. We evaluate on a curated set of 20 s sequences with a 5 s prediction horizon. Controlled variants share the same backbone, training data, decoder, and evaluation population. Against an otherwise identical VLA baseline, RedLight-VLA reduces red-light stop-line overshoot from 7.3% to6.8%, reduces stop-line velocity error by 12.7%, and improves 3 s trafficlight-sliced ADE/FDE from 0.274/0.964 m to 0.247/0.897 m. Green-light false stops increase from 3.2% to 3.9%; however, combining BR with AUX supervision mitigates the larger increase observed for AUX alone (4.0%). The combined model also improves non-traffic-light ADE/FDE from 0.268/0.956 m to 0.241/0.876 m and outperforms either mechanism alone on all four sliced displacement measures.
summary_zh: 基于行为克隆的视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）驾驶策略在处理信号交叉口处由规则约束的稀有操作时存在明显缺陷：制动和起步样本在平均轨迹损失中的占比极低，而融合后的表征缺乏针对管控交通灯和停止线状态的显式监督信号。本文提出RedLight-VLA训练目标，该方法利用专家未来轨迹和自动生成的感知目标，无需额外的人工规则标注。首先，基于轨迹的行为重加权（BR）模块采用旋转不变纵向动力学和保尺度降维方法强化稀有减速和加速行为的权重，该模块禁用时可完全恢复基线模型性能。其次，并行辅助（AUX）头模块在融合后的连续规则token中锚定交通灯和停止线状态，无需自回归语言生成，也无需修改轨迹解码器。我们在经过筛选的20秒序列数据集上进行评估，预测时域设置为5秒。所有对照变体共享相同的骨干网络、训练数据、解码器和评估样本集。与完全相同的VLA基线模型相比，RedLight-VLA将红灯下停止线越线率从7.3%降至6.8%，停止线速度误差降低12.7%，3秒交通灯分段平均位移误差/最终位移误差（ADE/FDE）从0.274m/0.964m提升至0.247m/0.897m。绿灯误停率从3.2%上升至3.9%，但行为重加权与辅助监督结合的方案缓解了仅使用辅助监督时出现的更大幅增长（4.0%）。组合模型还将非交通灯场景下的ADE/FDE从0.268m/0.956m提升至0.241m/0.876m，在所有四个分段位移指标上的表现均优于单独使用任意一种机制的模型。

title: Parametric Multimodal User Memory: Storing What Captions Cannot Carry
title_zh: 参数化多模态用户记忆：存储文本描述无法承载的信息
authors: Bojie Li, Noah Shi
abstract: A personalized agent needs a user memory: a persistent model of who its user is. Today it is almost always text -- transcripts and captions retrieved by similarity. This serves the captionable half of a person ("my cat is named Bibi"), but discards the perceptual half no caption can hold: how a voice sounds, how a face reads across age and lighting, how tired someone sounds. We measure this loss across five modalities: a strong caption-based re-identifier recovers as little as 0.11 of a dedicated encoder's recall, collapsing toward chance on non-nameable signals.We instead ground perceptual memory in the model, decomposing recall into two subproblems: a vision-language model grounds the referent in context (what and where), and a dedicated encoder extracts an identity key (who), stored as one inline token read by attention at generation with no external round-trip. Neither suffices alone -- the VLM identifies cross-age faces at only 0.54 recall where a face encoder reaches 0.81, and an ungrounded encoder recognizes a two-person-scene referent at 0.05 -- yet together they reach correct-region oracle (0.96), generalizing to multi-speaker audio and video. The recognition core is training-free: it reproduces the encoder's recall on any frozen model at O(1) registration cost. On PerceptMem (12 domains, 1,080 tasks) perceptual identity is capacity-limited while exact facts are binding-limited: identity belongs in a parametric bank, facts in a text store. The two memories compose cleanly: an agent with both can remember not only what its user said, but also what they are like.
summary_zh: 个性化智能体需要用户记忆模块，即对用户特征的持久化建模。当前这类模块几乎全部采用文本形式，通过相似度检索获取转录内容和图像描述。这类方案只能覆盖用户可被描述的部分特征（如“我的猫叫Bibi”），但会丢失所有文本描述无法承载的感知类信息：比如某人的声音特质、不同年龄和光照条件下的面部特征、某人的疲惫语气等。我们在5种模态上对这类信息损失进行了量化：性能优异的基于描述的重识别模型的召回率仅为专用编码器的0.11，在非命名类信号上的性能几乎退化为随机猜测。本文将感知记忆直接嵌入模型内部，将召回任务拆解为两个子问题：视觉语言模型在上下文中锚定指代对象（明确“是谁、在哪里”），专用编码器提取身份密钥（明确“是谁”），身份密钥以内联token的形式存储，生成阶段通过注意力机制读取，无需外部往返调用。两个子模块单独使用均无法达到理想效果：视觉语言模型的跨年龄人脸识别召回率仅为0.54，而专用人脸编码器可达0.81；未经过锚定的编码器在双人场景下的指代识别召回率仅为0.05，但二者结合后正确区域识别的最优召回率可达0.96，且可泛化到多说话人音频和视频场景。该识别核心无需训练：可在任意冻结模型上复现编码器的召回性能，注册成本为O(1)。在包含12个领域、1080个任务的PerceptMem数据集上的实验表明，感知身份的性能瓶颈为容量限制，而精确事实的性能瓶颈为绑定限制：身份信息适合存储在参数化库中，事实信息适合存储在文本库中。两类记忆可无缝协同：同时搭载两类记忆的智能体不仅可以记住用户说过的话，还可以记住用户本身的特征。

title: MedTVL: Harnessing Vision and Language for Medical Time Series Classification
title_zh: 融合三轴IMU传感器与集成学习的帕金森病严重程度有效分类方法
authors: Jiexia Ye, Jia Li, Fugee Tsung
abstract: Recent advancements in multimodal learning for medical time series (MedTS) classification highlight the benefits of integrating complementary modalities for clinical decision. However, existing methods typically focus on bi-modal interactions (e.g., time series and text), leaving the tri-modal synergy between time series, vision, and language largely unexplored. Inspired by diagnostic practice synergizing numerical assessment, visual inspection and clinical context, we introduce MedTVL, a text-guided dual-pathway architecture tailored for MedTS classification. Specifically, it synergizes a convolution-based temporal pathway for fine-grained temporal dynamics from raw numerical sequences and a transformer-based visual pathway for holistic morphological structures from time-series-derived images. Such combination of cross-modal and architectural heterogeneity provides a comprehensive diagnostic perspective. To further resolve potential diagnostic ambiguity, both pathways are guided by adaptive medical textual semantics. Finally, a Mixture-of-Experts mechanism dynamically routes each instance to specialized fusion experts, capturing instance-specific reliance on the temporal and visual pathway outputs. In addition, MedTVL supports multimodal contrastive learning to mitigate the clinical label scarcity challenge. Extensive experiments across multiple medical datasets and tasks, spanning supervised, few-shot, and contrastive learning settings, demonstrate the superiority and transferability of MedTVL, highlighting its potential for robust clinical decision support.
summary_zh: 帕金森病（PD）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，会严重影响运动能力，引发震颤、僵直、姿势不稳和运动迟缓等症状。及时的临床治疗、疾病管理与患者生活质量与帕金森病的早期准确识别密切相关。近年来，可穿戴传感器技术与人工智能技术的发展为构建非侵入式、数据驱动的疾病检测方法提供了可能。本文提出了一套对比人工智能系统，通过分析惯性测量单元（IMU）采集的运动和震颤数据实现帕金森病检测，数据包含加速度传感器和陀螺仪传感器在X、Y、Z三个方向上的运动信号，这些症状信号可提供与帕金森病相关的细微运动缺损的有效信息。我们对比了多个分类模型的性能，包括支持向量机（SVM）、逻辑回归（LR）、K近邻（KNN）、决策树（DT）、极端梯度提升（XGBoost）和轻量梯度提升机（LightGBM）。实验结果显示，逻辑回归在所有评估指标上的性能约为75%，K近邻约为90%，支持向量机的性能接近94%，决策树和XGBoost的分类准确率分别接近96%，LightGBM在所有评估方法中性能最优，其准确率、精确率、召回率和F1值均约为97%。结果表明，所提出的机器学习方法在帕金森病严重程度分类任务中具备准确高效的预测能力。

title: Integrating Triaxial IMU Sensors and Ensemble Learning for Effective Parkinson Disease Severity Classification
authors: Rehan Khan, Muhammad Junaid Asif, Rana Fayyaz Ahmad
abstract: Parkinson disease PD is a progressive neurodegenerative disease that can have a significant impact on motor performance resulting in the appearance of symptoms such as tremors rigidity postural instabilities and bradykinesia. Timely clinical treatment disease management and quality life of the patients are closely linked to early and appropriate identification of PD. Over the past few years the growth of wearable sensor technology and artificial intelligence AI have made it possible to create noninvasive and data driven disease detection methods. This paper proposes a comparative system using artificial intelligence to detect Parkinsons disease by analyzing the motion and tremor data captured by an inertial measurement unit IMU. The data comprises the signals of the acceleration and gyroscope sensors measuring movement in three directions X Y and Z. The signs and symptoms provide helpful information about subtle motor deficits associated with PD. Several classification models like Support Vector Machine SVM Logistic Regression LR KNearest Neighbors KNN Decision Tree DT Extreme Gradient Boosting XGBoost and Light Gradient Boosting Machine LightGBM were used to compare their effectiveness. The Logistic Regression model had a performance around 75 percent in all evaluation metrics and KNearest Neighbours KNN around 90 percent. The support vector machine SVM performed almost 94 percent whereas the performance of classifiers such as Decision Tree and XGBoost was close to 96 percent and overall classification efficacy respectively. LightGBM model performs consistently at the best rank among all of the evaluated methods having Accuracy, Precision, Recall and F1score of around 97 percent. The results show that the proposed machine learning approach offers an accurate and effective predictive capability in the classification of PD severity.

title: SUN: Persistent Programs For Language-Grounded Control-to-Learning-to-Real Policies
title_zh: SUN：面向语言引导的“控制-学习-真实部署”策略的持久化程序
authors: Weiqi Wang, Zhi Li, Yudong Lei, David Martinez, Xiaofeng Gao 等 (10 人)
abstract: Bridging model-based control and learned policies in long-horizon manipulation has harbored a silent disagreement: control executes specified objectives, learning amortizes that behavior into a reactive policy, yet existing protocols discard task semantics, leaving rewards hand-crafted and behavior drifting from what controlthis http URLintroduce Semantically UNified (SUN) Programs, typed executables where geometric and contact relations are defined once and compiled into aligned Model Predictive Control (MPC) costs, satisfaction predicates, RL rewards, transition guards, and diagnostics. Our system, Kuafu, driven by large vision language systems, automatically synthesizes SUN Programs from language and scene semantics, screens feasibility via MPC, and retains semantics while training stage-conditioned policies. Across nine tasks, Kuafu achieves 82.03% macro-success, outperforming sparse-reward (35.67%) and Stage-BC (24.75%) baselines. At 8192-way scale, it generates 10.57x the successful trajectory time per hour of human teleoperation. With 500 trajectories per task, Kuafu data trains DP3 policies to 46.0% simulation success (vs. 22.4% for alternatives) and 34.7% on physical Franka and Kinova robots. These results establish that simulation-screened task semantics can effectively amortize control into robust policies, without demonstrations or manual dense rewards, unifying symbolic planning and data-driven execution.
summary_zh: 在长周期操作任务中，融合基于模型的控制与学习型策略的研究领域长期存在一个未被明确指出的分歧：控制模块执行指定目标，学习模块将该行为泛化为反应式策略，但现有协议会丢弃任务语义，导致奖励需要人工设计，且学习到的行为会逐渐偏离控制模块的预期。本文提出语义统一（Semantically UNified, SUN）程序，这是一类类型化可执行文件，几何和接触关系仅需定义一次，即可编译为对齐的模型预测控制（MPC）代价函数、满足性谓词、强化学习奖励、转移守卫和诊断规则。我们开发的Kuafu系统以大视觉语言模型为驱动，可从语言和场景语义中自动合成SUN程序，通过模型预测控制筛选可行性，并在训练阶段条件策略的过程中保留全部语义信息。在9项任务上的实验结果显示，Kuafu的宏平均成功率达到82.03%，性能远超稀疏奖励基线（35.67%）和Stage-BC基线（24.75%）。在8192任务规模下，该系统每小时生成的成功轨迹时长是人类遥操作的10.57倍。在每个任务仅使用500条轨迹的条件下，Kuafu生成的数据训练得到的DP3策略在仿真环境中的成功率达到46.0%（其他基线方法仅为22.4%），在真实Franka和Kinova机器人上的成功率达到34.7%。上述结果证明，经过仿真筛选的任务语义可有效将控制能力泛化为鲁棒的策略，无需演示数据或人工设计密集奖励，实现符号规划与数据驱动执行的统一。

title: Autonomously Acquiring Robot Manipulation Skills with Language-Driven Quality-Diversity
title_zh: 基于语言驱动的质量多样性算法自主获取机器人操作技能
authors: Émiland Garrabé, Mahdi Khoramshahi, Stéphane Doncieux
abstract: Quality-diversity (QD) algorithms have been gaining traction in robot learning, where diverse motion primitive libraries allow robots to adapt zero-shot to constraints at deployment time. However, such methods typically require expert designers to write the success condition, fitness and diversity metrics, and this strongly limits the robot's autonomy. On the other hand, existing LLM-based reward-shaping techniques allow robots to learn autonomously but only output single high-performing solutions, limiting the robot's adaptability. In this paper, we propose an approach designed to output diverse motion primitive archives by autonomously leveraging quality-diversity algorithms, only requiring a free-form description of the task in common language. To address the difficulty of designing relevant fitness and diversity metrics, we propose an autonomous exploration mechanism able to reliably output sets of functionals covering the fitness and behavior descriptor (BD) space. First, we pose policy exploration as a functional design problem, where the functional spaces are lower-dimensional than the full BD and fitness spaces, and propose an LLM-based exploration scheme to sample from these low-dimensional spaces without any task-specific prompts, fine-tuning or expert intervention. We adapt a multi-BD variant of the MAP-Elites success (MES) algorithm, designed to leverage the heterogeneous BD samples. Finally, through experiments based on the genesis simulator, we show that our method effectively generates archives of diverse motion primitives, outperforming classical QD algorithms with inferred and hand-written parametrizations on a set of $4$ robotic manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 质量多样性（Quality-Diversity, QD）算法在机器人学习领域受到越来越多的关注，该算法生成的多样化运动基元库可让机器人在部署时零样本适配各类约束。但这类方法通常需要专家设计人员手动编写成功条件、适应度和多样性指标，严重限制了机器人的自主性。另一方面，现有基于大语言模型的奖励塑造技术可让机器人自主学习，但仅能输出单一高性能解决方案，限制了机器人的适配能力。本文提出一种可自主利用质量多样性算法生成多样化运动基元库的方法，仅需用户用自然语言输入任务的自由描述即可。为解决相关适应度和多样性指标的设计难题，本文提出一种自主探索机制，可可靠生成覆盖适应度和行为描述符（BD）空间的泛函集合。首先，我们将策略探索定义为泛函设计问题，泛函空间的维度远低于完整的行为描述符和适应度空间，并提出基于大语言模型的探索方案，无需任何任务特定提示、微调或专家干预即可从这些低维空间中采样。我们对多行为描述符版本的MAP-Elites MES算法进行了适配，使其可利用异质性行为描述符样本。最后，基于Genesis仿真器的实验结果表明，在4项机器人操作任务上，本文方法可有效生成多样化的运动基元库，性能优于采用推断参数和手写参数的传统质量多样性算法。

title: LightNav-0: Eliciting VLM Spatial Intelligence for Generalist Embodied Navigation
title_zh: LightNav-0：激发视觉语言模型空间智能的通用具身导航模型
authors: Shaoan Wang, Aocheng Luo, Fei Huang, Jingyi Xu, Xiaoyang Wang 等 (20 人)
abstract: Embodied navigation requires agents to translate heterogeneous goals and visual observations into actions across tasks, environments, and robot embodiments. Modern vision-language models (VLMs) already encode spatial priors for visual grounding, spatial reasoning, and pointing, but these capabilities are rarely elicited directly for robot control. Existing navigation systems instead rely on task- or embodiment-specific components, fragmenting perception, reasoning, and action while offering limited generalization. Here we present LightNav-0, a compact generalist embodied navigation model that elicits the spatial intelligence of a pretrained VLM and aligns it with navigation, without task-specific prediction heads. LightNav-0 represents diverse navigation tasks through a unified token interface: dual-channel pointing expresses task-, scene-, and embodiment-agnostic spatial intent, while a residual vector-quantized action tokenizer maps this intent to precise, embodiment-specific trajectories. Together with temporally aware visual history compression, ER mid-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning, this formulation supports instruction following, open-vocabulary object navigation, and visual tracking within a single model. The navigation training corpus spans 2K+ scenes and 4K+ hours of embodied navigation data. LightNav-ER, the embodied-reasoning checkpoint used to initialize LightNav-0, attains the highest complete-set average across 8 embodied-reasoning benchmarks, while LightNav-0 achieves state-of-the-art monocular success rates across all 10 public navigation simulation settings. Real-world evaluations further demonstrate zero-shot generalization across robot embodiments, diverse scenes, and static and dynamic targets. These results establish compact VLMs as a unified and transferable backbone for generalist embodied navigation.
summary_zh: 具身导航要求智能体跨任务、跨环境、跨机器人形态将异构目标和视觉观测转化为动作。现代视觉语言模型（VLM）已经编码了用于视觉锚定、空间推理和指向的空间先验，但这些能力很少被直接用于机器人控制。现有导航系统反而依赖任务特定或形态特定的组件，割裂了感知、推理和动作的关联，泛化能力十分有限。本文提出LightNav-0，一款轻量型通用具身导航模型，可激发预训练视觉语言模型的空间智能并将其与导航任务对齐，无需设置任务特定预测头。LightNav-0通过统一的token接口表征各类导航任务：双通道指向机制表达与任务、场景、机器人形态无关的空间意图，残差向量量化动作tokenizer将该意图映射为精确的、适配特定机器人形态的轨迹。结合时间感知视觉历史压缩、ER中间训练、监督微调与强化学习，该框架可在单个模型内同时支持指令跟随、开放词汇对象导航和视觉跟踪三类任务。导航训练语料覆盖2000+场景和4000+小时的具身导航数据。用于初始化LightNav-0的具身推理检查点LightNav-ER在8个具身推理基准上的全集平均性能达到最优，LightNav-0在全部10个公开导航仿真设置上的单目成功率达到当前最优水平。真实场景评估进一步证明，该模型可跨机器人形态、不同场景、静态和动态目标实现零样本泛化。上述结果表明，轻量级视觉语言模型可作为通用、可迁移的骨干网络支撑通用具身导航任务。

title: The Structure of Merging Turbulent Jets Beneath a Small Quadrotor
title_zh: 小型四旋翼无人机下方合并湍流射流的结构特性
authors: Anoop Kiran, Nora Ayanian, Kenneth Breuer
abstract: The downwash wake of a hovering quadrotor governs both the vehicle's own performance and the safe spacing of multi-rotor formations. Prior measurements have largely characterized the mean flow, using single-point anemometry, volumetric tracking, or planar cuts through part of the rotor system. Higher-order turbulent statistics of the merged wake, and how they relate to canonical jet scaling, have remained unresolved, particularly for small quadrotors at the low-Reynolds-number end of the size range. Here, we present a detailed particle image velocimetry (PIV) study of the downwash of a hovering Crazyflie 2.1 quadrotor (arm length, $l = 46$ mm), sampled along a diagonal cut, passing through rotors along the symmetry axis of the quadrotor, and a front-rotor cut, passing through adjacent rotors. The four rotor jets merge into a single column by $z/l \approx 5$, beyond which the mean velocity profiles progressively approach the canonical round-jet self-similar form, collapsing by $z/l \approx 13$ when scaled by the local centerline velocity and half-width. Centerline decay and half-width growth follow canonical scaling laws with an effective source diameter $D_\text{eff} = 2.29\,l$, effective Reynolds number $Re_{D_\text{eff}} = 3 \times 10^4$, at the low end of the range over which canonical jet scaling has been established, and spreading and decay constants nonetheless within the canonical round-jet range. Resolving both cuts shows that the turbulent normal stresses retain a bimodal, cut-dependent signature of the four-rotor source throughout the measurement domain.
summary_zh: 悬停四旋翼的下洗尾流不仅影响飞行器自身性能，还决定了多旋翼编队的安全间距。现有测量工作大多采用单点风速测量、体追踪或旋翼系统局部平面切片的方式表征平均流场特性，合并后尾流的高阶湍流统计特性及其与标准射流标度规律的关联仍不明确，针对处于低雷诺数区间的小型四旋翼的相关研究尤为匮乏。本文采用粒子图像测速技术（PIV）对悬停状态下Crazyflie 2.1四旋翼无人机（臂长l=46mm）的下洗流场开展详细研究，采样路径包括穿过旋翼、沿四旋翼对称轴的对角切片，以及穿过相邻旋翼的前旋翼切片。实验结果显示，四个旋翼的射流在z/l≈5的位置合并为单一柱体，此后平均速度分布逐渐趋近于标准圆射流的自相似形态，采用局部中心线速度和半宽进行标度后，在z/l≈13的位置实现完全坍缩对齐。中心线衰减和半宽增长符合标准标度规律，对应的有效源直径D_eff=2.29l，有效雷诺数Re_D_eff=3×10^4，处于已验证的标准射流标度适用范围的低端，但其扩散常数和衰减常数仍处于标准圆射流的取值区间内。对两个切片的流场解析结果显示，在整个测量域内，湍流法向应力仍保留着四旋翼源的双峰、切片依赖特征。

title: SleepWalking: Privileged Representation Shaping for End-to-End Blind Locomotion in Legged Robots
title_zh: SleepWalking：面向足式机器人端到端盲运动的特权表征塑造
authors: Zheng Pan, Tenghui Wang, Peilin Li, Shiyu Zhou, Hao Sun 等 (8 人)
abstract: Partially observable locomotion requires a policy to act when task-relevant properties of the robot--environment state are not fully specified by instantaneous observations. Existing approaches often address this challenge by explicitly estimating missing physical variables or processing extended observation histories through structured architectures. We take a different view: partial observability is fundamentally an information-retention problem. The decisive question is not how task-relevant information enters the network, but whether the policy's internal state retains it. Guided by this perspective, we propose SleepWalking for Robot Locomotion (SWAQ), a one-stage end-to-end framework that uses next-step privileged physical reconstruction to shape what a recurrent history representation retains during policy learning, while the deployed actor uses only a direct history-to-action pathway. Under aligned training settings, SWAQ achieves a 15.0\% higher peak mean terrain level than DWAQ, the strongest non-exteroceptive baseline, while using 44.4\% fewer inference MACs per control step. Layerwise probes further show that information associated with the reconstructed physical variables remains linearly decodable through the policy head up to the layer preceding the action output. Complementary theoretical analysis relates privileged-variable recoverability to the achievable-return gap between history-based and privileged-information policy classes. These results suggest that semantic objectives can structure learning without requiring a corresponding architectural decomposition of the deployed controller.
summary_zh: 部分可观测运动要求策略在机器人-环境状态的任务相关属性无法通过瞬时观测完全确定的情况下完成决策。现有方法通常通过显式估计缺失的物理变量，或通过结构化架构处理扩展观测历史来应对这一挑战。本文提出了不同的研究视角：部分可观测性本质上是一个信息留存问题，核心问题并非任务相关信息如何输入网络，而是策略的内部状态是否能够留存这些信息。基于该视角，本文提出面向机器人运动的SleepWalking框架（SWAQ），这是一个单阶段端到端框架，利用下一步特权物理重建来引导策略学习过程中循环历史表征的留存内容，而部署阶段的执行器仅使用直接的历史到动作通路。在对齐的训练设置下，SWAQ的峰值平均地形等级比最强的非本体感受基线DWAQ高出15.0%，同时每控制步的推理乘累加运算（MAC）量减少44.4%。逐层探测实验进一步表明，与重建物理变量相关的信息，直到动作输出前一层都可以通过策略头线性解码。配套理论分析揭示了特权变量可恢复性，与基于历史的策略类和特权信息策略类之间的可实现回报差距的关联。上述结果表明，语义目标可以在不需要对部署控制器进行对应架构分解的前提下，完成结构化学习。

title: Zeva: In-Context Causal Learning for Generalizable Embodied Manipulation
title_zh: Zeva：面向可泛化具身操作的上下文内因果学习
authors: Fu Chen, Xin Ding, Bingjia Huang, Xiangyu Li, Mingju Wang 等 (11 人)
abstract: Generalizable embodied manipulation remains difficult to achieve through pretraining alone, due to unseen physical conditions in the real world. We argue that robots need to learn from their own physical interactions on the fly during real-world deployment and use this knowledge to inform subsequent actions. We present Zeva, the first framework that enables in-context learning from a robot's own physical interaction experience while keeping the policy model frozen. Zeva employs a Causal Interaction Extractor to encode an executed action and its induced state change into a causal interaction signal, which is stored in a dual-timescale causal memory. For subsequent actions, relevant causal interaction signals are retrieved from memory and injected into the frozen policy model as context. Experiments in simulation and real-world manipulation demonstrate that Zeva achieves the best performance among the compared frontier VLAs and WAMs and, more importantly, enables self-evolution during deployment without gradient updates. Its success rate continues to improve as the robot accumulates interaction experience. Furthermore, the acquired interaction experience can generalize across tasks.
summary_zh: 由于真实世界中存在不可见的物理条件，仅靠预训练很难实现可泛化的具身操作。本文认为机器人需要在真实世界部署过程中从自身的物理交互中实时学习，并利用这些知识指导后续动作。本文提出Zeva，首个能够在冻结策略模型的前提下，从机器人自身物理交互经验中实现上下文内学习的框架。Zeva采用因果交互提取器，将已执行动作及其引发的状态变化编码为因果交互信号，存储在双时间尺度因果内存中。执行后续动作时，框架从内存中检索相关因果交互信号，作为上下文注入冻结的策略模型。仿真与真实世界操作实验表明，Zeva的性能在所有对比的前沿视觉语言动作模型（VLA）和全臂操作器（WAM）中表现最优，更重要的是，它可以在无需梯度更新的前提下在部署过程中实现自我进化，随着机器人积累交互经验，其成功率会持续提升，且习得的交互经验可以跨任务泛化。

title: Provably Safe Decentralized Contingency MPC under State-Only Information and Limited Sensing for Nonlinear Multi-agent Systems
title_zh: 仅状态信息与有限传感下非线性多智能体系统的可证安全分散应急模型预测控制
authors: Max Studt, Georg Schildbach
abstract: This paper considers decentralized contingency MPC for multi-agent control under a state-only information pattern, with particular focus on limited sensing and plug-and-play operation. The objective is to retain recursive feasibility, safety, and Lyapunov-type convergence while reducing conservatism in local interaction handling. The framework relies on agent-wise fallback regions (safe sets) in which a feasible contingency maneuver to a safe equilibrium is always available. A novel safe-set update mechanism is introduced that supports less conservative decentralized interaction while preserving the underlying guarantees. This, in turn, enables memory-free local interaction and finite sensing ranges without requiring agents to reconstruct the exact neighbor geometry. The resulting scheme remains fully decentralized and preserves the shared-first-input contingency MPC structure. Theoretical guarantees and simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the approach in dense multi-agent scenarios.
summary_zh: 本文研究仅状态信息模式下的多智能体控制分散应急模型预测控制（MPC），重点关注有限传感与即插即用运行场景。研究目标是在降低本地交互处理保守性的同时，保留递归可行性、安全性与李雅普诺夫型收敛性。该框架基于智能体各自的回退区域（安全集），在该区域内始终存在可实现的、指向安全平衡点的应急机动策略。本文提出一种新型安全集更新机制，在保留底层安全保证的前提下支持保守性更低的分散交互，进而实现无记忆本地交互与有限传感范围，且无需智能体重建精确的邻居几何结构。最终方案完全去中心化，保留了共享首输入应急MPC结构。理论保证与仿真结果验证了该方法在密集多智能体场景下的有效性。

title: A Dual-Cam Parallel Elastic Actuator with Shared Gas-Spring Compensation for Humanoid Ankles
title_zh: 面向人形踝关节的共享气弹簧补偿双凸轮并联弹性致动器
authors: Jingcheng Jiang, Yifang Zhang, Nikos G.Tsagarakis
abstract: To improve torque capacity and energy efficiency of humanoid ankles, this paper proposes a 2-DoF parallel elastic actuator (PEA). The main novelty of the proposed design lies in its dual-cam, single-gas-spring architecture, which enables torque compensation in both pitch and roll using a shared elastic element, thereby improving structural compactness compared with conventional multi-element compensation schemes. By leveraging parallel gas springs and customized cam modules, the proposed architecture provides dual-axis torque assistance tailored to specific task requirements. The second key contribution is the formulation of a coupled 2-DoF mathematical model that explicitly captures the interdependence between the two compensation units through the shared spring. Based on this model, an optimization-based design framework is developed to synthesize customized cam profiles from prescribed torque references, establishing a systematic link from task requirements to hardware realization. The complete lower-leg CAD integration is presented in detail. Static FEA and kinematic simulations confirm the design's feasibility and torque-relief effectiveness. The results highlight the proposed design as a compact, customizable solution for 2-DoF humanoid ankle torque compensation.
summary_zh: 为提升人形踝关节的扭矩容量与能量效率，本文提出一款二自由度（2-DoF）并联弹性致动器（PEA）。该设计的核心创新点在于其双凸轮、单气弹簧架构，可通过共享弹性元件同时实现俯仰与滚转方向的扭矩补偿，相比传统多元件补偿方案大幅提升了结构紧凑性。通过并联气弹簧与定制化凸轮模块，该架构可提供适配特定任务需求的双轴扭矩辅助。本文的第二项核心贡献是构建了耦合二自由度数学模型，通过共享弹簧显式刻画两个补偿单元之间的相互依赖关系。基于该模型，本文开发了基于优化的设计框架，可从预设扭矩参考合成定制化凸轮轮廓，建立了从任务需求到硬件实现的系统化链路。本文详细展示了完整小腿的CAD集成方案，静态有限元分析（FEA）与运动学仿真验证了该设计的可行性与扭矩减负效果，结果表明该设计是面向二自由度人形踝关节扭矩补偿的紧凑、可定制解决方案。

title: Learning to infer and manipulate through distributed whole-arm interaction in a soft robot
title_zh: 软机器人中基于分布式全臂交互的推理与操作学习
authors: Chuhan Zhang, Ebrahim Shahabi, Kseniia Khomenko, Wei Pan, Cosimo Della Santina
abstract: In animals such as elephants and octopuses, acquiring non-visual information about an object and physically engaging with it are inseparable processes mediated by rich, large-area interactions between compliant appendages and the environment. Soft robots provide a natural platform for translating this principle into engineered systems. Yet current robotic intelligence makes limited use of physical interaction, treating it primarily as a disturbance to be rejected or, at best, as a means of compensating for object misalignment.Here, we introduce a physical intelligence framework in which distributed compliant interactions jointly reveal task-relevant information and organize manipulation behavior. This results in an intrinsically partially observable problem: key task-relevant information is never measured directly, but must instead be inferred from the history of physical interactions. We propose a reinforcement-learning architecture that addresses this challenge by learning a memory-based control policy end-to-end. The key innovations making this possible are (i) a pretrained exploration policy that provides a reference for broad workspace exploration, (ii) joint optimization that integrates exploration and grasping objectives within a single recurrent policy, and (iii) a two-stage sim-to-real adaptation including observation mapping and policy fine-tuning.We demonstrate this principle through blind whole-arm grasping with a hybrid rigid-soft robotic arm that we equip with IMUs embedded directly within its compliant structure, providing its only source of proprioceptive sensing. The learned policy successfully identifies and grasps various objects by autonomously coordinating workspace exploration, object encounter and localization, inference of grasp-relevant properties, and stable whole-arm wrapping.
summary_zh: 在大象、章鱼等动物中，获取物体非视觉信息与物理交互是不可分割的过程，二者由柔性附肢与环境之间丰富的大面积交互介导。软机器人是将该原理转化为工程系统的天然平台，但当前机器人智能对物理交互的利用十分有限，大多将其视为需要抑制的扰动，最多仅将其作为补偿物体位姿偏差的手段。本文提出一种物理智能框架，分布式柔性交互可同时揭示任务相关信息并组织操作行为，该框架天然对应部分可观测问题：关键任务相关信息永远无法被直接测量，必须从物理交互历史中推断得到。本文提出一种强化学习架构，通过端到端学习基于记忆的控制策略解决该挑战，支撑该架构的核心创新包括：(1) 预训练探索策略，为大范围工作空间探索提供参考；(2) 联合优化，将探索与抓取目标集成到单个循环策略中；(3) 包含观测映射与策略微调的两阶段 sim-to-real 迁移方案。本文通过在刚软混合机械臂上实现盲全臂抓取验证了该原理：该机械臂的柔性结构中直接嵌入惯性测量单元（IMU）作为唯一的本体感知来源，习得的策略可自主协调工作空间探索、物体接触与定位、抓取相关属性推理、稳定全臂包裹等过程，成功识别并抓取多种物体。

title: CIG-RL: Curiosity-Driven Information-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Source Term Estimation in Uncertain Environments
title_zh: CIG-RL：不确定环境下源项估计的好奇心驱动信息引导强化学习
authors: Junhee Lee, Seunghwan Kim, Hongro Jang, Hyungjin Kim, Hyoungho Park 等 (7 人)
abstract: Source term estimation (STE), which aims to estimate key properties of the gas source, is essential for identifying hazardous gas releases. Information-theoretic approaches have been adopted for autonomous STE using mobile sensors due to robustness in noisy environments, yet their online action selection incurs substantial computational cost. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) provides a promising alternative with its fast decision-making capability. In DRL-based STE, the agent selects actions based on belief states of the source term updated from noisy measurement sequences. However, existing methods rely on random exploration or solely on belief uncertainty reduction without an effective exploration strategy in DRL, which can limit policy robustness in noisy environments. To address this, we propose a curiosity-driven information-guided reinforcement learning for robust and efficient STE. The proposed method promotes active exploration of novel belief state transitions that have not been sufficiently explored during training. We further introduce an uncertainty-adaptive active perception reward to guide efficient source search under uncertainty. Simulations under high-noise conditions and real-world experiments demonstrate the robustness and feasibility of the proposed framework, highlighting its potential for practical STE problems.
summary_zh: 源项估计（STE）旨在估计气体源的关键属性，是识别危险气体泄漏的核心技术。信息论方法凭借在噪声环境下的鲁棒性，已被应用于移动传感器自主STE场景，但这类方法的在线动作选择会产生极高的计算成本。深度强化学习（DRL）凭借快速决策能力为该问题提供了极具前景的替代方案。在基于DRL的STE中，智能体基于从噪声测量序列更新得到的源项信念状态选择动作，但现有方法依赖随机探索或仅以降低信念不确定性为目标，缺乏DRL框架下的有效探索策略，会限制噪声环境下的策略鲁棒性。为解决该问题，本文提出好奇心驱动的信息引导强化学习方法，实现鲁棒高效的STE任务。该方法主动探索训练过程中未被充分探索的全新信念状态转移，进一步引入不确定性自适应主动感知奖励，引导不确定条件下的高效源搜索。高噪声条件下的仿真与真实世界实验验证了该框架的鲁棒性与可行性，展现了其在实际STE问题中的应用潜力。

title: Temporal Forcing: 4D Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: 时间强制：面向视觉语言动作模型的4D表征对齐
authors: Xingyu Ding, Yuzhong Zhao, Chunhai Zhao, Yinghuan Shi, Chaoyang Zhao 等 (6 人)
abstract: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) methods improve manipulation performance by aligning their representations with 3D scene geometry. However, these methods often struggle with long-horizon manipulation and observation aliasing between visually similar states due to a lack of temporal information: the 3D scene geometry captures only the current state, rather than how it has evolved over time. To resolve this, we present Temporal Forcing, a 4D representation alignment method for VLA models. Specifically, we first introduce a history pathway that enables a vanilla VLA model to summarize observation history into temporally aware latent representations. Then, the latent representations are aligned with the geometric features extracted by a pretrained 4D foundation model, which captures the evolving 3D world through temporally consistent geometric representations, enabling a deeper understanding of dynamic environments. Temporal Forcing reaches 98.8% on LIBERO, outperforming its base model by 2.2 points. On a physical hidden-placement task, it raises full-task success from 20.0% to 43.3%. Code will be publicly available.
summary_zh: 近期的视觉语言动作（VLA）方法通过将表征与3D场景几何对齐提升操作性能，但这类方法由于缺乏时序信息，通常难以处理长时序操作任务与视觉相似状态之间的观测混叠问题：3D场景几何仅能捕捉当前状态，无法刻画状态随时间的演化过程。为解决该问题，本文提出面向VLA模型的4D表征对齐方法——时间强制。具体而言，本文首先引入历史通路，使基础VLA模型能够将观测历史汇总为具备时序感知的隐层表征，随后将该隐层表征与预训练4D基础模型提取的几何特征对齐，该4D基础模型可通过时序一致的几何表征捕捉不断演化的3D世界，实现对动态环境的深度理解。时间强制方法在LIBERO基准上的准确率达到98.8%，相比基础模型提升2.2个百分点；在真实世界隐藏放置任务中，将全任务成功率从20.0%提升至43.3%，相关代码将开源公开。

title: Behavior-Skill: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Evaluating Vision-Language-Action Policies in Long-Horizon Tasks
title_zh: Behavior-Skill：面向长时序任务中视觉语言动作策略评估的细粒度基准
authors: Chunyun Ma, Lun Luo, Xingjian Luo, Xiexing Feng, Hang Zhang 等 (10 人)
abstract: Reliable execution of long-horizon mobile manipulation tasks remains challenging because overall task success depends on the successful completion of multiple constituent skills. Existing benchmarks, however, still rely primarily on full-task rollouts and aggregate task-level metrics, making intermediate failures difficult to observe and analyze. We present Behavior-Skill, a benchmark that reformulates the learning and evaluation of long-horizon tasks around executable constituent skills. It contains 235,492 skill instances from 10,000 demonstrations across 50 household tasks and 34 semantic skill categories. Each instance pairs a skill instruction with an aligned observation-action segment, and is further associated with a restorable intermediate state and a skill success condition to enable independent evaluation under valid preconditions. We further introduce trajectory-level and skill-level metrics to characterize policy capability beyond aggregate task success. Extensive experiments across representative VLA policies including pi0.5 and GR00T on the complete 50-task benchmark show that failures are highly non-uniform across skills, with contact-rich manipulation skills forming persistent bottlenecks. These results demonstrate that Behavior-Skill complements full-task evaluation by exposing intermediate capability profiles for analyzing and improving long-horizon VLA policies. Behavior-Skill is publicly available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 长时序移动操作任务的可靠执行仍极具挑战性，因为整体任务的成功依赖于多个组成技能的顺利完成。但现有基准仍主要依赖全任务 rollout 与聚合级任务指标，难以观测和分析中间过程的失败。本文提出Behavior-Skill基准，围绕可执行的组成技能重构长时序任务的学习与评估流程。该基准包含来自10000份演示数据的235492个技能实例，覆盖50项家庭任务与34个语义技能类别，每个实例将技能指令与对齐的观测-动作片段配对，同时关联可恢复的中间状态与技能成功条件，支持在有效前置条件下开展独立评估。本文进一步引入轨迹级与技能级指标，刻画超越聚合任务成功率的策略能力。在完整50任务基准上对pi0.5、GR00T等代表性VLA策略开展的大量实验表明，策略失败在不同技能间的分布高度不均，其中富接触操作技能是持续存在的性能瓶颈。上述结果表明，Behavior-Skill基准可补充全任务评估的不足，通过暴露中间能力剖面，支撑长时序VLA策略的分析与优化，Behavior-Skill已在指定链接公开可用。

title: Anomaly Detection on Small Industrial Components via Vision-Based Tactile Sensing
title_zh: 基于视觉触觉传感的小型工业组件异常检测
authors: G. F. Preziosa, M. Casiglia, M. Faroni, A. M. Zanchettin, P. Rocco
abstract: Automated inspection of small industrial components, including sub-centimetre-scale parts where defects are geometry-driven and poorly resolved by standard optical cameras, calls for sensing modalities that can directly capture fine surface geometry. Vision-based tactile sensors address this need by converting contact imprints into high-resolution image-like data compatible with existing deep-learning pipelines, yet their effective use for industrial anomaly detection (AD) remains largely unexplored. This work systematically evaluates unsupervised AD methods on a real tactile dataset covering five genuine industrial components acquired with a GelSight Mini sensor mounted on a collaborative robot. Four feature-embedding methods, SPADE, PaDiM, FAPM, and InReaCh, are compared under three validations explicitly motivated by the deployment constraints of contact-based sensing: a Good Fraction analysis establishing the minimum number of nominal contacts for stable performance, directly bounded by gel wear since every acquisition degrades the soft interface; a cross-position evaluation assessing generalization across different contact locations observing the same recurring surface pattern; and a low- versus high-resolution comparison evaluating the cost-benefit of higher-resolution tactile acquisition. Overall, this systematic benchmarking study provides practical guidance for researchers and practitioners adopting vision-based tactile sensing for industrial AD and shows how this modality can serve as a viable alternative for industrial quality-control tasks.
summary_zh: 厘米级以下的小型工业组件缺陷多由几何特征驱动，标准光学相机难以清晰识别，这类组件的自动化检测需要可直接捕捉精细表面几何的传感模态。视觉触觉传感可将接触印记转化为与现有深度学习流水线兼容的高分辨率类图像数据，恰好满足该需求，但该技术在工业异常检测（AD）中的有效应用仍未得到充分探索。本文在协作机器人搭载GelSight Mini传感器采集的、覆盖5类真实工业组件的触觉数据集上，系统评估无监督AD方法。本文针对接触式传感的部署约束，设计三类验证实验：对比SPADE、PaDiM、FAPM、InReaCh四种特征嵌入方法，分别开展：良品占比分析，确定实现稳定性能所需的最小标称接触次数，该指标直接受凝胶磨损限制（每次采集都会损耗软接触界面）；跨位置评估，验证在观测同一重复表面模式的不同接触位置上的泛化能力；低分辨率与高分辨率对比，评估更高分辨率触觉采集的成本收益。整体而言，该系统性基准研究为采用视觉触觉传感开展工业AD的研究人员与从业者提供了实践指导，证明该传感模态可作为工业质量控制任务的可行替代方案。

title: A Hybrid PEM-GP Framework for Uncertainty-Aware System Identification of Quadcopters
title_zh: 面向四旋翼无人机不确定性感知系统辨识的混合PEM-GP框架
authors: Abdallah Ghoul, Ismail Khalil Bousserhane, Kadri Boufeldja
abstract: Accurate dynamic models play a central role in achieving reliable control of quadcopters. Classical system identification methods remain widely used, mainly because of their interpretability. However, they often fail to capture important nonlinear effects, especially in small-scale aerial platforms where such effects become more pronounced.Data-driven approaches offer a different perspective. They can represent complex nonlinear dynamics more effectively, but this comes at the cost of reduced interpretability and the absence of well-calibrated uncertainty estimates.In this work, we propose a framework that combines physics-based modeling with data-driven learning, while explicitly accounting for uncertainty. A physics-based model is first identified using the Prediction Error Method (PEM), which captures the main structure of the system. The remaining dynamics are then modeled using a Gaussian Process (GP), allowing the residual behavior to be learned directly from data. This separation makes it possible to distinguish between known physical effects and unmodeled dynamics.The proposed framework is validated on a Duckiedrone-like experimental setup. The results show that the PEM-GP model achieves prediction accuracy comparable to that of a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network, while additionally providing calibrated uncertainty estimates. This combination improves model reliability and supports uncertainty-aware decision-making.
summary_zh: 精确的动力学模型是实现四旋翼无人机可靠控制的核心。经典系统辨识方法凭借可解释性得到广泛应用，但这类方法通常难以捕捉重要的非线性效应，在这类效应更为显著的小型无人机平台上表现尤为突出。数据驱动方法提供了不同的解决思路，可更高效地表征复杂非线性动力学，但代价是可解释性下降，且无法输出校准良好的不确定性估计。本文提出融合物理建模与数据驱动学习的框架，同时显式考虑不确定性。首先采用预测误差法（PEM）辨识得到物理基模型，捕捉系统的主体结构，剩余动力学部分采用高斯过程（GP）建模，直接从数据中学习残差行为。该分离方案可明确区分已知物理效应与未建模动力学。本文在类Duckiedrone实验平台上验证了所提框架的性能，结果表明PEM-GP模型的预测精度与长短期记忆网络（LSTM）相当，同时可输出校准后的不确定性估计，该组合特性提升了模型可靠性，可为不确定性感知决策提供支撑。

title: Scaffolding Foundation Models into Physical-World Agents Pushes the Frontier of Long-Horizon Navigation
title_zh: 将基础模型支架化为现实世界智能体，拓展长程导航领域边界
authors: Zixing Lei, Gengze Zhou, Xiong-Hui Chen, Jiazhao Zhang, Yiyang Huang 等 (10 人)
abstract: Long-horizon physical-world agents must reason over distant goals while grounding decisions in reliable closed-loop behavior. Today's foundation models split these capabilities: vision-language models (VLMs) infer missing information and adapt high-level plans but remain brittle and inefficient at repeated navigation grounding, while navigation foundation models (NFMs) robustly execute semantic goals but operate as bounded episodes without persistent task-level reasoning. We introduce NavMCP, an agentic scaffolding framework that couples a VLM reasoning agent with an NFM executor for long-horizon exploration. The VLM decides what evidence to seek, where to search, and when to stop, while the NFM grounds each semantic sub-goal into closed-loop navigation. Three channels structure their collaboration: intent translates evidence needs into navigation calls, observation converts rollouts into source-grounded trajectory evidence, and memory accumulates findings, negative evidence, and unresolved goals across calls. This design turns isolated navigation rollouts into persistent embodied interaction without retraining either model. On Embodied Question Answering, NavMCP achieves state-of-the-art results on HM-EQA, MT-HM3D, and EXPRESS-Bench. Under matched agent and executor backbones, it outperforms an episodic interface by 14.9 percentage points on HM-EQA. On a Unitree Go2, NavMCP reaches 78.3% success, with its margin over the strongest baseline growing from 10 to 45 points as the task horizon increases. These results demonstrate the potential of scaffolding complementary foundation models into long-horizon physical-world agents.
summary_zh: 长程现实世界智能体需要在可靠的闭环行为决策基础上，对远期目标进行推理。当前的基础模型拆分了这两类能力：视觉语言模型（VLM）能够推断缺失信息并适配高层规划，但在重复导航落地任务中表现脆弱且效率低下；而导航基础模型（NFM）可以稳健执行语义目标，但仅能在有限的独立片段中运行，不具备持久的任务级推理能力。本文提出NavMCP——一种智能体支架框架，将VLM推理智能体与NFM执行器耦合以实现长程探索：VLM负责确定需要搜寻的证据、搜索位置以及终止时机，NFM则将每个语义子目标落地为闭环导航。二者通过三类通道实现协同：意图通道将证据需求转化为导航调用指令，观测通道将执行推演结果转化为带来源标注的轨迹证据，记忆通道跨调用过程累积发现结果、负向证据与未完成目标。该设计无需对任意一类模型进行重新训练，即可将孤立的导航推演转化为持久的具身交互。在具身问答任务中，NavMCP在HM-EQA、MT-HM3D和EXPRESS-Bench数据集上取得了当前最优性能；在智能体与执行器骨干网络配置一致的条件下，其在HM-EQA上的表现比基于独立片段交互的方案高出14.9个百分点。在Unitree Go2四足机器人平台上，NavMCP的任务成功率达到78.3%，且随着任务视界增加，其相对于最优基线方法的性能优势从10个百分点提升至45个百分点。上述结果证明，将能力互补的基础模型通过支架方式整合为长程现实世界智能体具备巨大潜力。

title: PAVE: Predictive Alignment and Value-Guided Evolution for World-Action Policies
title_zh: PAVE：面向世界-动作策略的预测对齐与价值引导进化方法
authors: Botong Zhao, Fang Yu, Senhua Zhu, Xinyuan Chen, Yue Lu
abstract: Direct vision-language-action policies generate continuous robot actions efficiently, but standard behavior cloning leaves two complementary gaps: their representations are not explicitly required to describe how the scene evolves over multiple time scales, and deployment trajectories of unequal quality are often reused without separating useful dynamics from undesirable behavior. We introduce \method, a direct world-action policy that combines outcome-agnostic predictive learning with outcome-aware policy improvement. \method first retains a local fixed-offset JEPA objective and adds trajectory-relative multi-horizon transition alignment at 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% of the remaining episode. These training-only targets require the current policy representation to preserve both local physical changes and longer-range task progress, without supplying explicit future tokens to the action head. \method then trains an independent distributional value critic on cumulative deployment trajectories, computes action-chunk-aligned $N$-step advantages, and converts them into positive, negative, or null text conditions for a flow-matching actor. Thus, every valid trajectory can teach what physically happened, while the actor is deployed only under the condition associated with relatively better actions. The multi-horizon predictor and critic are removed from online execution, preserving direct action generation from the current observation, language instruction, and proprioception. \redclaim{Across the three simulation benchmarks, \method achieves the strongest overall performance while preserving the direct actor's online execution path.}
summary_zh: 直接视觉-语言-动作策略可以高效生成连续机器人动作，但标准的行为克隆方法存在两个互补的缺陷：其表征没有被明确要求描述场景在多时间尺度下的演化规律，且不同质量的部署轨迹通常被直接复用，无法将有用的动力学特征与不良行为区分开。本文提出PAVE这一直接世界动作策略，将与结果无关的预测学习和感知结果的策略改进相结合：PAVE首先保留局部固定偏移JEPA目标，同时在剩余片段的25%、50%、75%和100%节点处添加轨迹相对多视界转移对齐约束。这些仅用于训练的目标要求当前策略表征同时保留局部物理变化和更长周期的任务进度，无需向动作头输入显式的未来标记。随后PAVE在累积部署轨迹上训练独立的分布式价值评判器，计算与动作块对齐的N步优势函数，将其转化为流匹配执行器的正向、负向或空文本条件。由此所有有效轨迹都可以用于学习物理过程，而执行器仅在对应更优动作的条件下完成部署。多视界预测器和评判器均不参与在线执行，保留了从当前观测、语言指令和本体感知直接生成动作的特性。在三个仿真基准测试中，PAVE在保留直接执行器在线执行路径的同时取得了最优的整体性能。

title: SpectraTac: A Compact Camera-Free Optical Tactile Sensor with Distributed Color Sensing
title_zh: SpectraTac：搭载分布式颜色传感的紧凑型无相机光学触觉传感器
authors: Hao Wu, Haotian Guo, Yu Feng, Yutong Wang, Yanzhe Wang 等 (6 人)
abstract: Tactile sensing is essential for physical interaction in robotics and human--machine systems. However, combining rich tactile information with compact hardware, low cost, and low computational overhead remains challenging. This work presents SpectraTac, a compact, camera-free optical tactile sensor that combines active red--green--blue (RGB) illumination with spatially distributed color sensing. Contact deforms a compliant transparent elastomer and modulates its internal light field, producing spatially differentiated changes in color and intensity. Three distributed color sensors capture these responses as low-dimensional spatio-spectral features, avoiding cameras, imaging optics, and high-dimensional image processing. The device measures 19.2 mm in diameter and 4 mm in height, with a material cost below USD~5. A data-driven decoding framework simultaneously estimates three-dimensional (3D) force and the contact region from the optical measurements. For 3D force prediction, the sensor achieved mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 0.161, 0.164, and 0.429 N along the x-, y-, and z-axes, respectively. The nine-region contact-classification accuracy was 99.9%. We further evaluated real-time 3D force tracking and contact-region-based human--machine interaction through an interactive control task. These results indicate that distributed color-resolved optical sensing offers a compact, low-cost alternative to camera-based tactile sensing for robotics, wearable sensing, and interactive systems.
summary_zh: 触觉传感是机器人与人机系统物理交互的核心技术，但同时实现丰富触觉信息感知、紧凑硬件形态、低成本与低计算开销仍然存在挑战。本文提出SpectraTac这一紧凑型无相机光学触觉传感器，融合主动红绿蓝（RGB）照明与空间分布式颜色传感技术：接触动作会使柔性透明弹性体发生形变，调制其内部光场，产生空间差异化的颜色与强度变化。三个分布式颜色传感器将这些响应捕获为低维空间光谱特征，无需使用相机、成像光学元件，也避免了高维图像处理流程。该传感器直径仅19.2mm，高度4mm，材料成本低于5美元。本文设计的数据驱动解码框架可从光学测量结果中同时估计三维（3D）力与接触区域。在3D力预测任务中，传感器沿x、y、z轴的平均绝对误差（MAE）分别为0.161N、0.164N、0.429N；9区域接触分类准确率达到99.9%。本文还通过交互式控制任务验证了传感器的实时3D力追踪性能与基于接触区域的人机交互能力。结果表明，分布式颜色分辨光学传感是面向机器人、可穿戴传感与交互系统的紧凑型低成本触觉传感方案，可替代传统基于相机的触觉传感技术。

title: Data-Centric Neuromotor Interfaces for Portable Human-Machine Interaction
title_zh: 面向便携式人机交互的以数据为中心的神经运动接口
authors: Jiaxuan Li, Di Wu, Jianhua Liu, Yuxin Zhao, Jinnuo Li 等 (10 人)
abstract: Dexterous human-machine interaction requires intuitive and expressive interfaces that can be efficiently deployed on constrained edge devices. Flexible material-based neuromotor interfaces hold considerable promise, as they decode human movement intention into natural control. Although emerging flexible electronic skins enable wearable high-fidelity data acquisition, practical deployment inevitably involves trade-offs between computational resources and portability. We present a data-centric paradigm where physiological features yield fundamental separability, providing sufficient discriminative cues for recognition. A wireless, high-bandwidth system developed for collecting various electrophysiological signals, when integrated with muscle-specific electrodes, forms a surface electromyography-based interface. Exploiting highly separable data, a 2,210-parameter model achieves 94.36% accuracy across 34 gestures and can be rapidly deployed on edge devices, establishing a new thousand-parameter benchmark for dexterous decoding. The underlying data-algorithm interactions in the data-centric paradigm are further clarified, demonstrating its feasibility in real-world scenarios. This study provides a principled and validated pathway for practical deployment of reliable neuromotor interfaces.
summary_zh: 灵巧人机交互需要可在资源受限边缘设备上高效部署的高表现力直观接口。基于柔性材料的神经运动接口可将人体运动意图解码为自然控制指令，具备广阔应用前景。尽管新兴的柔性电子皮肤可实现可穿戴高保真数据采集，实际部署仍需在计算资源与便携性之间做出权衡。本文提出一种以数据为中心的范式：生理特征具备天然的可分性，可为识别任务提供充足的判别线索。本文开发了一套用于采集各类电生理信号的无线高带宽系统，将其与肌肉特异性电极集成后可构建基于表面肌电的接口。利用高可分性数据，仅含2210个参数的模型在34类手势识别任务中即可达到94.36%的准确率，可快速部署在边缘设备上，建立了灵巧解码领域的千参数级新基准。本文进一步阐明了该以数据为中心范式下的数据-算法交互机制，验证了其在真实场景中的可行性，为可靠神经运动接口的实际部署提供了经过验证的标准化路径。

title: CometVLA: Co-Training on an Embodied Data Pyramid towards Physical Understanding
title_zh: CometVLA：面向物理理解的具身数据金字塔协同训练方法
authors: Hanwen Wan, Dafeng Chi, Linbo Zhai, Tianao Shen, Yuzheng Zhuang 等 (9 人)
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models remain brittle in manipulation tasks that require physical commonsense. Current physical VQA data is typically disembodied and misaligned with robot action domains. Egocentric videos are used only as auxiliary pre-training. It remains unclear whether improved VLM physical understanding actually benefits downstream action generation. Therefore, we present CometVLA to close this gap. We construct CometData and CometBench, an embodied physical VQA corpus and benchmark strictly aligned with the robot's action data and embodiment. We introduce Global Action Prior (GAP) tokens, a compact learnable bottleneck that isolates task-agnostic motion regularities and lets the action head consume physical commonsense without corrupting the pre-trained VLM backbone. We co-train CometVLA across the embodied data pyramid, spanning teleoperation, simulation, egocentric trajectories, and VQA layers. On real-world manipulation tasks and RoboTwin simulation, CometVLA consistently outperforms strong VLA baselines. Correlation analysis shows that stronger VLM performance on CometBench indicates higher VLA success rates. Results demonstrate that physical understanding pre-training genuinely benefits downstream manipulation.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在需要物理常识的操作任务中表现仍然脆弱，当前的物理视觉问答（VQA）数据通常是脱离具身的，与机器人动作域不匹配，第一人称视频也仅被用作辅助预训练数据，目前尚不清楚提升视觉语言模型（VLM）的物理理解能力是否真的能优化下游动作生成效果。针对这一问题，本文提出CometVLA方案填补该空白：构建了CometData与CometBench——一套与机器人动作数据和具身特性严格对齐的具身物理VQA语料库与基准测试集；提出全局动作先验（GAP）标记，这一紧凑的可学习瓶颈层可分离与任务无关的运动规律，让动作头在不破坏预训练VLM骨干网络的前提下获取物理常识。本文在覆盖遥操作、仿真、第一人称轨迹、VQA层的具身数据金字塔上对CometVLA进行协同训练。在真实世界操作任务与RoboTwin仿真环境中，CometVLA的性能始终优于现有主流VLA基线方法。相关性分析表明，VLM在CometBench上的性能越高，对应VLA的任务成功率也越高，证明物理理解预训练确实可以为下游操作任务带来增益。

title: CanonNav: Disentangling Navigation Behavior from Camera Geometry in Cross-Platform Visual Navigation
title_zh: CanonNav：跨平台视觉导航中将导航行为与相机几何解耦的框架
authors: Dong-Wook Kim, Ji-Hoon Hwang, E-In Son, Mintaek Oh, Seung-Woo Seo
abstract: While visual navigation has advanced through imitation learning from cross-platform demonstrations, fully leveraging such data remains challenging. First, directly learning from image-trajectory pairs entangles navigation behavior with platform-dependent camera geometry. This hinders consistent learning by forcing the policy to implicitly infer camera geometry from visual observations, an inherently ill-posed problem. Second, imitation learning from demonstrated trajectories captures the expert's chosen motion but leaves the intermediate decisions underlying that motion implicit. To address these issues, we propose CanonNav, a visual navigation framework that disentangles navigation behavior from camera geometry and incorporates complementary planning supervision into learning from cross-platform demonstrations. CanonNav introduces camera geometry canonicalization, which transforms visual observations and trajectories into a camera-consistent representation space. Building on this representation, we derive safety and local-progress supervision using pseudo-labels from an offline traversability estimator. Safety supervision penalizes unsafe trajectories, while local-progress supervision guides where the robot should advance. Experiments across diverse camera configurations and environments show that, despite using only RGB at inference, CanonNav consistently outperforms RGB-based baselines and even surpasses RGB-D-based methods in challenging scenarios.
summary_zh: 基于跨平台演示数据的模仿学习推动了视觉导航技术发展，但充分利用这类数据仍然存在挑战：首先，直接从图像-轨迹对学习会将导航行为与平台相关的相机几何特性耦合，迫使策略从视觉观测中隐式推断相机几何（这一问题本身是不适定的），阻碍了一致性学习；其次，从演示轨迹进行模仿学习只能捕获专家选择的运动结果，无法显式获取该运动背后的中间决策逻辑。为解决上述问题，本文提出CanonNav这一视觉导航框架，可将导航行为与相机几何解耦，并在跨平台演示学习过程中引入互补规划监督信号。CanonNav提出相机几何标准化技术，将视觉观测与轨迹转换到相机特征一致的表征空间。基于该表征，本文利用离线可通行性估计器生成的伪标签构建安全监督与局部进度监督：安全监督对不安全轨迹施加惩罚，局部进度监督引导机器人的合理前进方向。在不同相机配置与多样化环境下的实验表明，CanonNav在推理阶段仅使用RGB输入的条件下，性能始终优于基于RGB的基线方法，甚至在高难度场景下超过了基于RGB-D的方法。

title: Optimized Modular Design and Development of a Tilt-Rotor Bicopter Drone
title_zh: 倾转旋翼双旋翼无人机的优化模块化设计与开发
authors: Saideep Verma, Nimisha Tatapudi, Akshay Arjun, Danwada Sharanya Sukka, Abhishek Sarkar 等 (6 人)
abstract: Hybrid systems like tilt-rotor bicopter drones combine the beneficial characteristics of both fixed-wing and rotary-wing technology, enabling long endurance and VTOL capability. However, such drones also require an optimum design to ensure both static and dynamic stability. The modular design of a traditional bicopter is developed in this paper based on extensive analysis and in-depth structural and aerodynamic simulations. The structural analysis has been performed to ensure that the aircraft's structure withstands the stresses encountered during different flight modes. Controlling the relative positions of the Center of Gravity (CG) and Neutral Point (NP) is an essential aspect of the design, ensuring stability during hover and positive stability during forward flight. The thrust and power analyses have been conducted to assess the flight performance and endurance. After analysis, the drone has been developed, and flight tests with a basic flight controller were conducted to validate the performance metrics obtained in the simulation.
summary_zh: 倾转旋翼双旋翼无人机这类混合系统融合了固定翼与旋翼技术的优势，同时具备长航时与垂直起降（VTOL）能力，但这类无人机需要经过优化设计才能保证静、动态稳定性。本文基于大量分析与深度结构、空气动力学仿真，完成了传统双旋翼无人机的模块化设计：通过结构分析确保无人机结构可承受不同飞行模式下的应力载荷；将重心（CG）与中性点（NP）的相对位置控制作为核心设计环节，保证悬停阶段的稳定性与前飞阶段的正稳定性；完成推力与功率分析以评估飞行性能与续航能力。分析完成后本文完成了无人机样机开发，搭载基础飞行控制器开展飞行测试，验证了仿真得到的各项性能指标。

title: Contrast-Free Autonomous Navigation of Untethered Endovascular Microrobots Using Single-Plane Fluoroscopy
title_zh: 基于单平面透视成像的无造影剂无缆血管内微型机器人自主导航方法
authors: Husnu Halid Alabay, Tuan-Anh Le, Ping Wang, Hakan Ceylan
abstract: Reliable three-dimensional (3D) navigation of magnetically actuated untethered microrobots remains a major barrier to clinical translation. X-ray fluoroscopy is the standard real-time imaging modality for endovascular procedures, but single-plane fluoroscopy provides only a two-dimensional (2D) projection, eliminating depth information and complicating autonomous navigation. Recovering this information through biplane imaging or repeated contrast-enhanced angiography increases procedural complexity, radiation exposure, or contrast burden. Here, we introduce VISTA (Virtual Integration for Spatial Tracking and Autonomy), a digital twin framework enabling contrast-free autonomous navigation under single-plane fluoroscopy. VISTA reconstructs vascular anatomy as a 3D digital twin, discretizes the vessel centerline into navigation milestones, and assigns the detected 2D robot position to the nearest projected milestone. Consecutive milestones define the local vessel orientation used to generate magnetic actuation commands, converting single-plane fluoroscopic observations into topology-constrained navigation states without requiring contrast injection during navigation. VISTA is demonstrated across anatomically distinct vascular phantoms under continuous flow and within the inferior vena cava of a live rat in vivo. Compared with conventional fluoroscopic human-in-the-loop control, VISTA reduced navigation time by up to 62%, corrective actuation commands by up to 98%, and radiation exposure by up to 57%.
