A single factor explains 74.5% of common variance and tracks model release date (R^2 = 0.505), so the leading axis of capability is substantially a time trend; where prior work controls for scale, compute adds little once date is removed. Removing the date trend lowers that share by 14.9 points, and by 24.1 with one row per base model. Under the dimensionality rule fixed in advance the economic benchmarks form no distinct factor, yet a leave-one-benchmark-out test with factors re-estimated inside every fold shows that a multi-factor representation predicts held-out economic scores better than a single general index (pooled Delta-MSE 0.037, 95% bootstrap interval [0.019, 0.055]). Economic benchmarks therefore add incremental predictive information to a largely date-driven general factor, and the evidence does not support treating them as a distinct latent capability. Leaderboards remain a sound guide to overall progress, but most of the gap between models released months apart is calendar, so a small gap between contemporaneous models should be date-adjusted before being read as a capability difference.
summary_zh: 当前前沿模型排行榜基于经济类基准（即测试模型完成从软件工程到银行工作流等各类专业任务的能力）对系统进行排名，这些排名会影响机构采购决策、监管关注重点，以及公众对工作模式变革的预期。这类基准测量的是独立于通用应试能力的特定能力，还是仅体现了随着模型性能提升所有基准都会同步上升的单一维度，是一个尚未得到研究的构念效度问题。本文使用固定哈希值的排行榜快照数据开展研究，该数据包含12个基准（其中4个为经济类基准）下的421种模型配置，将基准作为题项、模型作为受访者构建潜变量模型，在分析前预先设定4项假设及其阈值。结果显示单一因子可以解释74.5%的共同方差，且该因子与模型发布日期高度相关（R²=0.505），说明能力的主维度很大程度上是时间趋势；在现有研究控制模型规模的前提下，剔除日期变量后计算量几乎没有额外解释力。移除日期趋势后，上述方差占比下降14.9个百分点，若仅保留每个基础模型的单条数据则该占比下降24.1个百分点。根据预先设定的维度判定规则，经济类基准并未形成独立因子，但留一基准测试（每轮重新估计因子）显示多因子表示对留出经济类得分的预测效果优于单通用指数（合并Delta-MSE为0.037，95%自举区间为[0.019, 0.055]）。因此经济类基准可以在很大程度上由日期驱动的通用因子之外提供增量预测信息，现有证据不支持将其视为独立的潜在能力。排行榜仍是衡量整体进展的可靠指标，但发布时间相差数月的模型之间的性能差距大部分来自时间因素，因此同期发布模型之间的小差距需要先经过日期校正，才能被解读为能力差异。

title: Where Induction Runs Out: Description-Length Difficulty and the Memorisation Gap in Integer-Sequence Benchmarks
title_zh: 归纳的边界：整数序列基准中的描述长度难度与记忆缺口
authors: Sabilashan Ganeshan
abstract: Integer sequences from the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS) are increasingly used to benchmark mathematical reasoning in language models. We ask what such benchmarks actually measure, using an exactly computable reference learner: two-part minimum description length (MDL) over the class of P-recursive (holonomic) recurrences, evaluated on every prefix of a sequence as terms arrive. Three findings follow. First, MDL difficulty is a parameter count. The discovery point nd, the first prefix length at which a symbolic hypothesis beats verbatim storage, is predicted almost exactly by a combinatorial identifiability bound on the selected operator's order and degree. It is invariant to term magnitude: scaling Fibonacci over twelve orders of magnitude leaves nd unchanged, because a hypothesis must encode its own initial conditions and the magnitude cancels. Second, at scale the learner exhibits a regime our curated corpus could not produce even once: across 20,000 OEIS sequences, 89.98% of those that fit a recurrence on some prefix fit none at full length. We call this the wilderness -- induction acquires a theory, loses it, and never recovers. Third, evaluating three language models on sequences stratified by these MDL regimes refuted our pre-registered hypothesis: models do not confabulate where MDL reports no theory, but hedge appropriately. Confident errors are inverted, concentrating on the easy stratum, where apparent competence tracks recognition of the sequence rather than induction of its rule. OEIS-derived benchmarks therefore substantially measure memorisation, and MDL supplies a cheap, contamination-free difficulty signal they currently lack. Code and data are released.
summary_zh: 来自在线整数序列百科全书（OEIS）的整数序列正越来越多地被用于评测大语言模型的数学推理能力。本文使用可精确计算的参考学习器（基于P递归（全纯）递推类的两部分最小描述长度（MDL）方法，在序列逐次新增项时对每个前缀进行评估）研究这类基准的实际测量属性，得到三项发现：第一，MDL难度等价于参数计数。发现点nd（即符号假设首次优于逐字存储的前缀长度）几乎可以通过所选算子阶数与次数的组合可识别性界精确预测，且nd与项的大小无关：将斐波那契序列的数值缩放12个数量级后nd保持不变，因为假设需要编码自身的初始条件，数值大小的影响会被抵消。第二，在大规模场景下，学习器会出现一种在人工构建语料库中完全不会出现的状态：在20000条OEIS序列中，有89.98%的序列在某个前缀上符合递推关系，但在完整长度下不存在对应递推关系。本文将该状态称为「荒野区」：学习过程中归纳得到的规则会失效，且无法恢复。第三，使用按MDL状态分层的序列对三个大语言模型进行评测，结果推翻了预先注册的假设：模型不会在MDL判定不存在规则的区域编造结果，反而会给出恰当的不确定响应。模型的高置信度错误集中在简单分层区域，该区域的表观能力反映的是对序列的记忆而非对规则的归纳。因此基于OEIS的基准很大程度上测量的是模型的记忆能力，而MDL可以提供这类基准当前缺失的低成本、无数据污染的难度信号。本文已开源相关代码与数据。

title: Explanations, Prompts, and Formalizations: Arguments for New Norms in LLM-Enabled Mathematical Research
title_zh: 解释、提示与形式化：大语言模型赋能数学研究的新规范主张
authors: Axel Boldt
abstract: As several mathematical conjectures have recently been settled using large language models (LLMs), the mathematical community has formulated norms and recommendations regarding the publishing of such results. These norms do not cover the disclosure of the prompts and precise software setup used to obtain those results, nor do they require that results be formalized in a manner that allows for machine verification. I argue that both of these are essential. In addition, since LLM-obtained results may be hard to understand, human authors have the responsibility to invent intuitive explanations.
summary_zh: 近期已有多个数学猜想借助大语言模型（LLM）得到证明，数学界已经针对这类成果的发表制定了相关规范与建议。但现有规范并未覆盖对获取结果所用提示与精确软件环境的披露要求，也不强制要求将结果形式化为可被机器验证的格式。本文认为这两项要求都是必不可少的。此外，由于借助大语言模型得到的结果可能难以理解，人类作者有责任为其构建直观的解释。

title: Unlearning on Spatio-Temporal Graphs through Subgraph Virtual Edge Reconstruction
title_zh: 基于子图虚拟边重构的时空图遗忘方法
authors: Qiming Guo, Wenbo Sun, Chen Pan, Ye Wang, Wenlu Wang
abstract: Spatio-temporal graphs are widely used in modeling complex dynamic processes such as temporal forecasting, molecular dynamics, and healthcare monitoring. Recently, stringent privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA have introduced significant new challenges for existing spatio-temporal graph models, requiring complete unlearning of unauthorized data. Since each node in a spatio-temporal graph diffuses information globally across both spatial and temporal dimensions, existing unlearning methods primarily designed for static graphs and localized data removal cannot efficiently erase a single node without incurring costs nearly equivalent to full model retraining. To address this, we propose CallosumNet, a spatio-temporal graph unlearning framework biologically inspired by the corpus callosum structure. CallosumNet makes two key technical contributions: (1) it reconstructs subgraphs using biologically-inspired virtual edges; and (2) it restores interlinked spatio-temporal dependencies among subgraphs via a lightweight meta-graph integration layer. Empirical results on four diverse real-world datasets show that CallosumNet achieves complete unlearning while maintaining accuracy very close to the gold model. The code is publicly available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 时空图被广泛用于建模复杂动态过程，例如时序预测、分子动力学与医疗监测。近期通用数据保护条例（GDPR）、加州消费者隐私法案（CCPA）等严格的隐私法规对现有时空图模型提出了新挑战，要求模型能够完全遗忘未授权的用户数据。由于时空图中的每个节点都会在空间与时间维度全局传播信息，现有针对静态图和局部数据删除设计的遗忘方法无法在不产生接近全量重训练成本的前提下高效擦除单个节点的信息。为解决该问题，本文提出CallosumNet，这一受大脑胼胝体结构生物启发的时空图遗忘框架有两项核心技术贡献：（1）使用生物启发的虚拟边重构子图；（2）通过轻量级元图集成层恢复子图之间相互关联的时空依赖关系。在四个不同的真实世界数据集上的实验结果显示，CallosumNet可以实现完全数据遗忘，同时保持与黄金标准模型几乎一致的精度。相关代码已公开。

title: Spectral Analysis for Sparse Matrix Computation: Insights and Potential
title_zh: 稀疏矩阵计算的谱分析：洞见与潜力
authors: Ruifeng Zhang, Xipeng Shen
abstract: Sparse computations are fundamental to scientific computing, graph analytics, and machine learning, yet their performance is highly sensitive to the diverse sparsity and patterns. This is because cache reuse, memory coalescing, and load balancing depend critically on the sparsity patterns. This work gives the first known exploration of the connections between sparse matrix computation and spectral analysis by treating sparse matrices as two-dimensional signals and analyzing their frequency-domain representations through Fast Fourier Transform. We show that spectral signatures uncover global structural characteristics that are not sufficiently captured by conventional spatial statistics and provide complementary information for understanding sparse computation performance. Experiments on incorporating spectral features into machine-learning-based SpMV format selection demonstrate the usefulness of such spectral analysis over a state-of-the-art spatial-only model. By uncovering the principled connections between spectral characteristics and sparse matrix computations, this work introduces a novel analytical perspective into sparse computation, and provides a new approach to enhancing the current sparse structure characterization and optimization. On pruned LLM decoding, adding spectral features improves kernel selection and yields 1.035--1.245$\times$ kernel speedups.
summary_zh: 稀疏计算是科学计算、图分析与机器学习的基础，其性能对稀疏模式的多样性高度敏感，因为缓存复用、内存合并访问与负载均衡都高度依赖稀疏模式。本文首次探索稀疏矩阵计算与谱分析之间的关联：将稀疏矩阵视为二维信号，通过快速傅里叶变换分析其频域表示。研究发现，稀疏矩阵的谱特征可以揭示传统空间统计无法充分捕捉的全局结构特征，为理解稀疏计算性能提供补充信息。将谱特征融入基于机器学习的稀疏矩阵向量乘（SpMV）格式选择流程的实验显示，该谱分析方法的效果优于当前最优的仅使用空间特征的模型。通过揭示谱特征与稀疏矩阵计算之间的原理性关联，本文为稀疏计算引入了全新的分析视角，为现有稀疏结构表征与优化提供了新路径。在剪枝大语言模型解码场景中，加入谱特征可以优化内核选择，实现1.035~1.245倍的内核加速比。

title: Spatial Entropy based Partitioning for Spatiotemporal Graph Unlearning
title_zh: 基于空间熵划分的时空图遗忘方法
authors: Qiming Guo, Wenbo Sun, Ye Wang, Wenlu Wang
abstract: Spatiotemporal graphs underpin applications such as traffic forecasting, weather forecasting, and healthcare monitoring. Privacy regulations such as the GDPR and the CCPA require the complete removal of unauthorized data from trained models, but achieving this on a spatiotemporal graph is difficult: because information propagates globally through both spatial and temporal message passing, fully erasing a node's influence forces costly full-graph retraining. ST-graph unlearning requires both exactness and efficiency. We propose IsleNet, which uses spatial-entropy-guided partitioning to create balanced, locally coherent subgraphs and reconnects them with lightweight virtual edges. Upon an unlearning request, only the affected subgraph encoder and virtual-edge layer are retrained, ensuring exact removal with low cost. Experiments on four real-world benchmarks show that IsleNet attains up to 94% of full-graph accuracy while reducing unlearning time by up to an order of magnitude. Our code is publicly available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 时空图是交通预测、气象预报、医疗监测等应用的底层支撑技术。GDPR（通用数据保护条例）、CCPA（加州消费者隐私法案）等隐私法规要求从训练完成的模型中彻底移除未授权数据，但在时空图上实现该目标存在较大难度：由于信息通过空间和时间的消息传递在全局传播，要完全擦除某个节点的影响需要代价极高的全图重训练。时空图遗忘同时要求精确性与高效性，本文提出IsleNet框架，采用空间熵引导的划分策略生成均衡、局部连贯的子图，并通过轻量虚拟边将子图重新连接。收到遗忘请求时，仅需重训练受影响的子图编码器与虚拟边层，即可在低成本下实现数据的精确移除。在4个真实世界基准数据集上开展的实验表明，IsleNet可达到全图训练精度的94%，同时将遗忘耗时最高降低一个数量级。相关代码已通过公开链接开源。

title: Information-Based Calibration of Uncertainty Quantification in Product-of-Experts Gaussian Process Models
title_zh: 专家乘积高斯过程模型中不确定性量化的信息驱动校准方法
authors: Yean Hoon Ong, Paolo Barucca, Wei Pan, Jun Wang
abstract: Gaussian process (GP) regression with a single global GP (GP-glo) incurs cubic computational cost, limiting scalability to large datasets. Product-of-experts GP models (GP-pro), which combine local GP models to capture global correlations, alleviate this computational burden. However, training local experts on disjoint data subsets can lead to overestimated posterior variances. We propose GP-pro-c, a product-of-experts GP model that calibrates these variances using an information-based method. The method exploits the monotonicity and submodularity of information gain in GPs to define a calibration ratio that reduces the posterior variance of individual local GP models. We evaluate GP-pro-c using negative log-likelihood (NLL), root mean squared error (RMSE), and expected normalised calibration error (ENCE). Experiments on four synthetic functions and six regression datasets show that GP-pro-c achieves average reductions of 2.3% in NLL and 12.0% in ENCE compared with the uncalibrated GP-pro model. The proposed method mitigates posterior variance overestimation while maintaining predictive accuracy and reducing computational complexity. GP-pro-c provides a promising approach for uncertainty estimation in scalable GP models and may serve as a useful surrogate model for Bayesian optimisation with high-dimensional and large-scale data.
summary_zh: 采用单一全局高斯过程（GP-glo）的高斯过程回归存在立方级计算复杂度，限制了其在大规模数据集上的可扩展性。专家乘积高斯过程模型（GP-pro）通过组合多个局部高斯过程模型捕捉全局相关性，缓解了上述计算负担。但在互不重叠的数据子集上训练局部专家会导致后验方差被高估。本文提出GP-pro-c，一种采用信息类方法校准方差的专家乘积高斯过程模型：该方法利用高斯过程中信息增益的单调性与次模性定义校准系数，降低各局部高斯过程模型的后验方差。本文采用负对数似然（NLL）、均方根误差（RMSE）、期望归一化校准误差（ENCE）作为评估指标对GP-pro-c进行验证，在4个合成函数与6个回归数据集上的实验结果显示，与未校准的GP-pro模型相比，GP-pro-c的NLL平均降低2.3%，ENCE平均降低12.0%。该方法在保持预测精度、降低计算复杂度的同时缓解了后验方差高估问题，为可扩展高斯过程模型的不确定性估计提供了可行方案，也可作为高维大规模数据贝叶斯优化的有效代理模型。

title: MEL: Coordinate-Preserving EEG Tokenization for fMRI Translation
title_zh: MEL：面向fMRI转换的保坐标脑电图分词化方法
authors: Xiangyu Liu, Zeting Yan, Zhitong Yin, Boyang Li, Xi Zhang
abstract: Translating electroencephalography (EEG) into functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is important for medical neuroimaging, clinical brain-state monitoring, and multimodal neural decoding, because it aims to infer spatially organized hemodynamic activity from fast and accessible electrophysiological recordings. Existing EEG-to-fMRI studies mainly pursue stronger decoders, but the problem is also constrained by a representation-interface mismatch: fMRI responses are delayed, temporally integrated, and spatially distributed, whereas generic EEG encodings often entangle temporal lag, channel identity, and frequency-band structure. We propose Multi-band EEG Latent-state Tokenization (MEL), a coordinate-preserving EEG representation framework that anchors each target fMRI response to its preceding EEG history and organizes it into lag-channel-frequency neural-state tokens. By explicitly capturing hemodynamic latency and spectral-spatial dynamics, MEL aligns fMRI-pertinent EEG representations with capacity-controlled readouts without depending entirely on model scaling. Experiments on VU EEG-fMRI benchmarks and external Oddball data show that MEL improves prediction over strong NeuroBOLT baselines. Ablations and controls further indicate that the gains come from structured EEG representation rather than leakage, shortcut statistics, or decoder capacity.
summary_zh: 将脑电图（EEG）转换为功能磁共振成像（fMRI）对医学神经成像、临床脑状态监测与多模态神经解码具有重要意义，该技术可通过快速易获取的电生理记录推断具有空间组织结构的血流动力学活动。现有EEG转fMRI研究主要聚焦于性能更优的解码器，但该问题同时受表征接口不匹配的约束：fMRI响应存在延迟、时间积分特性且呈空间分布，而通用的EEG编码通常会混淆时间滞后、通道标识与频段结构。本文提出多频段脑电隐状态分词化框架（MEL），这是一种保坐标的EEG表征框架，可将每个目标fMRI响应锚定到其前置EEG历史上，并将其组织为滞后-通道-频率维度的神经状态token。通过显式捕捉血流动力学延迟与谱-空间动态特性，MEL在不完全依赖模型缩放的前提下，将与fMRI相关的EEG表征与容量可控的读出层对齐。在VU EEG-fMRI基准数据集与外部Oddball数据集上开展的实验表明，相较于性能优异的基线模型NeuroBOLT，MEL的预测效果更优。消融实验与对照实验进一步证明，性能提升来源于结构化EEG表征，而非数据泄露、捷径统计特性或解码器容量。

title: A Spectral Identifiability Threshold for Dissipative Rate Recovery from Truncated Liouvillian Spectra
title_zh: 基于截断刘维尔谱的耗散速率恢复的光谱可识别性阈值
authors: Yujun Ji, Somyajit Chakraborty
abstract: Open quantum systems lose energy and phase coherence through different dissipative processes, but these processes can produce overlapping dynamical signatures. The Liouvillian spectrum summarizes how such a system relaxes, yet it is not obvious how much of that spectrum is needed to distinguish the underlying dissipation rates. We study this question for amplitude damping and dephasing in a six-qubit Lindblad model whose spectrum can be derived analytically. We retain only the slowest non-steady spectral modes and ask how many are required before each dissipative rate becomes recoverable. We show that population modes contain no dephasing information, which creates a lower bound of D = 2^n retained modes for uniform dephasing identifiability in the relevant rate regime. The measured recovery threshold reaches this bound at n = 4,5,6, while n = 3 remains above it. At n = 6, least squares achieves a mean joint absolute error of order 10^-9, compared with 4.355 x 10^-4 for four tabular learning methods. Robustness tests show that this advantage weakens when the spectra are perturbed and when a transverse field breaks the commuting structure. These results show that the amount and structure of retained spectral information can determine whether dissipative parameters are recoverable, independently of the estimator used. The present conclusions apply to noise-free simulator spectra rather than measurement-derived spectra.
summary_zh: 开放量子系统会通过不同的耗散过程损失能量与相位相干性，但这些过程可能产生重叠的动力学特征。刘维尔谱可对系统的弛豫特性进行总结，但目前尚不明确需要获取多少谱信息才能区分底层的耗散速率。本文针对可解析推导谱结构的六量子比特Lindblad模型中的振幅阻尼与退相问题开展研究，仅保留最慢的非稳态光谱模式，探究恢复所有耗散速率所需的最少模式数量。研究发现，布居模式不包含任何退相信息，这使得在对应速率区间内实现均匀退相的可识别性，所需保留的模式数下界为D=2^n。当量子比特数n=4、5、6时，实测恢复阈值达到该下界，而n=3时的阈值仍高于该下界。n=6时，最小二乘法得到的联合绝对误差均值可达10^-9量级，远优于4种表格学习方法的4.355×10^-4。鲁棒性测试表明，当光谱受到扰动、横向场破坏对易结构时，该性能优势会减弱。上述结果证明，与所使用的估计器无关，保留的光谱信息的数量与结构可决定耗散参数是否可被恢复。本文结论适用于无噪声模拟器光谱，而非实测光谱。

title: Signed random Fourier features for fast density estimation with indefinite kernels
title_zh: 面向不定核快速密度估计的带符号随机傅里叶特征方法
authors: Xie Wang, Nicolas Langrené, Wen Chen
abstract: Kernel density estimation (KDE) is one of the most fundamental statistical estimators of density functions. Its direct implementation on a dataset of $N$ points incurs an $\mathcal{O}(N^{2})$ computational cost, which is prohibitive for large-scale datasets. Kernel approximation techniques can be applied to bring the computational cost down to $\mathcal{O}(N)$. The random Fourier features (RFF) technique, based on sampling from the spectral density of the kernel function, has become popular to speed up kernel estimators for machine learning applications. Unfortunately, it is restricted to positive definite kernels, while the majority of kernel functions popular in KDE, such as the parabolic kernel, do not satisfy this property. To overcome this limitation, this article introduces the signed random Fourier features (SRFF) technique. It is a generalization of RFF compatible with indefinite kernels whose inverse Fourier transform is absolutely integrable. The motivation for introducing this method is to speed up KDE in the case of multivariate compact kernels, which are generally not positive definite. We detail how to implement SRFF for both product kernels and isotropic kernels. For the class of Kuttner-Golubov kernels $K(\boldsymbol{x}_{i},\boldsymbol{x}_{j})=(1-\left\Vert \boldsymbol{x}_{i}-\boldsymbol{x}_{j}\right\Vert ^{\alpha})^{\beta}\mathbf{1}_{\{\left\Vert \boldsymbol{x}_{i}-\boldsymbol{x}_{j}\right\Vert \leq1\}}$ where $\boldsymbol{x}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}$, $\boldsymbol{x}_{j}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}$, $\alpha>0$, $\beta>0$, which includes the triangular, parabolic, biweight, triweight, and other kernel functions of interest for KDE as particular examples, we provide an explicit acceptance-rejection algorithm to sample from its signed spectral density. Our numerical tests on a dataset of one million points confirm the computational efficiency and accuracy of SRFF for large-scale KDE.
summary_zh: 核密度估计（KDE）是最基础的密度函数统计估计方法之一，直接在包含N个点的数据集上实现核密度估计的计算复杂度为O(N²)，难以应用于大规模数据集。核近似技术可将计算复杂度降至O(N)，其中基于核函数谱密度采样的随机傅里叶特征（RFF）技术已被广泛用于加速机器学习场景下的核估计。但该技术仅适用于正定核，而核密度估计中常用的多数核函数（如抛物核）并不满足正定条件。为克服该局限，本文提出带符号随机傅里叶特征（SRFF）技术，该方法是RFF的泛化版本，兼容逆傅里叶变换绝对可积的不定核。该方法的提出动机是加速多元紧核场景下的核密度估计，这类核通常不具备正定性。本文详细阐述了乘积核与各向同性核的SRFF实现方案，针对Kuttner-Golubov核类（包含三角核、抛物核、双权核、三权核等核密度估计常用核函数），给出了从其带符号谱密度中采样的显式接受-拒绝算法。在百万级点数据集上开展的数值测试验证了SRFF在大规模核密度估计场景下的计算效率与精度。

title: Sense Once, Serve Many: Common-Trace Factorized Constrained PPO for Online Sensing-Session Consolidation in Multi-Tenant ISAC Networks
title_zh: 一次感知、多用户服务：面向多租户通感一体网络在线感知会话整合的公共轨迹分解约束PPO方法
authors: Dang-Dung Vu
abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) networks can serve compatible requests through shared sensing sessions, but consolidation couples admission, reuse, profile selection, sensing service-level agreements (SLAs), communication quality of service (QoS), and future commitments. We formulate this problem as a constrained Markov decision process and propose Common-Trace Factorized Constrained Proximal Policy Optimization (CT-PPO). During training, stochastic policy replicas share the same primitive workload trace; leave-one-out discounted Monte Carlo return contrasts provide reward credit to applicable actor factors, while constraint credit remains factor/prefix-specific. Across five training seeds and matched workloads, CT-PPO achieves the highest mean macro return, exceeding matched Joint-Credit PPO (JC-PPO) by 0.934 (95% confidence interval [0.702, 1.164]) and SLA-Aware Greedy by 1.847; versus JC-PPO, it reduces sensing-resource cost by 6.277 and raises accepted requests per created session by 0.0806. A four-way ablation shows that the factorized surrogate alone yields no detectable macro-return gain, whereas adding common-trace reward credit produces the dominant improvement. Without retraining, CT-PPO retains a return advantage at low, nominal, and high arrival loads, with the strongest gain under clustered arrivals. Deployment uses public observations and hard masks; CT-PPO's extra parameters are training-side, its actor footprint matches JC-PPO, and actor-only CPU latency is effectively unchanged.
summary_zh: 通感一体（ISAC）网络可通过共享感知会话为兼容请求提供服务，但会话整合过程需要同时对接准入控制、资源复用、配置选择、感知服务水平协议（SLA）、通信服务质量（QoS）与未来资源承诺等多个维度。本文将该问题建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，提出公共轨迹分解约束近端策略优化算法（CT-PPO）。训练过程中，随机策略副本共享相同的原始工作负载轨迹；留一法折扣蒙特卡洛回报对比可为对应动作因子分配奖励信用，而约束信用仍保留在因子/前缀维度。在5个训练种子与匹配工作负载下，CT-PPO的平均宏观回报最高，相较于匹配的联合信用PPO（JC-PPO）高出0.934（95%置信区间[0.702, 1.164]），相较于SLA感知贪心算法高出1.847；与JC-PPO相比，其感知资源成本降低6.277，每创建一个会话可接纳的请求数提升0.0806。四组消融实验表明，单独使用分解代理无法观测到宏观回报提升，而加入公共轨迹奖励信用后可实现最显著的性能增益。无需重训练的前提下，CT-PPO在低、标称、高到达负载下均保持回报优势，在聚集到达场景下增益最为明显。该部署方案采用公开观测值与硬掩码，CT-PPO的额外参数均位于训练侧，其动作网络的内存占用与JC-PPO相当，仅动作网络的CPU时延几乎无变化。

title: A-MADiff: Attention-Guided Multi-Agent DRL with Diffusion Policies for Memory-Aware Task Orchestration in Mobile AIGC Networks
title_zh: A-MADiff：面向移动AIGC网络内存感知任务编排的扩散策略注意力引导多智能体深度强化学习方法
authors: Chongzhi Wu, Zhengtao Li, Jiawen Kang, Jinbo Wen, Xiaohuan Li 等 (7 人)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence-Generated Content (AIGC) services employ Generative AI (GenAI) models to automatically generate diverse content. Mobile AIGC networks host GenAI models on edge-located AIGC Service Providers (ASPs) to deliver low-latency and personalized AIGC services for mobile users. However, AIGC inference tasks typically occupy GPU memory until task completion, causing GPU memory exhaustion at serving ASPs and triggering out-of-memory failures rather than merely increasing service latency. Existing studies on AIGC task orchestration have largely overlooked GPU memory feasibility constraints. To address this issue, we develop a cooperative multi-agent orchestration framework, in which each edge node is equipped with a scheduling agent to route tasks to local ASPs or neighboring edge nodes. Since scheduling agents make decisions based only on local observations, while peer offloading couples their resource states and long-term utilities, we formulate the orchestration process as a cooperative Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (Dec-POMDP). To solve the Dec-POMDP, we propose an \underline{A}ttention-guided \underline{M}ulti-\underline{A}gent deep reinforcement learning algorithm with \underline{Diff}usion policies (A-MADiff) under the centralized training with a decentralized execution paradigm. A-MADiff employs diffusion-based decentralized actors to generate multi-modal preferences over feasible orchestration actions, and an attention-guided centralized critic to estimate per-agent values from cross-agent states under GPU memory heterogeneity. Numerical results demonstrate that A-MADiff significantly improves the cumulative reward over the state-of-the-art baseline.
summary_zh: 生成式人工智能内容（AIGC）服务采用生成式AI（GenAI）模型自动生成多样化内容，移动AIGC网络将GenAI模型部署在边缘侧的AIGC服务提供商（ASP）上，为移动用户提供低延迟、个性化的AIGC服务。但AIGC推理任务通常会持续占用GPU内存直到任务完成，容易导致服务侧ASP的GPU内存耗尽，触发内存不足故障，而非仅提升服务时延。现有AIGC任务编排研究大多忽略了GPU内存可行性约束。为解决该问题，本文提出协作式多智能体编排框架，每个边缘节点部署一个调度智能体，将任务路由到本地ASP或相邻边缘节点。由于调度智能体仅基于局部观测做出决策，而对等卸载过程会耦合各节点的资源状态与长期效用，本文将编排过程建模为协作式分散部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（Dec-POMDP）。为求解该Dec-POMDP，本文在集中训练分散执行范式下提出基于扩散策略的注意力引导多智能体深度强化学习算法（A-MADiff）。A-MADiff采用基于扩散的分散动作网络生成可行编排动作的多模态偏好，采用注意力引导的集中评价网络在GPU内存异质性条件下基于跨智能体状态估计每个智能体的价值。数值实验结果表明，相较于现有最优基线方法，A-MADiff可显著提升累积回报。

title: RL-FAT: Reinforcement Learning for Fair Adversarial Training
title_zh: RL-FAT：面向公平对抗训练的强化学习方法
authors: Tejaswini Medi, Levan Mikeladze, Margret Keuper
abstract: Deep neural networks remain highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, and adversarial training (AT) has become a widely used approach for improving robustness. However, improvements in average robust accuracy often mask substantial class-wise disparities: while some classes become more robust, others may remain disproportionately vulnerable under attack. This imbalance raises an important adversarial fairness concern, particularly in vision tasks where reliable robustness is expected across all categories. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{RL-FAT}, a reinforcement-learning-inspired fair adversarial training framework that uses policy-gradient based feedback from adversarial predictions. RL-FAT interprets the prediction distribution as a policy and combines correctness-based prediction rewards with class-wise value estimates to compute class-specific advantages for policy-gradient optimization. This enables the model to adaptively focus on class-wise misclassification. Furthermore, we introduce a fairness-emphasis adversarial loss that assigns stronger training pressure to classes with high adversarial loss, thereby mitigating class-wise robustness disparity. By combining reinforcement-driven adaptation with fairness-emphasis regularization, RL-FAT improves adversarial robustness while promoting a more balanced robustness distribution across classes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive robust accuracy and substantially reduces class-wise robustness imbalance compared with standard adversarial training baselines.
summary_zh: 深度神经网络仍极易受到对抗扰动的攻击，对抗训练（AT）已成为提升模型鲁棒性的主流方法。但平均鲁棒精度的提升往往掩盖了显著的类别间差异：部分类别的鲁棒性得到提升的同时，其他类别在攻击下仍可能存在明显的脆弱性。这种不平衡引发了重要的对抗公平性问题，尤其在要求所有类别均具备可靠鲁棒性的视觉任务中。为解决该问题，本文提出RL-FAT，一种受强化学习启发的公平对抗训练框架，采用来自对抗预测的基于策略梯度的反馈。RL-FAT将预测分布视为策略，将基于正确性的预测奖励与类别级价值估计相结合，计算类别特定优势值用于策略梯度优化，使模型能够自适应地聚焦于类别级的误分类问题。此外，本文引入公平性增强对抗损失，为对抗损失较高的类别分配更强的训练压力，缓解类别间的鲁棒性差异。通过融合强化学习驱动的自适应机制与公平性增强正则化，RL-FAT在提升对抗鲁棒性的同时，促进各类别间的鲁棒性分布更加均衡。大量实验表明，与标准对抗训练基线相比，本文方法可获得有竞争力的鲁棒精度，同时大幅降低类别间的鲁棒性不平衡程度。

title: HalluPrism: When Multimodal Uncertainty Should Diagnose, Not Decide
title_zh: HalluPrism：面向多模态不确定性的诊断优先框架而非决策优先框架
authors: Aman Prakash, Sourish Dasgupta, Tanmoy Chakraborty
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can assign similar confidence to answers that fail for different reasons. We propose HalluPrism, a behavioral diagnostic that re-runs an answer after visual degradation, blank-image replacement, and grounding or relation checks. These targeted probes yield a signature over visual-perturbation sensitivity (V ), image-removal confidence retention (L), and grounding/relation-probe instability (A). Across 58K+ examples from four benchmarks and four MLLMs, image-removal confidence retention is most prevalent, while grounding/relation-probe instability better separates failure families. Only 18 of 48 source-target checks are diagonally aligned, so the coordinates should be interpreted jointly rather than as independent causal sources. With the dataset fixed, the joint signature improves failure-family AUROC from 0.634 to 0.769 on HallusionBench and from 0.707 to 0.817 on VizWiz, with smaller gains on POPE and VSR. In pooled XGBoost analysis, AUROC rises from 0.78 with scalar confidence to 0.95 with (V, L, A) and 0.97 when confidence is added. The same signature does not automatically improve correctness ranking. The three tested direct scalarizations can harm it. These results separate failure diagnosis from abstention scoring: multimodal uncertainty should characterize failure structure before it is used to decide whether to abstain or correct.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）可能会给由不同原因导致的错误答案分配相近的置信度。本文提出HalluPrism，一种行为诊断方法，在对答案进行视觉降质、空白图像替换、 grounding/关系校验后重新运行推理。这些定向探测可生成由视觉扰动敏感度（V）、图像移除后置信度留存率（L）、grounding/关系探测不稳定性（A）构成的特征向量。在4个基准数据集、4个多模态大模型的5.8万余条样本上开展的实验表明，图像移除后置信度留存现象最为普遍，而grounding/关系探测不稳定性可更好地区分不同类型的错误。48组源-目标校验中仅有18组满足对角对齐，因此需要联合解读三个坐标，而非将其视为独立的因果来源。固定数据集的前提下，该联合特征可将HallusionBench上的错误类型识别AUROC从0.634提升至0.769，将VizWiz上的对应指标从0.707提升至0.817，在POPE与VSR数据集上的性能提升幅度更小。在合并的XGBoost分析中，仅使用标量置信度的AUROC为0.78，使用(V,L,A)特征的AUROC为0.95，加入置信度后AUROC可达0.97。但该特征无法自动提升正确性排序效果，测试的三种直接标量化方法甚至会损害正确性排序性能。上述结果将错误诊断与弃权评分任务区分开：多模态不确定性在被用于决定是否弃权或修正之前，应当首先用于表征错误的结构。

title: Uniform Statistical Convergence of Empirical Sinkhorn Potentials with Exponential and Polynomial Dependence on the Regularization Parameter
title_zh: 经验Sinkhorn势的一致统计收敛性：关于正则化参数的指数与多项式依赖特性
authors: Denis Belomestny
abstract: We study the empirical Sinkhorn estimator of the entropic optimal transport potentials under the uniform loss. Since the potentials are only unique up to additive constants, we measure the error using the quotient supremum norm, defined as $d_\infty([u],[v]) = \inf_{a\in\mathbb{R}}\|u-v-a\|_\infty$. For a fixed regularization parameter $\varepsilon>0$, we establish a non-asymptotic statistical rate of $n^{-1/2}$. This is achieved by combining the Birkhoff-Hopf contraction theorem with entropy bounds on normalized kernel sections. However, the constant in this bound grows exponentially with $1/\epsilon$. To improve this, we isolate geometric conditions under which the empirical estimator maintains the $n^{-1/2}$ rate but features polynomial dependence on $1/\varepsilon$. The key requirement is a polynomial residual-stability estimate for the population Sinkhorn map. We provide sufficient criteria for this, including a polynomial contraction property and a local inverse estimate. Furthermore, we introduce two rigorously verifiable model classes an $\varepsilon$-weak residual-interaction class obtained after separable centering and another based on connected tight-edge graphs for fixed discrete costs where the polynomial rate is guaranteed without relying on abstract resolvent assumptions. Finally, we establish matching minimax lower bounds demonstrating that the $\varepsilon n^{-1/2}$ rate cannot be uniformly improved in the bounded-interaction regime.
summary_zh: 本文研究一致损失下熵最优传输势的经验Sinkhorn估计器。由于势仅在差一个加法常数的意义下唯一，本文采用商上确界范数度量误差，定义为d_∞([u],[v])=inf_{a∈R}||u-v-a||_∞。对于固定的正则化参数ε>0，本文推导得到非渐近统计速率n^{-1/2}，该结果通过结合Birkhoff-Hopf压缩定理与归一化核截面的熵界得到。但该界中的常数随1/ε呈指数增长。为优化该问题，本文明确了可使经验估计器保持n^{-1/2}速率、同时关于1/ε呈多项式依赖的几何条件，核心要求是总体Sinkhorn映射满足多项式残差稳定性估计。本文给出了该条件成立的充分判据，包括多项式压缩特性与局部逆估计。此外，本文提出两类可严格验证的模型类：一类是经过可分离中心化得到的ε弱残差交互类，另一类是基于固定离散代价下连通紧边图的模型类，二者均可在不依赖抽象预解条件的前提下保证多项式速率成立。最后本文推导得到匹配的极小极大下界，证明在有界交互场景下εn^{-1/2}速率无法在一致意义下进一步优化。

title: Explainable Machine Learning for Broadband Adoption Disparities: Tract-Level Prediction and SHAP-Based Factor Profiling
title_zh: 面向宽带普及差异的可解释机器学习：街区级预测与基于SHAP（SHapley加性解释）的因子画像
authors: Xiao Han
abstract: The United States has allocated approximately $65 billion through the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act for broadband expansion, yet evidence-based methods for targeting these investments remain underdeveloped. This paper presents an explainable machine learning framework for profiling broadband adoption disparities at census-tract granularity across 83,359 tracts nationwide. Using 65 socioeconomic, demographic, and infrastructure features derived from the American Community Survey 2022, we train a LightGBM model under spatial five-fold cross-validation, achieving R^2 = 0.533 and Spearman rho = 0.763; state-held-out cross-validation (51 folds) confirms generalization (R^2 = 0.525). TreeSHAP analysis identifies income and education as the dominant factor group (with the engineered interaction term absorbing attribution from its constituent features), and SHAP-based clustering reveals three exploratory factor profiles: Well-Connected Moderate (~49K tracts), Affordability-Limited Severe (~21K tracts), and Rural-Elderly (~13K tracts). As a screening tool, ML-based tract selection captures 38.0% of the total adoption gap within the top 10% of tracts versus 35.2% for income-only heuristics (+2.8 pp, p < 0.002, county-block bootstrap); in regret-reduction terms, the model closes 19% of the remaining gap between income-only and oracle selection. The primary contribution is the per-tract factor decomposition: SHAP identifies which feature groups (income/education, rurality, age) are most strongly associated with each tract's predicted gap, and informs differentiated investigation. A temporal stability check, training on ACS 2017 and predicting ACS 2022 with zero survey-year overlap, confirms ranking stability (rho = 0.784, noting hyperparameters tuned on 2022 data).
summary_zh: 美国已通过《基础设施投资和就业法案》划拨约650亿美元用于宽带扩张，但用于精准投放这些投资的循证方法仍有待完善。本文提出了一种可解释机器学习框架，可在全国83359个人口普查街区粒度下刻画宽带普及差异。采用来自2022年美国社区调查的65项社会经济、人口统计和基础设施特征，我们在空间五折交叉验证下训练LightGBM（轻量梯度提升树）模型，得到R²=0.533、斯皮尔曼相关系数rho=0.763；基于州外留一法的51折交叉验证验证了模型泛化性（R²=0.525）。TreeSHAP（树型SHAP）分析识别出收入与教育是主导因子组（构造的交互项吸收了其组成特征的归因贡献），基于SHAP的聚类得到三类探索性因子画像：连通度中等群体（约4.9万个街区）、可负担性受限严重群体（约2.1万个街区）、乡村老年群体（约1.3万个街区）。作为筛选工具，基于机器学习的街区选择方法可在排名前10%的街区中覆盖总普及缺口的38.0%，相比仅依据收入的启发式方法高出2.8个百分点（p<0.002，县域块 bootstrap 检验）；在遗憾缩减维度上，该模型可填补仅用收入选择与最优选择之间剩余缺口的19%。本文的核心贡献是街区级因子分解：SHAP可识别哪些特征组（收入/教育、乡村属性、年龄）与每个街区的预测缺口关联最强，为差异化调研提供支撑。时间稳定性检验（在2017年美国社区调查数据上训练，在完全无重叠的2022年调查数据上预测）验证了排序稳定性（rho=0.784，注：超参数在2022年数据上调优）。

title: PathGuide: Dynamic Classifier-Free Guidance via On-Policy Transport Alignment
title_zh: PathGuide：基于同策略传输对齐的动态无分类器引导方法
authors: Avishag Nevo, Tamir Hazan
abstract: While modern generative models excel at modeling complex data, precise inference-time control in conditional generation remains a critical challenge. Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a primary mechanism for such control, yet it is typically treated as a static tuning parameter. In flow-based models, however, the guidance scale fundamentally dictates the velocity field and the resulting probability path, making guidance selection a dynamic path-optimization problem. We introduce PathGuide, a framework that reformulates scalar CFG selection as an on-policy transport problem. Leveraging the weak form of the continuity equation, we derive a selection criterion with a direct path-correctness interpretation: we prove that if the guided field is weakly equivalent to the exact conditional field along the generated rollout, the sampler's path coincides with the target conditional law. For scalar CFG, this criterion yields a strictly quadratic local objective with an efficient, closed-form selector for each solver interval. PathGuide enables optimal guidance scales to be computed and used online during generation or fitted offline as a reusable piecewise-constant schedule. We validate our method on low-resolution image manifolds and controlled settings across various continuous-time flow constructions, demonstrating that this transport-based selector improves path alignment and sample fidelity over both fixed and state-of-the-art adaptive guidance baselines.
summary_zh: 现代生成式模型在复杂数据建模方面表现优异，但条件生成中的推理时刻精准控制仍是核心挑战。无分类器引导（CFG）是这类控制的核心机制，但通常被视为静态调优参数。然而在基于流的模型中，引导系数从根本上决定了速度场和最终的概率路径，使得引导选择成为一个动态路径优化问题。本文提出PathGuide框架，将标量CFG选择重构为同策略传输问题。利用连续性方程的弱形式，推导了具备直接路径正确性解释的选择准则：证明如果引导场在生成轨迹上与精确条件场弱等价，采样器的路径将与目标条件分布完全重合。对于标量CFG，该准则可生成严格二次型局部目标，为每个求解区间提供高效的闭式选择器。PathGuide支持在生成过程中在线计算并使用最优引导系数，也可离线拟合为可复用的分段常数调度策略。我们在低分辨率图像流形和多类连续时间流构造的受控场景下对方法进行验证，结果表明该基于传输的选择器相比固定引导和当前最优的自适应引导基线，在路径对齐度和样本保真度上均有提升。

title: Optimally Selecting Representative Agents from a Metric Space
title_zh: 度量空间中代表性智能体的最优选择方法
authors: Benjamin Cookson, Eva Deltl, Yeeseok Oh
abstract: This paper studies the problem of proportionally fair clustering, where the goal is to select $k$ ``centers'' from a metric space that fairly represent a set of agents who also lie in the metric space. Specifically, we focus on finding a clustering satisfying a fairness property known as the Droop core. In the practical special case in which the set of feasible center locations contains every agent location, the previous best-known result guaranteed a $(1 + \sqrt{2})$-approximation of the Droop core, while the best-known lower bound was $2$. In this paper, we show that this lower bound is tight and that a clustering in the $2$-Droop core always exists. Further, we show that such a clustering can be achieved by only selecting centers from locations in the metric space where an agent resides. We establish this using Scarf's theorem guaranteeing a nonempty core for balanced non-transferable utility games. This result has several interesting corollaries. Most notably, it resolves the $\beta$-plurality problem of Aronov et al. [2021] for general metric spaces. The main result of this paper was generated by $\mathtt{ChatGPT}$-$\mathtt{5.6}$-$\mathtt{Sol}$ through a series of interactions with the authors. The authors of this paper verified the generated proof and rewrote it for clarity.
summary_zh: 本文研究比例公平聚类问题，目标是从度量空间中选择k个“中心”，公平代表同样位于该度量空间内的全部智能体集合。我们重点探索满足名为Droop核心的公平性属性的聚类方案。在可行中心位置包含所有智能体位置的实用特例中，此前最优的已知结果仅能保证Droop核心的(1+√2)近似，而已知的下界为2。本文证明该下界是紧的，即2-Droop核心内的聚类方案始终存在，且这类聚类仅需从智能体所在的度量空间位置中选取中心即可实现。我们通过Scarf定理（保证均衡非转移效用博弈的核心非空）证明了上述结论。该结果可推导出多个有意义的推论，最值得关注的是，它在通用度量空间下解决了Aronov等人2021年提出的β-多数问题。本文的核心结果由ChatGPT-5.6-Sol通过与作者的多轮交互生成，作者对生成的证明过程进行了验证并重新撰写以提升可读性。

title: Titans-QFWP: A Regime-Aware Hybrid Quantum Fast Weight Programmer for Portfolio Optimization
title_zh: Titans-QFWP：面向投资组合优化的机制感知混合量子快速权重编程器
authors: Ming-Kai Hung, Jun-Hao Chen, Yun-Cheng Tsai, Samuel Yen-Chi Chen
abstract: We propose Titans-QFWP, a hybrid reinforcement learning architecture integrating a Quantum Fast Weight Programmer with Titans-style memory (Persistence, Surprise, and Forgetting) for adaptive portfolio optimization. To address high-dimensional market features, we introduce an enhanced A3C^2 framework with Hungarian-aligned K-means clustering and scaled log-return rewards. Evaluated on 468 S&P 500 stocks under an Equal-Parameter-Count (EPC) benchmark with approximately 3,000 trainable parameters, Titans-QFWP achieves strong performance (median ARR 0.4260, Calmar 8.5504, IR 0.8427). Ablation results reveal that quantum gating fundamentally reshapes memory component roles, with Persistence supporting drawdown control, Surprise contributing to return generation, and Forgetting providing additional stabilization. By stabilizing these quantum representations, the model enables defensive allocation during market drawdowns while preserving upside potential.
summary_zh: 本文提出Titans-QFWP混合强化学习架构，将量子快速权重编程器与Titans风格记忆模块（包含持久性、新奇性、遗忘性三类组件）相结合，实现自适应投资组合优化。为处理高维市场特征，我们提出增强版A3C²框架，融合匈牙利对齐K-means聚类和缩放对数收益率奖励函数。在等参数量（EPC）基准下以468只标普500成分股为测试集（模型仅含约3000个可训练参数），Titans-QFWP取得优异表现：平均年化收益率0.4260、卡玛比率8.5504、信息比率0.8427。消融实验结果表明，量子门机制从根本上重塑了记忆组件的作用：持久性模块支撑回撤控制，新奇性模块贡献收益生成，遗忘性模块提供额外稳定性。通过稳定这些量子表征，模型可在市场回撤阶段实现防御性配置，同时保留上行收益潜力。

title: Selective Disclosure of Hidden Directives in Reasoning Models: Behavioral Asymmetry and Steering
title_zh: 推理模型中隐藏指令的选择性披露：行为不对称性与引导方法
authors: Zimo Shi, Xander Tifft, Wen Xing
abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning traces are increasingly proposed as a mechanism for AI oversight: a monitor inspecting a model's reasoning can, in principle, detect misbehavior invisible from outputs alone. This assumes CoT surfaces what a model is instructed to do regardless of the instructions given. We test this assumption along two axes. First, we introduce the Instruction-Compliance Gap (ICG): the difference in probability that a model's CoT explicitly references a hidden system prompt directive when that directive is malign versus benign. Across 100 task pairs and 8 frontier reasoning models from 5 families, we find consistent asymmetric disclosure, a higher probability of leaking malign hidden instructions than benign ones, in Qwen3-14B (Wilcoxon $p=0.0001$, $+13.9$pp), Qwen3-32B ($p=0.0011$, $+13.0$pp), Qwen3-235B ($p=0.035$, $+5.8$pp), and similar results with MiniMax-M2.5 and DeepSeek-R1. The detector has 100% precision against two independent blinded labelling passes, and an LLM monitor reading only the reasoning trace reproduces the asymmetry in all 8 models against directive-free controls, identifying the specific directive in 82% of malign traces which the detector classifies as clean. Second, steering vectors extracted in MiniMax-M2.5 via Contrastive Activation Addition causally induce hiding from bare prompts and suppress it from prompts that would otherwise produce it, replicating in Qwen3-14B under a pre-registered design. Benign and malign-derived hiding vectors are highly similar (cosine $0.804$ in MiniMax-M2.5; $0.970$ in Qwen3-14B), implying that in these models the disclosure asymmetry arises from differential activation of a shared hiding direction rather than separate mechanisms.
summary_zh: 思维链（CoT）推理轨迹正逐渐成为AI监管的常用机制：原则上，仅检查模型推理过程的监控器可以检测到仅从输出无法识别的不当行为。该机制的隐含假设是，无论收到何种指令，思维链都会完整呈现模型被指示执行的内容。本文从两个维度对该假设进行验证：首先提出指令遵从缺口（ICG）指标，即隐藏系统提示指令为恶意指令和良性指令时，模型思维链显式提及该指令的概率差值。在100组任务对、5个系列共8个前沿推理模型上，我们观测到一致的不对称披露现象：Qwen3-14B（Wilcoxon p=0.0001，高出13.9个百分点）、Qwen3-32B（p=0.0011，高出13.0个百分点）、Qwen3-235B（p=0.035，高出5.8个百分点）披露恶意隐藏指令的概率显著高于良性指令，MiniMax-M2.5和DeepSeek-R1也呈现类似结果。该检测方法在两轮独立盲标下的精确率达100%，仅读取推理轨迹的大语言模型监控器在所有8个模型上均复现了该不对称性（与无指令对照组相比），且在被检测器分类为“正常”的恶意轨迹中，可识别出82%轨迹对应的具体隐藏指令。其次，通过对比激活加法方法从MiniMax-M2.5中提取的引导向量，可主动诱导无额外提示场景下的指令隐藏行为，也可抑制原本会触发的隐藏行为，该效应在预注册实验设计下的Qwen3-14B上同样复现。从良性和恶意隐藏场景中提取的引导向量高度相似（MiniMax-M2.5中余弦相似度0.804，Qwen3-14B中为0.970），表明上述披露不对称性源于共享隐藏方向的差异化激活，而非两类场景下的独立机制。

title: Spectral-Embedded Operator Learning for Three-Phase Interfacial Flow: A Ternary Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes Benchmark
title_zh: 面向三相界面流的谱嵌入算子学习：三元Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes基准
authors: Muhammad Abid, Arth Sojitra, Omer San
abstract: Operator-learning surrogates have been benchmarked largely on single-field, single-interface problems, leaving unclear whether architectural choices validated in those settings transfer to constrained, multiphase flows. We introduce a three-phase interfacial-flow benchmark to examine whether the trunk coordinate representation matters for a multi-channel, interface-dominated target. The configuration consists of an air bubble rising through water, piercing a water-oil interface, and entraining a water plume into the oil within a bounded, wall-confined domain. Reference data are generated using a structure-preserving ternary Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes solver that algebraically preserves the simplex constraint. From 1,024 Sobol-sampled simulations spanning a nine-dimensional parameter space, we learn the mapping from physical parameters to five-channel space-time fields. We compare three parameter-matched DeepONet variants differing only in trunk representation: raw coordinates (DeepONet), random Fourier features (FEDONet), and a fixed tensor-product Chebyshev dictionary (SEDONet). SEDONet reduces the test relative L2 error by 16.8% compared with FEDONet and by 24.0% compared with DeepONet, while improving all five output channels. Spatial and temporal error analyses localize the principal gains near the diffuse interfaces and after bubble breakthrough. The results indicate that the Chebyshev representation is particularly effective for the strongly non-periodic wall-normal and temporal structure of this three-phase flow.
summary_zh: 现有算子学习代理模型大多仅在单场、单界面问题上完成基准测试，无法验证在这类场景下验证的架构选择是否可迁移到带约束的多相流场景。本文构建了三相界面流基准测试集，验证主干坐标表征是否对多通道、界面主导的目标任务存在显著影响。测试配置为：受限壁面域内，气泡在水中上升，穿透水油界面，裹挟水羽进入油相。采用保结构三元Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes求解器生成参考数据，该求解器可代数性保持单纯形约束。基于覆盖9维参数空间的1024组Sobol采样仿真数据，学习从物理参数到5通道时空场的映射。我们对比三个参数量匹配的DeepONet变体，三者仅在主干表征上存在差异：原始坐标DeepONet、随机傅里叶特征FEDONet、固定张量切比雪夫字典SEDONet。测试结果显示，SEDONet的测试集相对L2误差相比FEDONet降低16.8%，相比DeepONet降低24.0%，所有5个输出通道的误差均得到改善。时空误差分析表明，性能提升主要集中在扩散界面附近和气泡突破界面后的区域。结果表明，切比雪夫表征对该三相流的强非周期壁面法向结构和时间结构具有特别优异的适配性。

title: Sparse Koopman Autoencoders Identify Local Dynamical Regimes in Multibasin Systems
title_zh: Sparse Koopman Autoencoders：识别多 basin 系统中的局部动力学区域
authors: Aidan Li, Uday Kiran Reddy Tadipatri, Mahan Fathi, Sarath Chandar, Ross Goroshin
abstract: Koopman autoencoders (KAEs) seek a higher-dimensional latent representation in which nonlinear dynamics evolve linearly. However, many interesting systems have multiple basins of attraction, and both theoretical and empirical work has shown these multibasin systems cannot generally admit a single finite-dimensional global Koopman embedding under standard assumptions. We posit that encoders with a sparsity-inducing objective encouraging few active latent coefficients will provide latent supports as an inspectable basin-modeling principle for Koopman autoencoders. We use these encoders producing sparse latents in training Sparse Koopman Autoencoders (SKAEs) without basin labels or other regime annotations, and treat the learned latent supports as model-produced regime variables after training. Across a range of procedurally generated multibasin systems and chaotic flows, we show that SKAEs have superior forecasting performance compared to dense-latent KAEs. We also perform a mechanistic study that shows latent supports produced by SKAEs are both essential for the quality of the representation and useful for identifying basins on held-out basin interior states, whereas dense-latent KAEs collapse to an uninformative single family. These results identify sparse latents and their corresponding supports as label-free, interpretable regime variables for Koopman learning in nonlinear systems with multiple local dynamical laws.
summary_zh: Koopman自编码器（KAE）旨在寻找高维隐表征，使得非线性动力学在该空间内呈线性演化。然而大量实际系统存在多个吸引盆，现有理论和实证研究均表明，在标准假设下这类多盆系统通常不存在单一的有限维全局Koopman嵌入。本文提出，引入稀疏诱导目标、鼓励仅少量隐系数激活的编码器，可为Koopman自编码器提供可解释的盆建模原则。我们采用这类生成稀疏隐表征的编码器训练稀疏Koopman自编码器（SKAE），训练过程无需盆标签或其他区域标注，训练后将学习到的隐支撑集作为模型生成的区域变量。在一系列程序生成的多盆系统和混沌流测试集上，我们发现SKAE的预测性能显著优于稠密隐表征的KAE。机制研究进一步表明，SKAE生成的隐支撑集不仅对表征质量至关重要，还可用于在未见过的盆内部状态上识别不同盆，而稠密隐表征KAE会坍缩为无信息的单一家族表征。上述结果证明，稀疏隐表征及其对应的支撑集是无标签、可解释的区域变量，可支撑多局部动力学规律非线性系统的Koopman学习。

title: NVE: A Separability and Coverage-Aware Internal Validation Metric for Biclustering
title_zh: NVE：面向双聚类的可分性与覆盖度感知内部验证指标
authors: Paritosh Tiwari, I Navin Kumar, James C. Bezdek, Punit Rathore
abstract: Biclustering, or co-clustering, aims to discover coherent submatrices by grouping rows and columns of a data matrix simultaneously. This local two-dimensional structure makes validation more difficult than in ordinary clustering, where internal indices usually rely on compactness and separation in a single shared feature space. Existing popular internal biclustering measures such as Mean Squared Residue (MSR), and Virtual Error (VE) mainly evaluate within-bicluster coherence. Although useful, these measures do not directly assess whether the extracted biclusters are mutually distinct or whether they explain a meaningful portion of the data matrix. This paper investigates Normalised Virtual Error (NVE), an internal validation metric that extends VE using a super-bicluster normalization strategy. By comparing the VE of each bicluster with the VE obtained after merging it with other biclusters, NVE introduces a relative notion of separability and redundancy. We also study a coverage-adjusted variant, NVE\textsubscript{cov}, which penalizes solutions that obtain low error by selecting only very small submatrices. Through controlled synthetic benchmarks and yeast gene-expression datasets, we examine whether NVE and NVE\textsubscript{cov} provide information beyond standard coherence-based metrics. The results show that NVE is sensitive to redundant and poorly separated biclusters, while NVE\textsubscript{cov} changes solution rankings when low-error biclusters cover only a negligible part of the matrix. These findings suggest that NVE-based measures are useful complementary criteria for internal co-clustering validation, especially when coherence, separability, and coverage must be considered jointly.
summary_zh: 双聚类（或称共聚类）旨在通过同时对数据矩阵的行和列分组，挖掘出连贯的子矩阵。这类局部二维结构使得双聚类的验证难度远高于普通聚类：普通聚类的内部指标通常依赖单一共享特征空间内的紧凑性和分离度。现有主流双聚类内部指标如均方残差（MSR）、虚拟误差（VE）主要评估双聚类内部的一致性，这类指标无法直接评估提取的双聚类是否相互独立，也无法评估其是否覆盖了数据矩阵的有意义部分。本文研究归一化虚拟误差（NVE）这一内部验证指标，该指标通过超双聚类归一化策略扩展了传统VE方法：通过对比单个双聚类的VE值与该双聚类和其他双聚类合并后的VE值，引入了可分性与冗余度的相对度量。我们进一步研究了覆盖度调整变体NVE_cov，该指标会对仅选择极小子矩阵实现低误差的方案施加惩罚。通过受控合成基准测试和酵母基因表达数据集，我们验证了NVE和NVE_cov可提供超越传统一致性指标的额外信息：NVE对冗余、分离度差的双聚类敏感，而当低误差双聚类仅覆盖矩阵可忽略部分时，NVE_cov会改变原有方案的排序结果。上述发现表明，基于NVE的指标是双聚类内部验证的有效补充准则，尤其适用于需要同时兼顾一致性、可分性和覆盖度的场景。

title: Hybrid Semantic Context-Enhanced Ensemble Learning for Wind Power Ramp-Event Forecasting and Uncertainty-Aware Evaluation
title_zh: 融合混合语义上下文增强集成学习的风电爬坡事件预测与不确定性感知评估
authors: Momina Liaqat Ali, Muhammad Abid, Muhammad Abdullah, Aneela Zameer
abstract: Wind power ramp events which are sudden, large swings in turbine output over short windows are difficult to estimate, and standard models often miss them. Hybrid forecasting approach is built which augments semantic context to ramp-event forecast. Rather than applying an extensive language model directly to predict turbine operating data, we have implemented a pipeline where turbine operating data is converted to simplified text, which is then converted to dense embeddings to be used as inputs for ensemble models incorporated with other features. Testing runs are performed at multiple intervals within the SDWPF dataset, including 10-minute, 30-minute, and 60- minute horizons, with ramp events constituting the highest change in future power output. We check robustness against autoregressive, LSTM, and GRU baselines plus several ensemble configurations, using Diebold-Mariano tests and bootstrap confidence intervals, and we vary the ramp threshold, compress the embeddings with PCA, and validate externally on Kaggle SCADA and NREL data with uncertainty-aware scoring. The semantic-context features produce negligible yet statistically significant gains over the baselines in multiple paired ensemble runs, most clearly at the 30- and 60-minute horizons where these gains hold across different ramp-threshold definitions, and PCA compression helps in some longer-horizon cases. The best context- augmented ensembles rank near the top overall, though the GRU model still posts the lowest ramp-event RMSE at 30 and 60 minutes. External tests confirm the error reduction generalizes across datasets, but the size of the gain depends on both model and dataset. Prediction intervals cover most test cases well but weaken during ramp events, pointing to a localized shift in the data distribution.
summary_zh: 风电爬坡事件指风机出力在短时间窗口内发生的大幅突变，这类事件难以预测，传统模型通常存在漏检问题。本文构建了融合语义上下文的爬坡事件混合预测框架：不直接使用大语言模型预测风机运行数据，而是实现了一套流水线，将风机运行数据转换为简化文本，再映射为稠密嵌入，与其他特征共同作为集成模型的输入。在SDWPF数据集的多个时间间隔（10分钟、30分钟、60分钟预测视界）下开展测试，爬坡事件定义为未来功率输出的最大幅度突变。通过与自回归模型、LSTM、GRU基线及多种集成配置对比，采用Diebold-Mariano检验和bootstrap置信区间评估，同时调整爬坡阈值、使用PCA压缩嵌入，并在Kaggle SCADA数据集和NREL数据集上开展外部不确定性感知验证。结果表明，在多组配对集成实验中，语义上下文特征相比基线取得了统计显著的小幅提升，该提升在30分钟和60分钟视界下最为明显，且在不同爬坡阈值定义下均成立，PCA压缩在部分长视界场景下可进一步提升性能。性能最优的上下文增强集成模型整体排名靠前，不过GRU模型在30分钟和60分钟场景下仍取得最低的爬坡事件均方根误差。外部测试验证了误差降低效果可跨数据集泛化，但提升幅度同时依赖模型和数据集特性。预测区间可对大部分测试样本实现有效覆盖，但在爬坡事件期间性能下降，表明该场景下数据分布发生了局部偏移。

title: Sharp Restricted Isometry Thresholds for Global Minima of Rank-Restricted Matrix LASSO
title_zh: 秩受限矩阵LASSO全局极小值的最优受限等距阈值
authors: Richard Y. Zhang
abstract: We determine the sharp restricted isometry threshold for recovery at global minima of the rank-restricted matrix LASSO. For target rank $r_{\star}$, if the rank-$k$ RIP constant satisfies $\delta<\delta_{\mathrm{sharp}}(k/r_{\star})$, where $\delta_{\mathrm{sharp}}(t)=t/(4-t)$ for $0<t<4/3$ and $\delta_{\mathrm{sharp}}(t)=\sqrt{(t-1)/t}$ for $t\ge4/3$, then every global minimizer has Frobenius error $\lesssim\sqrt{r_{\star}}\lambda$ for all $\lambda\gtrsim\|\mathcal{A}^{*}(\xi)\|_{\mathrm{op}}$ and at every search rank $r\ge r_{\star}$. The constants depend only on the RIP constant and $t=k/r_{\star}$, and in particular are independent of the search rank. When the rank restriction is inactive, the result specializes to the ordinary convex matrix LASSO. We also obtain the analogous results for sparsity-restricted vector LASSO. Conversely, we show that the threshold $\delta<\delta_{\mathrm{sharp}}(k/r_{\star})$ cannot be improved, due to the existence of counterexamples whose global minimizers fail to recover the ground truth.
summary_zh: 本文确定了秩受限矩阵LASSO全局极小值实现精确恢复的最优受限等距阈值。对于目标秩r_★，若秩-k受限等距常数满足δ<δ_sharp(k/r_★)（其中当0<t<4/3时δ_sharp(t)=t/(4-t)，当t≥4/3时δ_sharp(t)=√((t-1)/t)），则对于所有满足λ≳||A*(ξ)||_op的λ，以及所有搜索秩r≥r_★，每个全局极小值的Frobenius误差均满足≲√r_★ λ。相关常数仅依赖受限等距常数和t=k/r_★，与搜索秩无关。当秩限制不起作用时，该结果可退化为普通凸矩阵LASSO的对应结论。我们还针对稀疏受限向量LASSO推导了类似结论。反之，我们证明阈值δ<δ_sharp(k/r_★)是不可改进的：存在反例使得对应问题的全局极小值无法恢复真实解。

title: Jigsaw-CRL: Recovering Global Latent Causal Order from Fragmented Multi-Client Interventions
title_zh: Jigsaw-CRL：从碎片化多客户端干预中恢复全局潜在因果序
authors: Haijie Xu, Chen Zhang
abstract: Causal representation learning (CRL) aims to recover latent causal variables and their structural relations from high-dimensional observations. Existing CRL methods typically assume that all environments are defined over the same latent variables, or at least share a common latent representation space. We study a fragmented multi-client setting, where multiple clients interact with the same global latent causal system but each client only accesses and intervenes on a subset of the latent variables. In this regime, marginalizing unused latent variables induces bidirected edges, so a single client no longer admits a node-wise latent causal graph, and the global latent causal order must be recovered by assembling client-specific structural fragments. We propose \textbf{Jigsaw-CRL}, a framework for recovering global latent causal order from such fragmented interventions. Under soft interventions, differences between precision matrices across environments exhibit a low-rank structure governed by latent ancestor relations. This enables recovery, for each client, of a block partition, the corresponding block-level ancestral order, and latent subspaces, and then assembly of these fragments into the global node-level latent causal order. We establish identifiability guarantees, develop practical algorithms, and validate the framework on synthetic data. Our codes are available onthis https URL
summary_zh: 因果表征学习（Causal Representation Learning, CRL）旨在从高维观测数据中恢复潜在因果变量及其结构关系。现有CRL方法通常假设所有环境都基于相同的潜在变量定义，或至少共享同一个公共潜在表征空间。本文研究碎片化多客户端场景：多个客户端与同一个全局潜在因果系统交互，但每个客户端仅能访问和干预部分潜在变量。在该场景下，对未使用的潜在变量做边缘化处理会生成双向边，因此单个客户端无法得到节点级的潜在因果图，必须通过拼接不同客户端的结构片段来恢复全局潜在因果序。本文提出Jigsaw-CRL框架，可从这类碎片化干预中恢复全局潜在因果序。在软干预条件下，不同环境的精度矩阵之间的差异呈现由潜在祖先关系决定的低秩结构。该特性支持为每个客户端恢复出块划分结果、对应的块级祖先序以及潜在子空间，之后将这些片段拼接得到全局节点级潜在因果序。本文证明了该方法的可识别性保证，开发了可落地的算法，并在合成数据上验证了框架的有效性，相关代码已公开至对应链接。

title: V2TATC: A Joint Voice-Trajectory Embedding Framework and Dataset for Air Traffic Controller Situational Awareness
title_zh: V2TATC：面向空中交通管制员态势感知的语音-轨迹联合嵌入框架与数据集
authors: Louis Brusset, Mathurin Petit, Jordan Kam, Alexandre Bayen
abstract: As air traffic volumes in the National Airspace System continue to expand, in particular in the low altitude airspaces, the need for scalable decision support tools used by air traffic controllers will also require more development. This article introduces Voice-to-Trajectory for Air Traffic Control, a joint voice communication-flight trajectory data embedding framework, that can be a component of situational awareness in congested airspaces, and assist the development of tools for ATC as they reason in real-time over Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast trajectories, or the intent expressed by pilots in natural language. We show that these data modalities are not independent and represent a common physical referent: an aircraft flying through the airspace. V2TATC maps a voice instruction and the trajectory of the addressed aircraft to nearby points in a single latent space that can be queried in both directions. It combines a self-supervised trajectory encoder, a frozen large-scale speech encoder, a contrastive joint embedding, and a bijective lifting via normalizing flows. We demonstrate V2TATC's effectiveness on the San Francisco Bay Area, for its concentration of major airports, and its mix of commercial and general aviation low altitude traffic. Lastly, we release a novel paired voice-trajectory dataset, and report experiments on cross-modal retrieval, ablations, and latent-space analysis.
summary_zh: 随着美国国家空域系统的空中交通流量持续增长，尤其是低空空域流量的扩张，面向空中交通管制员的可扩展决策支持工具的开发需求也在不断提升。本文提出面向空中交通管制的语音转轨迹框架（Voice-to-Trajectory for Air Traffic Control, V2TATC），这是一种语音通信-飞行轨迹数据联合嵌入框架，可作为拥堵空域态势感知的组成模块，辅助开发空中交通管制工具，支持管制员对自动相关监视广播（Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast）轨迹、以及飞行员用自然语言表达的飞行意图进行实时推理。本文证明两类数据模态并非相互独立，它们指向同一个物理对象：在空域中飞行的航空器。V2TATC可将语音指令与对应航空器的轨迹映射到同一潜在空间中距离相近的点，支持双向查询。该框架融合了自监督轨迹编码器、冻结的大规模语音编码器、对比联合嵌入模块，以及通过归一化流实现的双射提升模块。本文以旧金山湾区为测试场景验证V2TATC的有效性，该区域聚集了多个主要机场，同时混合了民航和通用航空的低空交通。最后本文发布了全新的语音-轨迹配对数据集，并报告了跨模态检索、消融实验以及潜在空间分析的相关结果。

title: Continuity-Free Near-Minimax Leading-Order Regret for CVaR-UCBVI
title_zh: 无连续性假设下CVaR-UCBVI的近极小极大领先阶遗憾
authors: Yuanlong Chen
abstract: For finite-horizon tabular CVaR reinforcement learning, prior work proves a $\widetilde{O}(\tau^{-1}\sqrt{SAK})$ leading regret bound for arbitrary normalized return laws and the sharper $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAK/\tau})$ rate under a density lower bound. We show that the same Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI algorithm attains the sharper rate without continuity assumptions. The key is a selected-budget self-bound: the conditional variance of the episode shortfall is at most $\tau$ plus the value-estimation width. Substitution into the original Bernstein decomposition yields, with high probability, $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAK/\tau}+(SAHK^{1/4}+S^2AH)/\tau)$ regret for arbitrary normalized return laws, including atomic, mixed, and continuous laws. The $\tau^{-1/2}$ leading term matches the expected-regret minimax lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Thus Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI is minimax-optimal over the full return-law class in the leading-order regime; the lower-order terms retain their $\tau^{-1}$ dependence.
summary_zh: 针对有限时域表格型条件风险值（Conditional Value at Risk, CVaR）强化学习，现有研究证明对于任意归一化回报分布，算法的领先阶遗憾上界为\(\widetilde{O}(\tau^{-1}\sqrt{SAK})\)，在密度下界条件下可得到更紧的\(\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAK/\tau})\)速率。本文证明，相同的Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI算法无需连续性假设即可达到上述更紧的速率。核心创新点为提出了选定预算自界性质：回合损失的条件方差不超过\(\tau\)加上值估计宽度。将该性质代入原始的Bernstein分解后，可高概率得到任意归一化回报分布（包括原子分布、混合分布和连续分布）下的遗憾界为\(\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAK/\tau}+(SAHK^{1/4}+S^2AH)/\tau)\)。其\(\tau^{-1/2}\)阶领先项在仅差对数因子的条件下匹配期望遗憾的极小极大下界，因此Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI在全回报分布类的领先阶区间内达到极小极大最优，低阶项仍保持\(\tau^{-1}\)的依赖特性。

title: Revisiting the Provable-Auditable Privacy Gap of DP-SGD
title_zh: 重新审视DP-SGD的可审计理论隐私差距
authors: Saloni Modi, Srivi Balaji, Yusong Zhu, Gautam Kamath, Kevin Tian
abstract: Differential privacy (DP) has traditionally been used to provide theoretical upper bounds on an algorithm's stability to changing its training data. In modern private machine learning applications, achieving strong tradeoffs between utility and theoretical privacy is challenging, and thus one may optimistically hope that existing theoretical privacy analyses are loose. Recent work on privacy auditing has adopted a dual viewpoint, instead lower bounding the true privacy of an algorithm by constructing empirical distinguishing events. The auditing literature has thus far yielded a pessimistic outlook on the looseness of theoretical privacy bounds for DP-SGD, the de facto private training method in modern ML, as nearly-matching empirical lower bounds have been achieved under various threat models [NHSBTJCT23, AC24, CBP25].In this work, we propose the empirical privacy lower bound of an algorithm as a concrete metric to optimize for, complementary to the theoretical upper bound. We give a lightweight defense framework that generically augments optimization methods in the ML pipeline to have significantly-improved empirical privacy on standard benchmarks. Moreover, we show that our framework comes at no theoretical privacy cost when augmenting DP-SGD, unlike previously-proposed defenses against membership inference attacks. We evaluate our defense against a broad range of audit constructions, models, and datasets to demonstrate its flexibility.
summary_zh: 差分隐私（Differential Privacy, DP）传统上用于为算法的训练数据稳定性提供理论上界。在现代隐私机器学习应用中，要在效用和理论隐私之间实现良好的权衡十分困难，因此很多研究者乐观地认为现有理论隐私分析的结果是偏宽松的。近期隐私审计相关研究采用了对偶视角：通过构造经验区分事件，为算法的真实隐私提供下界。现有审计研究对现代机器学习中主流的隐私训练方法DP-SGD（差分隐私随机梯度下降）的理论隐私界宽松度持悲观态度，已有研究在多种威胁模型下得到了与理论上界几乎匹配的经验下界[参考文献NHSBTJCT23, AC24, CBP25]。本文提出将算法的经验隐私下界作为可优化的具体指标，作为理论上界的补充。本文提出一种轻量级防御框架，可通用地增强机器学习流水线中的优化方法，在标准基准上大幅提升经验隐私性能。此外本文证明，与之前提出的针对成员推理攻击的防御方法不同，将该框架与DP-SGD结合不会产生任何理论隐私损失。本文在大量审计构造、模型和数据集上对该防御方法进行评估，验证了其灵活性。

title: MERIT: Mitigating Exposure Bias in Generative XMC for User-Interest Propensity Modeling
title_zh: MERIT：面向用户兴趣倾向建模的生成式极端多标签分类（XMC）中曝光偏差缓解方法
authors: Abhinav Mahajan, Arindam Sarkar, Prakash Mandayam Comar
abstract: Matching users to interest categories at scale is central to personalized shopping, but the task is challenging in large e-commerce platforms, where label spaces continually evolve and user-interest signals are sparse and long-tailed. Autoregressive language models are appealing because their world knowledge and semantic priors over descriptors generalize across extreme label spaces and accommodate multiple valid label assignments. Yet under teacher-forced fine-tuning, inference-time predictions become part of the conditioning context: early errors steer later outputs toward co-occurring labels, over-generating near-correlates and missing unrelated true interests. We present MERIT, a framework for user-interest propensity modeling that mitigates this exposure bias through a self-correction objective. A permutation-invariant multi-target loss over shuffled mixtures of gold and mined hard-negative labels exposes the generator to erroneous prefixes while preserving the efficiency of teacher-forced training. This training objective concentrates supervision at classification positions, yielding propensity-aligned hidden states powering a lightweight scorer for bidirectional retrieval (interests for users and users for interests). On a proprietary e-commerce dataset with 250k+ interest categories, MERIT improves global recall by at least 11.9% and average Hit@k by 6.1%. In production A/B tests, it achieves +0.26% gain in user conversion.
summary_zh: 大规模将用户匹配到兴趣类别是个性化购物场景的核心任务，但在大型电商平台中该任务极具挑战性：标签空间持续演化，用户兴趣信号稀疏且呈长尾分布。自回归语言模型具备显著优势，其世界知识和描述符语义先验可泛化到极端标签空间，支持多个有效标签分配。但在教师强制微调模式下，推理阶段的预测结果会成为条件上下文的一部分：早期错误会引导后续输出向共现标签偏移，导致生成过多的近相关标签，遗漏不相关的真实兴趣。本文提出MERIT框架用于用户兴趣倾向建模，通过自校正目标缓解上述曝光偏差。该框架对黄金标签和挖掘得到的难负样本标签的打乱混合结果采用排列不变多目标损失，在保留教师强制训练效率的同时，让生成器接触错误前缀。该训练目标将监督信号集中在分类位置，生成与兴趣倾向对齐的隐状态，支撑轻量级打分器实现双向检索（为用户匹配兴趣、为兴趣匹配用户）。在包含25万+兴趣类别的私有电商数据集上，MERIT的全局召回率至少提升11.9%，平均Hit@k指标提升6.1%。在生产环境A/B测试中，该方法带来了0.26%的用户转化率提升。

title: Leveraging Turn-taking Dynamics for Intent Recognition in Multi-party Conversations
title_zh: RankShift：数据库内分类偏移的检测与解释
authors: Galo Castillo-López, Alexis Lombard, Gaël de Chalendar, Nasredine Semmar
abstract: We propose a multi-task learning approach for multi-party dialogue intent recognition that leverages an auxiliary task that models turn-taking dynamics. Specifically, we introduce turn-transition entropy, a self-supervised target computed from the sequence of speaker transitions, which quantifies the predictability of interaction patterns. Experiments on multiple pre-trained models demonstrate that incorporating this auxiliary task improves intent recognition performance, outperforming existing approaches which ignore multi-party interaction dynamics. We find that our proposed continuous target can be learned as a single-task objective, suggesting that it is an actual signal carrying useful information.
summary_zh: 登录服务可能收到数量正常的登录失败请求，但其中某一类来源的占比从2%增长到30%；系统日志中也会出现类似模式：某类罕见事件模板变得常见，但总消息速率保持稳定。这类事件仅改变活跃类别的分布，不改变事件总数量。RankShift可在存储数据的分析型数据库内部检测这类变化：它使用皮尔逊分数对比每个时间窗口的类别占比与良性参考窗口的分布，皮尔逊分数的分项可识别出导致变化的类别。同一条查询可返回偏移分数、校准后的告警结果以及贡献度最大的增长类别。本文在HDFS、BGL和Thunderbird三个公开日志数据集上对RankShift进行评估：在HDFS数据集上，其AUROC达到0.999，与计数向量自编码器的1.000仅差0.001；在Thunderbird数据集上其AUROC为0.983，优于自编码器的0.949。在受控固定总量实验中，RankShift可检测到事件计数监控无法识别的罕见类别偏移，其AUROC达到0.787，优于自编码器的0.771。在三个数据集上，观测到的误报率均符合预设的运行阈值。RankShift无需模型训练或额外推理服务，而部署后的自编码器体积是RankShift的137倍。

title: RankShift: In-Database Detection and Explanation of Categorical Shifts
authors: Omair Shafi Ahmed
abstract: A login service can receive its usual number of failed sign-ins while one source grows from 2% to 30% of them. The same pattern appears in system logs when a rare event template becomes common while the message rate stays stable. These events change which categories are active without changing how many events occur. RankShift detects such changes inside the analytical database that stores the data. It compares each window's category shares with a benign reference using a Pearson score whose terms identify the categories responsible for the change. The same query returns the score, calibrated alert, and largest increasing contributions. We evaluate RankShift on HDFS, BGL, and Thunderbird. It matches the count-vector autoencoder within 0.001 AUROC on HDFS (0.999 versus 1.000) and leads on Thunderbird (0.983 versus 0.949). In a controlled fixed-volume experiment, RankShift detects rare-category shifts that are invisible to event-count monitoring, reaching 0.787 AUROC compared with 0.771 for the autoencoder. Across all three corpora, observed false-alarm rates track the requested operating levels. RankShift requires no model training or inference service, and the autoencoders deployed state is 137x larger.

title: SemKV: Semantic Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization Guided by the Quality Cliff for Long-Context LLM Inference
title_zh: SemKV：面向长上下文大语言模型推理、由质量悬崖引导的语义混合精度KV缓存量化
authors: Daeha Lee, Do-Hyung Kim, Jae-Hong Kim
abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck of long-context large language model (LLM) inference, growing linearly with context length. We show that uniform KV quantization on a fractional-bit grid does not degrade gracefully: under a prespecified multi-seed statistical protocol, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with an affine quantizer is statistically indistinguishable from FP16 KV down to 2.322 code bits/value and collapses at 2.0 bits - a quality cliff in (2.0, 2.322] that reappears in generation-time quantization and multi-turn dialogue and transfers to Mistral-7B. The cliff reframes importance-aware mixed precision: above it, eight model-internal importance indicators are statistically interchangeable, so the benefit of mixing is grid interpolation, reaching average precisions uniform quantization cannot realize. SemKV preserves every token, ranks tokens by a model-internal score, and assigns two adjacent above-cliff precisions, achieving a measured 6.0x storage reduction with no statistically detectable quality difference from full KV (n=900, three seeds), and outperforming FP16 token pruning granted a 1.5x larger memory budget. Replacing the affine base with a distortion-optimized quantizer (TurboQuant-MSE) lowers the cliff in every protocol tested, raising the no-detectable-loss operating point to 7.9x. The recipe: measure the cliff for the target deployment setting, then interpolate above it.
summary_zh: 键值（Key-Value, KV）缓存是长上下文大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）推理的主要内存瓶颈，其内存占用随上下文长度线性增长。本文研究发现，在分数比特网格上的均匀KV量化不会平滑降质：在预设的多种子统计协议下，采用仿射量化器的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型，在码率低至2.322比特/值时，量化后的KV与FP16精度KV的性能在统计上无差异，但在2.0比特时性能完全崩溃，在区间(2.0, 2.322]内存在质量悬崖，该现象在生成时量化、多轮对话场景中均会复现，且可迁移到Mistral-7B模型。该悬崖特性重构了重要性感知混合精度的设计逻辑：在悬崖精度阈值以上，8种模型内部重要性指标的性能在统计上无差异，因此混合精度的收益来自网格插值，可实现均匀量化无法达到的平均精度。SemKV保留所有token，基于模型内部分数对token排序，分配两个相邻的高于悬崖阈值的精度，实测可实现6.0倍的存储降低，且与全精度KV的性能差异在统计上不可检测（n=900，3个随机种子），性能优于内存预算高1.5倍的FP16 token剪枝方法。将仿射基础量化器替换为失真优化量化器TurboQuant-MSE后，所有测试协议下的质量悬崖阈值都会进一步降低，可将无感知损失的运行点提升至7.9倍存储压缩率。该方法的核心思路为：针对目标部署场景测量质量悬崖，在悬崖精度阈值以上做插值分配即可。

title: Learning-Theoretic Foundation for General Coded Computing: The Straggler Setting
title_zh: 通用编码计算的学习理论基础：滞后工作节点场景
authors: Parsa Moradi, Behrooz Tahmasebi, Mohammad Ali Maddah-Ali
abstract: Coded computing has emerged as a powerful paradigm for mitigating the impact of straggling workers in distributed computing systems. However, existing coded-computing schemes are predominantly designed for the exact recovery of highly structured computations, such as polynomial evaluation and matrix multiplication, and typically rely on strict recovery thresholds. These assumptions significantly limit their applicability to modern machine-learning workloads, particularly deep neural networks (DNNs), whose computations generally lack rigid algebraic structure and, in many applications, require only accurate approximations rather than exact recovery.To address this gap, we revisit coded computing from a learning-theoretic perspective and introduce General Coded Computing (GCC). Rather than adopting existing algebraic tools, GCC formulates coded computing through a natural end-to-end mean-squared error loss that directly measures the discrepancy between the desired computations and their recovered estimates. By deriving suitable upper bounds and restricting the encoder and decoder to a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) with mild smoothness constraints, we show that both the encoder and decoder admit specific representations as linear combinations of RKHS kernel functions. This representation allows the corresponding coefficients to be computed efficiently. Moreover, this framework enables us to establish theoretical performance guarantees for GCC under two complementary straggler regimes. In the worst-case setting with $N$ worker nodes, and at most $S$ stragglers, we show that the end-to-end loss decays at least at rate $O(S^3N^{-3})$ for standard configurations. We then study a probabilistic setting in which each worker independently straggles with probability $p$. We prove that the expected loss can still converge at rate $O(\log_{1/p}^3(N)N^{-3})$.
summary_zh: 编码计算是缓解分布式计算系统中滞后工作节点（straggler）影响的主流范式。但现有编码计算方案大多针对高度结构化计算（如多项式求值、矩阵乘法）的精确恢复设计，通常依赖严格的恢复阈值。这些假设极大限制了其在现代机器学习负载（尤其是深度神经网络）中的适用性：这类计算通常不具备严格的代数结构，且很多应用场景仅需要精确近似结果，不需要完全精确的恢复。针对该问题，本文从学习理论视角重新审视编码计算，提出通用编码计算（General Coded Computing, GCC）框架。GCC不采用传统代数工具，而是通过自然的端到端均方误差损失来直接衡量目标计算结果与恢复估计值之间的差异。通过推导合适的上界，将编码器和解码器限制在满足温和平滑性约束的再生核希尔伯特空间（Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space, RKHS）内，本文证明编码器和解码器都可以表示为RKHS核函数的线性组合，对应的系数可高效计算。该框架支持在两类互补的滞后节点场景下为GCC建立理论性能保证：在包含N个工作节点、最多S个滞后节点的最坏情况场景下，对于标准配置，端到端损失的衰减速率至少为\(O(S^3N^{-3})\)；之后本文研究概率场景，每个工作节点独立以概率p出现滞后，证明该场景下期望损失仍可达到\(O(\log_{1/p}^3(N)N^{-3})\)的收敛速率。

title: Off-Policy Evaluation for Semantic ID Recommenders: Does the Model's Own Code Hierarchy Help?
title_zh: 面向语义ID推荐系统的离线策略评估：模型自身的码层次结构是否有用？
authors: Artem Betlei
abstract: Generative recommenders increasingly emit semantic IDs (SIDs): each item is a short sequence of hierarchical discrete codes from a residual quantizer, decoded autoregressively. Before spending scarce A/B-test, a team may decide offline which decoder or reranking variants are worth testing - a job for off-policy evaluation (OPE). We ask a simple question: can the model's own SID tree serve as the action abstraction for that OPE? Our answer has three parts. (i) Under the near-argmax logging real recommenders use, per-item OPE is hopeless - as item-level effective sample size is usually small on production logs - but marginalizing items to code-prefix clusters restores estimable support and cuts error. (ii) This gain is thanks to coarsening, not to the hierarchy specifically; but the SID tree is what makes coarsening feasible in a generative system - each cluster's mass is exactly and cheaply returned by the decoder, whereas flat clustering requires enumerating item/leaf masses that a code-only decoder does not directly expose. (iii) Resolution depth is the operative knob - coarser under scarce support - and a conditional bias bound links the coarsening bias to the quantizer's worst-case reconstruction residual and the target-logging divergence.
summary_zh: 生成式推荐系统越来越多地输出语义ID（Semantic IDs, SIDs）：每个物品对应残差量化器生成的分层离散码的短序列，通过自回归方式解码。在投入稀缺的A/B测试资源之前，开发团队通常需要离线评估不同解码器或重排序变体的效果，筛选出值得测试的方案，该任务可通过离线策略评估（Off-Policy Evaluation, OPE）完成。本文研究一个核心问题：模型自身的SID树是否可作为该离线策略评估的动作抽象？研究结论分为三部分：（1）在真实推荐系统采用的近argmax日志记录机制下，物品级的离线策略评估几乎不可行——生产日志中的物品级有效样本量通常很小，但将物品聚合到码前缀簇后可恢复可估计的支撑集，降低评估误差。（2）该收益来自粗粒度化操作，并非层级结构本身带来的，但SID树让生成式系统中的粗粒度化操作变得可行：解码器可直接低成本返回每个簇的总量，而扁平化聚类需要枚举仅含码的解码器无法直接暴露的物品/叶子节点总量。（3）分辨率深度是可调控的核心参数：在支撑集不足时选择更粗的粒度，条件偏差界可将粗粒度化偏差与量化器的最坏情况重构残差、目标日志分布的散度关联起来。

title: Conservative Hybrid Graph Networks for Process Systems with Learned Routing
title_zh: 面向具备学习路由能力的过程系统的保守恒混合图网络
authors: Paolo Guida
abstract: Industrial process networks do not maintain a single effective topology while operating: streams are throttled or bypassed, and units move between idle, transition, and active regimes. Models of such systems are typically trained on measured state trajectories while the operating mechanisms that generated them remain latent, and an unconstrained graph network can fit such a trajectory without assigning stable physical meaning to the recovered routing. We address both problems with the Conservative Hybrid Graph Network (CHGN), which learns routing, regime assignment, and removal rates as data-driven surrogates and inserts them into a fixed transport equation, so that the mass balance holds by construction for any predicted routing. CHGN trained on networks of 10-20 nodes transfers zero-shot to unseen graphs of 25-40 nodes without retraining, reaching an RMSE of 2.1e-3 against 6e-2 to 9e-2 for GNN baselines under the same protocol, with a gate MAE of 7.9e-3 and regime accuracy of 94.3% (1.2e-2 and 96.4% respectively on the fixed training topology). On a fluid-mixing pilot plant, CHGN improves on a persistence baseline for held-out physical faults but does not predict manual interventions, for which the governing valve actions are unobserved. The model therefore transfers across process topologies without retraining and exposes the latent mechanisms governing plant behaviour to inspection.
summary_zh: 工业过程网络在运行过程中并不维持单一的有效拓扑：物流会被节流或旁路，设备单元会在空闲、过渡和工作状态之间切换。这类系统的模型通常在测量得到的状态轨迹上训练，而生成这些轨迹的运行机制是隐式的，无约束图网络可以拟合这类轨迹，但无法为恢复得到的路由赋予稳定的物理意义。本文提出保守恒混合图网络（Conservative Hybrid Graph Network, CHGN）来同时解决上述两个问题：该框架将路由学习、状态分配和移除率作为数据驱动代理，嵌入到固定的输运方程中，使得任意预测路由都天然满足质量守恒约束。在10-20个节点的网络上训练得到的CHGN可以零样本迁移到未见过的25-40节点图结构上，无需重新训练，在相同实验设置下其均方根误差为2.1e-3，而基线图神经网络模型的误差范围为6e-2到9e-2；其门控平均绝对误差为7.9e-3，状态分类准确率为94.3%（在固定训练拓扑上的对应指标分别为1.2e-2和96.4%）。在流体混合中试装置上，CHGN在未见过的物理故障场景下的表现优于持续性基线模型，但无法预测人工干预行为，因为这类场景下的控制阀门动作是未被观测的。该模型可跨过程拓扑迁移且无需重训练，还可将支配工厂运行行为的隐式机制暴露出来供后续分析。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Task Learning for Joint Modulation Recognition and SINR Estimation
title_zh: 面向联合调制识别与信干噪比估计的不确定性感知多任务学习
authors: Kosar Nourolahi, Vahid Ghasemi
abstract: Joint modulation recognition and signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) estimation can reduce duplicated processing in intelligent receivers, but the two tasks have different uncertainty characteristics. This letter proposes an uncertainty-aware multi-task model that transforms each short normalized in-phase/quadrature window into 36 deterministic, label-free statistics, learns a shared representation, and uses task-specific adapters for modulation classification and heteroscedastic SINR regression. A joint uncertainty score combines classification entropy and predicted regression variance to support selective inference. Simulations cover QPSK, 8PSK, 16QAM, and 64QAM under matched additive white Gaussian noise/Rayleigh channels and an unseen frequency-selective Rician channel. Over five independent seeds, the proposed model improves matched and unseen-channel accuracy over conventional multi-task learning by 14.86 and 8.61 percentage points, respectively, while reducing SINR mean absolute error by 1.60 and 1.61 dB. Confidence-based rejection further lowers modulation error under channel mismatch.
summary_zh: 联合调制识别与信干噪比（Signal-to-Interference-plus-Noise Ratio, SINR）估计可以减少智能接收机中的重复处理流程，但两个任务的不确定性特性存在差异。本文提出一种不确定性感知多任务模型，将每个短归一化同相/正交窗口转换为36个无标签的确定性统计量，学习共享表征，并使用任务专属适配器分别完成调制分类和异方差SINR回归任务。联合不确定性得分结合了分类熵和预测回归方差，支持选择性推理。仿真场景覆盖了匹配加性高斯白噪声/瑞利信道下的QPSK、8PSK、16QAM、64QAM调制方式，以及未见过的频选莱斯信道场景。在5次独立随机种子实验下，所提模型在匹配信道和未见过信道上的准确率相比传统多任务学习分别提升14.86和8.61个百分点，同时SINR平均绝对误差分别降低1.60dB和1.61dB。基于置信度的拒绝机制可进一步降低信道失配场景下的调制识别错误率。

title: Unsupervised Latent Space Alignment with Hyperspherical Geodesic Matching
title_zh: 基于超球面测地匹配的无监督隐空间对齐
authors: Cameron Ryan, Vivek Sivaraman Narayanaswamy, Kowshik Thopalli, Shusen Liu
abstract: Independently trained neural networks tend to encode the same data with similar latent geometries. These latent geometries are not directly compatible, yet they can be nearly the same up to some class of transformations. While there exists many methods for alignment between different latent spaces, it is typically done using a set of shared sample correspondences, known as anchors. This leaves a fundamental question: are the geometric signatures of different latent spaces representing similar data sufficient to recover an alignment between them? To that end, we introduce HGA (Hyperspherical Gaussian Alignment), a method that directly optimizes a transformation between two latent spaces by maximizing a geometric measure of "fit" between them. Since it is driven by the geometry of the latent spaces rather than paired data, HGA can operate in both an unsupervised and weakly supervised regime. On tasks such as model stitching or multilingual word embedding correspondence recovery, HGA manages to match supervised results with minimal or no supervision.
summary_zh: 独立训练的神经网络往往会用相似的隐空间几何结构对相同数据进行编码。这些隐空间几何结构并不直接兼容，但在经过某类变换后几乎可以实现对齐。现有大量针对不同隐空间的对齐方法通常需要使用一组共享的样本对应关系，即锚点。这引出了一个基础问题：表征相似数据的不同隐空间的几何特征本身是否足以实现二者的对齐？为回答该问题，本文提出超球面高斯对齐（Hyperspherical Gaussian Alignment, HGA）方法，该方法通过最大化两个隐空间之间的几何“拟合度”度量，直接优化二者之间的变换。由于该方法由隐空间的几何结构而非配对数据驱动，HGA可在无监督和弱监督两种模式下运行。在模型拼接、多语言词嵌入对应关系恢复等任务上，HGA仅需极少量监督甚至无需监督，即可达到与有监督方法相当的效果。

title: Quantitative Target Convergence and Uniform-in-Time Propagation of Chaos for Langevin-Regularized SVGD
title_zh: 朗之万正则化斯坦变分梯度下降的定量目标收敛性与时间一致混沌传播
authors: Sayan Banerjee, Dohyeon Kim
abstract: We establish quantitative convergence to the target and uniform-in-time propagation of chaos for Langevin-regularized Stein variational gradient descent. The Stein interaction need not be small relative to the confining Langevin drift and does not generally yield a contractive particle coupling. At the mean-field level, the Stein and Langevin components dissipate the same relative entropy in the kernel-induced Stein and $2$-Wasserstein geometries, producing the squared kernel Stein discrepancy and relative Fisher information. Under a log-Sobolev inequality for the target, this yields exponential last-iterate convergence. We also derive a finite-particle entropy identity relative to the product target, giving exponential-in-time convergence of the empirical measure up to polynomial sampling errors.For propagation of chaos, we develop two complementary finite-time approaches. A synchronous coupling, combined with exponential moment estimates for the nonlinear mean-field diffusion, yields explicit single-exponential bounds in Wasserstein distance and kernel Stein discrepancy (KSD). Moving-product entropy gives joint-law relative entropy control relative to the evolving mean-field product law and, through entropy superadditivity and concentration, fixed-marginal relative entropy and total variation bounds and empirical KSD estimates. Under an additional $T_2$ inequality for the initial law, it also yields Wasserstein bounds. Combining these finite-time estimates with target convergence at a logarithmic cutoff time gives polynomial uniform-in-time propagation of chaos rates in expectation for empirical KSD and $W_2^2$, and for fixed-marginal total variation and $W_2^2$. All bounds control the last iterate in physical time. We also compare the two finite-time mechanisms and identify regimes in which each gives the sharper polynomial exponent.
