abstract: Language is humanity's most consequential technology, yet for over a billion speakers across India's twenty-two constitutionally recognised languages, its digital layer remains structurally incomplete. Named Entity Recognition (NER), the foundational step in transforming raw text into machine-interpretable knowledge, has been studied exhaustively for English but remains largely unsolved across most Indic languages. This paper presents a rigorous comparative study of generative and encoder-based neural architectures for NER on all eleven languages of the Naamapadam benchmark. We evaluate five classic model families spanning sequence-to-sequence transformers and multilingual encoders; four decoder-only large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA and 4-bit NF4 quantisation; and nine generative models in zero-to-5-shot inference. Under strict CoNLL span-level evaluation, encoder-based models (mBERT and XLM-R, both F1=0.675 on Hindi) substantially outperform every generative architecture in ten of eleven languages, with gaps of 7.5-40 percentage points against the strongest competitor (Gemma-2-2B: avg F1=0.427). The best few-shot result reaches only 28% of the encoder baseline. We identify three language clusters--encoder-dominant, partial-coverage, and failure-zone; and provide actionable deployment guidelines grounded in transfer learning and low-resource NLP principles.
summary_zh: 语言是人类最重要的技术，但印度22种宪法承认语言的超10亿使用者，其数字语言生态仍存在结构性缺失。命名实体识别（NER）是将原始文本转化为机器可解析知识的基础步骤，针对英语的相关研究已经非常成熟，但绝大多数印度本土语言的NER问题仍未得到有效解决。本文针对Naamapadam基准覆盖的全部11种语言，开展生成式架构与编码器架构在NER任务上的全面对比研究。评估对象包括5类经典模型（序列到序列Transformer和多语言编码器）、4个使用LoRA和4-bit NF4量化微调的解码器-only大语言模型、9个零样本到5样本推理的生成式模型。在严格的CoNLL跨度级评估规则下，编码器模型（印地语任务上mBERT和XLM-R的F1值均为0.675）在11种语言中的10种上性能显著超越所有生成式架构，与最强竞品Gemma-2-2B（平均F1=0.427）的性能差距达7.5~40个百分点。最优少样本结果的性能仅达到编码器基线的28%。本文将所有语言划分为三类：编码器主导类、部分覆盖类、失效类，并基于迁移学习和低资源自然语言处理原则给出了可落地的部署指南。

title: Detecting Hidden Chain-of-Thought in Large Language Models with Linguistic, Behavioral, and Mechanistic Indicators
title_zh: 基于语言、行为与机制指标检测大语言模型中的隐式思维链
authors: Armaan Singh, Ryan Trinh Le, Jasmine Kaur, Abdullah Sultan, Edward Lue Chee Lip 等 (8 人)
abstract: Large language models often answer complex reasoning questions without revealing intermediate steps, raising whether they reason latently or complete patterns. We propose the Hidden CoT Detection Score (HCDS), a comparative behavioral and mechanistic signal measuring whether neutral-prompt behavior aligns more closely with explicit CoT or explicit no- CoT. Here, hidden CoT operationally denotes this neutral-prompt CoT-like alignment; HCDS does not directly observe or prove an unexposed reasoning trace. On GSM8K, HCDS is significantly positive for both Qwen3-4B variants (Thinking $+1.87$, $p = 1.2 \times 10^{-7}$; Instruct $+1.41$, $p = 1.9 \times 10^{-4}$), replicates across a different inference stack and quantization within $0.08$ ($+1.80$ and $+1.45$), and is not significantly positive in seven of eight length-adjusted calibration-control cells. The unadjusted score produces large positive scores on single-step arithmetic and numeric factual lookup. The variants also respond differently to no-CoT instructions: Instruct complies from the prompt alone, whereas Thinking continues reasoning and requires intervention. These findings show stronger, less prompt-conditional CoT-like behavior in the reasoning-tuned model, consistent with but not proof of latent reasoning. HCDS thus investigates latent reasoning without relying on models' self-reported traces.
summary_zh: 大语言模型在回答复杂推理问题时往往不会输出中间步骤，这引发了学界对其究竟是进行潜在推理还是仅完成模式匹配的讨论。本文提出隐式思维链检测得分（Hidden CoT Detection Score, HCDS），这是一种对比性行为与机制信号，用于衡量中性提示下的模型行为与显式思维链（CoT）场景、显式无思维链场景的匹配程度哪一方更高。本文中隐式思维链的操作化定义即中性提示下与思维链行为相似的对齐特性；HCDS并不直接观测或证明未暴露的推理轨迹。在GSM8K数学推理数据集上，两类Qwen3-4B变体的HCDS均显著为正：Thinking变体得分+1.87（p=1.2×10^-7），Instruct变体得分+1.41（p=1.9×10^-4）；在不同推理栈与量化设置下的重复实验中，得分偏差不超过0.08，对应得分分别为+1.80和+1.45；而在8个经过长度调整的校准控制组中，有7组的HCDS未呈现显著正值。未调整的HCDS在单步算术运算和数值事实查询任务中会输出较大的正值。两类变体对无思维链指令的响应也存在差异：Instruct变体仅依靠提示即可遵守无思维链要求，而Thinking变体则会继续进行推理，需要额外干预才能停止。上述发现表明，经过推理微调的模型具备更强、更少受提示条件影响的类思维链行为，该结果与潜在推理假说一致，但尚不能作为潜在推理的直接证据。因此HCDS可在不依赖模型自报告推理轨迹的前提下，对大模型的潜在推理行为开展研究。

title: How Prolific Sellers Self-Present: Dissecting the Communication Patterns of 1.6 Million Reverb Listings
title_zh: 高产卖家的自我呈现：拆解160万条Reverb平台商品挂牌信息的沟通模式
authors: David M. Markowitz
abstract: The current paper draws on self-presentation theory and warranting theory to evaluate how the language patterns in an online marketplace reflect seller status (i.e., a prolific seller versus an everyday seller). Using 1.6 million musical instrument listings fromthis http URLin search of content, style, and structural differences in seller product descriptions, the evidence suggested prolific sellers tend to focus more on objective and functional aspects of a product (e.g., its features and specifications) and less on subjective characteristics like tone, relative to everyday sellers. Prolific sellers also communicated in a more narrative-like style, which was driven by an elevated use of personal pronouns, and they used longer descriptions than everyday sellers. Therefore, what prolific sellers focus on tends to be quite technical, but how they communicate this information is typical of a story that is told to potential buyers. Implications for self-presentation theory and warranting theory are discussed.
summary_zh: 本文基于自我呈现理论与保证理论，评估在线交易市场中的语言模式如何反映卖家身份（即高产卖家与普通卖家的差异）。研究使用来自Reverb乐器交易平台的160万条乐器挂牌数据，分析卖家产品描述在内容、风格和结构层面的差异，结果显示：与普通卖家相比，高产卖家更倾向于聚焦产品的客观功能属性（例如产品特性与参数规格），较少关注语气等主观特征；高产卖家的沟通风格更偏向叙事性，这一特征源于其对人称代词的高频使用，且其产品描述的长度普遍长于普通卖家。也就是说，高产卖家的内容侧重高度技术化，但其向潜在买家传递信息的方式却采用了典型的故事叙事逻辑。本文最后讨论了该研究对自我呈现理论与保证理论的启示。

title: XQDT: eXplainable and Quantitative Data-Text Alignment Metric with Feedback Signals
title_zh: XQDT：带反馈信号的可解释量化数据-文本对齐度量
authors: Kun Efimov-Zhang, Yifei Song, Claire Gardent
abstract: Evaluating data-text alignment remains challenging: existing metrics often provide limited explanations for the scores, while prompt-based LLM-as-Judge methods can be expensive and unreliable. We present an end-to-end explainable evaluation metric that fine-tunes a language model to identify omitted, extra, incorrect, and correct data units in a data-text pair. These local judgements are aggregated into precision, recall, and F1 scores, providing both fine-grained diagnostic feedback and an interpretable measure of alignment quality. Across benchmarks, our fine-tuned models outperform LLM-as-Judge methods in error prediction and achieve competitive precision, recall, and F1 scores, while maintaining strong correlation with human judgements. Beyond evaluation, our verifier outputs also provide useful feedback signals for downstream correction and refinement, supporting alignment-oriented improvement of data-to-text and text-to-data. Code and resources are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 数据-文本对齐度评估目前仍存在诸多挑战：现有度量方法通常只能给出得分，可解释性十分有限，而基于提示的大模型即裁判（LLM-as-Judge）方法不仅成本高昂，结果也不可靠。本文提出一种端到端可解释评估度量，通过微调语言模型识别数据-文本对中存在的遗漏、冗余、错误和正确数据单元，将这些局部判断结果聚合为精确率、召回率和F1值，同时输出细粒度诊断反馈和可解释的对齐质量度量。在多个基准数据集上，本文微调得到的模型在错误预测任务上的表现优于LLM-as-Judge方法，精确率、召回率和F1值均达到有竞争力的水平，且与人类判断结果保持强相关性。除评估功能外，本文的验证器输出还可为下游修正与优化提供有效反馈信号，支持面向对齐度提升的数据转文本、文本转文本任务优化。相关代码与资源已在公开链接开源。

title: Token Counts Are Not Model Lineage: A Frozen-Threshold Holdout Study of Black-Box LLM API Fingerprinting
title_zh: Token计数不等于模型谱系：黑盒大语言模型API指纹识别的固定阈值留出法研究
authors: Bo Chen
abstract: Black-box model attribution is increasingly relevant when large language models (LLMs) are served through relay and reseller APIs. A tempting low-cost signal is the prompt-token count returned by an OpenAI-compatible endpoint: two models that share a tokenizer and chat template may produce the same count sequence up to a fixed offset. Yet the validity of this signal for broader \emph{model-family} attribution has received little direct holdout testing. We conduct a frozen-threshold study over 24 labeled endpoint pairs, split evenly into a development set and an untouched holdout set, with three temporal repeats and 30 controlled texts per pair. We introduce a validity-gated result contract that distinguishes an observed dissimilarity from an uninformative measurement caused by missing usage data, rate limits, or endpoint policy. The resulting shift-invariant exact-match score perfectly separates the 12 development pairs, yielding a frozen threshold of 0.725. On holdout, however, only 6 of 12 pairs are eligible under the pre-specified three-repeat rule. Among eligible pairs, balanced accuracy is 0.75, sensitivity is 0.50 (95\% Wilson interval 0.15--0.85), and specificity is 1.00 (0.342--1.00). Two same-family pairs---Qwen 3.8 and DeepSeek V4 variants---fall below the frozen threshold. Across 4,320 formal API calls, every log is replayable, while holdout contains 189 non-200 responses and 157 successful responses without prompt-token usage. The study therefore validates token-count consistency as a fingerprint of a shared \emph{tokenization stack}, but rejects its use as a standalone necessary test for model-family lineage.
summary_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地通过中转、转售API对外提供服务，黑盒模型溯源的重要性日益凸显。一种极具吸引力的低成本溯源信号是OpenAI兼容接口返回的提示token计数：两个共享分词器与对话模板的模型，生成的token计数序列仅相差一个固定偏移量。但该信号用于更广泛的模型家族溯源的有效性，几乎没有经过直接的留出法测试验证。本文针对24组带标注的接口对开展固定阈值研究，将其平均划分为开发集和完全未使用的留出集，每组设置3次时间重复实验、30条受控文本。本文提出一种有效性约束结果契约，可区分观测到的不相似性与因使用数据缺失、速率限制或接口策略导致的无信息测量结果。最终得到的平移不变精确匹配得分可完美区分12组开发集接口对，对应的固定阈值为0.725。但在留出集上，12组接口对中仅有6组满足预先设定的三次重复规则；在符合条件的接口对中，平衡准确率为0.75，灵敏度为0.50（95%威尔逊区间为0.15~0.85），特异度为1.00（区间为0.342~1.00）。两个同家族模型——Qwen 3.8和DeepSeek V4变体的得分均低于固定阈值。在总计4320次正式API调用中，所有日志均可复现，但留出集包含189条非200响应，以及157条未返回提示token使用量的成功响应。本研究验证了token计数一致性可作为共享分词栈的指纹特征，但不支持将其作为判断模型家族谱系的独立必要测试。

title: When History Is Multimodal: Rethinking Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents
title_zh: 当历史成为多模态数据：重新思考长视界智能体的上下文管理
authors: Jiaqi Su, Cong Pang, Jiawei Hong, Tiankuo Yao, Zixuan Chen 等 (7 人)
abstract: Long-horizon agents need a context manager to compress growing interaction histories into a bounded working context, via passive strategies or active strategies that decide how memory is accessed and reorganized. Meanwhile, prior optical-memory work mainly treats pixels as a dense codec for textualized histories, often presupposing that rendering context into optical memory incurs a significant performance drop relative to text, thus coupling this representation with SFT, self-distillation, or reinforcement learning to close this gap, leaving unresolved (i) how visual rendering performs as a context manager under a fair, controlled comparison, and (ii) whether this carrier offers a native advantage when history is inherently multimodal. In this paper, we formulate context management as a budget-constrained history transformation and introduce Visual Rendering (VR) as a representational context manager. Under a shared harness, policy model, trigger, and task domain, we evaluate VR on four text-centric and three multimodal benchmarks against four baselines (No Compression, Discard-All, Sliding Window, Summarization), finding visual memory is a natural carrier of native visual evidence. Building on this finding, we propose VERA (Visual Evidence-Retaining strategy for long-horizon Agents), a training-free context manager built on deterministic rendering with no exposed memory operations: on text-centric benchmarks it renders textual history as VR does, while on multimodal benchmarks it retains native visual observations instead of translating them into text. Across nearly all benchmarks, VERA cuts cumulative non-cache tokens by 31.5%-63.1% versus No Compression, matches existing managers on text-centric tasks, and achieves the highest accuracy among all baselines on multimodal tasks, supporting a modality-preserving view of long-horizon context management.
summary_zh: 长视界智能体需要上下文管理器，通过被动策略或决定内存访问、重组规则的主动策略，将不断增长的交互历史压缩到有限的工作上下文空间中。现有光学内存相关研究大多将像素作为文本化历史的密集编解码器，普遍预设将上下文渲染为光学内存会相比文本形式出现显著性能下降，因此需要结合监督微调（SFT）、自蒸馏或强化学习来弥补性能差距，尚未解决两个核心问题：（1）在公平受控的对比条件下，视觉渲染作为上下文管理器的实际性能表现如何；（2）当历史本身就是多模态数据时，视觉载体是否具备原生优势。本文将上下文管理建模为预算约束下的历史转换任务，提出视觉渲染（Visual Rendering, VR）作为表征型上下文管理器。在统一的测试框架、策略模型、触发机制和任务域设置下，我们在4个文本中心基准和3个多模态基准上，将VR与无压缩、全丢弃、滑动窗口、摘要生成4种基线方法对比，发现视觉内存是原生视觉证据的天然载体。基于该发现，本文提出VERA（面向长视界智能体的视觉证据保留策略），这是一种无需训练的上下文管理器，基于确定性渲染实现，不暴露任何内存操作：在文本中心基准上，它像VR一样将文本历史渲染为视觉形式；在多模态基准上，它保留原生视觉观测，无需将其转换为文本形式。在几乎所有基准上，与无压缩方案相比，VERA可将累计非缓存token量降低31.5%~63.1%，在文本中心任务上与现有管理器性能持平，在多模态任务上取得所有基线中的最高准确率，为长视界上下文管理的模态保留思路提供了支撑。

title: En-ViMedNER: An English-Vietnamese Parallel Biomedical Corpus with UMLS Semantic Type Annotations
title_zh: En-ViMedNER：带统一医学语言系统语义类型标注的英-越平行生物医学语料库
authors: Nhu Vo, Phuong Nguyen, Nu Uyen Phuong Le, Inigo Jauregi Unanue, Dung D. Le 等 (7 人)
abstract: Biomedical Named Entity Recognition (NER) is fundamental to healthcare AI applications, including clinical decision support and medical information extraction. While corpora with Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) annotations, such as MedMentions, have driven progress in English biomedical NER, no comparable resource exists for Vietnamese. This paper presents En-ViMedNER, the first English-Vietnamese parallel biomedical NER corpus annotated with UMLS semantic types, which are language-neutral codes providing a shared cross-lingual label space and ensuring direct comparability with existing UMLS-based resources. The corpus contains 4,392 PubMed abstract pairs, 44,892 English-Vietnamese sentence pairs, and 202,949 aligned entity-mention pairs across 21 semantic types adapted from the MedMentions ST21pv dataset. To balance quality and scalability, we have constructed the corpus through automatic translation, expert post-editing, LLM-assisted label projection, and human verification and adjudication. We characterize En-ViMedNER as a large-scale silver-standard corpus with a human-audited and consensus-corrected mini-test subset. We evaluate En-ViMedNER in two settings: (i) Vietnamese-input/Vietnamese-output biomedical NER and (ii) English-input/Vietnamese-output cross-lingual NER. For Vietnamese NER, we benchmark Vietnamese-supervised encoder models, English-supervised multilingual encoder models, and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 52.70 on the test set and 53.78 on the mini-test set. For cross-lingual NER, we benchmark encoder-decoder models and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 45.44 on the mini-test set. We publicly release our corpus, corpus construction pipeline, and baseline models to facilitate future Vietnamese biomedical NLP research.
summary_zh: 生物医学命名实体识别（NER）是临床决策支持、医学信息抽取等医疗AI应用的基础。虽然带有统一医学语言系统（Unified Medical Language System, UMLS）标注的语料库（例如MedMentions）推动了英文生物医学NER的发展，但目前越南语领域尚无同类资源。本文提出En-ViMedNER，这是首个带UMLS语义类型标注的英-越平行生物医学NER语料库，UMLS语义类型是与语言无关的编码，可提供跨语言共享标签空间，确保与现有基于UMLS的资源直接可比。该语料库包含4392对PubMed摘要对、44892对英-越句子对，以及202949条对应21种语义类型的对齐实体提及对，语义类型体系改编自MedMentions ST21pv数据集。为平衡质量与可扩展性，该语料库通过自动翻译、专家后期编辑、大模型辅助标签投影、人工核验与仲裁的流程构建。En-ViMedNER属于大规模银标准语料库，包含经过人工审核、共识修正的小型测试子集。本文在两种设置下对En-ViMedNER开展评估：（1）越南语输入/越南语输出的生物医学NER任务；（2）英语输入/越南语输出的跨语言NER任务。在越南语NER任务中，我们对越南语监督编码器模型、英语监督多语言编码器模型和基于提示的大模型进行基准测试，最优模型在测试集上的F1值为52.70，在小型测试集上的F1值为53.78。在跨语言NER任务中，我们对编解码器模型和基于提示的大模型进行基准测试，最优模型在小型测试集上的F1值为45.44。我们公开释放该语料库、语料库构建流水线和基线模型，为后续越南语生物医学自然语言处理研究提供支持。

title: VibeJam: A User Study Platform for Web Development with Agents
title_zh: VibeJam：面向智能体辅助Web开发的用户研究平台
authors: Nishant Balepur, Connor Baumler, Valerie Chen, Eunsol Choi, Rachel Rudinger 等 (6 人)
abstract: Programming with AI is increasingly agentic, users prompt LLMs to directly edit their code and review the changes, with adoption growing especially for web development tasks. Despite this growth, most NLP work uses offline evaluation and lacks support for online studies, losing insights into how programmers truly use coding agents. We release VibeJam, a browser-based user study platform for users to collaborate with AI agents to develop websites. VibeJam enables agent customization and uses the open-source Aider agent by default, and to mirror downstream use, we add diff review, chat and plan modes, and live website previews. In a pilot study with 55 released, game-based website creation tasks, five experienced AI programmers rate our system as fun, simple, and resembling commercial tools, while 13 junior students use VibeJam to make websites of higher quality than agents in the same task. We open-source VibeJam to spur extensions and support studies on how coding agents can help users.
summary_zh: AI辅助编程的智能体属性不断增强，用户通过提示大模型直接编辑代码、审核修改内容，这类工具在Web开发任务中的普及率尤其高。但目前绝大多数自然语言处理相关研究都采用离线评估，不支持在线用户研究，无法掌握程序员实际使用编码智能体的真实行为规律。本文开源VibeJam，这是一款基于浏览器的用户研究平台，支持用户与AI智能体协作开发网站。VibeJam支持智能体自定义，默认使用开源Aider智能体，为了还原真实下游使用场景，平台还新增了差异审核、对话与规划模式、网站实时预览功能。在包含55个游戏类网站创建任务的先导研究中，5名有AI编程经验的用户评价该系统趣味性强、操作简单，与商用工具体验相近；13名学生用户使用VibeJam完成的网站质量，高于直接使用智能体在相同任务中生成的结果。我们将VibeJam完全开源，以推动相关功能扩展，支持编码智能体辅助用户的相关研究。

title: Check The Scoreboard: An Analysis of Scoring Schemes on Multiple-Choice Evaluation
title_zh: 检查计分板：多项选择题评估的计分方案分析
authors: Nishant Balepur, Paiheng Xu, Wei Ai, Eunsol Choi, Rachel Rudinger 等 (6 人)
abstract: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) benchmarks in NLP use number-right scoring (accuracy), but in educational testing, the scoring scheme, the combination of the response mode models follow and the rule for grading responses, is a key design choice that dictates which abilities to reward. We examine how alternatives to number right change what MCQA measures with six education-inspired schemes that assess abilities beyond accuracy: distractor elimination, abstention, confidence calibration, and self-correction. On LLM benchmarks, these schemes: 1) shift rankings of 31 LLMs beyond rephrased number right prompts; 2) better predict the LLMs users prefer in LLM Arena; and 3) reveal distinct model capabilities, like that GPT-5 rarely abstains and readily self-corrects, while weaker open-weight models often abstain and hesitate to eliminate choices. Given the benefits of alternative scoring schemes, we discuss ways to extend them to tasks beyond MCQA.
summary_zh: 自然语言处理领域的多项选择题问答（MCQA）基准普遍采用选对数量计分（即准确率），但在教育测试领域，计分方案作为模型遵循的响应模式与评分规则的组合，是决定奖励何种能力的核心设计选择。本文考察了选对数量之外的6种受教育测试启发的替代计分方案，这些方案可评估准确率之外的能力：错误选项排除能力、弃权能力、置信度校准能力和自我修正能力。在大模型基准上的实验表明，这些计分方案具备三个特性：1）可改变31个大模型的排名，该排名差异无法通过改写选对数量提示复现；2）可更好预测大模型竞技场（LLM Arena）中用户偏好的模型排序；3）可揭示模型的独特能力，例如GPT-5极少弃权且乐于自我修正，而弱开源模型往往频繁弃权，对排除选项持犹豫态度。鉴于替代计分方案的诸多优势，本文最后讨论了将其扩展到MCQA之外其他任务的可行路径。

title: Improving Argument Saliency Coverage in Small LLMs for Long Legal Opinion Summarization via Sequence-Level Distillation
title_zh: 通过序列级蒸馏提升小参数大模型在长法律裁判文书摘要中的论点显著性覆盖度
authors: Mohamed Elaraby, Ahmed Elhady, Diane Litman
abstract: We show that sequence-level distillation from a capable long-context teacher model is a simple, annotation-free, and data-efficient strategy for improving argument saliency coverage in long legal opinion summarization, where small LLMs often struggle to retain the most salient argumentative content. Across student model sizes, distillation consistently surpasses tuning on expert-written summaries in our legal-opinion setting. We further demonstrate that most gains are achieved with as few as ~10 training summaries, highlighting the strong data efficiency of teacher-generated supervision. Finally, we find that summary distillation is sufficient for improvements: reasoning-chain distillation remains competitive with summary-only distillation, but provides marginal benefit when combined with summary supervision.
summary_zh: 针对小参数大模型往往难以保留长法律裁判文书中最具显著性的辩论内容的问题，本文提出从能力较强的长上下文教师模型开展序列级蒸馏的方案，这是一种简单、无需标注、数据效率极高的策略，可有效提升长法律裁判文书摘要任务中的论点显著性覆盖度。在不同参数量的学生模型上，蒸馏方案的表现始终优于在专家撰写的摘要上直接微调的基线。本文进一步证明，仅需约10条训练摘要即可实现绝大多数性能提升，凸显了教师模型生成监督信号的强数据效率。最后研究发现，仅使用摘要蒸馏就足以实现性能提升：推理链蒸馏的表现与仅摘要蒸馏的表现相当，但将推理链蒸馏与摘要监督结合仅能带来边际收益。

title: ManGo: Manga Active Narrative Grounding Optimization
title_zh: ManGo：漫画主动叙事锚定优化框架
authors: Hao Qiu, Junyan Wang, Zheyuan Liu, Lei Fan, Hong Jia 等 (7 人)
abstract: Manga visual question answering requires models to answer questions over panel-based visual narratives, where relevant evidence is distributed across ordered panels, embedded text, recurring characters, and implicit event transitions. This structure makes passive page encoding insufficient, as the model must identify which panels to inspect, what clues to retain, and when the accumulated evidence is sufficient for answering. We propose ManGo (Manga Active Narrative Grounding Optimization), an unsupervised framework for active manga visual question answering. ManGo introduces Active Narrative Sketching (ANS), which iteratively selects panels, extracts concise grounded clues, and decides when to stop, forming a compact question-directed evidence sketch before answer generation. To optimize this behavior without human-annotated answers or rationale paths, ManGo samples multiple ANS rollouts and applies group-relative training with two rewards: answer preference from listwise self-ranking and path consistency from stable ordered panel trajectories. The combined reward is optimized with group-relative policy training, encouraging the model to improve both final answers and the panel-level evidence paths that support them. Experiments on standard manga understanding benchmarks show that ManGo achieves state-of-the-art performance across different settings.
summary_zh: 漫画视觉问答任务要求模型基于分镜形式的视觉叙事回答问题，相关证据分布在有序分镜、嵌入文本、重复出现的角色和隐式事件转换中。这种结构导致被动页面编码的效果不足，模型必须自主确定需要检查哪些分镜、保留哪些线索、何时积累的证据足以支撑回答。本文提出ManGo（漫画主动叙事锚定优化），这是面向主动式漫画视觉问答的无监督框架。ManGo引入主动叙事草图（Active Narrative Sketching, ANS）机制，可迭代选择分镜、提取简洁的锚定线索、决定何时停止迭代，在生成答案前形成紧凑的、面向问题的证据草图。为了在无需人工标注答案或推理路径的前提下优化该机制，ManGo对多个ANS执行轨迹进行采样，采用组相对训练策略，引入两种奖励：基于列表式自排序的答案偏好奖励，以及基于稳定有序分镜轨迹的路径一致性奖励。通过组相对策略训练优化组合奖励，可同时鼓励模型提升最终答案质量和支撑答案的分镜级证据路径质量。在标准漫画理解基准上的实验表明，ManGo在不同设置下均取得当前最优性能。

title: GenRubric: Self-Evolving Rubric Generation for Scalable LLM Evaluation
title_zh: GenRubric：面向可扩展大语言模型评估的自演进评分标准生成框架
authors: Yifan Chen, Haitao Li, Qingyao Ai, Fengbin Zhu, Tat-Seng Chua 等 (7 人)
abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as scalable evaluators for open-ended tasks. However, many LLM judges derive query-specific criteria during scoring, leaving the evaluation requirements insufficiently specified and their coverage difficult to audit. Query-specific rubrics make these requirements explicit, but expert-written rubrics are costly to construct, while existing automatic methods typically rely on inference-time refinement or external supervision. We introduce GenRubric, a self-evolving framework that improves rubric generation from unlabeled queries without requiring additional human annotations during self-evolution. Our approach is based on rubric-induced self-consistency: independently sampled rubrics for the same query provide partial views of its latent evaluation requirements, and a comprehensive rubric should induce a response that generalizes across these complementary evaluation views. We implement this principle through reinforcement learning, combining a cross-rubric comprehensiveness signal with group-level and criterion-level rewards for rubric quality. We train GenRubric models at 4B, 8B, and 14B scales across multiple domains. Experiments on human-annotated rubric benchmarks show that self-evolution improves the agreement between evaluations induced by generated rubrics and those induced by expert-written rubrics. The improvements further generalize to held-out domains, demonstrating the potential of self-evolving rubric generation for scalable and query-specific LLM evaluation. Code and models are publicly available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 大语言模型正越来越多地作为可扩展评估器应用于开放式任务场景。然而，许多大语言模型评判器在评分过程中会生成针对特定查询的评判标准，导致评估要求定义不充分，标准覆盖范围难以审计。针对特定查询的评分标准能够明确评估要求，但专家编写评分标准的构建成本极高，现有自动生成方法通常依赖推理时优化或外部监督。本文提出GenRubric——一种自演进框架，可基于无标注查询优化评分标准生成，自演进过程中无需额外人工标注。该方法基于评分标准诱导自一致性原理：同一查询独立采样得到的评分标准可提供其潜在评估要求的局部视图，而一个完备的评分标准应当能够生成在这些互补评估视图上具备泛化性的响应。本文通过强化学习实现该原理，融合跨评分标准完备性信号与群组级、标准级的评分质量奖励，训练了4B、8B、14B三个不同参数量级的GenRubric模型，覆盖多个领域。在人工标注评分标准基准集上的实验表明，自演进机制能够提升生成评分标准诱导的评估结果与专家编写评分标准诱导的评估结果之间的一致性，该提升效果可进一步泛化到未参与训练的领域，证明自演进评分标准生成方法具备支撑可扩展、查询定制化大语言模型评估的潜力。代码与模型已在公开链接开源。

title: SkillForge: Compositional Skill Synthesis with Verification-in-the-Loop for Generating Formally Verified Dafny Programs
title_zh: SkillForge：带环内验证的组合技能合成框架用于生成经形式化验证的Dafny程序
authors: Yanming Liu, Xinyue Peng, Jiannan Cao, Xinyi Wang, Jinbo Su
abstract: Generating formally verified programs from natural language remains challenging: existing approaches either produce code in a single pass without recourse when verification fails, or rely on open-ended agentic reasoning that is non-deterministic and opaque. We introduce SKILLFORGE, a framework that decomposes formal code synthesis into a library of atomic, reusable skills, each targeting a specific subtask such as specification inference, body synthesis, invariant generation, error diagnosis, or targeted repair, and defined by a prompt template, tool binding, and decidable success criterion. A verification-driven harness orchestrates these skills: it submits candidates to the Dafny verifier, diagnoses failures into structured categories, deterministically routes to the appropriate repair skill, and iterates until formal correctness is proved or a budget is exhausted. On a curated benchmark of natural language to Dafny specification pairs, SKILLFORGE substantially outperforms both state-of-the-art agentic approaches (including ReAct-style agents, MCTS-based repair, and RL-guided verification) and traditional iterative baselines, while requiring fewer tokens and lower latency. Ablation studies confirm that every skill contributes measurably, and the harness converges rapidly with the majority of programs verified on the first attempt.
summary_zh: 从自然语言生成经形式化验证的程序目前仍存在诸多挑战：现有方法要么单次生成代码，在验证失败时没有修正机制，要么依赖开放式智能体推理，存在不确定性高、过程不透明的问题。本文提出SKILLFORGE框架，将形式化代码合成任务拆解为原子化、可复用的技能库，每个技能对应特定子任务，例如规范推断、函数体合成、不变量生成、错误诊断、定向修复等，每个技能由提示模板、工具绑定、可判定成功准则共同定义。由验证驱动的调度器对这些技能进行编排：将候选代码提交给Dafny验证器，将失败结果诊断为结构化类别，确定性路由到对应修复技能，迭代运行直到证明代码形式化正确或达到计算预算上限。在精心构建的自然语言到Dafny规范配对基准集上，SKILLFORGE的表现大幅超越现有最优智能体方案（包括ReAct风格智能体、基于MCTS的修复方法、强化学习引导的验证方法）与传统迭代基线，同时消耗的token数更少、延迟更低。消融实验证实所有技能都能带来可测量的性能提升，调度器收敛速度快，绝大多数程序在首次尝试时即可完成验证。

title: EVAR: Evidence-Validated Hypothesis Admission for Budget-Aware Narrative Reasoning
title_zh: EVAR：面向预算感知叙事推理的经验证假设准入框架
authors: Peilin Liu, Zhiquan Ji, Jinglong Ping
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often produce fluent but weakly grounded conclusions when reasoning over non-interactive, long-form narratives. A central failure mode is that unsupported intermediate hypotheses can enter the reasoning trajectory and contaminate subsequent inference, especially when evidence is scattered across distant parts of the story. To address this problem, we propose EVAR, an evidence-validated hypothesis admission framework for budget-aware narrative reasoning. EVAR first compiles the narrative into an immutable evidence store of source-linked atomic claims and assigns an instance-specific inference budget from unresolved gaps and uncertainty signals. During refinement, EVAR directly proposes candidate hypotheses for unresolved gaps, constructs hypothesis-conditioned validation challenges, and verifies each candidate against the locked store before admission: supported hypotheses enter the answer-supporting state, unverifiable ones are quarantined, and contradictory ones are discarded. A sufficiency-based stopping mechanism further avoids unnecessary refinement. Experiments on NarraCrime and multiple public reasoning benchmarks show that EVAR improves both task performance and evidence faithfulness while maintaining controllable inference cost.
summary_zh: 大语言模型在对非交互式长叙事文本进行推理时，经常生成流畅但依据不足的结论。这类问题的核心失效模式是：未得到支撑的中间假设会进入推理轨迹，污染后续推理过程，当证据分散在故事的不同远端段落时该问题尤为突出。为解决该问题，本文提出EVAR——面向预算感知叙事推理的经验证假设准入框架。EVAR首先将叙事文本编译为不可篡改的证据库，所有原子声明都关联原始来源，同时基于未解决的推理缺口与不确定性信号为当前实例分配定制化推理预算。在推理优化阶段，EVAR直接针对未解决的缺口生成候选假设，构建假设导向的验证任务，在候选假设准入推理流程前对照锁定的证据库完成校验：得到证据支撑的假设进入答案支撑状态，无法验证的假设被隔离，存在矛盾的假设被直接丢弃。基于充分性的停止机制进一步避免不必要的推理开销。在NarraCrime与多个公开推理基准上的实验表明，EVAR在保持推理成本可控的前提下，同时提升了任务性能与证据忠实度。

title: You Know What I Mean: A Benchmark for Agentic Conversational Reference Grounding
title_zh: 你懂我意思：面向智能体对话指代表 grounding 的基准测试集
authors: Karen Fuchs, Uri Katz, Yoav Goldberg
abstract: Collaborative conversations frequently contain references whose targets are indirect rather than named: resolving "this looks like the fix discussed yesterday" requires combining conversational context with evidence from the surrounding workspace which is accessible through APIs or user interfaces. We formalize this problem as Conversational Reference Grounding (CoRG): using a given set of tools to resolve a reference in conversation to the unique external item intended by the speaker. CoRG is challenging because it combines lexical, semantic, and temporal cues distributed across the conversation and the external workspace. Agents must translate these heterogeneous signals into effective tool use: formulating strategies, discovering plausible candidates, inspecting their metadata and content, and ruling out close alternatives. We study CoRG through RepoRef, a benchmark of 400 developer-chat segments grounded in GitHub issues, pull requests, and commits across 92 repositories. Unlike single-shot retrieval tasks, RepoRef often requires multi-step tool use. Our results show that CoRG remains challenging for current agents, even the best agent reaches only 67.0% success rate, leaving one third of references unresolved. These findings position CoRG as a concrete benchmark for studying how agents search, inspect, and verify information in realistic multi-tool environments.
summary_zh: 协作式对话中经常包含指向目标并非明确命名的指代，例如要解析“这个看起来像昨天讨论过的修复方案”这句话，需要结合对话上下文与可通过API或用户界面访问的周边工作区证据。本文将该问题正式定义为对话指代 grounding（CoRG）：使用给定工具集，将对话中的指代解析为说话人意图指向的唯一外部实体。CoRG任务难度较高，需要整合分布在对话与外部工作区中的词汇、语义、时序线索，智能体需要将这些异质信号转化为有效的工具调用行为：制定搜索策略、发现合理候选、检查候选的元数据与内容、排除近似干扰项。本文通过RepoRef基准集开展CoRG研究，该基准集包含400个开发者对话片段，全部锚定92个GitHub仓库的issue、拉取请求与提交记录。与单步检索任务不同，RepoRef通常需要多步工具调用。实验结果表明，当前智能体在CoRG任务上仍面临显著挑战，性能最优的智能体成功率仅为67.0%，仍有三分之一的指代无法被正确解析。研究结果证明CoRG可作为基准，用于研究智能体在真实多工具环境下的信息搜索、检查与验证行为。

title: A^2Agent: Action-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Repository-Level Code Localization Agents
title_zh: A²Agent：面向仓库级代码定位智能体的动作感知强化学习方法
authors: Doyeon Kim, Suyoung Bae, Yumin Lee, Jee-Hyong Lee
abstract: Localizing issue-relevant code regions is a critical step in automated software engineering. However, due to their reliance on sparse trajectory-level signals, existing methods cannot identify which per-turn actions are effective and often discover correct code regions during exploration but fail to commit them. To address these limitations, we propose an action-aware reinforcement learning method that combines a per-turn reward sequence rewarding both the discovery and commitment of gold code regions with an action-level advantage estimation scheme that isolates each action's credit by grouping turns sharing the same exploration context. Extensive evaluations show that our method improves the average F1 over the state-of-the-art (SOTA) by 1.58% on SWE-Bench Verified and 8.55% on SWE-Bench Pro, with our 4B model outperforming baselines up to 8x larger. Our code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 定位与issue相关的代码区域是自动化软件工程的关键步骤。现有方法依赖稀疏的轨迹级信号，无法识别每一轮动作的有效性，经常在探索过程中发现正确代码区域但无法将其固化。针对该缺陷，本文提出动作感知强化学习方法：融合逐轮奖励序列（同时奖励正确代码区域的发现与固化行为）与动作级优势估计方案（通过将共享同一探索上下文的轮次分组，独立评估每个动作的贡献）。大量评估实验表明，本文方法在SWE-Bench Verified基准上的F1值比现有最优水平高1.58%，在SWE-Bench Pro基准上高8.55%，本文训练的4B参数量模型性能超过参数量最高达其8倍的基线模型。相关代码已在公开链接开源。

title: Do LLMs Change Their Minds Like Humans? Diagnosing Human--LLM Divergence in Single-Turn Persuasion Judgments
authors: Lin Chen, Yitong Chen, Yong Li
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as proxies for human participants in social simulations, yet whether they update their beliefs in response to persuasive arguments, as humans do, remains poorly understood. We conduct a systematic comparison using a naturally occurring online persuasion corpus in which original posters explicitly verify whether a reply changed their view. Our results show that LLMs achieve only slight agreement with humans (Cohen's kappa ranging from 0.079 to 0.178). Content-level analyses show that humans and LLMs agree on the strongest persuasion cues but diverge on finer ones: humans are more swayed by novel content and assertive language, whereas LLMs favor topical similarity and surface-level formatting. At the level of persuasion strategy, LLMs underweight emotional appeals and overweight credibility signals relative to humans, while the type of proposition under debate exerts no measurable effect on the degree of divergence. Furthermore, switching from first-person role-playing to third-person observation shifts all models toward greater resistance to persuasion, with the effect varying across persuasion strategies and textual features. These findings highlight the risk of treating LLM judgments as faithful proxies for human belief updating and point to structural differences in how LLMs and humans process persuasive discourse. Our code is available atthis https URL.

title: HiVe: Beyond Static Prompts for Multitask Learning via Hierarchy-based Vertical Mixture-of-Experts
title_zh: HiVe：基于层次化垂直混合专家的多任务学习方法，突破静态提示局限
authors: HyeonJik Bae, Minyeol Kim, Susik Yoon
abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to scale, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a practical alternative to full-parameter adaptation. Prompt tuning is effective, but existing approaches either use flat prompt structures or hierarchical structures with fixed prompt composition, limiting adaptive prompt specialization. To address this limitation, we propose HiVe, a prompt tuning framework that models prompts at multiple levels and enables input-dependent specialization. HiVe constructs a prompt hierarchy by leveraging inter-task relationships during training, and employs a vertical mixture-of-experts (V-MoE) mechanism at inference time to compose prompts up to the level of specialization required for each input. Experiments show that HiVe consistently outperforms strong prompt tuning baselines across diverse tasks.
summary_zh: 随着大语言模型参数量持续增长，参数高效微调（PEFT）已成为全参数适配的实用替代方案。提示调优是一类有效的参数高效微调方法，但现有方案要么采用扁平提示结构，要么采用提示组合规则固定的层次结构，限制了提示的自适应定制能力。针对该缺陷，本文提出HiVe提示调优框架，在多个层级对提示建模，支持基于输入的定制化适配。HiVe在训练阶段利用任务间关系构建提示层次结构，推理阶段采用垂直混合专家（V-MoE）机制，根据每个输入所需的定制化程度动态组合提示。实验结果表明，在多类任务上HiVe的性能始终优于现有最优提示调优基线。

title: ReTrace: Rejected-Trajectory Conditioning for Speculative Decoding
title_zh: ReTrace：面向投机解码的拒绝轨迹条件化方法
authors: Luxi Lin, Zhanpeng Zeng, Shuang Peng, Songwei Liu, Rongrong Ji
abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language model inference by having a lightweight draft model propose multiple candidate tokens, which are then verified in parallel by a larger target model. However, after the first rejection, standard prefix-based verification discards the remaining draft suffix, so the computation spent generating and verifying those positions does not contribute to decoding progress. Focusing on DFlash, we show that rejected positions in a rejected suffix may still align with the target continuation, indicating that the draft model can retain useful semantic and structural information despite local token-level errors. Motivated by this observation and inspired by conditional diffusion, we introduce~\textbf{ReTrace}, a rejected-trajectory conditioning method that conditions each draft block on the rejected suffix from the previous round rather than generating it from fresh mask placeholders alone. ReTrace retains the hidden representations of the rejected suffixes, aligns them with the next draft block, refines them using target-aware correction signals from the same verification pass, and admits them into the drafter's input embeddings through gated residual fusion. Because rejected tokens are never committed and target-side verification remains unchanged, ReTrace preserves the lossless property of speculative decoding without requiring an additional model forward pass. Experiments with Qwen3 models across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and open-ended dialogue demonstrate that ReTrace consistently improves average acceptance length and end-to-end decoding speed over its DFlash backbone. By introducing cross-round conditioning without modifying within-round proposal generation, ReTrace is largely orthogonal to existing drafting improvements and might be combined with them for further gains.
summary_zh: 投机解码通过轻量级草稿模型生成多个候选token，再由更大的目标模型并行验证候选，从而加速自回归大语言模型推理。但在首次验证不通过后，标准的基于前缀的验证机制会丢弃剩余的草稿后缀，生成与验证这些位置所消耗的计算资源完全无法为解码进度做贡献。本文针对DFlash投机解码方案开展研究，发现被拒绝后缀中的部分位置仍然与目标模型的后续输出对齐，说明尽管存在局部token级错误，草稿模型仍然保留了有用的语义与结构信息。受该观察与条件扩散机制的启发，本文提出ReTrace——拒绝轨迹条件化方法，该方法将每一个草稿块的生成条件设置为上一轮的被拒绝后缀，而非仅从全新的掩码占位符开始生成。ReTrace保留被拒绝后缀的隐表示，将其与下一个草稿块对齐，利用同一轮验证过程中生成的目标感知校正信号对其优化，最后通过门控残差融合将其纳入草稿模型的输入嵌入。由于被拒绝的token永远不会被写入输出，且目标侧的验证流程保持不变，ReTrace保留了投机解码的无损特性，不需要额外的模型前向传播。在Qwen3系列模型上针对数学推理、代码生成、开放式对话任务开展的实验表明，与基线DFlash方案相比，ReTrace能够持续提升平均接受长度与端到端解码速度。ReTrace通过引入跨轮次条件化、不修改轮内候选生成逻辑，与现有草稿模型优化方案基本正交，可与这些方案组合实现进一步性能提升。

title: Evaluating the Capabilities of LLMs for Persuasive Dialogue
title_zh: 大语言模型的说服对话能力评估
authors: Jordan Robinson, Angus R. Williams, Katie Atkinson, Anthony G. Cohn
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate apparently highly persuasive text, but does sounding persuasive mean arguing well? We introduce \textsc{Persuasio}, a multi-agent dialogue platform grounded in a formal argumentation-based theory of persuasion dialogues that adjudicates logical winners during free-text debates. Using this system, we generated 192 debates on a UK political topic between humans and LLMs, and evaluated 22 interlocutors through both automated adjudication and 9,702 crowdsourced pairwise judgements across 1{,}386 annotation instances. We observed a consistent decoupling between subjective and formal persuasiveness: LLMs dominated the subjective ranking yet performed substantially worse under argumentation-theoretic adjudication, where humans remained competitive. Multi-agent and retrieval-augmented variants further widened this divergence. These findings reveal a systematic gap between rhetorical fluency and formal argumentative strength in LLM-based persuasive dialogues.
summary_zh: 大语言模型能够生成看似说服力极强的文本，但听起来有说服力是否等同于论证质量优异？本文提出Persuasio多智能体对话平台，该平台基于形式化论证的说服对话理论构建，可在自由文本辩论中判定逻辑层面的获胜方。基于该平台，本文生成了192场围绕英国政治议题的人类与大语言模型辩论，通过自动判定机制与覆盖1386个标注实例的9702次众包成对判断，对22名对话参与者开展评估。实验观察到主观说服力与形式化说服力存在系统性脱钩：大语言模型在主观排名中占据优势，但在基于论证理论的判定规则下表现远差于人类，人类在该规则下仍保持竞争力。多智能体与检索增强变体进一步放大了该差异。这些发现证明基于大语言模型的说服对话存在系统性缺陷：修辞流畅度与形式化论证强度之间存在显著差距。

title: DVBench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Understanding Dynamic Charts and Narratives in Data Videos
title_zh: DVBench：面向多模态大模型理解数据视频中动态图表与叙事的基准测试集
authors: Bomiao Wang, Zekai Shao, Jiexiang Lan, Xiaoliang Fu, Xingchen Zeng 等 (6 人)
abstract: While MLLMs have made significant strides in chart comprehension and video understanding, current evaluations largely isolate these capabilities, leaving a critical gap in understanding temporally evolving structured visual information. To address this gap, we introduce DVBench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on data videos, a storytelling medium that integrates dynamic charts with structured narratives. We decompose data video understanding into five dimensions. DVBench comprises 300 real-world data videos and 1,000 human-verified QA pairs curated through a rigorous semi-automated pipeline. Extensive evaluations of nine MLLMs show that Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves the best overall performance, while Kimi-k2.5 is the strongest open-source model. We further identify two notable phenomena: open-source model performance does not scale strictly with parameter size, and narrative proficiency does not guarantee visual capability. Fine-grained analyses and ablation studies further reveal dimension-specific weaknesses and the effects of frame configurations and subtitle inputs, informing future MLLM development. DVBench is publicly available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 尽管多模态大模型（MLLM）在图表理解与视频理解任务上已经取得显著进展，但现有评估方案大多将两类能力相互隔离，导致对时序演化结构化视觉信息的理解能力评估存在明显空白。针对该空白，本文提出DVBench基准集，用于评估多模态大模型在数据视频任务上的性能，数据视频是一类融合动态图表与结构化叙事的叙事媒介。本文将数据视频理解任务拆解为5个维度，DVBench包含300个真实世界数据视频与1000对经人工校验的问答对，通过严格的半自动化流程筛选得到。对9个多模态大模型的大量评估显示，Gemini-3.1-Pro的整体性能最优，Kimi-k2.5是性能最强的开源模型。本文进一步发现两个显著现象：开源模型的性能不会严格随参数量增长而提升，叙事理解能力无法保证视觉理解能力达标。细粒度分析与消融实验进一步揭示了不同维度对应的能力缺陷，以及帧配置、字幕输入对性能的影响，可为后续多模态大模型的优化方向提供参考。DVBench已在公开链接开源。

title: The Depth Flow of Token Representations Is Nonlinear and Does Not Descend Its Own Density
title_zh: 词元表示的深度流具有非线性特性且不会沿自身密度下降
authors: Alexandre Quemy
abstract: A token's representation is carried through the network layer by layer. The whole vocabulary carried together forms a flow. We fit this flow's equation of motion as a discrete Langevin model over corpus-mean trajectories of Pythia-160M and Pythia-410M, and score the predicted steps on held-out tokens. Linear maps are often used as cheap surrogates for a layer. The flow they summarize is not linear: a quadratic drift beats the linear linear map at every transition of both models, and the Kramers--Moyal estimator agrees wherever its neighborhoods stay local.We then characterize the flow further. First, we show that it does not descend its own log-density. The drift instead descends a potential that is not the density. Second, the rotational component is not negligible, $4$ to $45\%$ of the explainable drift, and the circulation shows in what the flow preserves: a token keeps its angular rank across all thirteen layers while its norm rank is shuffled and its concentration rank is reversed by the last block.
summary_zh: 词元的表示在网络中逐层传递，整个词表的表示共同传递形成一个流。我们在Pythia-160M和Pythia-410M的语料平均轨迹上，将该流的运动方程拟合为离散朗之万模型，并在留出词元上对预测步进行评分。线性映射常被用作层的低成本替代方案，但它们所概括的流并非线性：在两个模型的所有迁移过程中，二次漂移的表现均优于线性映射，且Kramers--Moyal（克拉默斯-莫亚尔）估计器在其邻域保持局部性的所有位置均与实验结果吻合。随后我们进一步刻画了该流的特性：首先，我们证明该流不会沿自身的对数密度下降，其漂移项实际下降的势函数并非密度本身；其次，流的旋转分量不可忽略，占可解释漂移的4%至45%，环流特性体现为流的守恒属性：词元在全部13层中始终保持其角向排名，但其范数排名会被打乱，浓度排名则会在最后一个模块中发生反转。

title: A Hub of Short Rows Inflates Intrinsic Dimension Estimation of Token Embeddings
title_zh: 短行构成的枢纽会放大词元嵌入的本征维度估计结果
authors: Alexandre Quemy
abstract: A token-embedding table holds a hub of short rows near its origin, and we show that this cluster biases what nearest-neighbor intrinsic-dimension (ID) estimators report. Because of the concentration of measure, a token is closer to the central cluster than to any other token, so its first two neighbors are both hub rows at nearly the same distance. As a result, the ID estimators such as TwoNN return a dimension far above the real ID. Measured one token at a time, dimension is a heavy-tailed distribution. Measured on the full vocabulary, it grows with the model's parameter count. However, when we remove the hub, the heavy tail disappears and the measured dimension collapses to a narrow range for eleven models, from GPT-2 to models such as K3 and GLM-4.7. The hub acts as a switch: a few hundred rows are enough to fully inflate the estimate. We reproduced an experiment stating that the intrinsic dimension (ID) of Pythia's token-embedding table grows with the parameter count, from $27$ to $122$ between 160M and 12B parameters. We show that this result disappears when the hub is removed: the table then reads $10$ to $17$ at every size. The hub contains a subset of the population that under-trained-token detectors flag, but on Pythia the hub that we detected and removed as a whole was updated during training: what seem to characterize these rows is simply their length, not an absence of updates. Finally, we show that normalizing the rows instead of removing them gives the same lower reading.
summary_zh: 词元嵌入表在原点附近存在一个由短行构成的枢纽集群，本文证明该集群会对最近邻本征维度（ID）估计器的输出结果产生偏差。由于测度集中效应，任意词元到中心集群的距离都小于它到其他任何词元的距离，因此其前两个最近邻几乎都是距离相近的枢纽行。这导致TwoNN等本征维度估计器返回的维度值远高于真实本征维度。逐词元测量得到的维度服从重尾分布，而在整个词表上测量时，维度值会随模型参数量增长。但当移除该枢纽集群后，重尾分布消失，11个从GPT-2到K3、GLM-4.7的模型的测量维度都会收敛到一个窄区间内。该枢纽起到了开关作用：仅需数百行就足以完全放大维度估计结果。我们复现了一项此前的实验，该实验指出Pythia词元嵌入表的本征维度随参数量增长，在160M到12B参数量区间内从27增长到122；本文证明移除枢纽后该结果不再成立：所有参数量级下的嵌入表本征维度仅为10到17。该枢纽包含了部分被欠训练词元检测器标记的样本，但在Pythia中，我们检测并整体移除的枢纽在训练过程中是被更新过的：这些行的核心特征仅仅是向量长度更短，而非未被训练更新。最后我们证明，对行向量做归一化而非直接移除，也能得到同样的低维度测量结果。

title: ACTD: Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization
title_zh: ACTD：带残差正则化的基于锚点的跨分词器蒸馏方法
authors: Huiyi Zhang, Zijian Li, Xiaocheng Feng, Weitao Ma, Xiaoliang Yang 等 (7 人)
abstract: Knowledge distillation effectively transfers reasoning capabilities from large language models to lightweight student models. To enable knowledge transfer across disparate model families, researchers increasingly explore cross-tokenizer distillation. However, cross-tokenizer distillation remains challenging due to vocabulary and sequence misalignment, while approximate vocabulary alignment can introduce additional noise into distillation. To address these challenges, we propose Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization (ACTD). ACTD bridges structural heterogeneity through vocabulary and sequence alignment, while mitigating alignment noise via a novel anchor loss with residual regularization. We further extend this framework to a multi-teacher setting. Evaluated across five reasoning benchmarks with three distinct teacher models, ACTD achieves state-of-the-art performance. Moreover, its multi-teacher extension outperforms the strongest single-teacher and multi-teacher baselines, further demonstrating the robustness of our method.
summary_zh: 知识蒸馏可以将大语言模型的推理能力有效迁移到轻量学生模型中。为了实现跨不同模型家族的知识迁移，越来越多研究者开始探索跨分词器蒸馏技术。但跨分词器蒸馏面临词表和序列不对齐的挑战，而近似词表对齐操作又会给蒸馏过程引入额外噪声。为解决上述问题，本文提出ACTD（Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization，带残差正则化的锚点型跨分词器蒸馏方法）。ACTD通过词表和序列对齐打通结构异质性，同时通过全新的带残差正则化的锚点损失缓解对齐噪声。我们进一步将该框架扩展到多教师场景下。在5个推理基准上使用3种不同教师模型开展的实验表明，ACTD取得了当前最优性能；其多教师扩展版本的表现超过了最强的单教师和多教师基线，充分证明了该方法的鲁棒性。

title: PrivBench: A Holistic and Modular Benchmarking Platform for Evaluating Text-to-Text Privatization
title_zh: PrivBench：面向文本文本私有化评估的全模块化基准测试平台
authors: Stephen Meisenbacher, Andreea-Elena Bodea, Ahmet Bilal Akın, Alexandra Klymenko, Jana Diesner 等 (6 人)
abstract: Natural Language Processing methods have enabled novel solutions and advances in the field of privacy, particularly in the sub-domain of text-to-text privatization, where the goal is to transform a sensitive input text into a privatized output by ideally masking (in)directly identifiable or otherwise private information. The evaluation of text-to-text privatization, however, is not straightforward, and the extant literature has utilized a myriad of techniques and metrics to quantify the privacy-preserving capabilities of privatization methods. Seeking to unify the evaluation of text-to-text privatization, we introduce PrivBench, a holistic and modular benchmarking platform for researchers and practitioners working on text privatization. PrivBench is holistic in that it evaluates privatization on a series of defined desiderata, which are structured into modules. PrivBench is not only modular but also extensible, allowing for future updates and benchmark versions. PrivBench is user-centered and promotes competition via real-time evaluation and a live public leaderboard. The platform is free to use and openly accessible atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 自然语言处理技术推动了隐私领域的诸多新方案与进展，尤其是在文本文本私有化子领域中，该领域的目标是将敏感输入文本转换为私有化输出，理想情况下可以掩盖直接/间接可识别信息或其他隐私内容。但文本文本私有化的评估并不简单，现有文献使用了大量不同的技术和指标来量化私有化方法的隐私保护能力。为统一文本文本私有化的评估体系，本文推出PrivBench，面向文本私有化方向的研究者和从业者的全模块化基准测试平台。PrivBench的全面性体现在它会按照一系列预设的评估准则对私有化效果进行评测，这些准则被组织为不同的功能模块。PrivBench不仅支持模块化设计，还具备可扩展性，支持后续更新和基准版本迭代。该平台以用户为中心，通过实时评估和公开在线排行榜促进技术竞争，可通过对应链接免费公开访问。

title: JPO: Juris Policy Optimization for Structured Legal Reasoning in Criminal Judgment Prediction
title_zh: JPO：面向刑事判决预测中结构化法律推理的司法策略优化
authors: Zhaolu Kang, Yantao Liu, Tailong Luo, Leqi Zheng, Lei Wei 等 (17 人)
abstract: Criminal judgment prediction requires models to infer statutory articles, charges, and sentencing outcomes from case facts. Unlike standard classification tasks, it involves a structured reasoning process in which statutes should be matched with facts, charges should be justified by statutes, and sentencing outcomes should remain consistent with charges. Existing approaches optimize final labels, and while some have attempted to evaluate reasoning quality, their evaluations are indirect, often relying on LLM-generated rubrics that reflect model-internal preferences rather than the inherent logical structure of legal adjudication. We propose Juris Policy Optimization (JPO), a post-training framework for structured legal reasoning in Chinese criminal judgment prediction. JPO first uses teacher-generated rationales to supervise a standardized four-step reasoning process, and then applies reinforcement learning with a composite reward over legal prediction quality, reasoning structure completeness, and cross-step consistency. JPO further introduces token-level advantage reweighting and adaptive clipping for legally salient reasoning segments. Experiments on multiple open-source language models and three Chinese legal benchmarks show that JPO consistently improves both judgment prediction and reasoning quality over supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning baselines.
summary_zh: 刑事判决预测任务要求模型从案件事实中推导出对应的法条、罪名和量刑结果。与标准分类任务不同，该任务涉及结构化推理过程：法条需要与事实匹配，罪名需要有对应的法条支撑，量刑结果需要与罪名保持一致。现有方法大多针对最终标签做优化，部分尝试评估推理质量的工作也采用间接评估方式，往往依赖大语言模型生成的评分标准，反映的是模型内部偏好而非法律裁判本身的固有逻辑结构。本文提出JPO（Juris Policy Optimization，司法策略优化），面向中文刑事判决预测任务的结构化推理后训练框架。JPO首先使用教师生成的推理依据对标准化四步推理过程做监督，随后应用结合法律预测质量、推理结构完整性、跨步骤一致性的复合奖励的强化学习方法。JPO还进一步针对法律关键推理片段引入了词元级优势重加权和自适应裁剪机制。在多个开源语言模型和三个中文法律基准上开展的实验表明，相较于监督微调与强化学习基线，JPO可以同时稳定提升判决预测效果和推理质量。

title: Beyond Surface Alignment: Grounding the Dynamics of Situational Understanding and Generative Control in LLMs
authors: Chenghao Yang
abstract: The current alignment tuning paradigm for Large Language Models (LLMs) prioritizes surface-level behaviors -- fluency, safety, and tonal consistency. While effective for casual chat, this thesis argues that such surface alignment masks a lack of grounding, creating models that are stylistically confident but situationally brittle. We propose a framework of Grounded Alignment, analyzing how models process context (Input) and structure generation (Output), then aligning these grounded behaviors to human needs.First, we evaluate failures in Situational Grounding. SitTest shows that despite large context windows, state-of-the-art models struggle to maintain a consistent "mental model" of a changing environment. ReCode further shows that models rely on surface heuristics rather than deep syntactic dependencies: they "read" extensive histories without truly "understanding" the evolving situation.Second, we evaluate Generative Grounding. We introduce the Branching Factor (BF) to map LLM generation, finding that standard alignment tuning constricts this landscape into premature stylistic collapse. Hindsight further shows that models often fail to understand their own generations.Finally, we propose Dynamic Control for grounded interaction. AI Realtor demonstrates context engineering to compensate for poor situational grounding. Base-Aligned Model Collaboration decouples exploration from stylistic constraints. We also present Annealed Sampling for verifiable reinforcement learning and apply these ideas to Addiction Support, where model-generated rationalization offers a communication interface for high-stakes domains. Collectively, this work moves beyond surface alignment toward agents anchored in both context and generation.

title: Agent Zero Memory: Provenance-Aware Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
title_zh: Agent Zero Memory：面向大语言模型智能体的溯源感知长期记忆系统
authors: Ming Wu, Pengyuan Zhu
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents need durable, faithful memory of everything a user or organization has said and stored, yet most memory systems commit to a single organizing structure (a fact store, a vector index, or a knowledge graph) and inherit its blind spots. We present Agent Zero Memory, a provenance-aware long-term memory system that distils a user's conversations, files, and connected sources into three parallel memory systems, each capturing a different facet of the same history: an episodic Memory Events timeline that makes when and what changed first-class, an associative entity-event knowledge graph that links people and projects across sessions, and a semantic, curated, citation-locked Hierarchical Documentary Memory (HDM) of durable facts. A retrieval turn runs an intent gate (so self-contained turns add no latency), a source router, and three concurrent agentic searches, one per system, each a tool-using loop over hybrid (embedding + lexical) search under agent-controlled filters; their grounded, cited answers are integrated into one answer with a single confidence. We formalize the reading discipline: every learned item is a provenanced item carrying its origin, timestamp, and evidence pointer, and every answer is read under a citation lock, so it may cite only evidence its reader actually opened; fabrication is structurally excluded and the system abstains rather than guesses. On two public benchmarks the system sets a new state of the art: 95.60% on LongMemEval and 93.60% on LoCoMo, improving over the strongest prior systems by +0.73 and +1.10 points. A controlled study across eight backbone LLMs characterizes the accuracy-cost-latency frontier: accuracy varies by only 3.4 points while per-query cost varies by ~30x, with near-state-of-the-art quality at up to 20x lower cost per query, the signature of memory-driven, rather than model-driven, quality.
summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体需要持久、可信地记录用户或组织的所有对话和存储内容，但现有大多数记忆系统都采用单一组织结构（事实库、向量索引或知识图谱），不可避免地继承了该结构的固有缺陷。本文提出Agent Zero Memory，一种具备溯源感知能力的长期记忆系统，它将用户的对话、文件和关联来源提炼为三个并行的记忆子系统，每个子系统捕获同一历史的不同维度：一是情景化记忆事件时间线，将变更时间和变更内容作为核心要素；二是关联型实体-事件知识图谱，跨会话关联人物和项目信息；三是经过整理、带引用锁定的语义化HDM（Hierarchical Documentary Memory，分层文档记忆），用于存储持久化事实。每轮检索会依次运行意图门控（保证自包含轮次不会增加延迟）、源路由调度，随后在三个子系统中并行执行智能体搜索，每个搜索都是在智能体控制的过滤条件下，结合嵌入搜索和词法搜索的混合工具调用循环；三个子系统返回的带引用的可信结果会被整合为一个带统一置信度的最终答案。我们对读取规则做了形式化定义：每一条学习到的内容都是带溯源信息的条目，包含来源、时间戳和证据指针，所有答案都在引用锁的约束下生成，仅能引用读取者实际打开过的证据，从结构上杜绝了内容生成造假，系统在信息不足时会直接弃权而非猜测。在两个公开基准上，该系统取得了新的最优性能：LongMemEval准确率达95.60%，LoCoMo准确率达93.60%，相比此前最强的系统分别提升0.73和1.10个百分点。在8种不同骨干大语言模型上开展的对照实验刻画了该系统的准确率-成本-延迟边界：准确率波动仅为3.4个点，而单查询成本波动可达30倍，在成本降低最高20倍的情况下仍能接近最优性能，体现了该系统的质量由记忆驱动而非模型驱动的核心特征。

title: Hindsight Memory-PRM: Supervising Memory Management with Auditable Hindsight Credit
title_zh: Hindsight Memory-PRM：基于可审计事后信用的记忆管理监督方法
authors: Haoxuan Jia, Yang Liu, Yingguang Yang, Yancheng Chen, Chongyang Zhang 等 (17 人)
abstract: Memory operations of long-horizon LLM agents are hard to supervise: an operation's value is unobservable when it is taken. But they are special -- they leave machine-readable evidence in the trajectory: retrieval hits and answer-time citations. Hindsight Memory-PRM exploits this audit trail twice: offline to train an operation-conditioned memory-utility critic, and online, where retrievals, citations, and one controlled deletion-and-reanswer per probe settle an intervention-calibrated entry-level presence credit, propagated along version chains as an action-level proxy reward -- no per-operation human labels, no Monte-Carlo replay of continuations. On held-out LoCoMo a local 8B policy reaches 77.5% under a fixed shared reader, surpassing its API teacher (65.1%) and all reproduced external systems, at one eighth the context of Mem0's official operating point; on LongMemEval, 79.0%. Ablations attribute the gain to causal calibration rather than signal density, and the policy converges to a multi-version memory organization whose gains no tested open-loop baseline reproduces.
summary_zh: 长程大语言模型智能体的记忆操作很难被监督：操作执行时无法直接观测其价值。但记忆操作存在特殊性：它会在轨迹中留下机器可读的证据，即检索命中记录和回答时的引用记录。Hindsight Memory-PRM（事后记忆过程奖励模型）两次利用该审计轨迹：离线阶段用于训练以操作条件为输入的记忆效用评估器；在线阶段，通过检索、引用以及每个探测样本受控的删除-重回答操作，生成经过干预校准的条目级存在信用，该信用沿版本链传播作为动作级的代理奖励，无需为每个操作标注人工标签，也无需蒙特卡洛重放后续轨迹。在留出的LoCoMo数据集上，本地8B参数量的策略在固定共享读取器下达到77.5%的准确率，超过了其API教师模型的65.1%以及所有复现的外部系统，所需上下文长度仅为Mem0官方运行配置的1/8；在LongMemEval数据集上准确率达到79.0%。消融实验证明性能提升来自因果校准而非信号密度，该策略最终收敛到多版本记忆组织结构，其性能增益无法被所有测试的开环基线复现。

title: How You Ask Shapes What You Get: A Theory-Seeded Measurement of Articulation in Advice-Seeking LLM Conversations
title_zh: 提问方式决定输出结果：基于理论构建的大语言模型咨询类对话表达程度度量研究
authors: Juneha Baek, Suhyeon Lee, Donghyuk Shin
abstract: Users articulate the same advice-seeking request in different ways: some specify detailed constraints, others gesture at a vague need. Prior work treats this variation as noise to be averaged away; we instead treat it as a stable, measurable structure in the input distribution. We ask whether articulation (how people ask) forms latent dimensions separable from topic (what they ask about), and whether it is associated with how language models respond. We extract interpretable features from 16,447 advice-seeking prompts pooled from public chat corpora (WildChat, LMSYS, and ShareChat) and recover a small set of latent articulation factors that replicate across train/test splits and across corpora. Because this structure is largely separable from topic, the populations it defines cut across topics and stay invisible to topic- or task-based evaluation. The factors define a handful of recurring articulation styles, one of which stands out: a long-form but information-poor style, roughly one in six prompts in the largest corpus, where models return shorter, vaguer answers and do not ask for clarification even though under-specification is exactly the condition that warrants it. The contrast holds within every topic group and length quintile, and is not under-specification alone -- a second, equally under-specified style does draw clarifying questions. Two independent human annotators reproduce this contrast. We argue that benchmarks should stratify on articulation, and we offer the extracted structure as a measurement instrument for doing so.
summary_zh: 用户会以不同方式表达相同的咨询类请求：部分请求会指定详细约束，另一些则仅模糊表达需求。此前的工作将这种表达差异视为需要被平均消除的噪声，本文则将其视为输入分布中稳定可测的结构。我们研究表达程度（用户的提问方式）是否构成与主题（用户的提问内容）可分离的潜在维度，以及它是否会影响大语言模型的响应效果。我们从WildChat、LMSYS、ShareChat等公开对话语料中汇总得到16447条咨询类提示，从中提取可解释特征，得到一组少量的潜在表达因子，这些因子在训练/测试集划分和不同语料间都具备可复现性。由于该结构与主题几乎完全可分离，它所定义的用户群体跨不同主题分布，无法被基于主题或任务的评估体系捕获。这些因子定义了几种常见的表达风格，其中一种尤为突出：长文本但信息密度极低的风格，在最大的语料中约占1/6，大语言模型针对这类提示返回的回答更短、更模糊，且不会主动请求用户补充信息，而这类信息不足的场景恰恰是应当发起澄清请求的场景。该对比关系在所有主题分组和所有长度五分位分组中都成立，且并非仅由信息不足导致：另一种信息不足程度相当的表达风格确实会触发模型的澄清提问。两名独立人类标注员可以复现该对比结果。本文认为基准测试应当按表达程度做分层，我们提取的表达结构可以作为实现该分层的度量工具。

title: SemTrace: Source-Grounded Semantic Signatures for Tracing LLM Exposure to Protected Documents
title_zh: SemTrace：基于源文档的语义签名用于追踪大语言模型接触受保护文档的行为
authors: Junyan Zhang, Yudong Zeng, Yongwei Huang, Zuhao Ouyang, Hong Chen 等 (6 人)
abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to read documents and produce downstream text, creating a provenance problem when the document owner cannot control or inspect the model that performs the generation. We introduce SemTrace, a source-grounded semantic watermark for detecting whether a generated review was influenced by a known protected manuscript copy. Rather than biasing token probabilities or imposing surface-form patterns, SemTrace constructs a document-specific binary signature from factual propositions that are directly supported by the manuscript itself. A protected PDF invisibly carries a content contract that selects one fact from each binary pair and asks an instruction-following reviewer to express those facts in fixed review slots without changing its independent evaluation. A frozen natural language inference model then decodes the resulting semantic evidence with explicit erasures and scores the recovered bits against the codeword assigned to that copy. This design targets model-agnostic, assigned-copy exposure detection while keeping the watermark semantically tied to the source document.
summary_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于读取文档并生成下游文本，当文档所有者无法控制或检查执行生成操作的模型时，就会出现溯源问题。本文提出SemTrace，一种基于源文档的语义水印技术，用于检测生成的评论内容是否受到已知受保护手稿副本的影响。SemTrace不会修改词元概率或施加表层形式模式，而是直接基于手稿支持的事实命题，构建文档专属的二进制签名。受保护的PDF会隐形携带内容契约，该契约从每一个二元事实对中选择一个事实，要求遵循指令的评论者在固定的评论槽位中表达这些事实，同时不改变其独立评估逻辑。随后使用冻结的自然语言推理模型，结合显式擦除操作解码得到的语义证据，将恢复得到的比特与分配给该副本的码字做比对打分。该设计实现了与模型无关的指定副本接触检测，同时保证水印在语义层面始终与源文档绑定。

title: Which one is banana man? Evaluating vision-language models in multi-turn pragmatic interpretation
title_zh: 谁是“香蕉人”？多轮语用理解场景下的视觉语言模型评估
authors: Alvin Wei Ming Tan, Ben Prystawski, Veronica Boyce
abstract: Flexible adaptation to context and shared pragmatic intuitions contribute to smooth human conversation. Iterated reference games---in which players repeatedly pick out novel referents using language---present a test case for agents' ability to perform context-sensitive pragmatic reasoning in multi-turn linguistic environments. We tested humans and vision--language models on their ability to identify the intended meaning of descriptions produced in iterated reference games, varying the provided context in terms of amount, order, and relevance. While humans performed well consistently, the models we evaluated could make use of prior context to interpret humans' referring expressions, but they struggled to build up the relevant context to interpret those expressions effectively. Our results suggest that the models we evaluated lack core skills needed for efficient linguistic collaboration.
summary_zh: 对上下文的灵活适配与共通的语用直觉是人类对话流畅开展的基础。迭代参考游戏要求玩家反复通过语言挑选出新的指代对象，为智能体在多轮语言环境中完成上下文敏感型语用推理的能力提供了测试场景。本研究在迭代参考游戏生成的描述语境下，对人类受试者与视觉语言模型识别描述指向含义的能力开展测试，测试过程中从上下文的信息量、呈现顺序、相关性三个维度调整给定语境。实验结果显示人类受试者始终表现优异，而受评估的模型虽然能够利用已有上下文解读人类的指代表达，却难以自主构建有效解读这些表达所需的相关上下文。研究结果表明，受评估的模型缺乏高效语言协作所需的核心技能。

title: OASIS: Optimizing Attacker Sequences for Hard-Label Black-Box Text Attacks
title_zh: OASIS（硬标签黑盒文本攻击攻击者序列优化框架）：面向硬标签黑盒文本攻击的攻击者序列优化
authors: Qian Chen, Shiliang Xiao, Yuzhi Liang
abstract: Different attack methods follow different search trajectories, they succeed on different subsets of samples, whereas existing hard-label black-box text attacks mainly focus on improving individual attackers or manually combining them. We present {\OURS}, a method for optimizing attacker sequences in hard-label black-box text attacks. {\OURS} first performs a one-time bi-objective attack chain search over candidate sequences to balance attack success rate and perturbation, and then reuses the selected fixed global chain during attack chain execution. Experiments across multiple datasets, victim models, and large language models show that {\OURS} consistently outperforms strong standalone baselines and simple manually constructed chains. These results suggest that attacker composition is not merely an implementation choice, but a practical optimization target for improving hard-label black-box text attacks.
summary_zh: 不同攻击方法遵循不同的搜索轨迹，在不同子集的样本上攻击成功，而现有硬标签黑盒文本攻击研究主要聚焦于优化单个攻击者，或是手动组合不同攻击者。本文提出OASIS方法，用于优化硬标签黑盒文本攻击中的攻击者序列：该方法首先对候选序列执行一次双目标攻击链搜索，平衡攻击成功率与扰动程度，随后在攻击链执行阶段复用筛选得到的固定全局链。在多类数据集、受害模型与大语言模型上开展的实验表明，OASIS的表现始终优于性能优异的独立基线方法与简单手动构建的攻击链。研究结果表明，攻击者组合并非只是实现层面的选择，而是提升硬标签黑盒文本攻击性能的实用优化目标。

title: Ontology-Guided Multi-Agent Extraction of Evaluation Objects from Academic Review Texts: Evidence from Chinese Library and Information Science
title_zh: 本体引导下的学术评论文本评价对象多智能体抽取：来自中国图书馆与情报学领域的实证证据
authors: Haolin Chen, Hongyi Dong, Yu Zhu, Yijia Hong, Leiqing Niu 等 (6 人)
abstract: Academic reviews, scholarly commentaries, and book reviews serve as sources of evaluative statements about theories, methods, literature, institutions, and policies, providing valuable evidence for scholarly evaluation. Existing scientific entity extraction methods mainly target research articles and are less effective for evaluation objects, which are often abstract, context-dependent, and characterized by ambiguous type boundaries. This study proposes an ontology-guided multi-agent framework for evaluation object extraction. The framework combines candidate discovery, ontology-constrained classification, and domain review. Experimental results show that it achieves a Precision of 90.33%, Recall of 84.55%, Entity-level F1 of 87.34%, Strict Typed F1 of 79.78%, and Type Accuracy of 91.35%, substantially outperforming rule-based and zero-shot baselines. Ablation results indicate that the multi-agent workflow improves recall and stability, while ontology-based boundary constraints enhance fine-grained classification and reduce category confusion. The framework supports the structured utilization of evaluative scholarly texts and provides methodological support for evidence-based research evaluation and STI mining.
summary_zh: 学术评论、学术评述与书评是针对理论、方法、文献、机构、政策的评价性陈述的重要来源，为学术评价提供了高价值证据。现有科学实体抽取方法主要面向科研论文设计，对评价对象的抽取效果较差——这类评价对象通常具有抽象性、上下文依赖性强、类型边界模糊的特征。本研究提出本体引导的多智能体评价对象抽取框架，该框架融合了候选实体发现、本体约束分类与领域评审三个模块。实验结果显示，该框架的精确率达90.33%、召回率达84.55%、实体级F1值达87.34%、严格类型匹配F1值达79.78%、类型准确率达91.35%，性能大幅超越基于规则的基线方法与零样本基线方法。消融实验结果表明，多智能体工作流提升了召回率与稳定性，基于本体的边界约束则提升了细粒度分类效果，减少了类别混淆。该框架支持评价类学术文本的结构化利用，为循证科研评价与科学技术信息（STI）挖掘提供了方法支撑。

title: LLM Judges as Raters: A Pre-Registered Audit of Severity, Halo, Reliability, and Version Instability in LLM Essay Scoring on Public Corpora
title_zh: 作为评分者的大语言模型评审员：公开语料库大语言模型作文评分中严苛度、晕轮效应、信度与版本不稳定性的预注册审计研究
authors: Veerendra Kumar Sunkavalli
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as essay graders in learning analytics, evaluated almost exclusively with agreement statistics. Educational measurement warns that raters also differ in severity, show halo, and drift as instruments. We treat LLM judges as raters and run a pre-registered rater-effects battery (many-facet Rasch severity, residual halo, generalizability/decision studies, cross-version shifts, differential functioning) on public corpora in two languages (ENEM/Essay-BR; ASAP): 2,377 essays, 12 judges, 4 providers, 5 version contrasts, replicated cells, released as a score tensor. Judge severity spans 219 points on ENEM's 0-1000 scale; on ASAP the panel spread is 15-33% of the score range against a between-trained-human gap near 1%. Judge-human correlations sit in an undiscriminating .47-.56 band. All five version contrasts shift severity beyond a family-wise permutation null (up to 133 points), and one judge was deprecated mid-study, caught by identity canaries. Two pre-registered tests returned honest nulls: severity-adjusted leaderboard reversals did not survive a permutation null, and "silent drift" was refuted: agreement moved with severity in four of five contrasts. Replication yields self-consistency (phi>=.80 at k<=2) but not human-level accuracy, and a same-instrument check overturned our own halo comparison: matched on instrument and calibration, we find no credible evidence that judge halo exceeds the trained-human range.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用作学习分析场景下的作文评分工具，现有评估几乎完全以一致性统计指标为依据。而教育测量领域的研究指出，评分者作为测量工具还存在严苛度差异、晕轮效应、评分漂移等问题。本研究将大语言模型评审员视为评分者，在两类语言的公开语料库（巴西ENEM作文数据集、ASAP作文数据集）上开展预注册的评分者效应综合测试，覆盖多面拉希（Many-Facet Rasch）严苛度分析、残差晕轮效应分析、概化/决策研究、跨版本偏移分析、功能差异分析，测试共涉及2377篇作文、12个评审模型、4个服务商、5组版本对照，所有评分结果以张量形式公开。实验结果显示，在ENEM的0-1000分评分区间内，不同评审模型的严苛度差异可达219分；在ASAP数据集上，评审组的严苛度跨度达到评分区间的15%-33%，而受过训练的人类评分者之间的差异仅为1%左右。大语言模型评分与人类评分的相关系数仅处于0.47-0.56的低区分度区间。全部5组版本对照的严苛度偏移均超出了基于族级置换零假设的阈值，最大偏移量达133分，其中1个评审模型在研究过程中被下线，通过身份校验探针被成功识别。两项预注册测试得到了符合预期的零结果：经严苛度调整后的排行榜反转现象无法通过置换零假设检验，“静默漂移”假设也被证伪——5组对照中有4组的评分一致性随严苛度同步变化。重复实验得到了较高的自一致性（当重复次数k≤2时，φ≥0.80），但未达到人类级别的准确率；同工具对照实验推翻了原有的晕轮效应对比结论：在控制工具与校准条件的情况下，没有可信证据表明大语言模型评审员的晕轮效应超出受过训练的人类评分者的范围。

title: CoCoA: Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment for Large Language Models
title_zh: CoCoA（上下文条件化文化对齐框架）：面向大语言模型的上下文条件化文化对齐方法
authors: Kyungdon Lee, Wei Xu, Alan Ritter, Dong-Ho Lee, JinYeong Bak
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often favor Western-associated entities across cultural contexts. Conventional debiasing methods aim for uniform neutrality, but cultural bias mitigation demands context-conditional behavior, preferring culturally appropriate entities when cultural cues are present and remaining neutral when they are absent. We propose CoCoA (Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment), a framework that learns this behavior through dual-context training on the same entity pairs under contexts with and without cultural cues. CoCoA combines a contrastive alignment objective with calibration and drift regularization, optimized through goal-aware gradient reconciliation. We evaluate CoCoA on CAMeL and Camellia, two entity-centric cultural bias benchmarks, across ten language settings and four LLMs. CoCoA reduces the Cultural Bias Score from 43 to 24 on average while maintaining near-neutral preferences at 50.2, with minimal impact on general performance across five standard benchmarks. These findings highlight that effective cultural alignment requires context-conditional modeling rather than uniform debiasing, and establish a new direction for mitigating entity-centric cultural bias in LLMs.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在各类文化语境下通常会偏向与西方相关的实体。传统去偏方法追求统一中立性，但文化偏差缓解需要实现上下文条件化行为：当存在文化线索时优先选择符合文化适配要求的实体，当不存在文化线索时保持中立。本文提出CoCoA（Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment，上下文条件化文化对齐）框架，通过对同一实体对在有无文化线索的两类上下文下开展双上下文训练，习得上述行为模式。CoCoA融合了对比对齐目标、校准模块与漂移正则化，通过目标感知梯度调和完成优化。本研究在两个以实体为核心的文化偏差基准CAMeL与Camellia上，覆盖10种语言设置与4类大语言模型开展评估。实验结果显示，CoCoA可将文化偏差得分从平均43降至24，无文化线索场景下的偏好接近中立值50.2，同时在5个标准基准测试上的通用性能几乎不受影响。研究结果表明，有效的文化对齐需要上下文条件化建模而非统一去偏，为缓解大语言模型中以实体为核心的文化偏差开辟了新方向。

title: SIC-Agents: Benchmarking and Building an Adaptive Simulator for Pediatric Serious Illness Communication Training
title_zh: SIC-Agents（儿科重症沟通训练自适应智能体）：面向儿科重症沟通训练的基准测试与自适应模拟器构建
authors: Zihan Wang, Anita Marie Slominska, Rennie Bimman, Elizabeth Di Flumeri, Amanda Mayappo-Neeposh 等 (13 人)
abstract: Pediatric serious illness communication (SIC) is critically important, yet scalable communication training for clinicians remains limited. Compared with other dialogue simulation settings, pediatric SIC poses additional challenges, including multi-party interactions, response to parental distress and strong dependence on feedback dynamics. Existing LLM-based simulators optimize generic dialogue quality rather than curriculum-contingent behavior required for effective SIC training. In collaboration with educators and pediatric clinicians, we introduce the first benchmark suite and simulation framework tailored to pediatric SIC training. Our benchmarks, PitfallBench and DialogueBench, evaluate simulators both at the turn-level and across full dialogues. We further propose SIC-Agents, a self-improving framework that generates a clinician-editable skill document to guide simulator behavior. Our experiments show that SIC-Agents outperforms static expert prompting. To support future research, we release our benchmarks for parent simulation in pediatric SIC atthis https URL
summary_zh: 儿科重症沟通（SIC）对临床诊疗至关重要，但面向临床医师的可规模化沟通训练资源仍然十分有限。与其他对话模拟场景相比，儿科重症沟通存在更多额外挑战，包括多方交互、对家长情绪崩溃的响应、对反馈动态的强依赖性。现有基于大语言模型的模拟器仅优化通用对话质量，无法满足有效重症沟通训练所需的课程适配行为要求。本研究与教育工作者和儿科临床医师合作，推出了首个专为儿科重症沟通训练设计的基准套件与模拟框架。研究提出的基准集PitfallBench与DialogueBench可分别在对话轮次层面与完整对话层面评估模拟器性能。本研究进一步提出SIC-Agents自优化框架，可生成支持临床医师编辑的技能文档，用于引导模拟器的行为。实验结果表明，SIC-Agents的性能优于静态专家提示方法。为支持后续相关研究，本研究公开了面向儿科重症沟通中家长角色模拟的全部基准数据集。

title: Vocabulary Growth Fundamentals: Bernstein Functions and Hausdorff Sequences
title_zh: 词汇增长基础：伯恩斯坦函数与豪斯多夫序列
authors: Łukasz Dębowski
abstract: We survey the theory of vocabulary growth founded in the setting of stochastic processes. In particular, we model the expected number of types through Bernstein functions and Hausdorff sequences. These classes of mathematical objects, defined by alternating signs of their derivatives or differences, can be related to continuous-time Poisson point processes and discrete-time IID processes, respectively. Building on previous accounts of the vocabulary growth, we integrate the broader theories of Bernstein functions and Hausdorff sequences and connect them with recently developed hapax rate models. In particular, we prove that the logistic hapax rate model has a non-negative spectrum and hence it defines a Bernstein function, thereby solving an earlier posed problem. We also analyze the limitations of the Bernstein--Hausdorff theory of the vocabulary growth by considering its generalizations under stationary and Weibull renewal processes.
summary_zh: 本文综述了基于随机过程场景构建的词汇增长理论，特别通过伯恩斯坦函数与豪斯多夫序列对词汇类型的期望数量进行建模。这类由导数或差分交替符号定义的数学对象，可分别与连续时间泊松点过程、离散时间独立同分布过程建立关联。本研究在现有词汇增长相关研究的基础上，整合了更广泛的伯恩斯坦函数与豪斯多夫序列理论，并将其与近年提出的罕用率模型建立关联。特别地，本文证明了逻辑罕用率模型具有非负谱，因此可定义为一个伯恩斯坦函数，解决了此前提出的一个公开问题。本研究还通过分析平稳更新过程与威布尔更新过程下的推广形式，讨论了伯恩斯坦-豪斯多夫词汇增长理论的局限性。

title: Whose Assessment of Distress? Community Perspectives and LLM Alignment on Well-Being Posts
title_zh: 谁在评估心理痛苦？心理健康帖子的社区视角与大语言模型对齐研究
authors: Andrew Aquilina, Xiang Lorraine Li, Yu-Ru Li
abstract: Judgments about psychological distress are socially situated: what counts as concerning hinges on community norms around emotional expression, vulnerability, and help-seeking. Yet large language models (LLMs) used for distress detection are typically aligned to a single, undifferentiated standard. How well do these models capture the perspectives of the communities whose language they assess? We address this question through a perspectivist annotation study in which 321 participants provided 9,587 judgments on 1,198 Reddit posts spanning six identity-based communities, yielding community-specific labels. Raters in the contextualized in-group condition show a modest tendency to agree more with their community than uncontextualized out-group raters (OR = 1.18), an effect varying significantly across communities. We then evaluate nine open-weight LLM configurations and four frontier configurations against these labels. Open-weight LLMs systematically over-estimate distress: when communities perceive none-to-mild distress, these models achieve only 31-44% accuracy, predominantly producing false positives. GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro show the same none-to-mild inflation even when their full-sample over/under rates are mixed, while Claude Opus 4 is more conservative. This pattern does not simply mirror an outsider reading position: uncontextualized out-group human aggregates were nearly symmetric, with 18% over-estimation versus 19% under-estimation. Instead, the models that inflate none-to-mild cases exhibit a distress prior that exceeds both contextualized in-group and uncontextualized out-group human judgments. These findings have implications for equitable AI deployment in mental health contexts, where miscalibrated distress detection may unevenly affect the communities being assessed.
summary_zh: 心理痛苦的判断具有社会情境属性：何种情况属于需要关注的范畴，取决于社区关于情绪表达、脆弱性表露与求助行为的规范。但当前用于心理痛苦检测的大语言模型（LLM）通常仅对齐单一无差别的评判标准。这类模型在多大程度上能够捕捉到其评估对象所属社区的视角？本研究通过视角主义标注实验回答这一问题：321名参与者对来自6个身份类社区的1198条Reddit帖子共给出9587条判断，生成了社区专属标注集。处于情境化组内条件下的标注者，相比无情境的组外标注者，与所属社区判断达成一致的倾向性更高（比值比OR=1.18），该效应在不同社区间存在显著差异。随后本研究使用上述标注集对9种开源大语言模型配置与4种前沿大语言模型配置开展评估。开源大语言模型普遍存在高估心理痛苦的问题：当社区判定帖子无痛苦或仅存在轻度痛苦时，这类模型的准确率仅为31%-44%，绝大多数错误为假阳性。GPT-5与Gemini 2.5 Pro即使在全样本层面的高估/低估率处于混合水平，也同样存在无/轻度痛苦场景下的评分膨胀问题，而Claude Opus 4的判断则更为保守。该模式并不能简单对应外部观察者的解读偏差：无情境的组外人类标注者的判断几乎对称，高估率为18%，低估率为19%。相反，出现无/轻度痛苦场景评分膨胀的模型，其内置的痛苦先验概率同时超出了情境化组内人类判断与无情境组外人类判断的范围。上述研究结果对心理健康场景下的公平AI部署具有参考价值，校准错误的痛苦检测可能对被评估的不同社区产生差异化的负面影响。

title: Evaluating the Semantic Specificity of Representation Steering in Language Models
title_zh: 语言模型中表示引导的语义特异性评估
authors: Zhangdie Yuan, Andreas Vlachos
abstract: Localized Representation Steering (LRS) is widely used to correct reasoning pathologies in large language models. However, standard benchmark evaluations can easily be fooled by superficial label overrides, creating a false impression of reasoning circuit repairs. In this work, we propose Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT), a diagnostic framework that audits representational interventions by evaluating them on rule families where the model is natively competent. Evaluating late-layer LRS for a widespread logical failure, contradiction blindness, reveals that the intervention merely injects a global label bias: applying the steering vector to rules the model already handles correctly (99.6% baseline) degrades performance to 40.4% by forcing false contradiction predictions. We support this diagnosis with four complementary controls (direct logit bias equivalence, control vector label-flipping, cross-model grafting, and early-layer steering checks), providing a rigorous methodology to distinguish genuine reasoning repairs from superficial label overrides.
summary_zh: 局部化表示引导（LRS）被广泛用于修正大语言模型的推理缺陷。但现有标准基准评估很容易被表层标签覆盖操作误导，产生推理电路已被修复的错误认知。本文提出Cross-Rule Transfer（CRT，跨规则迁移）诊断框架，通过在模型原生具备处理能力的规则族上开展评估，对表示干预操作进行审计。针对广泛存在的逻辑缺陷“矛盾盲”开展的底层LRS评估显示，这类干预仅注入了全局标签偏差：将引导向量应用于模型原本可正确处理的规则（基线准确率99.6%）时，会强制生成错误的矛盾预测，将性能降至40.4%。本研究通过4项互补对照实验（直接对数it偏差等价性、控制向量标签翻转、跨模型移植、底层引导检查）验证了该诊断结论，提供了可区分真实推理修复与表层标签覆盖操作的严谨方法论。

title: AlgoWorlds: Benchmarking Tool Use for Global Optimization in Algorithmic Worlds
title_zh: AlgoWorlds（算法世界全局优化工具使用基准）：算法世界场景下面向全局优化的工具使用基准测试
authors: Zixiang Xu, Jiaan Wang, Fandong Meng
abstract: Tool-use benchmarks generally evaluate whether an agent completes a workflow using appropriate tools and valid arguments. However, feasibility alone is insufficient in real-world decision settings such as route planning and fleet dispatch. Individual choices interact through shared constraints and costs, so a feasible solution may still be substantially suboptimal. This raises a harder question: can an agent turn information gathered through tools into a globally optimal decision? We introduce AlgoWorlds, a benchmark that transforms formally specified combinatorial optimization problems into partially observed decision environments with verifiable global optima. Each environment contains a hidden instance observed only through task-specific information tools, after which the agent commits to one structured decision evaluated for feasibility and optimality. AlgoWorlds contains 240 environments covering ten combinatorial optimization families and four workload levels. Family-specific deterministic programs generate the instances, exact algorithms certify their optima and determine workload levels, and two structurally different tool interfaces present each underlying instance. We evaluate seven leading LLMs, including Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.6 Sol. Achieving global optimality remains highly challenging: although leading models produce feasible decisions in most cases, the best-performing model reaches exact optimality in only 38.61% of cases. Even when agents collect sufficient information to reconstruct the hidden instance, most failures end in feasible but suboptimal decisions. The challenge therefore extends beyond information acquisition to information integration, global constraint reasoning, and decision verification. The project homepage is available atthis https URL, and the code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 现有工具使用基准通常仅评估智能体是否能使用合适的工具与合法参数完成工作流。但在路径规划、车队调度等真实决策场景中，仅满足可行性要求是远远不够的：个体选择会通过共享约束与成本产生交互，可行解仍可能远非全局最优解。这引出了一个更具挑战性的问题：智能体能否将通过工具收集到的信息转化为全局最优决策？本文提出AlgoWorlds基准，将形式化定义的组合优化问题转化为具备可验证全局最优解的部分可观测决策环境。每个环境包含一个仅能通过任务专属信息工具观测的隐藏实例，智能体完成信息收集后需要输出一个结构化决策，系统会同时评估该决策的可行性与最优性。AlgoWorlds共包含240个环境，覆盖10类组合优化问题与4个难度等级。由问题族专属的确定性程序生成实例，精确算法验证实例的最优解并确定难度等级，两类结构不同的工具接口向智能体呈现底层实例信息。本研究对7款主流大语言模型开展评估，包括Claude Opus 4.8与GPT-5.6 Sol。实验结果表明，实现全局最优的难度极高：尽管主流模型在绝大多数场景下都能生成可行决策，但表现最优的模型的精确最优解占比仅为38.61%。即使智能体收集到了足够重构隐藏实例的信息，绝大多数失败案例的结果都是可行但非最优的决策。因此该挑战的核心不止于信息获取，更涉及信息整合、全局约束推理与决策验证。本研究公开了项目主页与全部代码。

title: When to Adapt: Conditional Memory Adapters for Retention-Preserving Domain Specialization
title_zh: 何时适配：面向保留通用能力的领域专业化的条件记忆适配器
authors: Jiayu Hou, Lei Wang
abstract: Large language models deployed in specialized domains must improve in-domain performance without sacrificing general capabilities. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods are typically always on: their learned perturbations are applied to every input, which can degrade out-of-domain (OOD) performance.
