We propose Engram Adapter, a framework that repurposes pretraining-time conditional memory as a post-hoc adapter for frozen LLMs. It uses multi-channel matching over local n-gram patterns with explicit occupancy tracking as a lightweight selectivity prior, making residual injection more likely on in-domain inputs while a learned scalar gate suppresses incoherent OOD retrievals. We evaluate on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with AG-News and MedMCQA as adaptation tasks and OOD benchmarks spanning reasoning, translation, code generation, and legal reasoning. Engram Adapter improves in-domain accuracy while preserving 99.4%--100.1% of average OOD performance; on LegalBench it slightly exceeds the frozen base model on average, whereas comparable always-on baselines degrade sharply. Mechanistic analyses show that although OOD activations are non-zero, gate and projection attenuation reduce residuals to approximately 0.08% of hidden-state norm, yielding small KL drift and negligible accuracy change. These results suggest conditional activation is a promising route toward modular, retention-preserving domain specialization over frozen backbones.
summary_zh: 部署在专业领域的大语言模型需要在不损失通用能力的前提下提升领域内性能。现有参数高效微调方法通常处于持续激活状态：其学习到的扰动会被应用到每一个输入上，这会降低分布外（Out-of-Domain, OOD）性能。本文提出Engram适配器（Engram Adapter，记忆印迹适配器）框架，该框架将预训练阶段的条件记忆重新利用，作为针对冻结大语言模型的事后适配器。它通过对局部n元语法模式进行多通道匹配，并结合显式占用追踪作为轻量级选择性先验，使得残差注入更大概率发生在领域内输入上，同时通过学习得到的标量门控抑制不连贯的分布外检索。我们在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型上，以AG-News和MedMCQA作为适配任务，覆盖推理、翻译、代码生成、法律推理的分布外基准开展评估。Engram适配器在提升领域内准确率的同时，保留了99.4%~100.1%的平均分布外性能；在LegalBench基准上，其平均性能甚至略高于冻结的基础模型，而同类持续激活的基线方法性能则出现大幅下降。机制分析表明，尽管分布外激活值不为零，但门控和投影衰减将残差降低至隐藏态范数的约0.08%，产生的KL散度漂移极小，准确率变化可忽略不计。上述结果表明，条件激活是在冻结骨干网络上实现模块化、保留通用能力的领域专业化的极具前景的路径。

title: Padārtha: Ontology-Grounded Fine-Grained NER Benchmark for Classical Sanskrit
title_zh: Padārtha：面向古典梵语的基于本体的细粒度命名实体识别基准
authors: Sujoy Sarkar, Pretam Ray, Paramhans Shah, Manoj Balaji Jagadeeshan, Akash Gairola 等 (7 人)
abstract: Annotation schemas are not neutral. When applied to classical literature, tag sets developed for modern journalistic texts impose source-culture definitions on texts they were never designed to describe. We instead ground a schema in the tradition of the text itself introducing \textit{Padārtha}, the first ontology-grounded fine-grained Named Entity Recognition (NER) benchmark for Sanskrit, built on the \textit{Mahābhārata} epic. Our tag set derives from \textit{Nyāya-Vaiśesika}, a classical Indian ontological system, yielding 18 fine-grained categories organized under 10 ontological nodes and mapped onto five standard coarse tags, ensuring interoperability with existing benchmarks. Expert annotators label over 12.6K entries from a scholarly index of named entities, linked to corresponding mentions in the \textit{Mahānāma} corpus, producing fine-grained annotations for 108,335 entity mentions across 73,632 verses, along with a 5,000-verse expert-verified test set sampled to stress rare mentions. We present the first systematic benchmarking of generative NER against traditional architectures for Sanskrit, finding that fine-tuned generative models perform comparably to task-specific systems. However, all systems show a sharp decline from coarse to fine granularity and struggle with out-of-entity mentions unseen during training. The limitation is not due to data scarcity alone, as fine-tuned models recall unseen entities far worse than seen ones and tend to default to the majority sense under lexical ambiguity.
summary_zh: 标注模式并非价值中立。当为现代新闻文本开发的标签集被应用于古典文献时，会将源文化定义强加给其从未被设计用于描述的文本。本文将标注模式锚定在文本自身所属的传统体系中，提出Padārtha——首个基于本体的梵语细粒度命名实体识别（Named Entity Recognition, NER）基准，该基准基于史诗《摩诃婆罗多》构建。我们的标签集源自古印度本体论体系“正理-胜论（Nyāya-Vaiśesika）”，共包含18个细粒度类别，归属于10个本体节点下，并可映射到5个标准粗粒度标签，确保与现有基准的互操作性。专业标注人员对来自学术命名实体索引的1.26万余条条目进行标注，将其关联到《大名词（Mahānāma）》语料库中的对应提及位置，最终得到覆盖73632句诗句的108335个实体提及的细粒度标注，同时构建了一个包含5000句诗句的经过专家验证的测试集，该测试集经过采样可对稀有实体提及形成压力测试。本文首次针对梵语场景对生成式NER与传统架构开展系统性基准测试，发现经过微调的生成式模型性能与任务专属系统相当。但所有系统的性能从粗粒度到细粒度场景均出现大幅下降，且难以处理训练过程中从未见过的实体外提及。该限制并非仅由数据稀缺导致：经过微调的模型对未见过实体的召回率远低于见过的实体，且在词汇歧义场景下倾向于默认选择占比最高的语义。

title: All You Need Is Non-Commutative Words
title_zh: 你所需的全部即非交换词语
authors: Carla M. Quispe Flores, Stanley Salvatierra, Renan Cabrera
abstract: We represent lexical tokens as unitary matrices and encode each sentence as their ordered product. The noncommutativity of matrix product captures word order without positional encodings (PEs). The same algebra yields several capabilities, including antisymmetric self-attention with no query, key, or value projections, and parallel composition of variable-length text chunks at a reduced attention cost. Furthermore, it provides a canonical-coset readout layer that encodes all true unitary degrees of freedom compactly, while supporting continual learning through nested group extensions that enlarge the operator space with each new task preserving prior representations exactly. Across standard text-classification benchmarks, the method matches or exceeds bag-of-words baselines. Achieving higher accuracy on IMDB and comparable performance on AG News. Notably, this is accomplished by replacing the conventional $\sim$30,000-dimensional vocabulary space with a dense, 64-parameter real-valued encoding, highlighting the expressive efficiency of our parameterization.
summary_zh: 本文将词汇token表示为幺正矩阵，并将每个句子编码为这些矩阵的有序乘积。矩阵乘积的非交换性可以在不使用位置编码（Positional Encodings, PEs）的前提下捕捉词序信息。该代数框架可实现多种能力，包括无需查询、键、值投影的反对称自注意力，以及以更低注意力成本实现可变长度文本块的并行组合。此外，该框架还提供了标准陪集读出层，可紧凑编码所有真实幺正自由度，同时支持通过嵌套群扩展实现持续学习：每次新任务都会扩大算子空间，且完全保留之前的表示。在标准文本分类基准上，该方法性能匹配或超过词袋基线，在IMDB数据集上取得更高准确率，在AG News数据集上性能相当。值得注意的是，该效果是通过将传统约3万维的词汇空间替换为仅含64个参数的稠密实值编码实现的，充分证明了本文提出的参数化方法的表达效率优势。

title: Cloud and On-Premises Deployment of Uzbek Legal RAG via Targeted Retriever Fine-Tuning
title_zh: 面向乌兹别克法律检索增强生成（RAG）的云与本地部署：目标检索器微调方案
authors: Tatul Danielyan, Mariam Avetisyan, Hrant Davtyan
abstract: Deploying large language models for legal question answering raises challenges that general-purpose leaderboards do not capture, particularly for low-resource languages and under hard operational constraints. We report on building and operating a retrieval-augmented (RAG) legal assistant for Uzbek that must run in two regimes: a managed cloud service that maximizes answer quality within a per-token cost ceiling, and an on-premises deployment for clients whose legal data may not leave their infrastructure, restricting us to open-weight models on limited local hardware under latency constraints. Because no evaluation existed for this setting, we build two domain benchmarks: a retrieval benchmark of 178 expert-annotated legal queries with gold provision spans, and an end-to-end benchmark of 504 expert-curated question--answer pairs scored by an LLM judge whose ratings we validate against human judgments and against an independent-family judge. Applying these benchmarks under each regime, we find the open-versus-proprietary gap is small and cheaply closed by fine-tuning. Therefore, we train UTE-1, which is a state-of-the-art text embedder among open models for Uzbek. We also demonstrate that closing the performance gap via fine-tuning is both impractical due to the intensive hardware demands of long-context legal Q\&A and unnecessary, given that legal acts change frequently. We support this by reporting a negative result from a QLoRA experiment. We distill practical guidance for similar deployments, drawn from a system serving real users in production. We release our benchmarks, evaluation code and the fine-tuned embedder (UTE-1) \href{this https URL}{at this https URL} to support future work on low-resource legal NLP.
summary_zh: 面向法律问答的大语言模型部署面临通用排行榜无法覆盖的诸多挑战，对于低资源语言和处于严格运行约束下的场景而言更是如此。本文介绍了我们构建并运行的乌兹别克语检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）法律助手，该系统需要支持两种运行模式：托管云服务模式，在单token成本上限内最大化回答质量；本地部署模式，面向法律数据不可流出自有基础设施的客户，在有限本地硬件和延迟约束下仅使用开源权重模型。由于此前不存在适配该场景的评估体系，我们构建了两个领域基准：一个检索基准包含178条专家标注的法律查询及对应的标准答案片段，一个端到端基准包含504条专家整理的问答对，由大模型裁判打分，我们通过人工评判和独立家族裁判验证了该打分的有效性。在两种部署模式下应用上述基准开展测试后，我们发现开源模型与闭源模型的性能差距很小，且仅需通过微调即可低成本消除。因此我们训练得到UTE-1，这是目前开源乌兹别克语文本嵌入器中的当前最优模型。我们同时证明，通过微调消除性能差距既不现实（长上下文法律问答对硬件资源需求极高）也无必要（法律条文更新频繁），我们通过QLoRA（量化低秩适配）实验的负结果验证了该结论。本文基于已服务真实生产用户的系统，提炼出适用于同类部署场景的实践指导。我们公开了所有基准、评估代码以及微调后的嵌入器UTE-1，以支持未来低资源法律自然语言处理相关研究。

title: Modality Fault Lines: Structural Corruptions Reveal Fragile Omni-Modal Reasoning
title_zh: 大语言模型系统性偏好热门选项：多项选择题场景下的证据与缓解方案
authors: Zhaolu Kang, Meixin Wu, Yu Xue, Yingjie He, Qiming Shi 等 (9 人)
abstract: Omni-modal large language models are increasingly evaluated on clean text--vision--audio inputs, where every channel is present, synchronized, and readily interpretable. Such scores are often taken as evidence of robust cross-modal fusion, but clean evaluation cannot tell whether success depends on stable cross-modal structure or on cues sufficient only in intact inputs. To address this gap, we define a modality fault line: a boundary at which model behavior becomes unstable when a modality remains present and human-interpretable, but its internal evidence structure is perturbed. We introduce SCEval (Structure-Corruption Evaluation) a diagnostic evaluation protocol that keeps the question, answer space, and modality channels fixed while applying controlled structural corruptions to text, vision, and audio individually and jointly. Built from $273$ human-verified tri-modal examples from Social-IQ, OmniBench, and VALOR, SCEval evaluates $15$ proprietary and open-source omni-modal systems. The results show that structural corruption lowers clean accuracy, text--vision damage forms the most stable shared fault line, and multi-modal degradation is non-additive rather than a simple function of the number of corrupted modalities. Clean omni-modal accuracy therefore does not establish that a model will remain reliable when cross-modal evidence becomes structurally unreliable.
summary_zh: 多项选择题（Multiple-Choice Questions, MCQs）是评估大语言模型的标准格式，但选项的热门程度会干扰评估结果。现代大语言模型会系统性地偏好热门但错误的选项，而非冷门但正确的选项，我们将该漏洞称为**流行度偏差**。该模式与置信度校准失配现象吻合：即使模型在热门选项上的准确率大幅下降，其置信度仍然维持在较高水平。为系统性分离该现象，我们提出**PopMCQ**基准，该基准采用6种受控策略，在保持正确答案固定的前提下调整选项的热门程度。在最具对抗性的设置下，所有干扰项的热门程度均高于正确选项，模型选择热门错误答案的比例高达66%。为缓解该偏差，我们提出**PopDebias**，一种轻量级推理时校正方法，可从模型预测结果中估计并移除流行度先验。该方法无需微调，测试阶段无需标签（仅使用少量校准集完成参数拟合），额外计算成本可忽略不计。在22个开源大语言模型（参数量从0.5B到32B）上开展的实验显示，该方法可带来一致的性能提升，在强流行度干扰场景下准确率提升最高可达54.1个百分点。相关代码和数据已公开。

title: Large Language Models Systematically Favor Popular Options: Evidence and Mitigation Across MCQs
authors: Abdelrahman Abdallah, Mohammed Ali, Bhawna Piryani, Mahmoud Abdalla, Adam Jatowt
abstract: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs) are a standard format for evaluating large language models (LLMs), yet the popularity of answer options can confound evaluation. Modern LLMs systematically prefer popular but incorrect options over less popular correct ones, a vulnerability we call \textbf{popularity bias}. This pattern aligns with confidence miscalibration: model confidence remains high even as accuracy collapses for popular options. To systematically isolate this phenomenon, we introduce \textbf{PopMCQ}, a benchmark with six controlled strategies that vary option popularity while keeping the correct answer fixed. In our most adversarial setting, where all distractors are more popular than the correct option, models choose popular but wrong answers 66\% of the time. To mitigate this bias, we propose \textbf{PopDebias}, a lightweight inference-time correction that estimates and removes a popularity prior from model predictions. It requires no fine-tuning, is label-free at test time (using only a small calibration split for parameter fitting), and adds negligible computational cost. Experiments on 22 open-source LLMs (0.5B to 32B parameters) show consistent improvements, with accuracy gains up to 54.1 percentage points under strong popularity pressure. The code and data are availablethis https URL

title: When Patients Cut In: Extending Clinical Conversational AI Safety to Interruptions
title_zh: 当患者打断对话：将临床对话AI安全能力扩展至打断场景
authors: Zachary Ellis, Spencer Hazel, Adam Brandt, Yajie Vera He, Ernest Lim 等 (6 人)
abstract: Clinical voice agents are now deployed in routine care, where real patients do not wait their turn: they interrupt. These systems typically use a cascaded architecture (speech-to-text -> LLM -> text-to-speech), so when a patient cuts the agent off mid-utterance, clinically required content can be lost even when the model handles cooperative transcripts well. Yet clinical conversational-AI benchmarks almost universally assume patients wait for the agent to finish, missing interruption-induced loss of required content. We present a transcript-based evaluation of interruption recovery, adapting conversation-analytic overlap categories into three operational types (recognitional, competitive, transitional sub-unit) and testing four deployment-oriented, non-reasoning LLM configurations across four cells spanning history-taking (information gathering) and FAQ (information provision), scored on whether the agent preserves the clinically required content. In the gathering cells, target-question failure varied across models; in the provision cells, where arms are directly comparable, failure rose for every model. Rankings differ across cells, and competitive FAQ interruption produced 30/30 provision-coverage failures for all four models (Wilson 95% CI: 88.6-100.0%; baseline 0/30 for three, 4/30 for Llama). A brief apology marker ("sorry to interrupt") shifts recovery by tens of percentage points, inconsistently across models, and for one it reduces recovery. Interruption robustness therefore cannot be a single score: evaluation must be content-grounded, reported per cell, and matched to the deployment's interruption profile.
summary_zh: 临床语音代理目前已部署在常规诊疗场景中，真实患者不会等待代理说完，而是会主动打断。这类系统通常采用级联架构（语音转文本→大语言模型→文本转语音），因此当患者在代理输出中途打断时，即使模型可以很好地处理无干扰的对话转录，临床必需的内容也可能丢失。但现有临床对话AI基准几乎全部假设患者会等待代理说完，完全忽略了打断导致的必需内容丢失问题。本文提出一种面向打断恢复的转录本评估方案，将对话分析中的重叠类别调整为三种可操作类型（识别型、竞争型、过渡子单元型），并在覆盖病史采集（信息收集）和常见问题解答（信息提供）的4个场景中测试4种面向部署的非推理大语言模型配置，评估指标为代理是否保留了所有临床必需内容。在信息收集场景中，不同模型的目标问题失败率存在差异；在信息提供场景中所有模型的性能可直接对比，所有模型的失败率均出现上升。不同场景下的模型排名存在差异，竞争型FAQ打断场景下4个模型的内容覆盖率全部出现30/30的失败（Wilson 95%置信区间：88.6%~100.0%，其中3个模型的基线失败率为0/30，Llama的基线失败率为4/30）。简短的道歉标记（“抱歉打断一下”）可将恢复性能提升数十个百分点，但该效果在不同模型间不一致，甚至会降低其中一个模型的恢复性能。因此打断鲁棒性不能用单一分数衡量：评估必须以内容为基础，按不同场景分别报告，且需要与部署场景的打断特征相匹配。

title: Anchoring Speech with Semantics: A Multimodal Adapter Mechanism for Automatic Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages
title_zh: 基于语义锚定语音：面向低资源语言自动语音识别的多模态适配器机制
authors: Kuan-Tang Huang, Cheng-Yeh Yang, Chien-Chun Wang, Hung-Shin Lee, Hsin-Min Wang 等 (6 人)
abstract: Low-resource ASR remains difficult because scarce transcripts provide limited supervised evidence for target-side generation. To address this gap, we propose SAMA-ASR, a lightweight adapter mechanism that augments the decoder with semantic anchors from auxiliary translations and an acoustic anchor from speech; in principle, the mechanism can be applied to similar encoder--decoder multitask speech models. Through cross-modal adaptation, SAMA-ASR conditions decoder states on translation-derived semantic embeddings and a speech embedding, combining utterance-level meaning with speech-grounded evidence before token prediction. At evaluation time, these semantic anchors can be generated automatically by an upstream speech-to-text translator rather than supplied as oracle translations. Experiments on two 30-hour datasets covering the low-resource Sinitic varieties Taiwanese Hokkien and Hakka show that SAMA-ASR improves over acoustic, prior prompt-based, and semantic-only translation-guided baselines and remains effective in practical automatic semantic-anchor settings; translator-capacity analyses show that useful semantic anchors can be produced by a compact ST model.
summary_zh: 低资源语言自动语音识别（Automatic Speech Recognition, ASR）任务目前仍存在较大挑战，因为稀缺的转录本只能为目标侧生成提供有限的监督信号。为解决该问题，本文提出SAMA-ASR，一种轻量级适配器机制，该机制通过来自辅助翻译的语义锚点和来自语音的声学锚点增强解码器性能，原则上该机制可应用于类似的编码器-解码器多任务语音模型。通过跨模态适配，SAMA-ASR将解码器状态条件化到翻译衍生的语义嵌入和语音嵌入上，在token预测前将话语级语义与语音层面的证据相结合。评估阶段，这些语义锚点可由上游语音转文本翻译器自动生成，无需作为真值翻译提供。在覆盖两种低资源汉语分支（台湾闽南语和客家话）的两个30小时数据集上开展的实验表明，SAMA-ASR性能优于声学基线、现有基于提示的基线以及仅使用语义的翻译引导基线，且在实际自动生成语义锚点的设置下仍然有效；翻译器容量分析表明，紧凑的语音翻译模型即可生成可用的语义锚点。

title: Attribute-Based Activation Steering of LLMs for Group-Specific Explanation Generation
title_zh: 面向群体定制化解释生成的大语言模型属性级激活引导
authors: Leandra Fichtel, Janek Prange, Henning Wachsmuth
abstract: To effectively enable people to understand new topics, explanations should be tailored to their backgrounds and abilities. So far, prompting alone has been shown to be insufficient for creating such explanations and other computational methods are missing. Therefore, this paper investigates whether LLMs can be steered to generate explanations that are tailored to a specific group of people. To this end, we propose an approach that first identifies group-specific attributes in terms of explanatory style and knowledge of a specific target group. Building on activation engineering, it then computes attribute-based steering vectors and adds them to the internal activations of an LLM during inference to enable a fine-grained steering. In our experiments, we assess the steering effectiveness of our approach in terms of specificity and factuality of the generated explanations. Additionally, we evaluate the explanations in a study with human experts from different target groups. Compared to prompting and state-of-the-art steering baselines, our approach tailors the explanations significantly better to the target group while largely maintaining factuality.
summary_zh: 为了让用户有效理解新主题，生成的解释需要适配用户的背景和能力。目前仅靠提示工程已被证明不足以生成这类定制化解释，且缺乏其他有效的计算方法。因此本文研究是否可以引导大语言模型生成适配特定人群的解释。为实现该目标，本文提出的方法首先从解释风格和特定目标群体的知识储备两个维度识别群体专属属性。基于激活工程技术，该方法进一步计算基于属性的引导向量，并在推理阶段将其添加到大语言模型的内部激活中，实现细粒度引导。在实验中，我们从生成解释的针对性和事实性两个维度评估该方法的引导效果，同时通过来自不同目标群体的人类专家开展用户研究对解释进行评估。与提示工程和当前最优的引导基线方法相比，本文提出的方法可以显著提升解释对目标群体的适配性，同时基本保持解释的事实准确性。

title: Toward Cultural Alignment: Human-Centered Evaluation of Multimodal AI Stories Across Five African Communities
title_zh: 迈向文化对齐：面向五个非洲社区的多模态AI故事的人本评估
authors: Millicent Ochieng, Felermino D. M. A. Ali, Elizabeth A. Ankrah, Najeeb Gambo Abdulhamid, Migisha Boyd 等 (11 人)
abstract: In this paper, we examine how well AI-generated multimodal stories align with the lived practices, relationships, language, values, and visual expectations of the communities they represent. We conduct a community-grounded mixed-methods evaluation with 19 culture representatives across five African communities, combining quantitative annotations with qualitative focus group discussions. We find that cultural alignment depends not simply on recognizable cultural markers, but on how those markers fit social, linguistic, procedural, and visual context. From these evaluations, we develop a taxonomy of cultural alignment comprising five broader cultural marker categories and eight recurring mechanisms of misalignment. We additionally evaluate five multimodal LLM judges to examine whether automated evaluation can approximate community-grounded judgments at scale. Judge reliability and score calibration vary substantially across communities, with no single judge performing consistently across all five settings. These findings motivate community-calibrated evaluation pipelines in which automated judges are validated against community judgments to determine where they can be trusted and where human review remains necessary.
summary_zh: 本文研究AI生成的多模态故事与所代表社区的生活实践、社会关系、语言、价值观和视觉预期的对齐程度。我们开展了基于社区的混合方法评估，来自5个非洲社区的19名文化代表参与了本次评估，结合了定量标注和定性焦点小组讨论。我们发现文化对齐并不简单取决于可识别的文化标记，而是取决于这些标记与社会、语言、流程和视觉上下文的适配程度。基于评估结果，我们构建了文化对齐分类体系，包含5个大类文化标记和8种反复出现的不对齐机制。我们进一步评估了5个多模态大语言模型裁判，研究自动化评估是否可以大规模近似基于社区的人工评判结果。不同社区下裁判的可靠性和分数校准差异极大，没有任何一个裁判可以在全部5个场景下都保持稳定性能。上述结论表明需要构建经过社区校准的评估流水线，其中自动化裁判需要通过社区人工评判的验证，明确其适用场景和仍需人工审核的场景。

title: Toward a Cross-Lingual Romanization Ecosystem for Sinitic Languages: A Paired Mandarin-Cantonese Case Study
title_zh: 面向汉语族语言的跨语言罗马化生态系统：普通话-粤语配对案例研究
authors: Zijie Zhang, Tan Lee, Yong Cao, Benyou Wang
abstract: This paper proposes the Sinitic Romanization Ecosystem, a cross-lingual Sinitic romanization design framework with supporting digital infrastructure and a community-driven open-source workflow. The design framework addresses the lack of systematic cross-lingual romanization alignment among Sinitic languages through four design principles: phonetic correspondence for representing similar sounds with similar romanized symbols, historical-phonological correspondence for aligning cognate romanization strings, one-phoneme-one-symbol, and basic Latin-letter use, with a balancing consideration recognizing trade-offs among these principles. For the main paired case study, we devel-op CantRomZJ1 and MandRomZJ1, Cantonese and Manda-rin romanization schemes following the design framework, respectively. We also develop schemes for several other Sinitic languages, including Meixian Hakka, Shanghai Wu, and Nanjing Jianghuai Mandarin, following the same de-sign framework. To bring the romanization schemes into practical use, we develop open-source infrastructure for structured romanization storage, conversion, parsing, dic-tionary construction, and input-method generation. Finally, we evaluate the design framework through speech-to-romanization experiments based on Meta's Massively Mul-tilingual Speech (MMS) fine-tuning. Compared with the Pinyin+Jyutping baseline, our Man-dRomZJ1+CantRomZJ1 condition reduces Cantonese WER and CER by 7.80% and 10.61%, respectively. These results suggest that cross-lingual romanization alignment can improve transfer in low-resource Sinitic speech technology.
summary_zh: 本文提出汉语族罗马化生态系统（Sinitic Romanization Ecosystem），这是一套面向汉语族语言的跨语言罗马化设计框架，配套有支撑性数字基础设施与社区驱动的开源工作流。该设计框架通过四项设计原则解决当前汉语族语言间缺乏系统性跨语言罗马化对齐的问题：语音对应原则（用相似的罗马化符号表征相似发音）、历史音系对应原则（对齐同源罗马化字符串）、一音位一符号原则、基础拉丁字母使用原则，同时兼顾权衡上述原则间的取舍关系。在核心配对案例研究中，我们基于该设计框架分别开发了粤语罗马化方案CantRomZJ1与普通话罗马化方案MandRomZJ1。我们还遵循同一设计框架为其他多种汉语族语言开发了罗马化方案，包括梅县客家话、上海吴语、南京江淮官话。为推动罗马化方案落地实用，我们开发了面向结构化罗马化存储、转换、解析、词典构建与输入法生成的开源基础设施。最后，我们基于Meta大规模多语言语音模型（Massively Multilingual Speech, MMS）的微调实验对该设计框架进行评估。与拼音+粤拼的基线方案相比，本文提出的MandRomZJ1+CantRomZJ1方案可分别将粤语的词错误率（WER）与字符错误率（CER）降低7.80%和10.61%。研究结果表明，跨语言罗马化对齐能够提升低资源汉语族语音技术的迁移学习效果。

title: Quantifying Error Tolerance in Synthetic Data: An Atomic-level Operand vs. Operator Perturbation Study
title_zh: 量化合成数据的容错性：原子级操作数与操作符扰动研究
authors: Jiaxiang Liu, Chenhao Yuan, Shuwen Xu, Boxuan Xing, Xiusheng Huang 等 (12 人)
abstract: Synthetic data generation has become a cornerstone for advancing large language models. However, the lack of the quantitative analysis for error tolerance became a critical bottleneck. Consequently, current filtering strategies fluctuate between two extremes: they are either overly aggressive, risking the exclusion of potentially valuable samples, or overly permissive, failing to eliminate erroneous samples effectively. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces Atomic Tree Operation Modeling (ATOM), a framework that decomposes data into functional units ($f(x)\rightarrow y$). ATOM distinguishes benign Operand $x$ perturbations from fatal Operator $f$ perturbations. The former are needlessly discarded by aggressive filtering, while the latter slip through permissive filtering. Our experiments reveal a double dissociation: models are robust to operand perturbations but collapse under operator perturbations. By prioritizing operator over aggressive operand precision, our ATOM-synthesized data outperforms rigorous baselines (e.g., +3.1% gain over LIMA), suggesting that operator diversity matters more than operand precision. Our code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 合成数据生成已成为大语言模型技术迭代的核心基础，但目前针对合成数据容错性的定量分析缺失已成为关键瓶颈。这导致当前的过滤策略往往在两个极端间摇摆：要么过滤过于激进，存在排除潜在高价值样本的风险；要么过滤过于宽松，无法有效剔除错误样本。为填补这一研究空白，本文提出原子树操作建模框架（Atomic Tree Operation Modeling, ATOM），该框架将数据分解为功能单元$f(x)ightarrow y$，可区分良性的操作数$x$扰动与致命的操作符$f$扰动：前者往往被激进过滤策略无意义地丢弃，而后者则会从宽松过滤策略中逃逸。实验发现了一种双分离效应：大语言模型对操作数扰动具备鲁棒性，但在操作符扰动下性能会大幅下降。通过优先保障操作符多样性而非追求操作数精度，经ATOM合成的数据效果优于多个严格基线（相比LIMA基线性能提升3.1%），证明操作符多样性比操作数精度更为重要。相关代码已公布在对应公开链接中。

title: AI Historian: Helping historians organize and verify person-centred temporal clues from dispersed historical narratives
title_zh: AI历史学家：辅助历史学家从分散历史叙事中整理与验证以人为核心的时间线索
authors: Yifeng Lu, Zijie Yang, Jie Li, Qingkai Min, Yue Zhang
abstract: History is not preserved in complete, continuous form. Accounts of a person's activities, relationships and historical contexts are scattered across texts, chapters and narrative perspectives; historians must retrieve, identify and compare these materials to reconstruct temporal sequences and verify them against sources. Here we present AI Historian (AIH), an AI agent system that helps historians organize person-time evidence from dispersed biographical narratives. It takes source sentences as evidence units, identifies people and temporal cues, verifies candidate cross-text associations and infers comparable temporal ranges while preserving traceable source-text evidence. We evaluated AIH on six Shiji cases concerning Liu Bang, Xiang Yu and Xiao He. AIH Agent achieved a temporal-localization MicroIoU of 86.2%, compared with 81.3% for human-only annotation and 17.1% for direct large-language-model prompting; it required about 14 min, versus 1 h 32 min for human-only annotation. We further applied AIH to the Twenty-Four Histories and other ancient Chinese histories, ancient Japanese and Korean histories, and modern and contemporary historical materials, and released the results through Westlake Historian. These results indicate that AIH can reduce the cost of organizing historical materials at scale while turning connections obscured by chapter-based narration into traceable, revisable research questions for collaborative testing.
summary_zh: 历史并非以完整、连续的形式留存下来。关于人物活动、社会关系与历史背景的记录散落在不同文本、章节与叙事视角中，历史学家需要检索、识别并比对这些材料，重建时间序列并对照史料完成验证。本文提出AI历史学家系统（AI Historian, AIH），这是一套AI智能体系统，可辅助历史学家从分散的传记类叙事中整理人-时关联证据。该系统以史料语句为证据单元，识别人物与时间线索，验证跨文本候选关联，推断可比对的时间范围，同时保留可追溯的源文本证据。我们针对《史记》中涉及刘邦、项羽、萧何的6个案例对AIH系统进行评估，结果显示AIH智能体的时间定位微交并比（MicroIoU）达86.2%，而纯人工标注的该指标为81.3%，直接调用大语言模型提示学习的该指标仅为17.1%；AIH完成任务仅需约14分钟，而纯人工标注需要1小时32分钟。我们进一步将AIH应用于二十四史等中国古代史书、日本与韩国古代史书以及现当代历史资料，通过西湖历史学家平台（Westlake Historian）开放了相关研究成果。结果表明，AIH能够降低规模化历史资料整理的成本，同时将被章节式叙事掩盖的关联转化为可追溯、可修订的研究问题，支持协作式历史研究验证。

title: Recognition-Refusal Misalignment in LLMs: Why Models Answer Structurally Unanswerable Questions
title_zh: 大语言模型中的识别-拒答错位问题：模型为何会回答结构上不可解的问题
authors: Yucheng Du, Xiyang Hu
abstract: Large language models often answer structurally unanswerable questions, such as computing cot(-540°) or evaluating (1).startswith("1"), instead of abstaining. We ask whether this failure reflects missing recognition or failed routing from recognition to abstention. Across instruction-tuned models from 1.7B to 70B parameters, a single linear direction in the hidden state separates answerable from structurally impossible math and code prompts, showing that models represent impossibility before generation. Yet this recognition direction is nearly orthogonal to the canonical safety-refusal direction that mediates trained harmful-content refusal. An in-domain behavior-defined invalidity-aware direction is closer to recognition, but only partially aligned with it, and remains near-orthogonal to safety refusal. Generation-time steering along the recognition direction changes invalidity-aware behavior bidirectionally and dose-responsively on structural math and code cells, while random directions do not. Base/instruct comparisons further show that the low-cosine geometry is already present at the pretraining endpoint. The confident-on-impossible failure is therefore better explained as a routing failure than as an encoding failure: the model has a usable "no admissible answer" signal, but the safety-refusal pathway is not aligned to use it.
summary_zh: 大语言模型经常会选择作答而非拒答诸如计算cot(-540°)、判断(1).startswith("1")这类结构上不可解的问题。本文探究该失效现象究竟源于模型未识别出问题不可解，还是识别到不可解后未成功路由到拒答流程。针对参数量从1.7B到70B的多个指令微调模型，我们发现在隐藏空间中存在一个单一的线性方向，可将可解的数学、代码提示与结构上不可解的提示区分开，说明模型在生成内容前已经表征出了问题的不可解性。但该识别方向与管控训练得到的有害内容拒答的标准安全拒答方向几乎正交。经域内行为定义的无效感知方向与识别方向距离更近，但仅能实现部分对齐，且仍与安全拒答方向接近正交。在生成阶段沿识别方向进行引导，可在结构类数学、代码样本上双向调整模型的无效感知行为，且效果符合剂量响应规律，而沿随机方向引导则无该效果。基础模型与指令微调模型的对比进一步表明，这种低余弦相似度的几何特征在预训练结束时就已经存在。因此，模型在不可解问题上盲目作答的失效现象更适合用路由失效而非编码失效解释：模型已经具备可用的"无合规答案"信号，但安全拒答通路未与该信号实现对齐。

title: A Comprehensive Survey on Linguistic Steganography: Methods, Countermeasures, Evaluation, and Challenges
title_zh: 语言隐写术综合综述：方法、对抗措施、评估与挑战
authors: Ruiyi Yan, Chenhui Chu, Zhongliang Yang, Yugo Murawaki
abstract: Linguistic steganography hides secret messages in natural language text. Large language models (LLMs) have reshaped the field, but a systematic account of how these scattered advances collectively reshape the field in this new era is still missing. We provide one along four axes: 148 steganographic methods, 60 linguistic steganalysis countermeasures, 23 evaluation metrics, and 9 open challenges, each with taxonomies, reviews, and adoption analyses. Cutting across these axes, we identify five specific paradigm shifts in the LLM era: (1) from covertext modification to prompt-only generation, (2) from heuristic to provable security, (3) from white-box symmetric LMs to black-box or asymmetric access, (4) from security-centric designs to joint optimization, and (5) from text-quality concerns to engineering issues. The survey aims to serve as both a reference and a roadmap for practical and responsible linguistic steganography in the LLM era.
summary_zh: 语言隐写术将秘密信息隐藏在自然语言文本中。大语言模型（LLM）重塑了该研究领域，但目前仍缺乏系统性梳理该领域分散进展、明确大语言模型时代领域发展路径的综述文献。本文从四个维度展开综述：覆盖148种隐写方法、60种语言隐写分析对抗方法、23项评估指标与9项开放挑战，对每个维度都提供分类体系、研究进展梳理与应用场景分析。基于上述维度的交叉分析，本文总结出大语言模型时代语言隐写术的五大范式转变：(1) 从修改载密文本转向仅通过提示生成载密文本；(2) 从启发式安全转向可证明安全；(3) 从白盒对称语言模型转向黑盒或非对称访问模式；(4) 从以安全为核心的设计转向多目标联合优化；(5) 从关注文本质量转向工程化落地问题。本综述可作为大语言模型时代实用化、合规化语言隐写术研究的参考资料与发展路线图。

title: RouteSparse: Input-Conditional Pattern Routing for Budgeted Long-Context Prefilling
title_zh: RouteSparse：面向预算受限长上下文预填充的输入条件模式路由方法
authors: Chao Zhang, Yifan Ji, Ziyan Zhang, Kai Song, Fei Lin
abstract: Dynamic sparse attention can reduce the quadratic cost of long-context prefilling without changing model weights. MInference assigns each attention head one pattern offline and estimates that pattern's sparse indices for every prompt. This design is efficient, but it assumes that a head's preferred pattern and sparsity budget remain suitable across inputs. We introduce RouteSparse, which routes each head and prompt segment among a small library of GPU-efficient sparse patterns. A low-cost probe estimates pattern utility and uncertainty; a latency-aware router then selects a pattern and budget, while uncertain cases fall back to a denser mask. We formulate routing as constrained risk minimization, derive an attention-output error certificate from omitted probability mass, and evaluate the method on long-context retrieval, question answering, summarization, and language modeling. On Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct with 128K-token prompts, RouteSparse achieves $6.5\times$ dense prefill speed with a 0.2-point RULER drop relative to dense attention, compared with $7.3\times$ speed and a 1.6-point drop for fixed per-head routing. Ablations confirm that input-conditional routing, hardware profiling, and selective dense fallback each contribute to the quality--latency tradeoff.
summary_zh: 动态稀疏注意力可在不修改模型权重的前提下降低长上下文预填充阶段的二次方计算开销。现有MInference方案为每个注意力头离线分配一个固定模式，为每个提示预估该模式的稀疏索引，该设计效率较高，但假设每个注意力头的偏好模式与稀疏度预算在所有输入下都适用。本文提出RouteSparse方法，可在一组GPU友好的稀疏模式库中为每个注意力头与提示段路由选择适配的模式。该方法通过轻量探测预估模式的效用与不确定性，再由时延感知路由器选择适配的模式与预算，对不确定的样本自动回退到更密集的掩码。本文将路由问题建模为约束风险最小化问题，基于遗漏概率质量推导注意力输出误差保证，并在长上下文检索、问答、摘要与语言建模任务上对方法进行评估。在搭载128K令牌提示的Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct模型上，RouteSparse的预填充速度达到稠密注意力的6.5倍，相比稠密注意力的RULER指标仅下降0.2分；作为对比，固定每头路由方案的速度为7.3倍，但RULER指标下降1.6分。消融实验证实，输入条件路由、硬件性能分析与选择性稠密回退三项机制均对模型的质量-时延权衡优化有贡献。

title: How Mental Health Self-Disclosure Becomes Visible: Evidence from Eight Conditions on Reddit
title_zh: 心理健康自我表露的可见性生成机制：来自Reddit平台八类场景的实证证据
authors: Renkai Ma, Lingyao Li, Shanting Chen, Chen Chen, Fan Yang 等 (6 人)
abstract: People share mental health diagnoses on social media, yet how such language becomes visible around their self-disclosure, and whether community engagement tracks it, remain unexamined across conditions. We analyze 89,605 Reddit posts from 739 users across eight conditions, removing each user's diagnosis disclosure and aligning their surrounding posts to that anchor. Within the pre-disclosure year, language-visible burden was highest in the month before disclosure for six conditions, earlier for post-traumatic stress disorder and furthest from it for borderline personality disorder, and remained visible afterward rather than resolving. The theme Seeking Clinical Explanations showed the largest early-to-late difference before disclosure in five conditions, yet engagement rarely tracked what users wrote: only 9 of 360 language--engagement correlations survived correction. Disclosure is therefore a waypoint in an unevenly visible process, and we offer implications for community practice and platform design where engagement metrics do not reflect clinical need.
summary_zh: 用户会在社交媒体上分享自身的心理健康诊断结果，但这类语言表达如何在自我表露行为周边形成可见性、社区互动行为是否与该可见性匹配，目前尚未在多类场景下得到验证。本文分析了Reddit平台739名用户发布的89605条帖子，覆盖8类心理健康场景，通过移除每个用户的诊断表露内容、将其周边帖子对齐到该表露锚点开展研究。结果显示，在表露前的一年时间窗口内，6类场景下的语言表征出的负担水平在表露前一个月达到峰值，创伤后应激障碍场景的负担峰值出现时间更早，边缘型人格障碍场景的负担峰值距离表露时间最远，且表露后负担水平仍保持可见，并未消解。在表露前的阶段，"寻求临床解释"主题在5类场景下的早期-晚期差异最大，但社区互动几乎与用户发布的内容特征无关：360组语言-互动相关性中仅9组通过多重检验校正。因此，自我表露只是一个可见性分布不均的过程中的中间节点，本文研究结论可为社区运营实践与平台设计提供参考，避免仅用互动指标衡量用户临床需求的偏差。

title: Detecting and Guiding LLM-Generated Korean Poetry with Interpretable Form-level Features
title_zh: RENSA：基于丰富环境元数据的共享分布式端点导航方法，用于自动化联邦SPARQL查询生成
authors: Keunhyeung Park, Seunguk Yu, YoungBin Kim
abstract: LLMs often struggle with modern Korean poetry, producing outputs that resemble "line-broken prose." We address two coupled tasks: detecting whether a Korean poem is human- or LLM-authored, and guiding LLMs to generate poetry closer in form to human writing. We quantify the human-LLM gap along four form-level linguistic dimensions: output length (Volume), the diversity and connective use of line-final forms (Structure Variation), the irregularity of line lengths (Rhythmic Irregularity), and adherence to standard orthography (Normative Adherence). We operationalize these dimensions as five interpretable features. For detection, a logistic regression classifier over these five features attains an average AUC-ROC of 83.60 in zero-shot out-of-distribution detection across seven unseen LLMs, versus 75.84 for the strongest baseline in our comparison, KatFishNet, an absolute gain of 7.76 AUC points and a 10.23% relative improvement; one generator-specific punctuation pattern outside our taxonomy remains a boundary case. For generation, expert evaluation on GPT-5.2 prefers feature-guided poems over the unconstrained baseline, and analyses across GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3 show that targeted length, rhythm, and ending statistics move toward the human distribution. These results suggest that interpretable, language-specific features can bridge the diagnosis and guidance of LLM-generated poetry.
summary_zh: 随着知识图谱技术的普及，知识图谱数据库的数量大幅增长。知识图谱可通过联邦SPARQL查询实现分布式数据的动态集成，但由于跨去中心化数据集的详细结构知识缺失，在联邦环境下构建高效查询存在很大挑战。尽管VoID等标准提供了基础元数据，但这类标准无法捕获查询优化所需的复杂互联关系与权威分布信息，导致现有引擎往往依赖运行时ASK查询完成源选择，大幅提升了通信开销。本文提出RENSA框架，这是一套联邦SPARQL查询生成框架，可利用SPARQL构建元数据（SBM）的扩展机制，通过集成类别与权威信息，将主语、宾语的使用映射到特定谓词，在无需运行时通信的前提下实现精准源选择与查询变量的语义约束推断。在多数场景下，生成的配置文件体积不足原始数据集三元组的1%，存储效率优异。在LargeRDFBench基准（包含13个数据集、超10亿个三元组、32个查询）上的评估结果显示，RENSA的源选择效果与当前最优方法相当，同时完全消除了ASK查询开销。此外，RENSA可推断查询变量的类别与权威约束，即使在异构端点间也能完成数据源识别。生成的配置文件还可提供人类可读的结构洞察，支撑半自动化查询生成。

title: RENSA: Rich Environment Metadata to Navigate Shared and Distributed Endpoints for Automated Federated SPARQL Query Generation
authors: Victor Eiti Yamamoto, Takeda Hideaki, Yamamoto Yasunori
abstract: The number of knowledge graph databases has increased significantly with the proliferation of knowledge graph technologies. Knowledge graphs enable the dynamic integration of distributed data through federated SPARQL queries. However, constructing efficient queries in a federated environment is challenging due to the lack of detailed structural knowledge across decentralized datasets. While standards like VoID provide basic metadata, they often fail to capture the complex interlinks and authority distributions necessary for optimization. Consequently, current engines frequently rely on runtime ASK queries for source selection, increasing communication overhead. We propose RENSA, a federated SPARQL query generation framework that leverages an extension of SPARQL Builder Metadata (SBM). By integrating class and authority information, mapping subject and object usage to specific predicates, RENSA enables precise source selection and semantic constraint inference for query variables without runtime communication. The generated profiles represent less than 1\% of the original dataset triples in most cases, ensuring storage efficiency. Evaluation on the LargeRDFBench benchmark (13 datasets with >1B triples, 32 queries) shows that RENSA achieves source selection results comparable to state-of-the-art methods while eliminating ASK query overhead. Furthermore, we demonstrate that RENSA infers class and authority constraints for query variables, enabling the identification of data sources even across heterogeneous endpoints. These profiles additionally offer human-readable structural insights for semi-automated query generation.

title: VocalAffectBench: Evaluating Vocal Emotion Recognition in AI Audio Models
title_zh: VocalAffectBench：面向AI音频模型的语音情感识别评测基准
authors: Models Luc Debaupte, Tyler Baumgartner, Brandon Tai, Candice Fan, Bill Wang 等 (6 人)
abstract: Voice products increasingly need affective cues that are present in speech but absent from transcripts. We introduce VocalAffectBench, a public, test-only benchmark for evaluating whether AI audio models can identify expressed vocal emotion from raw audio. The benchmark contains 273 human-recorded English WAV clips from 51 speaker accounts totaling 1.95 hours across seven labels: angry, disgusted, fearful, happy, neutral, sad, and surprised, with 39 clips per class. All baselines are evaluated from audio alone, without transcripts or contextual metadata. Across six released baselines, average accuracy is 35.5%. The strongest baseline, gemini_3_5_flash, reaches 46.5% on the seven-way task, above the 14.3% random baseline but far from robust emotion recognition. A secondary valence-bucket analysis maps labels into positive, neutral, and negative classes, excluding surprised because its valence is ambiguous. Aggregate accuracy under this coarser view is 50.9%. Performance is highly uneven across classes. By recall, neutral is identified most reliably at 75.6% averaged across baselines, while surprised and fearful reach only 10.7% and 15.4%, respectively. These results show that the evaluated baselines can extract some affective signal from speech, but discrete expressed-emotion recognition remains fragile, especially for non-neutral emotions that are often most important in voice agent workflows.
summary_zh: 语音类产品越来越需要利用语音中存在但文本转录中缺失的情感线索。本文发布VocalAffectBench，这是一个公开的仅用于测试的基准数据集，用于评估AI音频模型能否从原始音频中识别出语音表达的情感。该基准包含来自51名说话人的273段人工录制英语WAV音频，总时长1.95小时，覆盖愤怒、厌恶、恐惧、开心、中性、悲伤、惊讶7类情感标签，每类标签对应39段音频。所有基线模型都仅基于音频输入完成评估，不提供文本转录或上下文元数据。在6个公开基线模型上的测试结果显示，平均准确率仅为35.5%。性能最优的基线模型gemini_3_5_flash在7分类任务上的准确率为46.5%，虽高于14.3%的随机基线，但距离鲁棒的情感识别仍有很大差距。后续开展的效价桶分析将标签映射为积极、中性、消极三类（排除效价模糊的惊讶类），该粗粒度分类下的总体准确率为50.9%。模型性能在不同类别间分布极不均衡：从召回率指标看，所有基线识别中性情感的平均准确率最高，达75.6%，而惊讶类与恐惧类的召回率仅为10.7%与15.4%。上述结果表明，参评基线模型可从语音中提取部分情感信号，但离散表达情感识别的性能仍十分薄弱，尤其是在语音智能体工作流中往往最为关键的非中性情感识别效果仍有待提升。

title: Causal Interventions Reveal Typologically Organized Syntactic Mechanisms in Multilingual Language Models
title_zh: 因果干预揭示多语言语言模型中按类型学组织的句法机制
authors: Sasha Boguraev, Toshiki Nakai, Kyle Mahowald, Julius Steuer
abstract: Linguistic theory has long recognized cross-linguistic syntactic regularities, leading to claims that these similar structures are processed by similar mechanisms. However, this hypothesis has been difficult to test empirically due to our lack of fine-grained, manipulable access of human processing mechanisms. In this work, we take advantage of techniques from mechanistic interpretability to study such a question in multilingual LMs. We first isolate language-internal mechanisms before attempting to transfer them cross-lingually. Across four models and three well-studied constructions (subject--verb number agreement, anaphoric pronoun gender agreement, and filler--gap object extraction) we find consistent cross-lingual mechanism transfer. We further find transfer to be graded, with more transfer between more typologically similar languages. We believe our work provides novel hypotheses about cross-linguistic syntactic structures and multilingual processing, and more broadly shows how the study of language models can help inform linguistic theory.
summary_zh: 语言学理论长期以来一直认可跨语言的句法规律性，提出这类相似结构由相似机制处理的论断。然而由于我们无法对人类语言处理机制进行细粒度、可操作的访问，这一假设长期以来难以通过实证检验。本研究利用机制可解释性领域的技术，在多语言语言模型中探究该问题。我们首先分离出语言内部机制，再尝试实现其跨语言迁移。在4个模型、3种被广泛研究的句法结构（主谓数一致、回指代词性数一致、填充语-空位宾语提取）上，我们观测到稳定的跨语言机制迁移现象。进一步研究发现该迁移具有梯度性，类型学上更相似的语言之间迁移程度更高。本研究为跨语言句法结构与多语言处理提供了全新的研究假设，更广泛地展示了语言模型研究如何为语言学理论的发展提供支撑。

title: VoiceCodeBench: Evaluating Exact Structured-Token Recovery in Automatic Speech Recognition
title_zh: VoiceCodeBench（语音代码基准）：评估自动语音识别中的精确结构化令牌恢复能力
authors: Tyler Baumgartner, Brandon Tai, Lisa Kaelin-Martin, Candice Fan, Luc Debaupte 等 (7 人)
abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems are commonly evaluated with word error rate (WER), yet many voice workflows depend on exact written values for identifiers, paths, and measured quantities. A transcript can appear fluent and achieve low WER while corrupting a value that a downstream system must parse, store, or execute.We introduce VoiceCodeBench, a benchmark for evaluating exact structured-token recovery in English ASR. It contains 300 human-recorded workplace segments spanning eight workflow domains and 1,482 audited target entities across 26 entity types, each with a canonical written form recoverable from the audio. Under a raw-audio-only protocol, systems receive audio bytes without additional context or metadata. Alongside WER, we evaluate Canonical Token/Entity Match (CTEM), Task Success Rate (TSR), and per-type exact recovery.Across 12 baseline ASR systems, lower WER generally corresponded to better structured-token recovery but did not fully determine it: Spearman correlations were -0.73 for both WER versus CTEM and WER versus TSR. The strongest baseline by TSR reached only 68.7%, leaving nearly one third of recordings with at least one unrecovered workflow-critical value. These results show that entity-sensitive metrics are needed to assess whether ASR output preserves exact values that production systems must parse, route, store, compare, or execute.
summary_zh: 自动语音识别（ASR）系统通常采用词错误率（WER）作为评估指标，但许多语音工作流依赖标识符、路径、测量值等内容的精确书面形式。即便转录结果流畅、WER值较低，下游系统需要解析、存储或执行的关键数值也可能已被损坏。本文提出VoiceCodeBench，即用于评估英语ASR系统精确结构化令牌恢复能力的基准数据集，包含300段人工录制的职场语音片段，覆盖8个工作流领域，共1482个经过审核的目标实体，分属26种实体类型，每个实体都有可从音频中还原的规范书面形式。在仅使用原始音频的评估协议下，系统仅接收音频字节，无额外上下文或元数据。除WER外，我们还采用规范令牌/实体匹配率（CTEM）、任务成功率（TSR）以及单类型精确恢复率作为评估指标。在12个基线ASR系统上的实验结果显示，更低的WER通常对应更优的结构化令牌恢复能力，但WER无法完全决定该性能：WER与CTEM、WER与TSR的斯皮尔曼相关系数均为-0.73。TSR表现最优的基线系统仅达到68.7%的得分，近三分之一的录音中至少存在1个无法恢复的工作流关键数值。上述结果表明，需要采用对实体敏感的指标来评估ASR输出是否保留了生产系统必须解析、路由、存储、比对或执行的精确数值。

title: Latent-Space Intervention for Cross-Lingual Factual Consistency: Consistency Improvements without Accuracy Drops
title_zh: 面向跨语言事实一致性的隐空间干预：在不损失准确率的前提下提升一致性
authors: Faeze Ghorbanpour, Constanza Fierro, Alexander Fraser, Anders Sogaard
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often answer the same factual question differently across languages. We study whether cross-lingual latent-space intervention can reduce this inconsistency. We train layer-specific autoencoders on parallel multilingual representations and apply inference-time corrections to factual QA prompts. We find that latent intervention improves geometric alignment between languages, and that this improvement translates into consistent gains in cross-lingual consistency with English across both open-ended and multiple-choice QA formats, without degrading factual accuracy. In open-ended QA, Spearman's rank correlation between English and non-English languages improves substantially, with gains of 0.16 for English-Arabic and 0.20 for English-Russian pairs. In multiple-choice QA, answer agreement with English improves consistently across both KLAR and mParaRel. Ablations show that AE reconstruction yields consistent gains at no accuracy cost, while PCA projection contributes marginally, and mean-shift produces substantially larger consistency gains in open-ended QA at the cost of some accuracy.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）针对同一事实性问题的回答往往因语言不同存在差异。本研究探究跨语言隐空间干预是否能够降低这类不一致性。我们在平行多语言表征上训练层特定自编码器（autoencoder, AE），并在推理阶段对事实性问答提示施加校正。研究发现，隐空间干预能够提升不同语言之间的几何对齐程度，该提升可转化为开放式问答与多项选择问答场景下与英语对齐的跨语言一致性的持续提升，且不会降低事实准确率。在开放式问答中，英语与非英语语言之间的斯皮尔曼等级相关系数显著提升，英-阿配对提升0.16，英-俄配对提升0.20。在多项选择问答中，KLAR与mParaRel两个数据集上与英语的答案一致性均得到持续提升。消融实验结果表明，自编码器重构可在不损失准确率的前提下稳定提升一致性，PCA投影的贡献较为有限，而均值偏移方法可在开放式问答中实现大幅一致性提升，但会损失部分准确率。

title: Evaluating Multilingual Sentence Embeddings for Translation Error Detection:An English--Greek Contrastive Study
title_zh: 面向翻译错误检测的多语言句向量评估：英希对比研究
authors: Eleftherios Kalogeros, Athanasios Ntalakas, Manolis Gergatsoulis, Paschalis Nikolaou, Sotiria-Lito Alexaki
abstract: Multilingual sentence embeddings are increasingly used to estimate semantic similarity across languages, yet their sensitivity to fine-grained translation errors remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates whether general-purpose multilingual embedding models can distinguish correct English-Greek translations from minimally modified erroneous alternatives. A contrastive dataset was developed from FLORES+ sentence-aligned reference translations and reviewed by two translation experts. It contains 1,850 examples across ten core and five exploratory error categories, covering factual, lexical-semantic, grammatical, relational, referential, and discourse-level phenomena.Five multilingual sentence-embedding models (BGE-M3, Multilingual E5, Multilingual MPNet, LaBSE, and Jina Embeddings v3) were evaluated using cosine similarity between each English source sentence and its correct and erroneous Greek translations. A reference-free COMETKiwi model was also evaluated as an MT quality-estimation baseline. Performance was assessed through contrastive accuracy and score margins for category-specific sensitivity. BGE-M3 achieved the highest accuracy among embedding models at 89.30 percent, while COMETKiwi achieved 94.49 percent. Embedding models detected explicit factual and lexical changes more reliably than tense-and-aspect and pronoun-coreference errors. COMETKiwi improved performance on several difficult categories, including tense and aspect, pronoun and coreference, and semantic-role errors, but showed lower sensitivity to date-and-time errors and underperformed the embedding models on numbers. The results show complementary error-sensitivity profiles: multilingual sentence embeddings provide useful semantic adequacy signals but are better suited as components of broader translation-evaluation frameworks than as standalone metrics.
summary_zh: 多语言句向量目前已被广泛用于估算跨语言语义相似度，但该类模型对细粒度翻译错误的敏感度仍未得到充分研究。本研究探究通用多语言嵌入模型能否区分正确的英-希翻译与经过最小修改的错误翻译版本。研究基于FLORES+句对齐参考翻译构建了对比数据集，由两名翻译专家审核，包含1850个样本，覆盖10个核心错误类别与5个探索性错误类别，涉及事实层面、词汇语义层面、语法层面、关系层面、指称层面与语篇层面的各类语言现象。本研究共评估5个多语言句向量模型（BGE-M3、Multilingual E5、Multilingual MPNet、LaBSE、Jina Embeddings v3），评估方式为计算英语源句与其对应的正确、错误希腊语翻译之间的余弦相似度，同时将无参考的COMETKiwi模型作为机器翻译质量评估基线。研究通过对比准确率与类别特定敏感度的得分裕度来评估模型性能。嵌入模型中BGE-M3的准确率最高，达到89.30%，而COMETKiwi的准确率为94.49%。嵌入模型对显式事实与词汇变化的检测可靠性高于时态体、代词共指类错误。COMETKiwi在时态体、代词共指、语义角色等多个困难类别上的性能更优，但对日期时间类错误的敏感度更低，在数字类错误上的表现不及嵌入模型。研究结果显示两类模型的错误敏感度特征具有互补性：多语言句向量可提供有效的语义充分性信号，更适合作为广义翻译评估框架的组件，而非独立评估指标。

title: Distributional Validity and Calibration of a Korean Synthetic Persona Panel for Digital and AI Service Use: A Secondary-Data Validation Against the Korea Media Panel Survey
title_zh: 面向数字与AI服务使用场景的韩国合成角色面板的分布效度与校准：基于韩国媒体面板调查的二次数据验证
authors: Howard Kim, Keun Tae Cho
abstract: Synthetic personas based on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as substitutes for human survey respondents, yet systematic validation outside English-speaking contexts remains scarce. This secondary-data study evaluates how well a Korean synthetic persona panel (NVIDIA Nemotron-Personas-Korea), conditioned into Gemini 3.5 Flash (primary) and EXAONE (comparison), reproduces digital and AI service-use distributions from the KISDI Korea Media Panel Survey. Sex-and-age-stratified panels of about 8,000 personas per model answered the survey's own items - eight service-use indicators and eight innovativeness and acceptance constructs - and were compared against weighted survey estimates. The overall mean absolute error (MAE; RQ1) was 15-19 percentage points (pp), with binary item-mean correlations of 0.69-0.90. Segment error (RQ2) across five demographic axes was 15-19 pp, with between-group gaps up to 52.4/36.2 pp (Gemini/EXAONE). Errors followed model-specific signatures: an age stereotype with low anchoring (Gemini) versus an acquiescence-consistent level bias (EXAONE). Reference-year analysis was consistent with temporal misalignment driving most generative-AI overestimation, whereas short-form underestimation was framing-sensitive. Holdout calibration on 30% of the real data (RQ3) roughly halved sex-by-age cell MAE (18.9->8.6, 15.9->6.7 pp) - yet direct estimation from the same real subsample was far more accurate (3.6 pp), and the correction did not transfer across time. The calibrated panel retained an advantage only under extremely scarce real data (about 100 responses) and, for one model, for unobserved segments. Persona-narrative conditioning beat demographic-only conditioning, but neither surpassed simple real-data baselines. Synthetic panels are thus not survey substitutes; their value is diagnostic, with operational use confined to settings lacking real data.
summary_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的合成角色正逐渐被提出作为人类调查受访者的替代方案，但在英语语境之外的系统性验证仍十分匮乏。本二次数据研究评估了韩国合成角色面板（NVIDIA Nemotron-Personas-Korea）在接入Gemini 3.5 Flash（主模型）与EXAONE（对比模型）的条件下，复现韩国信息通信振兴院（KISDI）韩国媒体面板调查中数字与AI服务使用分布的能力。两个模型分别生成约8000个按性别年龄分层的角色面板，回答调查中的全部题项：共8项服务使用指标、8项创新性与接受度构念，结果与加权调查估计值进行比对。整体平均绝对误差（MAE，对应研究问题1）为15-19个百分点，二元题项均值相关系数为0.69-0.90。跨5个人口统计维度的细分群体误差（对应研究问题2）为15-19个百分点，组间最大差距分别达52.4/36.2个百分点（Gemini/EXAONE）。误差呈现出模型特异性特征：Gemini存在低锚定的年龄刻板印象，EXAONE则存在与默许偏差一致的水平偏差。参考年份分析结果显示，时间错位是生成式AI高估现象的主要诱因，而短视频使用的低估则对提示框架敏感。在30%真实数据上的留出校准（对应研究问题3）可将性别-年龄单元格的平均绝对误差大致减半（Gemini从18.9降至8.6个百分点，EXAONE从15.9降至6.7个百分点），但直接从相同真实子样本得到的估计结果准确率高得多（仅3.6个百分点），且该校正无法跨时间迁移。校准后的面板仅在真实数据极度稀缺（约100份回复）的场景下具备优势，其中一个模型还在未观测细分群体场景下具备优势。基于角色叙事的条件生成效果优于仅基于人口统计属性的条件生成，但二者均未超过简单的真实数据基线。因此合成面板无法替代真实调查，其价值体现在诊断层面，实际应用场景仅限于缺乏真实数据的环境。
